\"シンプルながらコク深い味わいの醤油ラーメン。飲んだあとに沁みる一杯でした。\.en: 'A shoyu ramen, simple yet rich and deep in flavour. A bowl that soaks in after drinking.' — June 2026, shoyu ramen.

\"小麦粉だけではなく添加物は極力使わず\"; 油は米油、砂糖はきび砂糖、国産米.en: 'using as few additives as possible, not just no wheat flour'; the oil is rice oil, the sugar is cane sugar, 100% domestic rice flour.

\"添加物は極力使わない、安心安全な米粉スイーツ\"..en: 'safe, secure rice-flour sweets using as few additives as possible'.

\"白砂糖・添加物を使用しないチョコレート\" and \"グルテンフリーやオー.en: 'chocolate using no white sugar or additives' and 'particular about ingredients such as gluten-free and organic cacao'; sells rice-flour cakes.

/sweets-factory: 「スイーツは植物性食材のみ使用、米粉やナッツパ.en: /sweets-factory: 'The sweets use only plant ingredients and are made gluten-free, using rice flour, nut powders and so on instead of wheat flour.' Home page: 'For children with egg, milk or wheat allergies. We want you to gather round a cake with friends and family.'

1,980円〜。つけダレを要確認。.en: From ¥1,980. Ask about the dipping sauce.

100%プラントベース＆グルテンフリー、無添加・化学調味料不使用で、ヴィーガンも.en: 100% plant-based and gluten-free, additive-free and MSG-free, so vegan and gluten-free travellers can choose anything on the menu with confidence.

12品。天婦羅8種、〆はかき揚げ手打ちそば。ランチ限定。.en: 12 dishes. 8 kinds of tempura, finishing with kakiage and hand-made soba. Lunch only.

140円〜。つゆは鰹・昆布だしに醤油＝小麦。ちくわ・さつま揚げ等の練り物にも小麦.en: From ¥140. The broth is bonito-kombu dashi with soy sauce = wheat. Fish-paste items such as chikuwa and satsuma-age usually contain wheat too.

14品。活き穴子の天婦羅と名物トリュフそば。ランチ限定。天婦羅の衣＝小麦、そばも.en: 14 dishes. Live anago tempura and the signature truffle soba. Lunch only. Tempura batter = wheat, the soba also has a wheat binder, and the hitsumabushi sauce = soy sauce. Lunch 11:30–14:30.

1934年（昭和9年）創業の老舗喫茶。芝居の世界に憧れた初代・原田邦雄が、東京の.en: An old coffee shop founded in 1934 (Showa 9). The first owner, who longed for the world of theatre, is said to have named it after the Tokyo avant-garde company 'Tsukiji Shogekijo'. The first owner, who had never studied architecture, created the space by conveying ideas to craftsmen by instinct: plaster walls, colourful irregular tiles, carving on pillars and skirting boards, oil paintings and wood-carved reliefs, decorative plates, clocks and other heavy furnishings, giving the air of having wandered into an old European castle. The 2nd floor was originally living quarters, but was converted into part of the shop around 1951–52. Handed down over three generations since its founding, it is now kept by the third generation. One of the oldest surviving coffee shops in the city, going back to the 1930s when Kyoto's coffee culture began.

1946年（昭和21年）、終戦直後の姫路に創業した町中華食堂。 食糧難の時代、調.en: A neighbourhood Chinese diner founded in 1946 (Showa 21) in Himeji just after the war. In a time of food shortage, using scraps such as pork fat and cabbage cores for staff meals is said to be the origin of its shumai, which was later improved for customers and became the signature dish. For over 70 years, with Showa-era interiors and tableware almost unchanged, it has been loved by generations of Himeji people. It is now in Nishi-Nikaimachi.

1968年兵庫県生まれ。高校・大学時代から飲食業に携わり、ホテル勤務ではプロ野球.en: Born in Hyogo in 1968. Worked in food service from high school and university; at a hotel, cooked meals for professional baseball players. Went independent from a conviction that "food made in advance can't move people", and believes in live cooking in front of guests. Omotenashi Kikou was listed in a 2016 Hyogo restaurant guide. Now also chairs the Hyogo Prefecture Specialty Products Promotion Association.

1970年創業、鳥羽駅から約300m・約58席の昭和レトロな喫茶＆洋食店。ボリュ.en: Founded in 1970, a Shōwa-retro coffee shop and Western-style diner of about 58 seats, about 300 m from Toba Station. Famous for the hearty 'bomb set meal' and a huge plate of chicken (about 16 pieces) hiding spaghetti underneath. The coffee is made by a master who has won the national Coffee Masters championship, and from the window you can see trains and the Shimakaze.

1970年愛知県生まれ。 祖母の手作り弁当をきっかけに料理の道へ。 愛知万博フラ.en: Born in Aichi Prefecture in 1970. A grandmother's home-made bento led to cooking. After experiencing a three-star-level kitchen at the French Pavilion restaurant at Expo 2005 Aichi, went to France to train. Back in Japan, worked at Celeste, Hakuunkan and elsewhere before going independent in September 2013.

1977年大阪生まれ。 祖母が料理店を営んでいたことに影響を受け料理の道へ。 調.en: Born in Osaka in 1977. Turned to cooking under the influence of a grandmother who ran a restaurant. After culinary school, trained in Japanese and French cooking at hotels and restaurants in Nagoya, and went independent in Nagono in 2008.

1979年に調理師免許を取得、1980年に広島女学院大学文学部を卒業。結婚後は家.en: Obtained a cook's licence in 1979 and graduated from Hiroshima Jogakuin University, Faculty of Letters, in 1980. Devoted to the home after marrying, but a husband's illness led to opening the soup-and-obanzai shop 'Kitchen Potluck' in 2000. Moved to Fukuromachi, Naka-ku in 2010 and opened the natural-food shop 'AGRI' (now in Nakamachi). Serves as a director of Slow Food Hiroshima and, as a member of Hiroshima City's rice-flour promotion committee, works to spread rice flour, and is active in many fields, including cooking segments on TV and radio and lecturing at alma mater Hiroshima Jogakuin University since 2013.

1995年北海道生まれ。調理師専門学校を経て、南青山の「Lus」、代官山のミシュ.en: Born in Hokkaido in 1995. After culinary school, trained at Lus in Minami-Aoyama and at the one-Michelin-star Abyss in Daikanyama, then joined three-star Quintessence in 2020. In 2024, trained at the two-star Restaurant Blanc in Paris. Back in Japan in 2025, became chef of Brillance. Age 30. The pâtissier is a Brillance colleague from the same intake (born in Kumamoto in 1993, from Quintessence, trained at Jacques Genin and Masai Kuta in Paris).

1オーダー100ml。清澄剤の使用は要確認。.en: 100 ml per order. Ask about fining agents.

2008年開業。那古野の古い町家を改装した隠れ家的な2フロア構造。.en: Opened in 2008. A hideaway on two floors in a renovated old Nagono townhouse.

2010年創業。名古屋市東区主税町のオフィス街に立つタンメン専門店。店主の森下幸.en: Founded in 2010. A tanmen specialist in the office district of Chikara-machi, Higashi-ku, Nagoya. As owner Yukio Morishita says in an Instagram profile, "pursuing a one-of-a-kind, superb tanmen every day," it is a neighbourhood Chinese place focused solely on vegetable-laden tanmen.

2014年ごろ大型施設への卸販売を中止して店内に空きスペースが生じ、米粉との出会.en: Around 2014 it stopped wholesale to large facilities, leaving empty space in the shop; an encounter with rice flour and the question 'What can only a rice shop do?' led to opening 'Rice-shop Café Fe~ru' in 2017.

2015年4月13日開業。オーナーは福井県にゆかりがあり（屋号「越廼屋」は福井の.en: Opened on 13 April 2015. The owner has ties to Fukui Prefecture (the name Koshinoya comes from Koshino in Fukui) and opened the shop to bring Fukui regional food to Nagoya's business district. A small lunch-only shop on the 1st floor of a building right by exit 4 of Marunouchi subway station (15 seconds on foot).

2016年に『ミシュランガイド富山・石川（金沢）2016 特別版』で一つ星を獲得.en: In 2016 it won one star in the 'Michelin Guide Toyama · Ishikawa (Kanazawa) 2016 Special Edition'.

2017/07の店内板。小麦粉の生地＋おたふく系ソース（小麦）。鉄板も共用。.en: 2017/07 in-shop board. Wheat-flour batter + Otafuku-style sauce (wheat). Shared griddle too.

2017/07の店内短冊。パン粉＝小麦、共用フライヤー。2026/02の口コミも.en: 2017/07 in-shop paper tag. Breadcrumbs = wheat, shared fryer. A 2026/02 review also confirms ordering 'gansu'.

2017/07の店内短冊。ポン酢・煮汁に醤油（小麦）。.en: 2017/07 in-shop paper tag. Soy sauce (wheat) in the ponzu and simmering liquid.

2017/07の板。キムチ・タレに醤油／魚介。価格は読み取り不確実。.en: 2017/07 board. Soy sauce / seafood in the kimchi and sauce. Price reading uncertain.

2017/07の板。ソース次第。鉄板は小麦生地と共用。価格は読み取り不確実。.en: 2017/07 board. Depends on the sauce. Griddle shared with the wheat batter. Price reading uncertain.

2017/07の板。バター＝乳、醤油の有無を要確認。価格は読み取り不確実。.en: 2017/07 board. Butter = dairy; ask whether soy sauce is used. Price reading uncertain.

2017/07の板。米自体は問題ないが味付けの醤油／ソースに小麦の可能性が高い。.en: 2017/07 board. The rice itself is fine, but the seasoning's soy sauce / sauce very likely contains wheat. Ask.

2017/07の板。醤油の有無を要確認。価格は読み取り不確実。.en: 2017/07 board. Ask whether soy sauce is used. Price reading uncertain.

2017年3月1日、姫路のおみぞ筋商店街に開店（カフェ・ケーキ店「テンヤ」跡地を.en: Opened on 1 March 2017 in Himeji's Omizo-suji shopping arcade (renovating the former café and cake shop "Tenya"). The owner began training in soba at 18, including at a soba shop in Izushi, and went independent after about 20 years. It opened with the wish to "be a local shop loved by office workers and families alike".

2017年に訪れた東京餃子通信の記者は、綺麗な焼き色の餃子を「見た目と異なり上品.en: A Tokyo Gyoza Tsushin reporter who visited in 2017 described the nicely browned gyoza as having "a refined flavour, unlike their look", rather than a punchy garlic taste.

2019年「愛知サラダメシ総選挙」でブロンズ賞を受賞。地元・無農薬野菜を活かした.en: Won the Bronze Award in the 2019 'Aichi Salad Meal General Election', recognised for colourful salads making use of local pesticide-free vegetables.

2019年「愛知サラダメシ総選挙」ブロンズ賞受賞。野菜料理へのこだわりが第三者機.en: Bronze Award in the 2019 'Aichi Salad Meal General Election'. Its commitment to vegetable dishes has been recognised by a third party.

2020年11月、名古屋・那古野の四間道エリアに開業。 築約90年の古民家を改装.en: Opened in November 2020 in the Shikemichi area of Nagono, Nagoya. A renovated old house about 90 years old, where diners can look out on a Japanese garden said to be about 320 years old. It shares the site with the Japanese restaurant Kaiin. Run by Matsuri Group, which also has Sakae and Ikeshita branches (the Ikeshita branch opened in July 2021 inside Ikeshita Central Garden).

2020年11月のオープン記念イベントでは子どもたちが親のためにそうめん料理を作.en: At the November 2020 opening event, a "kids' restaurant" had children cook somen dishes for the parents, while the adults were invited on a Himeji Castle tour: a community-building event.

2020年5月1日、姫路城の麓・本町68の家老屋敷B棟（かつての武家屋敷エリア）.en: A small restaurant opened on 1 May 2020 in building B of the chief-retainer residences at Honmachi 68, at the foot of Himeji Castle (a former samurai-residence area). Among the historic buildings below the castle, it serves as a lunch stop for tourists and locals between castle visits.

2021年10月16日オープン。店主は梶木美夕紀さん。.en: Opened 16 October 2021. The owner is Kajiki Miyuki.

2022年6月の地元メディア報道では、オープン前の店舗にカレーやナン、タンドリー.en: In June 2022 local media reported a "grand opening soon" notice on the shop front showing curry, naan and tandoori chicken, building up local anticipation.

2022年9月28日、愛知県体育館1階にオープンした週末営業のカジュアルカフェ。.en: A weekend casual café opened on 28 September 2022 on the 1st floor of the Aichi Prefectural Gymnasium. Using its location in a public facility in the Nagoya Castle area, its main customers are tourists and local families.

2022年の口コミで880円（2017年の店内板は800円）。小麦粉の生地＋おた.en: ¥880 in a 2022 review (¥800 on the 2017 in-shop board). Wheat-flour batter + Otafuku-style sauce (wheat). Shared griddle too.

2023/01の店内板に200円で掲載。具と味付け海苔に醤油が入ることが多い。現.en: Listed at ¥200 on the in-shop board in 2023/01. The filling and seasoned nori often contain soy sauce. Not seen on the current wall cards, so ask whether it is still available.

2023年に京都女性起業家賞・優秀賞、京都商工会議所主催の知恵-1グランプリ チ.en: In 2023 it won an Excellence Award at the Kyoto Women Entrepreneurs Awards and the Grand Prix in the challenge category of the Chie-1 Grand Prix organised by the Kyoto Chamber of Commerce.

2024-12のメニューカードより。味付けを要確認。小麦生地と同じ鉄板。.en: From the 2024-12 menu card. Ask about the seasoning. Same griddle as the wheat batter.

2024年6月15日オープン。船場川沿いの古民家を改装した空間で、大きな窓と庭を.en: Opened 15 June 2024. In a renovated old house beside the Senba River; the counter seats overlook a large window and garden with a view of Himeji Castle's keep. Popular from the start as a lunch with a view of the castle.

2024年7月、創業100年を超える姫路の酒蔵「龍力（本田商店）」とコラボし、イ.en: In July 2024, opened a rooftop restaurant on the 4th floor of Egret Himeji in collaboration with Tatsuriki (Honda Shoten), a Himeji brewery over 100 years old, serving special Tatsuriki sake not available elsewhere.

2024年の口コミ写真で夏に提供を確認。カード未掲載のため価格・シロップの内容は.en: A 2024 review photo confirms it was served in summer. Not on the card, so price and syrup contents unconfirmed.

2025-04の店内黒板より。殻付き焼き牡蠣。添えのポン酢に注意。.en: From the in-shop blackboard, 2025-04. Grilled oysters in the shell. Watch the ponzu served with them.

2025-10のカード価格。2026-04の写真では値札シールが貼られており新価.en: Price from the 2025-10 card. In the 2026-04 photo a price sticker covers it and the new price is illegible. Some methods dust the oysters with wheat flour, so ask.

2025/04と2025/11の口コミがともに1,000円で確認。抹茶自体は小麦.en: Reviews from 2025/04 and 2025/11 both confirm ¥1,000. Matcha itself has no wheat. The wagashi served with it depends on the day; nerikiri (rice, beans) has no wheat, but ask.

2025/04の写真では価格が切れて読めず。2023/08の品書きでは¥850。.en: Price cut off and unreadable on the 2025/04 photo. ¥850 on the 2023/08 menu. Batter, noodles and sauce all wheat.
Price cut off and unreadable on the 2025/04 photo. ¥850 on the 2023/08 menu. Noodles and sauce = wheat.

2025/04の品書き写真では価格が切れて読めず。2023/08の同じ品書きでは.en: On the 2025/04 menu photo the price is cut off and unreadable. ¥1,100 on the same menu in 2023/08. Batter, noodles and sauce all wheat.

2025年10月16日、JR二条駅からほど近い聚楽廻南町に開業した新しいラーメン.en: A new ramen specialist that opened on 16 October 2025 in Jurakumawari-minamimachi, close to JR Nijo Station. Run by F-Lead Inc. (headquartered in Nagoya, founded May 2019), it opened under the banner 'ramen connecting the world and Kyoto'.

2025年2月からカフェ営業（月・水〜金 12:30〜16:00）をスタート。デ.en: Café hours began in February 2025 (Mon and Wed–Fri, 12:30–16:00). The hideaway bistro, once dinner-only, now opens in the daytime too, with sweets and café-only drinks.

2025年4月14日、カンテサンスの看板デザート「ガトー・オー・コンテ」（36ヶ.en: On 14 April 2025, Quintessence's signature dessert, the Gâteau au Comté (made with 36-month-aged Comté), went on sale by reservation at Brillance too. Previously available only by lottery, this one-of-a-kind dessert being available in Nagoya made news.

2025年6月30日にグランドオープンした、名古屋・丸の内のビル2階に構える隠れ.en: A hideaway Indian-Nepalese restaurant and bar on the 2nd floor of a building in Marunouchi, Nagoya, which had its grand opening on 30 June 2025 (about 4 minutes on foot from Marunouchi Station). The concept is two-in-one: authentic spice curry by day, and a bar with over 30 whiskies and wines by night. Spice level is selectable from 0 to 5, so it also suits people who don't like heat. Cooks from the region pursue the taste of India and Nepal while finishing it to be easy for Japanese diners.

2025年9月1日に姫路市久保町にオープン。 山陽姫路駅から徒歩約5分、MIST.en: Opened 1 September 2025 in Kubo-cho, Himeji. A small koryori restaurant on the 1st floor of the MISTRAL Kubo-cho building, about 5 minutes' walk from Sanyo-Himeji Station.

2026-06の店頭ポスター。天ぷら・フライを含む構成のため小麦。内容は要確認。.en: In-shop poster 2026-06. Includes tempura and fried items, so wheat. Ask about the contents.

2026-06の店頭黒板。生ビール＝麦芽＝大麦でグルテンあり。ハイボールも麦。.en: In-shop blackboard 2026-06. Draft beer = malt = barley, contains gluten. Highballs are barley too.

2026/02の口コミが「おすすめの豚そば」として注文。価格は未確認。小麦粉の生.en: A 2026/02 review ordered it as 'the recommended pork soba'. Price unconfirmed. Wheat-flour batter + Otafuku-style sauce (wheat). Shared griddle too.

2026/05の口コミが「おたふくソースの味」と記述＝小麦ソース。価格未確認。.en: A 2026/05 review describes 'the taste of Otafuku sauce' = wheat sauce. Price unconfirmed.

2026/05の口コミで現行を確認。チーズ＝乳。鉄板は小麦生地と共用。価格は読み.en: Confirmed as current by a 2026/05 review. Cheese = dairy. Griddle shared with the wheat batter. Price left blank because the reading is uncertain.

2026/05の口コミで現行を確認。板の価格列が写真上で一段ずれる可能性があるた.en: Confirmed as current by a 2026/05 review. The board's price column may be one row off in the photo, so no amount is given. Ask about soy sauce and oyster sauce in the seasoning.

2026/06のレシートに¥2,000（税込）。品書き写真には未掲載で内容は未確.en: ¥2,000 (tax included) on a 2026/06 receipt. Not on the menu photo, so contents unconfirmed.

2026年1月の口コミより。タルタルの調味に醤油を使う可能性。表面を軽く火を通し.en: From a January 2026 review. Soy sauce may be used to season the tartare. Lightly seared on the surface, rare inside.

2026年1月の口コミより。タレは要確認。.en: From a January 2026 review. Ask about the sauce.

2026年1月の口コミより。下味・タレは要確認。.en: From a January 2026 review. Ask about the marinade and sauce.

2026年4月24日オープンの新店。 名古屋・丸の内のオフィス街（丸の内駅8番出.en: A new shop opened on 24 April 2026. In the office district of Marunouchi, Nagoya (about 3 minutes on foot from exit 8 of Marunouchi Station), its concept is robata charcoal grilling over binchōtan paired with sake.

2026年4月の口コミより。ポン酢・ごまだれ＝小麦の可能性。.en: From an April 2026 review. Ponzu and sesame sauce = possibly wheat.

2026年4月の口コミより。ユッケだれは醤油ベース＝小麦。.en: From an April 2026 review. Yukhoe sauce is soy-based = wheat.

2026年6月21日オープン。スリランカ出身のオーナーが名古屋市西区城北町の目立.en: Opened on 21 June 2026. Run by an owner from Sri Lanka in an inconspicuous back alley in Nishi-ku, Nagoya. Starting to draw attention as 'seriously Sri Lankan food', with overwhelming value at about half the going rate and authentic flavour served straight to the plate.

2026年6月の店頭ボードに掲載。カレールウは小麦を含むことが多い。ドリンクと一.en: On the shop's board in June 2026. Curry roux often contains wheat. ¥200 off when ordered with a drink.

20種以上のカレー（辛さ5段階調整可）と石窯（タンドール）焼きナン.en: Over 20 curries (spiciness adjustable in five levels) and naan from a tandoor oven

60分900円／120分1,800円。ビール・麦焼酎を含むためグルテン回避には不.en: 60 min ¥900 / 120 min ¥1,800. Includes beer and barley shōchū, so not suited to avoiding gluten. At least one food item per person must be ordered.

648471.com（公式）と ことりっぷ（co-trip 701134）、ふる.en: 648471.com (official), co-trip (701134), Furusato Choice / Furunavi and Tabelog agree in supporting: a soy-milk pâtisserie led by Uno Yukiko, opened in 2006; meeting a boy with 23 food allergies in December 2009; completing a cake free of 29 allergens in 2020; and in October 2023 renovating and reopening the production factory and shop to go fully gluten-free.

6個860円／8個1,150円／12個1,720円／16個2,300円。店は「お.en: 6 for ¥860 / 8 for ¥1,150 / 12 for ¥1,720 / 16 for ¥2,300. The shop states 'we'll pack the kinds you like' and 'we also take orders by phone'.

7大アレルゲンフリーのお好み焼き.en: okonomiyaki free of the 7 major allergens

8種類の茸の濃厚な風味。テリーヌは季節ごとに入れ替わる。.en: The rich flavour of 8 kinds of mushroom. The terrine changes with the season.

A5ランク黒毛和牛の鉄板焼き（サーロイン・フィレ・シャトーブリアン）、活アワビ・.en: Teppanyaki of A5 Kuroge wagyu (sirloin, fillet, chateaubriand), live abalone and spiny lobster.

A5和牛スパイシー特大唐揚げラーメン.en: A5 wagyu spicy extra-large karaage ramen

ALL ¥600（税込）、プレートとのセットは¥400。.en: ALL ¥600 (tax included); ¥400 in a set with a plate.

Archived article 「新ご当地グルメ広島つけ麺（冷麺）広島市中区八.en: Archived article 'New local gourmet: Hiroshima tsukemen (cold noodles), Naka-ku, Hiroshima, Hatchobori, "Himawari"': menu 'Hiroshima-style tsukemen (with a rice ball at lunchtime), regular (1 portion of noodles) ¥950 / Hiroshima-style ramen (shoyu, tonkotsu) ¥700 / spicy ramen ¥700 / ramen set (ramen, karaage, rice) ¥850 / phantom Himawari curry ¥750'; 'the noodles are extra-thin, normal firmness, smooth texture'. No allergen or gluten-free note anywhere.

Archived article: 「カツオだしがきいてうま味あり。」／「大きな.en: Archived article: 'Full of umami from bonito dashi.' / 'On the big plate, onion, boiled egg, chāshū, cucumber, shredded nori, lemon, radish sprouts, cabbage and tomato are beautifully arranged with the noodles' / 'Incidentally, at night it operates as a yakiniku restaurant serving A4-grade or higher beef.'

BRUTUSの記事が、女将・千鶴子さんが一人で切り盛りする8席のカウンター餃子店.en: A BRUTUS article introduces an 8-seat counter gyoza shop (about 58 years in business) run single-handedly by okami Chizuko-san: preparation from 6:30 a.m.; double-ground pork with Kochi garlic chives and Aomori garlic wrapped in custom thin wrappers; fried in an iron pan greased with lard; the words 'the wrappers are alive, so frying them is hard'; the play of bean sprouts and spring-onion sauce, the 'spring-onion pocket'; and an azuki ice bar to finish.

CAMPFIRE・食べログで、2025年10月15日開業、北区柳原（名城公園駅徒.en: CAMPFIRE and Tabelog confirm the opening on 15 October 2025, Yanagihara, Kita-ku (7 minutes on foot from Meijo Koen Station), the second shop of Caffe CAMMELLO (Joshin), a collaboration with an Italian chef, stone-oven pizza and house-made pasta, the origin of TAPIRO = tapir (sound sleep, peace of mind), and wine-bar service after 22:00. Wines are Italian and Californian, plus whisky.

Chef Mohan Kumar says: 塩はヒマラヤ岩塩、お米はコシヒカリ.en: Chef Mohan Kumar says: "We use Himalayan rock salt and Koshihikari rice. Indian curry usually uses a lot of oil, but we use as little as possible to keep it healthy."

Cited Tabelog page: genre 「かき、海鮮」, revie.en: Cited Tabelog page: genre 'oysters, seafood', review title 'Grilled oysters you can enjoy every which way', related keywords 'grilled oysters / butter-soy / lemon / ponzu / anago / yellowtail'. A Yahoo Japan search of the shop surfaces the flavour list: 'from standards like ponzu and butter-soy to unusual ones like Remosco, chilli oil, yuzu kosho, wasabi soy sauce and tomato cheese', and prices grilled oysters with butter-soy ¥700 / grilled oysters ¥550 / grilled oysters with lemon ¥600.

Closed 21 June 2026. Tabelog 17014312 is.en: Closed 21 June 2026. Tabelog 17014312 is titled "[Closed] Kitchen Yuki - Hokutetsu Kanazawa / Western food" at "Kanazawa M'za B1F, 15-1 Musashi-machi, Kanazawa, Ishikawa" and states "This shop is now closed." Kanazawa Keizai Shimbun (2026-07-08) reports that "Go Go Curry Kanazawa M'za opened on 5 July on the first basement floor of the department store Kanazawa M'za (Musashi-machi, Kanazawa), reusing the fitted premises of the curry shop 'Kanazawa Curry Kitchen Yuki', which closed on 21 June", and gives the reason: "Kitchen Yuki, leaving M'za for business-plan reasons". Go Go Curry's own 2026-07-03 release says the same. The operator's site now lists

Corroborated: 豆乳などを活用することで全商品グルテンフリーの身体に.en: Corroborated: a patisserie kind to the body, with every product gluten-free through the use of soy milk and more.

Current self-description on cocoroba2022.en: Current self-description on cocoroba2022.com is 'Rice-flour bread CoCoRoBA opened in November 2022 in Saeki-ku, Hiroshima, as a rice-flour bread specialist.' plus 'We worked on making delicious gluten-free bread dough using only domestic rice flour, with no unnecessary additives. People with the three major food allergies (wheat, egg, milk) and health-conscious people can eat it with peace of mind. (Only the cheese and chocolate ones contain "milk".)' The word 完全 (fully) does not appear in the page text.

Current site (renewed 2026-06-15): 「全国初の.en: Current site (renewed 2026-06-15): "Japan's first food-therapy specialist. Our 'eating fast', born from our own research, is additive-free and gluten-free and improves circulation and flow…"

Current wording: 「ヴィーガン 白湯らぁ麺 ¥1,200(税込).en: Current wording: 'Vegan paitan ramen ¥1,200 (tax included). A rich vegan paitan ramen carefully finished with soy milk and aromatic vegetables, using no animal ingredients at all. Topped with flavourful ganmodoki and colourful red-heart radish among many vegetables.' plus 'Vegan tantan ramen ¥1,250 (tax included)'.

Deli-koma と oishii-shinshu が『無添加と地産地消』『無.en: Deli-koma and oishii-shinshu introduce the concept, 'additive-free and local production for local consumption' and 'gentle flavours without MSG', and say the owner came from Kimagure Hachibei. Vegewel states 'ramen-making without barriers', vegan ramen, wheat-free noodles and allergy care.

FindMeGlutenFree: Mexico Kitchen Bar Mu、.en: FindMeGlutenFree: Mexico Kitchen Bar Mu, 5-2 Hommachibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6944-1920, official mu-mexico-osaka.jimdo.com; no gluten-free menu but options exist; not dedicated gluten-free; no dedicated fryer. Reviews (2025 – October 2026): some days run single-handed; many gluten-free options; the best nachos; tacos; mango margarita sour; burritos are not GF; the chef pointed out the items with gluten (jalapeño poppers, burritos, fried-shrimp tacos, quesadillas, mole); smallish portions; nachos and corned-beef tacos; gluten-free chocolate cake; corn tortilla tacos; shared kitchen; tequila highball.

FindMeGlutenFree: OKO - Fun Okonomiyaki.en: FindMeGlutenFree: OKO - Fun Okonomiyaki Bar, 2-4-13 Dotonbori, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 090-5897-3366; gluten-free menu; not dedicated gluten-free; in 59 public collections. Reviews (to October 2026): owner-chef Shiho runs it single-handed; order at the counter and go up to the 2nd-floor seats; called by number; clear your own table; self-serve drinks ¥100; about 5 gluten-free okonomiyaki (beef and onion, triple meat, mushroom and sausage); choice of vegetable and bean toppings; large portions (M is enough); gluten-free gyoza and fries; gluten-free beer; vegan options; gluten-free stickers; separate utensils and griddle; opens around 18:00 with a queue; a 40-minute wait at 18:05; a celiac diner reacted in April 2026; a December 2025 tip says 'closed' but reviews continue. The old official domain oko-osaka.com is now an unrelated site.

FindMeGlutenFree: OKO takoyaki、大阪市中央区東心斎.en: FindMeGlutenFree: OKO takoyaki, 1-15-24 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 090-7571-8939, Instagram @oko_tako_osaka; gluten-free menu; not dedicated gluten-free; 2nd floor. Reviews (2026): soy-flour takoyaki; set with rice, soup and cabbage; run single-handed; order and pay at the window; called by number; some say vegan, vegetarian and gluten-free while one says 'not vegan'; seasoning underwhelming; one preferred the other OKO; a punk atmosphere; cheap with big portions; a reviewer's daughter with celiac disease ate more here than anywhere else in Japan.

FindMeGlutenFree: OSAKA ENGINE RAMEN、大阪市.en: FindMeGlutenFree: OSAKA ENGINE RAMEN, Hauser Sakaisuji-Hommachi Ekimae Bldg 1F, 2-2-15 Azuchimachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-7636-8802, Instagram @osakaengine_ramen; gluten-free menu; 152 ratings. Shop's description: gluten-free noodles are cooked with dedicated equipment and utensils and served in dedicated gluten-free bowls. Reviews (August–October 2026): the best ramen in Japan; marked on the menu; everything can be made gluten-free; gluten-free beer, gyoza and desserts; black-garlic ramen; the vegan Zesty; dedicated bowls and no-gluten coasters; gluten-free tags; private rooms; Zesty #1; sake tasting flight; umeshu; not dedicated gluten-free; gluten-free rice noodles cost extra; miso ramen; tender chashu; counter.

FindMeGlutenFree: PANCAKE & books biblio.en: FindMeGlutenFree: PANCAKE & books bibliothèque, Namba Parks 4F, 2-10-70 Nambanaka, Naniwa-ku, Osaka, 06-4395-5757; gluten-free menu; not dedicated gluten-free; a dedicated gluten-free waffle maker reported; no dedicated fryer. Reviews (July–October 2026): every pancake batter can be made gluten-free; staff point out toppings that aren't suitable; on request staff wash the pan and utensils; fluffy; True Butter; fruit and nuts; berries; ricotta and salmon; matcha; a card setting out gluten-free precautions; allergy-aware. Opening hours could not be retrieved.

FindMeGlutenFree: RE-public by BASE ISLA.en: FindMeGlutenFree: RE-public by BASE ISLAND KITCHEN, 1-16-27 Kita-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka, 080-7013-5231, Facebook baseislandkitchen; reported as dedicated gluten-free; a dedicated gluten-free fryer reported. Reviews (2025 – October 2026): Jamaican food; jerk chicken with potato wedges; jerk chicken and bean wrap; nachos (sell out early); tapas; lemon-blueberry cake; large portions; the owner is careful about gluten and pointed out that only the beer is not gluten-free (January 2026); free of gluten and dairy; a menu that is vegan apart from the chicken plates (2025); 12:00–18:00 (sometimes later on Fridays, April 2026); opening days are unpredictable, so check Facebook or Instagram; one found it closed on a Wednesday and says Mondays and Tuesdays are closed too (2025).

FindMeGlutenFree: Shinsekai Paprika Shok.en: FindMeGlutenFree: Shinsekai Paprika Shokudo Vegan&Gluten-Free, 3-4-5 Ebisuhigashi, Naniwa-ku, Osaka, 06-6567-9376, Instagram @shinsekai.paprika_vegan; reported as dedicated gluten-free; a dedicated fryer reported. Reviews (2024 – October 2026): gluten-free beer; ordering by QR code; everything labelled; vegetarian takoyaki; aubergine and pumpkin kushikatsu; fried vegetables; tempura; all the shoyu is gluten-free; cinnamon doughnuts; English menu; a shop run by a woman; hand-made, gluten-free and vegan; everything except the soy meat is gluten-free (labelled); ramen; fried avocado; fried mochi; reasonable prices; check opening hours.

FindMeGlutenFree: Shojin Sushi Minamo、大阪.en: FindMeGlutenFree: Shojin Sushi Minamo, Keiwa Bldg Lefre 21, 1-10-11 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka, Instagram @shojin_sushi_minamo; reported as dedicated gluten-free; in 25 public collections. Reviews (2025 – July 2026): vegan, gluten-free sushi; looks and tastes like real sushi; assortments; pickled ginger; gluten-free beer and shoyu; preparation visible from the counter; jazz; one said it was open for lunch only (2025); only basic English; reasonably priced. Opening hours not found.

FindMeGlutenFree: Streamer Coffee Compan.en: FindMeGlutenFree: Streamer Coffee Company, 1-10-19 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6252-7088, Instagram @streamer_coffee_company; gluten-free menu; not dedicated gluten-free. Reviews (2025 – October 2026): a few gluten-free cakes and sweets, individually wrapped; matcha chocolate, peanut-butter chocolate and salted chocolate brownies; macadamia white-chocolate bar; chocolate chip; oat chai latte; a gluten-free sign outside the shop; not everything is available every day; items are unlabelled, check the poster; given a regular cookie when the gluten-free brownie was sold out (October 2026); checked drinks too after seeing a gluten-free card.

FindMeGlutenFree: Vegan Cafe Tsukineko、大.en: FindMeGlutenFree: Vegan Cafe Tsukineko, Ebenezer Bldg 1F, 1-14-12 Nambanaka, Naniwa-ku, Osaka, 06-4400-3987, Instagram @vegancafe_tsukineko; gluten-free menu; not dedicated gluten-free; a dedicated fryer reported. Reviews (2025 – October 2026): a small cat-themed cafe, 7 seats; the menu is gluten-free and vegan (labelled, except one drink); pancakes with fruit and soy cream; cat-shaped pancakes; gyoza; tempura (aubergine too); vegan curry; scones with apple and vegan cream; vegan ice cream with gluten-free biscuits and granola; jazz; some found portions small and prices high; slow service at busy Saturday lunchtimes; 'no traces'.

FindMeGlutenFree: crepe aimer(クレープ エメ)、大.en: FindMeGlutenFree: crepe aimer, 1-2-1 Otedori, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6943-0333, Facebook crepe.aimer; gluten-free menu; not dedicated gluten-free; a dedicated fryer and dedicated kitchen space reported. Reviews (November 2025 – August 2026): rice-flour crêpes; most of the menu is gluten-free; staff kind and knowledgeable; one says the taste isn't very French (no strawberries or Nutella); sweet and savoury; labelled; margherita; bismarck; seasonal strawberry daifuku; near Osaka Castle; drinks and ice cream; the owner knows gluten well and everything except the custard is gluten-free; pay outside and eat standing.

FindMeGlutenFree: my bowl 北堀江店、大阪市西区北堀江1.en: FindMeGlutenFree: my bowl Kita-Horie, 1-11-8 Kita-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka, Instagram @mybowljp; gluten-free menu; not dedicated gluten-free. Reviews (2025 – October 2026): pancakes, banana bread, coffee, avocado toast, salmon and cream-cheese toast, salads, açaí bowls, smoothies; dairy, meat, vegan, gluten-free and vegetarian all together; one says the staff understand gluten-free (October 2026); breakfast until 11:00, lunch until 13:00; smallish portions; the gluten-free granola is made in a factory that also handles wheat; staff did not understand celiac disease or cross-contamination (April 2026); GF marked on the menu.

First fragment is verbatim: 「小麦粉アレルギーの方に.en: First fragment is verbatim: 'We take care for people with wheat allergies'. Second is NOT: the page says 'If customers wish, we will do our best to prepare menus that also handle food allergies other than wheat.'

Go! NAGANO（id20535）は総料理担当を小川真宏氏（漢字は真宏）とし.en: Go! NAGANO (id20535) names Ogawa Masahiro (written 真宏) as head of cooking, running the Fuchinobo kitchen for about 30 years, and describes the signature 'Mangetsu' as a steamed dish of Matsushiro Chinese yam skin wrapped around a shiitake-walnut miso filling. The official syojin.html calls Mangetsu 'the lodging's speciality' and lists sesame tofu in every course. The Zenkoji official site confirms the alternative name 'Engi-dō'. The head priest Wakaomi Takanori's view of shojin is also confirmed in press reports.

HICBC(CHANT特集)によると、店主・桑野俊昭は福岡・久留米出身で、九州(.en: According to HICBC (CHANT feature), owner Kuwano Toshiaki is from Kurume, Fukuoka, and buys ultra-thin Kyushu (Fukuoka) ramen noodles direct. The signature Taiwan mazesoba was born by chance from a regular's request to add noodles to the popular Taiwan stir-fried bean sprouts. Stir-fried at high heat with a secret soy tare and three oils. About 21 seats; bookings are 1–1.5 months out, with customers coming from afar.

JAあいち豊田グリーンセンター松平店.en: JA Aichi Toyota Green Center branch

JR京都伊勢丹などで販売の詰め合わせギフト。.en: An assortment gift sold at JR Kyoto Isetan and elsewhere.

JR奈良駅から徒歩約10分、住宅街の細い路地にある古民家を改装したヴィーガンカフ.en: A vegan café in a renovated old house down a narrow lane in a residential area, about 10 minutes' walk from JR Nara Station. Opened December 2017.

JR鳥羽駅名店街内の食堂（旧店名「大家族」）。テーブル席と座敷で計約30席。「ネ.en: A diner inside the JR Toba Station shopping arcade (formerly called 'Daikazoku'). About 30 seats at tables and on tatami. It 'closes when the fish runs out', and the famous seafood bowl often sells out by evening. At lunch almost everything is cooked by one person, so there may be a wait. Also serves big fried shrimp, sashimi set meals, Ise udon and grilled turban shell.

KissPress・Tanosu・budou-chan・姫路経済新聞より。202.en: From KissPress, Tanosu, budou-chan and the Himeji Keizai Shimbun. Opened 1 May 2024 in Okada, the first food venture of the amusement-equipment company GP&M. The manager (named differently in two sources) loves music and curry, and the name comes from a wish to recreate the taste of Shupura, an Indian restaurant (now closed) frequented as a student in Matsumoto (Nagano). Rice curry with 15 spices, keema plus chicken, bone-in chicken. budou-chan and KissPress state gluten-free and no butter.

Life Designs・Only Roaster・ウォーカープラス等が、嶋勇也.en: Life Designs, Only Roaster, Walker Plus and others support Shima Yuya's career (born in Nagoya in 1982; Kato Coffee → a roastery in Gifu → about 50 CVs sent in Melbourne → opened June 2017), about 10 coffees roasted in-house on a Giesen W6A, bean sales, and work as a competition judge.

Live menu: 勝谷あんマーガリン, 自家製抹茶あんホイップ, 瀬戸内レモ.en: Live menu: Katsutani anko margarine, house-made matcha anko whip, Setouchi lemon anko and cream cheese, lots of custard, seaweed-salt (海人の藻塩) milk cream, rum raisin, crunchy peanut, chocolate, egg (egg salad), vegetable and egg, old-style Napolitan (grated cheese), Hokkaido croquette, chicken nanban. Plant-leaning outliers: Katsutani anko ¥350 and strawberry jam ¥350.

Official menu: 「※卵、乳、小麦、そば、落花生（ピーナッツ）、えび.en: Official menu: '*No specified allergenic ingredients, including egg, milk, wheat, buckwheat, peanuts, shrimp and crab, are used.' and '…for safety, the curry sauce is served in its package.'

Official site: 「旬の食材を吟味し料理長が真心を込めた物をご提供し.en: Official site: "We serve dishes of carefully chosen seasonal ingredients, prepared by the head chef with heart. Local kaiseki devoted to each season's bounty of the mountains and rivers."

Own menu page, 背脂ブラック: 「完全オリジナルで厳選したたまり醤.en: Own menu page, back-fat black: 'A Kyoto ramen known for a rich, black soup layering a completely original, carefully chosen tamari soy sauce with a special soy sauce carrying the umami of slowly prepared chāshū.' Header line: 'Akky-style chūka soba — a particular taste with richness and umami, using tamari soy sauce'

PR TIMES(2026年6月5日): グルテンフリーかつ動物性原材料不使用の.en: PR TIMES (5 June 2026): a ramen specialist that is gluten-free and free of animal ingredients; everything served is 100% plant-based with none of the five pungent alliums (gokun); new sesame-vinegar reimen ¥2,200 (no animal ingredients, gokun or wheat); Bakuromachi Estate Bldg 1F, 1-4-10 Bakuromachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 11:00–22:00 (kitchen closes 21:15); closed Wednesdays. Tabelog: 070-5638-4042; reservations accepted; 12:00–23:00 (food L.O. 22:15); closed Wednesdays; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; 27 seats; no smoking; no children's chairs. 2026 reviews (July–September): ground floor of the building that houses the Mongolian consulate; spacious and clean; medicinal soy-milk tantanmen ¥2,200 → ¥2,420; rice-flour noodles with plenty of vegetables; mild heat; opened 29 January; a new format from MERCY Vegan Factory in Kawaramachi; tomato ramen ¥1,980; salt ramen ¥1,870; noodle refill ¥660; a thin kombu salt soup with lemon; medium-thick wavy noodles of Hokkaido rice flour; pepper and chili on the table; feels aimed at overseas visitors; organic lemonade and salt bread; some find it pricey.

PR TIMES・CentralWalker・食べログによると、2025年9月1.en: According to PR TIMES, CentralWalker and Tabelog, it opened on 16 September 2025 inside Kawabun, an old ryōtei with about 400 years of history. 11 counter seats entered through the kitchen door; run by Plan・Do・See. The sushi chef is a woman, rare in the trade (name not published). The concept is 'casual enjoyment of authentic Edomae sushi'; lunch ¥3,800, dinner ¥7,800. Kombu-cured sea bream, marinated tuna, ikura, red miso soup, tamago and more. Reviews call it 'top-class value' with red-vinegar rice 'easy to eat even for Nagoya people'.

PR TIMES・gcjapan より、イタリアン出身で麺庄（Mensho）で修.en: PR TIMES and gcjapan confirm: Sho Isogai, from Italian cooking and trained at Mensho; opened Mendokoro Guriko in Okayama in 2017, earning a Bib Gourmand and a Tokyo Ramen Show appearance; the second brand Wamen Guriko's Kyoto main shop opened on Rokkaku-dori on 23 July 2025; the chicken salt is an 8-hour chicken consommé + freshwater clams with Japanese / Italian / French / Mongolian salt tare; the sea-bream salt is domestic wild red sea bream with Okinawa / Niigata salt; and thin noodles of 100% domestic wheat.

PR TIMES（1.000048612）は運営を合同会社U.I.interna.en: PR TIMES (1.000048612) says it is run by U.I.international LLC (head: Tomoki Kimishima); after the first shop in Yudanaka (2016), the Zenkoji Monzen shop opened on 20 September 2019 in a converted Taishō-era tabi (sock) merchant's house; and Shinshu miso has about half the national market. chomiryo.jp says Isazaki Saizo, in charge of menu development, joined part-time in the second year of university and stayed after graduating, turning down a job offer elsewhere.

PR TIMES（171.000044858）は2025年6月2日開業、運営は軽.en: PR TIMES (171.000044858) says it opened on 2 June 2025, run by Fons Co. of Karuizawa (operator of Kawakamian), in the former Takizawa Shoten building (over 100 years old), reusing a signboard by Akiyama Hakugan, and serving Sanada-maru (local chicken) dishes. blog.nagano-ken carries a comment from manager 眞倉博之: 'Few places stay open in the evening, so we hope people will drop in at night too and that we can help revitalise the area.'

PR TIMES（ATE-LINK運営・2026年3月20日グランフェスタ5番街.en: PR TIMES (run by ATE-LINK; opened in Gran Festa 5-ban-gai on 20 March 2026; café 11–15, night 16–23; chicken-cutlet fried rice over 1 kg in total; at night "YORU NO MARUMASA" with roast beef etc.), budou-chan (started in Fukusaki; huge portions; ¥50 reusable containers), and a search confirming Instagram @kissalavuri420 = "Kissa Lavuri (高橋恵美)".

PR TIMES（八百彦本店）とssu.co.jpブログが、2022年3月18日.en: PR TIMES (Yaohiko Honten) and the ssu.co.jp blog support the March 18, 2022 opening inside Nagoya Noh Theatre, operation by Yaohiko Honten (over 300 years old), the three-brand line-up, head chef Chikazawa's Aichi Master Craftsman recognition, about 5,000 meals a day, and the Kinjō ¥3,800 and Fukuju ¥9,900 courses. No published source gives head chef Chikazawa's given name, so it is left out.

PUKKUは米粉シフォンケーキ専門店（株式会社PUKKU、奈良市西登美ヶ丘4-5.en: PUKKU is a rice-flour chiffon cake specialist (PUKKU Co., 4-5-7 Nishi-Tomigaoka, Nara City, on Narayama-odori, with a café serving breakfast from 9 am and lunch). It uses red-hen eggs, 100% Hokkaido raw milk, Kyushu rice flour, mineral-rich cane sugar and organic vanilla. The signature '100-year chiffon' uses Yoshino pure kuzu and rice syrup (from a rice-syrup maker of over 160 years) and no wheat flour (gluten-free). Reached 559% of its Makuake target (AtPress).

Plant-based side: 「ところてん」「豆かん」「くずきり」「あんみ.en: Plant-based side: "tokoroten", "beans in agar", "kuzu noodles", "anmitsu", "matcha & fine fresh sweet set". Animal side: "ice cream with bean paste (vanilla)", "ice cream with bean paste (matcha)", "cream anmitsu" and "dorayaki 'Hodatsu'". The kakigori entries read "shaved ice, Noto blueberry / shaved ice, Uji matcha: please enjoy it with the smooth melt of Kanazawa ice-house ice and Morihachi's special syrup".

Resol Hotel特集とjouhou.nagoya・juno.nagoyaが.en: The Resol Hotel feature, jouhou.nagoya and juno.nagoya support: run by Holidays Co. (which also runs OHAGI3 in Moriyama Ward; representative Hirokazu Ochiai); a renovation of the former Nagono Elementary School lunch kitchen; the big cauldron at the entrance; matcha served in milk bottles; anko at 47–49° Brix; a 34-bean keema curry; and the themes of the Momotaro paradox and Shuntaro Tanikawa's "Morning Relay".

Retty・食べログで、近江町市場十間町口の10席の小さなカウンター店、大将と女.en: Retty and Tabelog confirm: a small 10-seat counter at Omicho Market's Jikkenmachi entrance; the master and the proprietress; seared blackthroat seaperch, white shrimp, conger eel; an omakase of about 12 pieces + soup; served one plate at a time at the guest's pace. The 'Ume' course name and sweet shrimp were not confirmed, so removed.

Retty・食べログ・chirickで確認：鳥羽駅至近のさざえ街、生簀から選んで.en: Confirmed on Retty, Tabelog and chirick: on Sazae Street near Toba Station; choose from the tank and have it charcoal-grilled; turban shells, large clams, abalone, whitebait from Toshijima; hiogi scallops (like scallops, with a rich flavour); local sake; dogs allowed by reservation.

Retty・食べログ・ぐるなびで、横安江町の昭和レトロなそば・うどん定食処(約4.en: Retty, Tabelog and Gurunavi confirm: a Shōwa-retro soba and udon set-meal diner in Yoko-Yasue-machi (about 47 seats); mackerel simmered in miso, hayashi katsu rice, tempura-and-egg bowl, ramen, hot-pot udon; a calm, homey atmosphere.

Shop's own statement: 「パンは卵、牛乳、豆乳、小麦粉、砂糖.en: Shop's own statement: "Our bread uses no egg, milk, soy milk, wheat flour or sugar. It's made from rice grains, not rice flour"

TANOSU取材・姫路みたいより。2018年6月、自宅倉庫を改装して開業。店主は.en: From a TANOSU feature and Himeji Mitai. Opened in June 2018 in a renovated home storehouse. The owner's name is given. Allergy-friendly cakes use rice-flour sponge with no egg, dairy or wheat ("Komeyoshi" also has no soy), but the regular cakes use domestic wheat flour, and some items use wheat, such as fresh wheat gluten. Made-to-order allergy-friendly and character cakes available.

TANOSU取材記事・てくてくひめじ・公式サイトより。アスリート夫婦(片方はFI.en: From a TANOSU feature, Tekuteku Himeji and the official site. An organic café run by an athlete couple (one a FIFA international football referee). Moved from Otsu-ku to Shikama-ku Kamo and reopened in January 2025. Learned roasting at JOKI COFFEE in Kochi; offers five kinds of beans. Serves a rice-flour waffle and rice-flour carrot cake (gluten-free), but also bakes its own bread with organic Haruyokoi wheat and rye (not a dedicated GF kitchen).

TOBA Pearl Town公式ページが、いせえびを鳥羽湾・真珠島・行き交う船.en: The TOBA Pearl Town official page introduces Iseebi as one of the few places in Toba where you can eat looking out over Toba Bay, Pearl Island and passing boats, and confirms a menu of Ise lobster, abalone, fried shrimp curry, sashimi set meals and more.

TV番組「マツコの知らない世界」では、きな粉のスペシャリスト穴沢聖子が「ぜいみ.en: On a TV programme, a kinako specialist (穴沢聖子) introduced "Zeimi Fukuyutaka", and the flavour of kinako made from Fukuyutaka, a premium soybean from Saga, was featured.

Tabelogで2014年2月28日開店・北海道出身の店主・ジンホル鍋(ジンギス.en: Tabelog confirms: opened 28 February 2014; an owner from Hokkaido; jinhoru hot pot (jingisukan lamb + offal) ¥1,180; sea urchin sent directly from Hokkaido; the connoisseur's way of dipping Nishiyama ramen in the sauce and meat juices. Pork / miso offal and sea urchin at ¥1,800 are not stated, so softened.

Tabelogで、1985年創業（約40年）、金沢駅東口・近江町市場至近、カウン.en: Tabelog confirms: founded 1985 (about 40 years); near Kanazawa Station's east exit and Omicho Market; counter, raised tatami and tatami room (32 seats in all); Hokuriku seafood; filefish with liver in house-made ponzu; conger eel with a special sauce prepared over several days; Ishikawa local sake.

Tabelogで、長町の旧家を改装した純和風の甘味処、丹波大納言の自家製餡・白玉.en: Tabelog confirms: a purely Japanese-style sweets house in a renovated old Nagamachi house; house-made bean paste of Tanba Dainagon beans, shiratama, agar and ice cream (all house-made except fruit); cream anmitsu with fruit from Fruit Sakano in Omicho; tea anmitsu (white syrup scented with orange liqueur); Uji kintoki; kuzu noodles. Zenzai in winter.

Tabelogとma8coroはヤマサ蒲鉾直営、大手前エリアの2階、券売機式カウ.en: Tabelog and ma8coro confirm: run directly by Yamasa Kamaboko; 2F in the Otemae area; ticket-machine counter; soba eaten with salt; Himeji oden (ginger soy sauce). The official yumenosoba.com confirms 80/20 soba made with buckwheat flour from Yumesaki.

Tabelogの情報として「予算やメニューに関するご要望にも対応可能」との記載が.en: Tabelog notes that 'requests about budget and menu can be accommodated', showing willingness to consult in advance, but whether there is a specialist allergy protocol is unknown. Calling before visiting (052-265-5557) is strongly recommended.

Tabelogは2025/9/1開業、久保町MISTRALビル1階、山陽姫路駅徒.en: Tabelog confirms: opened 1 September 2025; MISTRAL Bldg 1F, Kubo-cho; about 5 min walk from Sanyo-Himeji Station; a proprietress who is a registered dietitian; always over 10 Harima local sakes. Hot Pepper confirms healthy daily obanzai of freshly picked vegetables.

Tabelog（2011年7月15日オープン、北区金城2-5-11、82席、モー.en: Tabelog (opened 15 July 2011, 2-5-11 Kinjo, Kita-ku, 82 seats, morning service, bread from Honma Bakery, house blend) and the official Kinshachi Club group site (a relaxed, leisurely, comfortable space, sofa seating throughout) confirm the shop's features. GOTRIP (2016) features it as a classic example of Nagoya café culture. The owner's personal name is not public.

Tabelog（住所：中区三の丸3-1-1 名古屋市役所東庁舎B1F、平日11:.en: Tabelog (address: B1F, Nagoya City Hall East Building, 3-1-1 Sannomaru, Naka-ku; weekdays 11:00–13:30; ticket machine, IC cards accepted; good value) and tabezero, Nagoya City's food-loss reduction site, confirm the location, weekday-lunch-only hours and small portions on request. The names of the owner and cooks are not public.

Table row: 定食のおかず ｜ 小麦不使用の調味料を厳選.en: Table row: set-meal sides | carefully selected wheat-free seasonings

TableCheck・ヒトサラ・宮島観光協会ブログ・indeed求人が、宮島桟橋.en: TableCheck, Hitosara, a Miyajima Tourist Association blog and an indeed job ad report a new sukiyaki restaurant about 2 minutes on foot from Miyajima pier that carefully serves Hiroshima beef sukiyaki one party at a time, sources vegetables, eggs and seasonings from Hiroshima as far as possible, welcomes small bookings (2–3 people), and takes its name from the Rokumeikan, 'where people gather, talk and host'.

The World's 50 Best・Haute Living・jouhou..en: According to The World's 50 Best, Haute Living and jouhou.nagoya, Shingo Gokan went to New York at 23 without speaking English, was turned down as a pâtissier and became a bartender instead; 7 years at Angel's Share; won Bacardi Legacy in 2012. Opened The SG Club in Shibuya, Tokyo in 2018; No. 10 in the World's 50 Best Bars and Best Bar in Japan in 2020. The bar has ranked in the World's 50 Best Bars seven years running. Nagoya's THE BAR CASTLE, on the 4th floor of Espacio Nagoya Castle (opened October 2025), features cocktails overseen by the SG Group, afternoon tea by Suzuki Shigeo (Atelier Ukai), Moroccan lamps and a terrace looking out on Nagoya Castle.

Vegewel と食べログの日本語情報より：本人の説明は「全てヴィーガンのオーガ.en: From Vegewel and Japanese Tabelog information: the owner's own description is 'We are an all-vegan organic takeaway café'. Opened on 14 June 2025 inside Mitaki Share Kitchen, open Friday–Sunday only, cash only, takeaway only. No shop-made gluten-free claim, only Vegewel's tag.

Vegewel・Hachidory・てくてくひめじ・Instagramより。姫路.en: From Vegewel, Hachidory, Tekuteku Himeji and Instagram. A vegan restaurant at Nishi-Shinzaike 1-1-8, Himeji. Tekuteku records: the owners, a couple (one a pastry chef); 6 years at a hotel on Ishigaki Island and 5 years on Okinawa's main island; opened September 2014; moved from Nishi-Imajuku to the present site in February 2020. About 50 kinds of pesticide-free vegetables, cooked completely additive-free. Lunch is a reservation-only course for one group a day (2–4 people); GF vegan baked sweets on sale from noon. One owner's given name appears only on the owner's own Instagram (@cafuu3283), and its reading is not publicly confirmed.

Vegewel掲載ページ、japanese-heart.com紹介記事、note.en: From the Vegewel listing, a japanese-heart.com feature and a travel writer's note.com article. The owner is Masayuki Kamimae. Studied dance in California and experienced organic living; back in Japan, worries about the amount of additives and health led to opening ONE EARTH. Built the basement shop by hand; located in the Namiki-dori area. The concept: 'thinking about the future through what we eat'. Centred on vegan and organic; gluten-free is only a Vegewel tag, with no shop-made wheat-free claim confirmed.

Wikipedia等によると、明治末期創業の宮島の老舗もみじ饅頭店で岩村家が代々.en: According to Wikipedia and others, an old-established Miyajima momiji manjū shop founded at the end of the Meiji era and run by the Iwamura family for generations. On 10 May 1934, when Prince Takamatsu visited Itsukushima and asked then-owner Iwamura Eikichi for coarse bean paste, 'Tsubu Momiji' was devised. Chairman's Award at the 21st National Confectionery Exposition in 1988. Hokkaido azuki is simmered for 6–8 hours, and they are served freshly baked.

Y.YACHT STOREのプロフィールによると、宮田せい子は愛知県岩倉市出身。.en: According to the Y.YACHT STORE profile, Miyata Seiko is from Iwakura, Aichi. After high school, went to culinary school and worked as a cook at welfare facilities, then attended a dietitian school, passed the national registered-dietitian exam and also worked at hospitals and a kindergarten. Started 'Hoshinoko Shokudo' in 2017, writes articles for &(COOK) and teaches cooking classes. internal-reform reports queues of 20+ at the Higashi Betsuin morning market (28th of each month); Tabelog says a shop with 4 counter seats opened in Kami-Nagoya, Nishi-ku on 12 January 2026. Birth year not stated.

Yahoo!ニュースが店主（元・電気関係の営業マン、九州出身）、宮崎産『康卵』（.en: Yahoo! News confirms the owner (a former electrical-goods salesman, from Kyushu), Miyazaki brand eggs (康卵) (about ¥100 each), a cost ratio of about 50%, Akita Komachi rice and daily queues. jouhou.nagoya confirms the opening on 13 December 2025, becoming a cook at 40, and five of those eggs in one omurice; oinagoya confirms a previous career running a Chinese restaurant, Taka, on the Endoji shopping street.

[Mom & Pop] もみじ饅頭 木村屋は、宮島桟橋から表参道商店街に入ってす.en: [Mom & Pop] Momiji manjū Kimuraya is a small, personally run shop specialising in hand-baked momiji manjū, on the corner just inside the Omotesando shopping street from Miyajima pier. Each one is baked at the front, so you can enjoy them warm, fresh from the iron, on the spot. (Map pin approximate — Omotesandō; use the Maps link for exact spot.)

ajibana、キング軒公式(kodawari)、広島市公式ブランドページで、2.en: ajibana, King-ken's official site (kodawari) and Hiroshima City's official brand page confirm the opening in November 2011 and the move into Tokyo in 2015, 'King-ken soy sauce' specially made by Kawanaka Shoyu (founded Meiji 39, 1906), medium-thin noodles custom-made by Kuchii Seimen of Hatsukaichi, 'Takarajima negi' from Kurahashi, five-spice chilli oil aged over a month and a half, and Sichuan pepper ground the same day.

aquarium.co.jp/school/lunch: 海の見えるレストラン「.en: aquarium.co.jp/school/lunch: 'Bayside', a restaurant with a sea view; Ise udon / ramen / curry / fried rice sets, a low-allergen curry, a 28-allergen table (for school groups). Tabelog 24011542: ocean view of Toba Bay; Ise udon curry, shoyu ramen, fried chicken bowl, soft serve.

bm-peekaboo の広島米粉スイーツ12選（#5）に「一軒家を改装したとい.en: bm-peekaboo's 12 Hiroshima rice-flour sweets (#5) says: 'In the shop, a remodelled house, rows of homely chiffon cakes made with love, using carefully chosen ingredients besides rice flour such as cane sugar, organic soy milk and rice oil.' Address Minetaka, Hatsukaichi, Hiroshima; hours 11:00–16:00. Popular flavours are announced on the official Instagram (@comecome_chiffon_). No shop-made wheat-free / gluten-free claim could be confirmed.

budou-chanで店主はイタリアン・和食・焼き鳥を経て2015年に開店、本町.en: budou-chan confirms: the owner worked in Italian, Japanese and yakitori before opening in 2015; Honmachi 68, near the castle; the name honours a woman who ran a bread and grocery shop in Aboshi for 40 years; visits to Sri Lanka (not India); over 10 spices and the words "I worked it out in my head and made it edible". tanosu confirms 11 seats, a vegan tofu and bean curry developed for foreign tourists' dietary restrictions, and Awaji Island onions.

budou-chanは2018/10/18開業、清交倶楽部運営（Miketide.en: budou-chan confirms: opened 18 October 2018; run by Seiko Club (Miketide, Fukutei and others); 1F of the Daiwa Roynet Hotel; frontages on both the Route 2 side and the Miyuki-dori side. The official gorp site and Gurunavi confirm Himeji's famous conger eel, about 15 Harima local sakes always available, and Dr.Fry (a cooking machine that reduces oil absorption).

budou-chan・himeji-mitaiで2022年7月、ビエラ姫路（南駅.en: budou-chan and himeji-mitai confirm it opened in July 2022 in Viera Himeji (Minami-Ekimae-cho 125) as an Indian and Nepalese restaurant, with five spiciness levels, many sets and a mild Nepalese-style curry. Hot Pepper confirms over 20 curries (the original's "over 22" was wrong) and various tandoor-baked naans. The pre-opening notice in June 2022 is confirmed by budou-chan.

budou-chan・il-riccio.com公式が、みゆき通りで創業48年を.en: budou-chan and il-riccio.com confirm: it grew out of a natural-foods shop that reached 48 years on Miyuki-dori; moved to Gofukucho (Gofukucho 18) in November 2019 and restarted as a plant-based café and natural-foods shop; the owner teaches macrobiotic cooking; a 100% plant-based, organic policy; the name (hedgehog). Allergy-free is not guaranteed.

budou-chan・ramen-miyako公式で京都をテーマにしたラーメン京.en: budou-chan and the ramen-miyako official site confirm: Ramen Kyo (Miyako), a Kyoto-themed chain with shops in Kyoto, Hyogo, Nara and Shiga; next to the 2F ticket gates of Sanyo-Himeji Station; low-temperature-aged thin noodles and "Gion paitan"; chashu and a soft-boiled egg. Closed 6–16 October 2025 and reopened on 17 October as "Ekimen Ramen Kyo", introducing value sets such as ¥660.

budou-chan・tanosuで2023年7月14日、西二階町にごはんとプレ.en: budou-chan and tanosu confirm it opened on 14 July 2023 in Nishi-Nikaimachi as the second shop of Gohan to Plate Zigzag (Higashiyama), switching to obanzai. tanosu confirms Bizen ware inherited from the family home displayed on the shelves; kisspress confirms miso soup with three misos and daily dashi; ameblo confirms a 16-kind daily obanzai set meal (¥1,980 before tax) and that over 90% of customers are women.

budou-chan・食べログで、創業82年、店名は曽祖父が敬慕した勝海舟に由来.en: budou-chan and Tabelog confirm: 82 years in business; the name comes from Katsu Kaishu, admired by the founder's great-grandfather; once four shops, now one; tonkatsu and tonjiru are the specialties; TV appearances. Pork in the omurice is unconfirmed, so it is softened to "said to".

budou-chan（open-casaisola）はバーミリオン出身のシェフ、.en: budou-chan (open-casaisola) confirms: a chef from Vermillion; creative charcoal-grilled Italian with Ieshima seafood; opened in Shikama on 30 July 2020; the meaning of the name. kaitenheiten records the closure on 19 June 2026 and the move to Minami-machi on 3 July. Tabelog and Instagram (@casa.isola = 村角徳昭) confirm the new shop at Minami-machi 60-2, 86 m from Sanyo-Himeji Station, the 3 July opening and the chef's name.

choco0824で篠原秀和は秋田県にかほ市象潟町出身、イタリア18年、NOBU.en: choco0824 confirms Shinohara Hidekazu is from Nikaho, Akita Prefecture; 18 years in Italy; NOBU ARMANI; Zero Milano; Who's Who Chefs world TOP 100; and Ginza zero Tokyo. lemon8 confirms that Roberto Baggio and others frequented Zero Milano. tokai-tv confirms a lasagne of six layers of pasta + tomato, white sauce, Hatcho miso and soy sauce, and kinshachi-yokocho confirms the range including shirasu from Shinojima. The birthplace 'Nago / Akita' and 'Shikoji island' were errors and have been corrected. The etymology of the shop name Y = Japan + Italy has no source and was softened.

co-trip・amatsubo.com: 昭和39年(1964)創業、香林坊か.en: co-trip and amatsubo.com: founded Shōwa 39 (1964); moved from Korinbo to Kakinokibatake in 1984; several shops in the city. Oden wasn't originally on the menu but was added at customers' request and became the signature. The dashi is only bonito and kombu, seasoned with Noto salt and sake. Kurumabu, akamaki, scallop, winter kobako-crab oden, jibuni. Buys from Omicho. Aims to be 'a 100-year company'.

co-trip・公式によると、宮島の牡蠣専門店『牡蠣屋』が営む2号店のカフェ。看.en: According to co-trip and the official site, a café that is the second shop of Kakiya, a Miyajima oyster specialist. The signature is oil-marinated oysters made from rare premium oysters (about ¥800 in the shop / about ¥1,300 per jar). No background music, valuing quiet — 'the absence of sound is itself a value' — with views of ferries and oyster rafts from the terrace. Also a Setouchi lemon rare cheesecake.

coco-cacao.jp と kameoka-up.net によれば、白砂糖・.en: According to coco-cacao.jp and kameoka-up.net, a bean-to-bar chocolate shop in Nishinokyo Sanjobocho, Nakagyo-ku, Kyoto, with no white sugar or additives, gluten-free, and particular about organic cacao, integrated from choosing the cacao beans to manufacturing. International Chocolate Awards eight times. Also sells rice-flour cakes and vegan chocolate.

coil-japan公式・weekend-kanazawa: 金沢はこまち2F、.en: coil-japan official and weekend-kanazawa: 2nd floor of Kanazawa Hakomachi, near Omicho Market. An experiential creative Japanese restaurant where you build your own thin rolls, gunkan and tempura bowl from about 50 ingredients, and whisk matcha too. Okamochi set about ¥4,200 (5 kinds + tempura + matcha). Vegan/shojin and gluten-free courses (book via TableCheck). Renovated February 2026. *No firm statement on allergen safety.

corezo は砂糖・小麦粉不使用と27種のスパイス、五葷(ニンニク・ねぎ・らっ.en: corezo confirms no sugar or wheat flour and 27 spices, and a bean curry without the five pungent vegetables (garlic, green onion, rakkyo, garlic chives, asatsuki) (veg / macrobiotic / vegan / Muslim-friendly). weekend-kanazawa backs up the bean curry without the five and a new cacao & nut vegan curry. jinomon/hokuriku-curry back up that the owner studied curry for over 15 years, including in Canada, and opened in 2015 (the official site doesn't spell out the story). Allergy/GF is described only as the shop's own claim; safety is not asserted.

dainichi-nagano（2025/04）は大勧進・紫雲閣内の寺院カフェで.en: dainichi-nagano (April 2025) confirms a temple café in Daikanjin's Shiunkaku; the ¥1,500 shojin porridge set; Obuse chestnut sweets; the custom of choosing a monk's handwritten chopstick sleeve to take home; and a tatami room overlooking the main gate, main hall and lotus pond. Run by Izutsuya Tetsuji (from December 2024, per Daikanjin materials).

dancyu・タケマシュラン・食べログが、2015年10月開業、熊本出身・緒方博.en: dancyu, Takemashuran and Tabelog record the October 2015 opening, Hiroyuki Ogata from Kumamoto, about 10 years of French training (Huis Ten Bosch Hotel Europe), head chef of a bistro set, a Bib Gourmand within 2 years of opening, hamburger steak of aged Omi beef and Kagoshima pork, over 80 menu items, and Western food like a kappo where the ingredients come first.

deli-komaでイタリアで修業したオーナー・クレジット不可(現金のみ)・24.en: deli-koma confirms: an owner who trained in Italy; no credit cards (cash only); 24 seats (about 6 tables); simple yet authentic flavours that make the most of the ingredients; plenty of starters, meat and fish; nearest station Zenkoji-shita. There is no source for a Tuscan style or carpaccio, so softened or removed.

digistyle-kyoto（48193）が2024年11月開店・千本通（千本.en: digistyle-kyoto (48193) confirms the November 2024 opening on Senbon-dori (near Senbon-Demizu), dongpo-pork mazesoba by a Chinese chef, the first noodle choice at a Taiwan mazesoba specialist (whole-grain-blend medium-thick and wavy noodles), Kujo negi of the kind used by high-end ryōtei, triple-folate eggs from Tamba (Mizuho), and 10 kinds of seasoning. kyo-soku (notenki) confirms foam chicken paitan ramen, chāshū rice and Taiwanese beer.

discoverjapan・2nenzaka・ダイナースが、1948年祇園花見小.en: discoverjapan, 2nenzaka and Diners record that it began in 1948 as 'Tsubosaka' on Hanamikoji in Gion, loved by writers such as Tanizaki Jun'ichiro and by geiko and maiko; after closing in the early Heisei years it reopened in 1994 with a ten-seat counter in a renovated home on Ninenzaka; the okami Masako Mishina and family run it; beef stew with demi-glace prepared over two weeks; bite-size portions for maiko; and chazuke to finish.

e-cocooo・smilenavi・web-komachi・primelife.en: e-cocooo, smilenavi, web-komachi and primelifenet agree: opened June 2019; the owner moved from Tokyo; open Thursday to Saturday only; Nagano-grown (partly Hokkaido) wheat, wholemeal and rye flours; natural yeast from Nagano fruit and the owner's own pesticide-free wheat; home-grown strawberries; hard campagne loaves and vegan croissants.

e-sousyoku・公式・tanosu・kisspress・budou-cha.en: e-sousyoku, the official site, tanosu, kisspress and budou-chan confirm: 川原亜弥 moved from the beauty business to bread; opened in April 2010; it began with a partner's love of New York burgers (a past dream of studying in the US went unrealised); 20+ bagels from a Hokkaido Haruyutaka blend with Hoshino natural yeast; 100% Aussie beef burgers; being sustained by customers saying "delicious"; and the story of being "too handsome to show [a] face" before the second shop. A claim of a research trip to the US could not be verified and was corrected.

enishioumicho.gorp(公式)は『大口水産グループの直営店』である.en: enishioumicho.gorp (official) confirms: 'run directly by the Oguchi Suisan group'; blackthroat-seaperch hitsumabushi eaten three ways (wasabi soy → sea urchin + shiso / sesame → chazuke in a broth of the fish's bones); market 'extra' service. co-trip backs up a whole blackthroat seaperch and the bone-broth chazuke; weekend-kanazawa backs up the Kaisen Enishi bowl (about 13 kinds) and the step-by-step way of eating. The operator is corrected to Oguchi Suisan, not 'Okuguchi'.

everysoy.com（公式ブランド・メニュー・店舗ページ）は、京湯葉の老舗『.en: everysoy.com (official brand, menu and shop pages) says it is a soy café by the old Kyoto yuba maker 'Yubasho', made with carefully chosen fresh soy milk, serving rice-flour, dairy-free soy choux cream and soy tiramisu. A shop at Shijo-Karasuma (Tabelog EVERYSOY Shijo-Karasuma). Also featured on KBS Kyoto radio.

food-japonと近江町市場公式で、赤レンガの建物、ガラス張りの焙煎機、約2.en: food-japon and the Omicho Market official site confirm: a red-brick building; a roaster behind glass; about 20 house-roasted beans; the Higashide blend balancing acidity and bitterness; a pudding of egg, cream, milk and vanilla beans (sells out by evening); a 2022 collaboration with Lotte Choco Pie.

food-japon及びkanazawa.ccで、1988年創業、柿木畠、店主・.en: food-japon and kanazawa.cc confirm: founded 1988 in Kakinokibatake; owner Ishiguro Itaru; sashimi in wooden tubs; blackthroat seaperch; Tengumai straight from the brewery's mini tank; Kaga vegetables (Gorojima Kintoki, kinjisō, Kaga thick cucumber, Noto taro); local fish from Shinminato and Noto; drunken crab and winter yellowtail. Namerō and cured mackerel were not confirmed, so removed.

food-japon記事と公式店舗情報は約1世紀の卸業→2001年にし茶屋街に出.en: A food-japon article and the official shop information confirm: about a century as a wholesaler → a shop in the Nishi Chaya district in 2001, renovated November 2013; a townhouse opposite the geisha office; 'shitatari mochi' with a 3-day shelf life; lettering by the proprietress.

food-japon記事は1966年に宮島幸雄氏が金沢駅前で創業、金沢カレーのル.en: A food-japon article says it was founded in 1966 by 宮島幸雄 in front of Kanazawa Station, one of the roots of Kanazawa curry, with its black curry. A tacsp article confirms the M'za branch (15-1 Musashi-machi) has fewer items than the main shop, focuses almost entirely on Kanazawa curry, with pork cutlet curry as the signature, sold via a ticket machine (camembert and hayashi are not in this article).

food-japon記事はシアトル出身の夫とシアトルのコーヒー店で働いた日本人妻.en: A food-japon article confirms: run by a husband from Seattle and a Japanese wife who worked at a Seattle coffee shop; a renovated townhouse in Yoko-Yasue-machi; Seattle beans roasted in Kanazawa, 5 blends; a 1943 cash register in actual use; camera and sewing-machine decor; house-made BBQ pork sandwiches and carrot cake.

food-japon記事は上田穣氏が練り物メーカーで40年勤務・工場長、揚げたて.en: A food-japon article says 上田穣 worked 40 years at a fish-cake maker, as factory manager; freshly fried satsuma-age; 'raw kamaboko' rested a week. Searches (OIC Kanazawa, etc.) confirm Hirosaka Palace 1F, about 9 counter-only seats, queues before opening, and the Ageha set (about ¥1,500).

food-japon記事は屋号の由来(祖父が12人兄弟の8番目)・三代家族経営・.en: A food-japon article confirms the origin of the name (the grandfather was the 8th of 12 siblings), three generations of family running it, the third generation's training at Taihei Sushi (Nonoichi), and the film 'Inochi no Teisharyō' starring Yoshinaga Sayuri; kaz-ogawa confirms 68 years in business, the third generation, and a review calling it the most Kanazawa-like sushi shop.

fujiyaheigoro公式・thefujiyagohonjin・sheage.en: The fujiyaheigoro official site, thefujiyagohonjin, sheage and searches back up: the founding of the Fujiya honjin in 1648; the name Heigoro passed down the generations; visits by Itō Hirobumi and Fukuzawa Yukichi; the 1925 Western-style building; registered tangible cultural property in 1997; becoming THE FUJIYA GOHONJIN in 2006; and in 2012 moving from Patio Daimon to the Fujiya annex as the main shop. The anecdote of a shop looking ahead to reopening the inn was removed because its source (Yahoo) now returns 404.

gcjapanが牡蠣そば(澄んだ鶏ガラ+牡蠣煮干し・牡蠣ペースト・丸大醤油・北海.en: gcjapan confirms the oyster soba (clear chicken bones + oyster niboshi, oyster paste, Maruta soy sauce, Hokkaido-wheat medium-thin noodles, 6 seats + 1 table); noodlers (February 2025 article) confirms the oyster soba was discontinued and chūka soba (chicken → clear pork) and spring-onion ramen made standard, and an extra charge introduced for extra heat on the spicy mazesoba.

gcjapanで『らぁ麺とうひち出身の店主』、2026/5/18開業、ラーメン1.en: gcjapan confirms 'an owner from Ramen Touhichi', the 2026/5/18 opening, ramen ¥1,100 / 180 g, tsukemen ¥1,300 / 250 g, special ¥1,500 with four kinds of chāshū of a branded pork. kyotopi confirms the career (from Touhichi → manager of Raamen Suguru → a yakiniku restaurant → independent), no tabletop seasonings, an open kitchen with an L-shaped counter of about 10 seats, and a soup with thick umami. 'First disciple' and 'about 7 years' are in neither source and were removed.

gcjapan・kyoto-optionが、2010年開業、有名京都居酒屋を支え.en: gcjapan and kyoto-option report the 2010 opening, an owner who supported a famous Kyoto izakaya, oden served year-round, potato salad made with oden dashi, Nankan-age, daruma lanterns, about 20 seats, and ramen to finish.

gcjapan・kyotogourmetが、1968年創業、夫婦経営、『技』の暖.en: gcjapan and kyotogourmet record founding in 1968, run by a married couple, a noren reading 'craft', a long, narrow 'eel's bed' layout, 13 seats + a tatami room, a loin cutlet about 1.5 times the usual size, roughly cut cabbage, white-miso pork soup sharp with sansho, sauce made in front of you, about 7 kinds of sake, and spiny lobster and abalone by reservation.

gf-akane（小麦アレルギーのブロガー）が松本店のGF米系麺（玄米麺）と、通.en: gf-akane (a blogger with a wheat allergy) describes the Matsumoto shop's GF rice-type noodles (brown-rice noodles), usually boiled in the same pot as the wheat noodles but in a separate pot on request. The official samurai-noodle.jp states the roasted-miso brand (Sapporo, Shibuya, Azumino, Matsumoto), oriental-vegetarian options in Shibuya and Matsumoto, and rice-flour noodles. Tabelog confirms the address (Takamiya-kita 3-1), hours and closing on the third Wednesday. Safety for celiac diners is not guaranteed.

gibierto と web-komachi がホテル勤務14年超、2019年開.en: gibierto and web-komachi back up over 14 years working in hotels, opening in 2019, game venison dishes, Neapolitan pizza of a Shinshu + Italian wheat blend, a green exterior and about 24 seats. The venison steak sauce is described as a seasonal berry sauce.

goguynetで2023年12月8日開店・お溝筋商店街（二階町）、食べログで全.en: goguynet confirms the opening on 8 December 2023 in the Omizo-suji arcade (Nikaimachi); Tabelog confirms 11 seats (3 counter, two 4-person tables) and a weekday lunch (sashimi, tempura, chawanmushi, etc.). nomu220 confirms the ¥1,000 daily lunch and the story of being served bottled beer at the draft price when the draft ran out.

goguynet：2024年6月15日オープン、姫路城西側・船場川沿いの古民家を.en: goguynet: opened 15 June 2024; a renovated old house beside the Senba River, west of Himeji Castle; counter and garden with a view of the keep; only a chef's-choice lunch at ¥3,300 (tax included); pickles and dressings handmade.

goodnaturestation・kyotokurasu・lmaga・kyot.en: goodnaturestation, kyotokurasu, lmaga and kyotopi confirm: produced by Yuji Iwasaki, owner-chef of the two-Michelin-star 'VELROSIER'; bones of five kinds — duck, jidori, venison, beef and pork — + porcini / longan / tomato / dried shiitake; extra wontons (pork, onion, arrowhead, celery); a renewal on 13 May 2023 on GOOD NATURE STATION 2F; and a Bib Gourmand listing.

groovyjapanで『最初の店はシアトル』『日本で苦戦→インドネシア人留学生.en: groovyjapan confirms 'the first shop was in Seattle', 'struggled in Japan → an Indonesian student's question "only chicken?" was the turning point → halal certification from the Malaysia Halal Corporation', 'Ayam = chicken (Indonesian / Malay)', and 'owner Saifullah, a prayer space'. A web search supports owner Saifullah being a former teacher from Sri Lanka who came to Japan to study. japanhalal confirms the 4th halal-certified shop at Shijo-Karasuma, richness with a seafood aroma, finely chopped onion and spring onion, and no MSG.

h-megourmet.com が、うぐいすを1948年（昭和23年）に広島ラー.en: h-megourmet.com reports Uguisu as one of the three stalls that gave birth to Hiroshima ramen in 1948 (Showa 23), that the founder learned soup-making in Manchuria and then started a stall in Nakashinchi before moving to Nagarekawa, pork-bone-shoyu chūka soba, spring-onion chūka soba and oden, and late-night hours (20:00–26:00). A park-side blog supports a late-night bowl in Nagarekawa and a nostalgic taste.

himeji-festa（播州室津・吉田水産の直営店、グランフェスタ6番街、浜焼.en: Confirmed by himeji-festa (run directly by Yoshida Suisan of Banshu Murotsu; Gran Festa 6-ban-gai; hama-yaki), the official maruhou.owst.jp (hama-yaki at every seat; seasonal all-you-can-eat November–May; cooked from the tank after ordering) and himeji588 (¥1,000 oyster set plus free steamed oysters for an Instagram follow; Murotsu oysters).

himeji-spice・tanosu・kisspress・tekuteku が.en: himeji-spice, tanosu, kisspress and tekuteku confirm: the owner; experience at the cave café TEEDA; opened 13 July 2025; Honmachi 68, Himekoji 2F (an old house about 70 years old); the origin of the name; a 100% plant-based menu; taco rice ¥1,500; rice-flour and okara muffins; care for nut allergies (no almond flour); a bring-your-own tie-up with KUUHAKU COFFEE. Full GF or allergy safety is not asserted.

himeji588（2016）は店主金井千秋（千秋ママ）、母からの約6年前の継承.en: himeji588 (2016) confirms: the owner, 金井千秋 ("Mama"); took over from a parent about six years earlier; 8 seats; Tajima chicken slaughtered that morning; skewers from ¥130. The ma8coro blog records that hine-pon is pre-prepared so it comes out fast, and the grilled bone-in mature-hen thigh (no source says the shop originated it).

hiramipan.co.jp(公式)は2011年3月創業・2017年9月1日に.en: hiramipan.co.jp (official) confirms: founded March 2011; Hiramipan Co. established 1 September 2017; representative 平見高広; a renovated Taishō-era ironworks; 'I don't want to be just a bakery / like a picture-book author's books or a fashion designer's clothes, no uncool bread'; also runs a creperie, gallery and pizzeria. food-japon backs up the Ghibli-like exterior and croque madame / breakfast from 8 am.

hitosara は現店主・松下素久(1987年石川生)が京都・大阪の割烹で修業.en: Hitosara confirms the current owner 松下素久 (born 1987 in Ishikawa) trained at kappo restaurants in Kyoto and Osaka and carries on the previous generation's Kaga cuisine with a sibling; 25 seats; steamed dishes, soups and meat grilled on stone. gorp (official) backs up the previous owner's uncompromising devotion to flavour, daily market buying and the processes of simmering, resting and steeping. The 1979 founding and the previous owner's given name were not confirmed, so left vague.

hitosara: 店主・畑純平（1974年奈良生まれ）。学生時代のアルバイト調.en: hitosara: owner Hata Junpei (born 1974 in Nara). Started cooking in a student part-time job, qualified as a cook, managed restaurants, then went independent. A certified sake sommelier, with the house's own sake 'Ura Shinomine'. Yamato vegetables, Yamato chicken and local fish; assorted vegetable sashimi; live horse-mackerel sashimi.

hitosaraは日本料理・懐石/会席、上階のウイスキーバー、瀬戸内の魚、冬のふ.en: hitosara confirms: Japanese cuisine, kaiseki and banquet courses; a whisky bar upstairs; Seto Inland Sea fish; in winter, fugu (tessa), oysters, conger eel and duck hot pot. The years in business ("decades") and "over 100 dishes" could not be confirmed in sources, so each was softened.

hitosara人物ページ（生年月日・二代目・人柄）、magazine.hito.en: Confirmed by the Hitosara profile page (date of birth, second generation, personality), magazine.hitosara (about 50 years in business, i.e. since around 1970; raised in Shiso; over 20 years after training in Kyoto and Kobe; the family's own rice from Shiso), the official news/631 (wild conger eel 5–10 times the price; sewage-treatment risk; steaming), and favy (a Hyogo restaurant guide; Kansai TV's Yo-i Don).

hitosara店舗ページ（有本良・1985年兵庫・Hummingbird 20.en: Confirmed by the Hitosara shop page (有本良; born in Hyogo in 1985; joined in 2018 from Hummingbird 2000), the official site (the shop that originated anago-meshi; ginger in the sauce; grilled then steamed; 1 min walk from Omizo-suji), tanosu (fresh conger eel all year, rare even in the city; the original sauce brushed on and turned 2–4 times) and kisspress (12 years; three ways to eat it).

hotpepper と gnavi が城山公園内・1905年（明治38年）創業、.en: Hot Pepper and Gurunavi back up its location in Shiroyama Park, founding in 1905 (Meiji 38), the tradition that its name comes from Emperor Meiji's words 'What a view!', kaiseki of Shinshu ingredients, and room for up to 200 people.

intojapanwaraku・weekend-kanazawa: 店主・西村純.en: intojapanwaraku and weekend-kanazawa: owner Nishimura Junya trained 7 years at the famous 'Chikuwa' and opened in July 2022 in 'Toryanse KANAZAWA FOODLABO' in Katamachi (Kanazawa's first oden stand). The finishing dashi omelette is ¥600 (2 eggs, oden dashi only). The dashi is Rausu kombu + bonito + Ono soy sauce. House-made fish cakes with Kaga lotus root or red pickled ginger. The principle: 'precisely because we're a newcomer, the real flavour'.

irohado.com/en は1925年12月木曽（鬼無里）創業、パン・和菓子.en: irohado.com/en says it was founded in December 1925 in Kiso (Kinasa), switched from bread and Japanese sweets to oyaki in the 1960s; fourth-generation president 伊藤博武; about 130 employees; the Nakamise shop opened in May 2020; Grand Prix at the 75th Japan Food Selection (May 2024). shun-gate reports that a vegetable oyaki is hand-wrapped in about 20 seconds, a skill that takes about a year to learn; Oyaki Farm makes 8,000–14,000 a day; and the president's comment that they go well with beer and coffee.

irukara・reo-gourmet・boooonで確認：オーナー和田幸夫（松.en: Confirmed on irukara, reo-gourmet and Boooon: owner Wada Yukio (born in Matsumoto → Nagano; to Tokyo for interior design; scaffolder 6–7 years; hotel food service, then 4 years of lunches borrowing a bar's daytime → independent). Concept Mr Sunday Trip; the firm Sunday Retro Pudding (with cinnamon or Yawataya Isogoro shichimi); coffee jelly with Matsuda milk from a 100-year-old Omachi dairy; daily single-origin coffee.

iseshima 115013: 地元の魚介類を使った海鮮居酒屋、海鮮丼が人気、.en: iseshima 115013: a seafood izakaya using local seafood; the seafood bowl is popular; open at lunch, daytime drinking welcome; #solo diners very welcome. Tabelog 24015561: genres seafood, tempura, izakaya; seafood bowl, Ise lobster sashimi, premium nigiri.

it-marketing・ヒトサラ・検索で、安田忠正は1968年兵庫県生まれ、ホ.en: it-marketing, Hitosara and searches confirm: 安田忠正, born in Hyogo in 1968, cooked for professional baseball players at a hotel, then went independent with live cooking; Kiko Live Food runs Omotenashi Kikou, Bettei Tanikatsu and Senhime Chaya; listed in a 2016 Hyogo restaurant guide; chairs the Hyogo specialty products association. Tatsuriki's official site confirms the July 2024 opening on Egret's 4th floor.

ja.wikipedia は不室屋が慶応元年(1865)創業・久右衛門が尾張町に.en: Japanese Wikipedia confirms: Fumuroya was founded in Keiō 1 (1865); 久右衛門 settled in Owari-chō and the heir 六右衛門 began making fu; the name comes from Fumuro village; sudare-fu; over 150 years. co-trip backs up a townhouse in Higashiyama's Higashi Chaya district, tatami, gold leaf, the famous shiratama fresh fu (bean paste / kinako / mitarashi) and seasonal fresh-fu sweet soup.

jisyameguri・るるぶは、店主が名店『翁』のそば打ち名人・高橋邦弘の直弟.en: jisyameguri and Rurubu report that the owner is said to have learned from a direct disciple of the soba master of the famous 'Okina', in-house stone-milled pesticide-free buckwheat from Gunma, about 12 table seats, and lunch only until sold out. kyotopi introduces an inconspicuous frontage, duck seiro, grilled miso and winter sobagaki zenzai.

jouhou.nagoyaが昭和48年(1973)創業・北区清水・かき揚げ丼(特.en: jouhou.nagoya confirms founding in Showa 48 (1973), Shimizu, Kita-ku, kakiage-don (the tokujō with about twice the shrimp), serving in order of ordering rather than seating, closing when ingredients run out, and the 2019 Michelin Plate listing. The official tp-mitsumura site confirms the location at 3-19-18 Shimizu, Kita-ku and 'closes when the ingredients run out'.

jouhou.nagoyaで2024年5月9日開店・西区堀端町（筋違橋交差点南側.en: jouhou.nagoya confirms the opening on 9 May 2024, Nishi-ku (south side of a nearby crossing), the owner's Instagram @tsukasaorange, a jidori shoyu ramen of Nagoya Cochin and Kyo-Akajidori, house-made noodles and Seto pork chāshū. Tabelog reviews confirm a married couple running it on opening day and a queue of several people 20 minutes before opening (no mention of selling out).

jouhou.nagoyaは米粉100%・小麦不使用（生地もカスタードも）、北海.en: jouhou.nagoya says: 100% rice flour, no wheat (in both batter and custard); run by a rice farmer in Rankoshi, Hokkaido (the fifth generation of a farm); the parent shop in Hokkaido opened in March 2021, and the Nagoya stand in Osu on 7 February 2025. nhkomorebi reports no wheat, oats or buckwheat, and that a customer with a wheat allergy checked with staff and ate with peace of mind. Vegewel #2544 lists the GF menu, the Osu address, 10:00–20:00 and stand service.
