おから入り鶏つくねとお豆腐御膳.en: chicken tsukune with okara and a tofu set

おすすめの食べ方は、無料のごはんにチャーシューとおろしにんにくをのせ、醤油をひと.en: The recommended way to eat it: put chāshū and grated garlic on the free rice and drizzle on soy sauce. On the table are grated garlic, ichimi, soy sauce and cucumber pickles.

おでんと串カツ姫路のお店.en: Oden to Kushikatsu Himeji no Omise

おでんのだしは醤油・白だし＝小麦。練り物のつなぎにも小麦。品目・価格は当日の掲示.en: The oden dashi is soy sauce / shiro-dashi = wheat. Wheat in the fish-paste binders too. Items and prices per the day's posting.

おばんざいと地酒.en: obanzai home cooking and local sake

おばんざいや出汁には魚介・かつお出汁など動物性食材が使われることが多く、完全ヴィ.en: Obanzai and dashi often use animal ingredients such as seafood and bonito stock, so strict vegans need to consult in advance about customising.

おひたしのだし＝小麦醤油、かつお出汁。.en: The ohitashi dashi = wheat soy sauce and bonito stock.

おひとり様専門店.en: a shop just for solo diners

おまかせコースは事前相談でカスタマイズ可能（海外からのゲスト向けに神戸牛コース等.en: The chef's-choice course can be customised by consulting in advance (it has been changed to a Kobe beef course for guests from abroad, for example). Dietary restrictions may also be discussed if notified in advance.

おまかせセットの内容として掲載。餃子餡のつなぎと下味に小麦。単品価格は未公開。.en: Listed as part of the chef's-choice set. Wheat in the gyoza filling's binder and marinade. Single price not published.

おまかせランチ（¥3,300税込）— 旬の素材を少量多皿で盛り合わせたプレート形.en: Chef's-choice lunch (¥3,300 including tax): a plate of many small portions of seasonal ingredients. Pickles and dressings are all handmade.

おまかせ和食コースのため醤油・みりん・味噌など小麦含有調味料の使用が一般的に想定.en: As a chef's-choice Japanese course, seasonings containing wheat (soy sauce, mirin, miso) are generally expected, but no specific information on seasonings is disclosed on the official site or in reviews.

おみぞ筋商店街の地元向け蕎麦屋。英語メニューや英語対応スタッフの情報はなく、日本.en: A local soba shop in the Omizo-suji arcade. No information on an English menu or English-speaking staff; likely Japanese only.

おやき（野沢菜・なす・かぼちゃなど信州伝統の餡を包んだ蒸し焼き饅頭、常時20種類.en: Oyaki (steamed and grilled buns wrapped around traditional Shinshu fillings such as nozawana, eggplant and pumpkin; always more than 20 kinds) and Shinshu-made pickles.

おろしダレを使い和風に仕上げました.en: finished Japanese-style with a grated-daikon sauce

お前に店を譲る.en: I'm handing the shop over to you

お好きな担担麺＋鶏の唐揚げ2個＋ごはん小.en: any tantanmen + 2 pieces of fried chicken + small rice

お好みソース＝小麦。生地に小麦粉の可能性。.en: Okonomi sauce = wheat. The batter may use wheat flour.

お好み焼きには小麦・魚介由来のお好みソースが使われるのが一般的で、本品も例外では.en: Okonomiyaki generally uses an okonomi sauce derived from wheat and seafood, and this shop is presumably no exception. No information on a wheat-free sauce could be found.

お好み焼き＝小麦生地＋焼きそば麺＋お好みソース。小麦。.en: Okonomiyaki = wheat batter + yakisoba noodles + okonomi sauce. Wheat.

お好み焼き＝小麦生地＋焼きそば麺＋お好みソース。小麦。 イカ天は小麦の衣。.en: Okonomiyaki = wheat batter + yakisoba noodles + okonomi sauce. Wheat. Squid tempura has a wheat coating.

お好み焼き＝小麦生地＋焼きそば麺＋お好みソース。小麦。 チーズ＝乳。.en: Okonomiyaki = wheat batter + yakisoba noodles + okonomi sauce. Wheat. Cheese = dairy.

お好み焼き＝小麦生地＋焼きそば麺＋お好みソース。小麦。 ドリンク1杯＋ポテトサラ.en: Okonomiyaki = wheat batter + yakisoba noodles + okonomi sauce. Wheat. With one drink + potato salad. From a 2025-06 lunch announcement.

お好み焼き＝小麦生地＋焼きそば麺＋お好みソース。小麦。 明太子＝魚卵、チーズ＝乳.en: Okonomiyaki = wheat batter + yakisoba noodles + okonomi sauce. Wheat. Mentaiko = fish roe, cheese = dairy.

お好み焼き＝小麦生地＋焼きそば麺＋お好みソース。小麦。 生えび・イカゲソ・ホタテ.en: Okonomiyaki = wheat batter + yakisoba noodles + okonomi sauce. Wheat. With raw prawn, squid tentacles and scallop.

お子さんのいる女性店主のワンオペ.en: run single-handedly by a female owner who has children

お客さんが一口食べて『おいしい！』と喜んでくれる姿を見るのがうれしい.en: It makes me happy to see customers take one bite and light up, saying "Delicious!"

お客さんのほうがラーメンにくわしいんです.en: our customers know more about ramen than we do

お客さんのほうがラーメンにくわしいんです。こだわりのあるお客さんのアドバイスをた.en: Our customers know more about ramen than we do. We took in lots of advice from particular customers, and that became today's taste

お客様の好み・苦手なものなども出来る限り対応させていただいており.en: we accommodate guests' preferences and dislikes as far as we can

お寺の中にある静かな空間で、英語メニューや英語スタッフの記載なし。善光寺参拝客が.en: A quiet space inside a temple; no English menu or English-speaking staff recorded. The customers are mainly Zenkoji visitors.

お店の隣ではタイの食材や日用品を売っています.en: Next to the restaurant a shop sells Thai groceries and household goods

お昆布とお豆さんのチカラ.en: the power of kombu and beans

お湯で温めたそばに生卵が入った熱々の汁.en: soba warmed in hot water, in a piping-hot broth with a raw egg

お米パン／こめやパンは米・米油・メープル・塩・米種・酵母・お湯のみで焼く植物性の.en: The rice bread / Komeya bread is a plant-based food baked only with rice, rice oil, maple, salt, rice starter, yeast and hot water (rice bread is plant-based). The chiffon cake contains egg (chiffon contains egg).

お腹パンパン、ボリューム満点のランチ.en: a lunch so filling your stomach bursts

お茶の香りがふわっと香る.en: the scent of tea wafts up softly

お茶漬けの素・だしは醤油ベース。.en: The ochazuke base and dashi are soy-based.

お通しの山盛りキャベツ.en: a heaped plate of cabbage as the starter

お通しは大福、お持ち帰りもできます.en: The starter is a daifuku, and you can take some home

お酒にもごはんにも合います.en: goes with drinks and with rice

お食事に合わせた日本酒・ワインのペアリング付き。1〜8名様。.en: With a sake and wine pairing matched to the food. 1–8 guests.

かき揚げ丼。ぷりぷりの小海老をふんだんに使ったかき揚げは丼から溢れんばかりの肉厚.en: Kakiage-don. The kakiage, generous with plump small shrimp, is so thick it nearly overflows the bowl, with a sweet-savoury sauce and the aroma of sesame oil. The tokujō kakiage-don has about twice the shrimp.

かき揚げ＝小麦衣。そば＝小麦つなぎ＋打ち粉、つゆ＝小麦醤油。グルテンフリーではな.en: Kakiage = wheat batter. Soba = wheat binder + dusting flour; broth = wheat soy sauce. Not gluten-free.

かけ醤油＝小麦、かつお節＝非ヴィーガン。醤油抜きなら可の場合あり。.en: Soy sauce poured on = wheat, bonito flakes = not vegan. Sometimes OK without soy sauce.

かす中華そば.en: kasu Chinese soba (with crisp beef offal)

かつお出汁・魚介・鶏肉を使うメニューが同じ厨房で調理される。植物性のみへの対応に.en: Dishes with bonito dashi, seafood and chicken are cooked in the same kitchen. Nothing explicit about plant-only cooking.

かつお節を越前おろしそばのトッピングに使用しており、動物性食材を全メニューで使用.en: Bonito flakes top the Echizen oroshi soba, and animal ingredients are used in every item. Not vegan-friendly.

かつお節・生姜醤油が定番。要確認。.en: Usually bonito flakes and ginger soy sauce. Ask.

かつお節使用でヴィーガン不可。醤油は要確認。.en: Uses bonito flakes, so not vegan. Ask about the soy sauce.

かなめ金沢とことりっぷで、2004年開業、料亭穂濤が母体、料亭による甘味処は日本.en: Kaname Kanazawa and co-trip confirm: opened 2004, based on the ryotei Honami, said to be Japan's first sweets house run by a ryotei; pure kuzu noodles of finest Yoshino kuzu; Koichiro Koshikawa; a named grower for Gorojima Kintoki; earth walls a plasterer took about 3 months to finish and a single-slab table; borrowed scenery of Kanazawa Castle's stone walls and the Tatsumi canal; roasted stem tea (bōcha) included.

かに味噌甲羅焼き.en: crab miso grilled in the shell

かに面.en: crab 'face' (crab shell packed with meat, oden)

かぼちゃ、小麦粉、砂糖、大豆油、そば粉、食塩、酵母.en: pumpkin, wheat flour, sugar, soybean oil, buckwheat flour, salt, yeast

かまぼこのつなぎ、添え醤油＝小麦。.en: Kamaboko binder and the soy sauce served with it = wheat.

かまぼこは小麦でんぷんを含む製品あり。醤油も要確認。.en: Some kamaboko products contain wheat starch. Ask about the soy sauce too.

かまぼこは小麦デンプン、割下は醤油。.en: Kamaboko has wheat starch; the warishita is soy sauce.

かまぼこ・麩などの具は小麦。麩は純粋な小麦グルテン。.en: Toppings such as kamaboko and fu are wheat. Fu is pure wheat gluten.

からあげグランプリ金賞受賞.en: gold award at the Karaage Grand Prix

からくない汁あり担担麺＋おもちゃ.en: not-spicy tantanmen with broth + a toy

からだにも心にもやさしく、うれしい.en: kind and joyful to both body and mind

からだにやさしい旬をすべての人へ.en: seasonal food kind to the body, for everyone

がんもどきのつなぎに小麦粉・山芋を使うことが多い。.en: Ganmodoki often uses wheat flour and yam as a binder.

が判読できないため価格は空欄。小サイズ.en: can't be read, so the price is left blank. Small size

きこう公式・note・ヒトサラで、輝光ライブフードが運営、しらす丼は黒田官兵衛の.en: Kikou's official site, note and Hitosara confirm: run by Kiko Live Food; the whitebait bowl comes in a daimyo bowl shaped like Kuroda Kanbei's helmet (about 30 cm); Harima-nada whitebait (five rivers); Ibo no Ito somen and Himeji oden are served; Omotenashi Kikou was listed in a 2016 Hyogo restaurant guide.

きしめんは小麦100%の平打ち麺。.en: Kishimen is a 100% wheat flat noodle.

きしめんは平打ちの小麦麺.en: kishimen is a flat wheat noodle

きしめんは平打ちの小麦麺。.en: Kishimen is a flat wheat noodle.

きしめん＝小麦100%。名古屋名物の平打ち麺。.en: Kishimen = 100% wheat. Nagoya's signature flat noodle.

きたまち / 東大寺転害門近く・近鉄奈良駅北側（Kitamachi）.en: Kitamachi / near Tōdaiji's Tegaimon gate, north of Kintetsu Nara Station

きっこう公式が創作串揚げの先駆け店・四季折々の食材・ワイン/梅酒/焼酎・山陽姫路.en: Kikkou's official site confirms: a pioneer of creative kushiage; seasonal ingredients; wine, plum wine and shochu; 3 min walk from Sanyo-Himeji Station; counter plus tatami room. Being run by two people and "over ten years in business" rest on regulars' Tabelog reviews, so they are stated cautiously.

くずし割烹.en: kuzushi kappo (a relaxed take on fine Japanese cuisine)

くるまふ、ばい貝、赤巻、ふかし、厚揚げ、牛すじ.en: kurumafu, whelk, akamaki, fukashi, thick fried tofu, beef tendon

くるみと黒糖のみの菓子で通常は小麦・乳・卵なし。ただし同じ厨房で小麦菓子を焼いて.en: A sweet of walnuts and brown sugar only, normally with no wheat, dairy or egg. But wheat sweets are baked in the same kitchen, so traces are possible (celiacs should ask).

ぐるっぷは常時7〜8種類以上の生牡蠣と食べ比べセット、ガーリックバターソテーやア.en: gorp lists at least 7–8 kinds of raw oysters at all times with a tasting set, garlic-butter sauté, ajillo and a special oysters Rockefeller. A Home TV feature introduces it as a place to have raw oysters year-round, lunch included, saying the tasting itself is a precious experience for foreign visitors.

ぐるなびがお好み村4F、パリパリそば入り広島風お好み焼き、そば肉玉チーズ、おつま.en: Gurunavi confirms Okonomi-mura 4F, Hiroshima-style okonomiyaki with crisp soba, soba meat-and-egg with cheese, and everything from snacks to a finishing okonomiyaki.

ぐるなびで所在地『鈴木ビル1F』・名鉄瀬戸線東大手駅南口徒歩7分を確認。食べログ.en: Gurunavi confirms the location as Suzuki Building 1F, a 7-minute walk from the south exit of Higashi-Ote Station on the Meitetsu Seto Line. Tabelog and Hitosara confirm the street address in Higashi-ku and that it is an izakaya serving kushiage and oden. The main shop is in Izumi, Higashi-ku. The opening year is not confirmed in public sources.

ぐるなび・金沢ラボ・金沢日和で、『創業13年、昔ながらの喫茶店を目指して』のコン.en: Gurunavi, Kanazawa Lab and Kanazawa Biyori confirm: the concept 'founded 13 years ago, aiming to be an old-fashioned coffee shop'; coffee ground cup by cup; Viennese coffee; matcha/hojicha parfaits; cheesecake; zenzai; fine fresh sweets; second-floor window seats; 8 Japanese shaved ices in summer (about ¥900, ice and syrup separate). 'Stone-milled' could not be backed up, so removed.

ぐるなび等が丸の内・久屋大通の居酒屋で丸鳥の丸焼き（¥1,680）・生ビール（¥.en: Gurunavi and others confirm an izakaya on Hisaya-odori in Marunouchi with whole roast chicken (¥1,680), draft beer (¥390) and a Showa-retro atmosphere. A whole-roast-chicken course (6 dishes) is also ¥3,900.

ぐるなび（Gnavi）が、店名『三箆』は三枚のヘラが重なるロゴに由来し、店主は有.en: Gurunavi (Gnavi) introduces: the name 'Mihera' comes from a logo of three overlapping spatulas; the owner trained at a famous Hiroshima okonomiyaki shop; the noodles are spread on the griddle, crisped in lard and finished with garlic powder; the signature Mihera-yaki, tantan okonomiyaki and crispy potato salad; red (kimchi), black (curry / cheese) and white (cream / cheese) topping sets; teppan dishes such as lotus root in butter and garlic shrimp; and counter seats with griddles.

ぐるなび（西二階町65・扉ビル1F・14席）と食べログのレビュー（大将と奥様のお.en: Gurunavi (Nishi-Nikaimachi 65, Tobira Bldg 1F, 14 seats) and Tabelog reviews (hospitality from the chef-owner and a partner, Edomae nigiri, hidden scoring cuts, seasonal ingredients such as mackerel, sea urchin and matsutake, a long-standing shop loved by Himeji notables) support each statement. The chef-owner's real name is not public.

こだわりの生パスタ（明太子クリーム紫蘇パスタ、昔ながらの鉄板ナポリタンなど）とふ.en: Carefully made fresh pasta (mentaiko cream shiso pasta, old-fashioned hot-plate Napolitan and more) and fluffy pancakes.

こだわり出汁の金沢おでん.en: Kanazawa oden in a carefully made dashi

ことりっぷとfood-japonで、1957年大塚太蔵造氏創業、二代目正治→三代.en: co-trip and food-japon confirm: founded 1957 by 大塚太蔵造, second generation 正治 → third generation 正樹; the origin of hanton rice (1960s, recreating a dish from training days in Tokyo / 'Han' = Hungary + 'ton' = French for tuna / the spread-out egg on top became a talking point); 70–80% of customers order it, with queues; 正治's words, 'what matters is to keep carefully making good food'.

ことりっぷと公式コンセプトページで、店主森島幹裕（いわき市から避難）、2014年.en: co-trip and the official concept page confirm: owner 森島幹裕 (evacuated from Iwaki City); opened 2014; fully plant-based with no meat, egg, dairy or animal fat; Kaga vegetables; vegan veggie-combo lunch; soy-meat ginger pork and burgers; Ise Hikari rice; Tomo Farm / Eco Farm Okuno; 2–3 kinds of rice-flour gluten-free vegan muffins a day (sell out at once); logo by Sarah Williams (Cirque du Soleil's Viva Elvis).

ことりっぷ・iいじ金沢・週末金沢と検索で、1964年香林坊で創業（現社長の両親）.en: co-trip, Iiji Kanazawa, Shūmatsu Kanazawa and searches confirm: founded 1964 in Korinbo (by the current president's parents), moved to Kakinokibatake in 1984; at first two entrances and two signboards, a diner and a Western restaurant, with oden added later at customers' request; Kanazawa Oden 50-Year Shops Association (local ingredients, all year); kurumabu and daikon; a clear dashi of kombu and bonito with Noto salt and sake.

The Atelier Shion page confirms the 'Maimaiko delivery' pick-up service for those who can't come to Kusatsu, and prices for rice-flour chiffon cake, rice-flour bread and baked goods. bm-peekaboo mentions a rice-flour whole-cake decorating experience. No owner name can be found.

PR TIMES 000000135 supports the Gâteau au Comté sale on 14 April 2025.

エスパシオ公式とエスパシオエンタープライズのプレスリリースが、永田功の経歴（19.en: Espacio's official site and an Espacio Enterprise press release support Nagata Isao's career (born in Gifu in 1972; Castle Plaza at 18; head chef of Castle Plaza in 2009; head chef of Nagoya Castle hotel in 2013; head chef of Kuretake at Nagoya Kanko Hotel in November 2020; Japanese-cuisine head chef in January 2022; head chef of Jo in 2025; Aichi outstanding skilled worker = Aichi Master Craftsman in 2022; in charge of Japanese food at the State Guest House at Expo 2005), as well as supervision by Sasaki Hiroshi (Gion Sasaki), 'learning from the old to know the new', and the origin of Jo = castle. gourmetpress lists a special ¥40,000 Sasaki Hiroshi event on 26 July 2026.

エスパシオ／一休のレストラン紹介ページが総料理長・片桐優樹の経歴（北海道出身、2.en: The Espacio / Ikyu restaurant pages give head chef Katakiri Yuki's career (from Hokkaido; joined Ukai in 2004; Ginza Ukai-tei → TEPPAN Cuisinier; Omotesando Ukai-tei; 2017–2024 teaching in Kaohsiung, Taiwan / THE UKAI TAIPEI; back in Japan 2024; head chef of Shoryu 2025). PR TIMES confirms the first domestic consulting contract, UKAIzm (founded April 2025), the 1 October 2025 opening, the origami motif and the Nagoya Castle view; Tabelog confirms three cuts of Ukai premium beef, black abalone liver risotto and a sommelier on staff.

オイル漬けの下味に醤油を使う店が多い。要確認。.en: Many shops use soy sauce to season oil-marinated items. Ask.

Opened Pivote in Shikemichi on 28 August 2014. Teppan French centred on Ozaki beef from Ozaki Farm in Miyazaki; about 17 seats.

オーガニックのオリジナルブレンドコーヒーと、パルメザン・クリームチーズを使い自家.en: An organic original-blend coffee and a house-made cheesecake of Parmesan and cream cheese with house-made blueberry sauce. For light meals, a tomato curry of chicken thigh and mushroom and a risotto of red rice, spinach, soy milk, miso and olive oil are known.

オーナーシェフが食材の質に強いこだわりを持ち、三重県産有機農園野菜・三河湾の鮮魚.en: The owner-chef is exacting about ingredient quality, using select produce with stated origins such as organic farm vegetables from Mie, fresh fish from Mikawa Bay and Nagoya Cochin. The menu is highly transparent.

The space, a renovated townhouse built in 1941 (Showa 16) on the Shikemichi street in Nishi-ku, has a warm, wood-based feel that keeps the original fittings.

Then set up in a remodelled old house among the old streets of Shikemichi, Nagoya's historic district, and has for many years served original Japanese cuisine fusing French technique with the spirit of kaiseki.

オーナーシェフは東京のイタリアンレストランで長年修業を積んだ後、故郷の播磨地域に.en: The owner-chef trained for many years at Italian restaurants in Tokyo, then returned to the Harima region and opened this bistro on 12 April 2023 on the 3rd floor of the Artemis Building in Tatemachi. Fully vegan, gluten-free and nut-free. On 1 July 2023 it moved from Mochiidono to a townhouse in Higashi-Kido-cho and reopened, run by sisters.

Besides regular wheat cakes, it makes allergy-friendly, gluten-free cakes with rice flour from 朝日製粉所. Introduced as the pâtissier who devised the original Japanese-style sweets.

カウンター中心の活気ある居酒屋スタイルで、英語メニューや英語対応スタッフの情報は.en: A lively, counter-centred izakaya; no information on an English menu or English-speaking staff. Service is likely in Japanese only.

The owner, Mr./Ms. Ueshima, cleaned and restored the empty house personally and made a student-days dream of a shop come true. The speciality is the 'Kanakana meal', one price all day. A cheesecake steamed for about 3 hours and unchanging coffee from milou, a roaster in Gifu, are famous, and as a pioneer of the Naramachi townhouse-café boom it draws lines from weekday mornings.

Its concept combines pesticide-free and low-pesticide vegetables direct from local farmers with traditional Brazilian dishes, and its retro, cute interior makes it easy to enter even for a woman on her own.

Specialities are the feast set, the Koyomi bowl, and vegan, gluten-free sweets of house-made rice flour with no dairy, egg or white sugar. Open only for lunch Wednesday to Friday, but flexible on request.

With the concept "a place where people connect and both mind and body get healthier", it serves handmade lunches with seasonal vegetables from the local organic farmers' group Himeji Yuuki Yasai no Kai, and additive-free snacks.

ヒトサラが、店主・吉野恭生（1981年広島生まれ、学生時代のアルバイトでお好み焼.en: Hitosara reports owner Yasuo Yoshino (born in Hiroshima in 1981, captivated by okonomiyaki through a student part-time job) trained at famous Hiroshima shops and a Tokyo teppanyaki restaurant and opened in Kami-Hatchobori in November 2019; keeps the traditional Hiroshima taste using Isono Seimen and Otafuku; specialties Yatsunami-yaki, salt kōne and the most-reordered simmered pork-cartilage tendon. Tabelog confirms Kami-Hatchobori (174 m from Shukkeien-mae tram stop) and 21 seats in all at the teppan counter and tables.

ヒトサラとパープルによると、店主は高知県出身の上村政雄氏で、奈良の無国籍料理店や.en: According to Hitosara and Purple, owner Kamimura Masao, from Kōchi Prefecture, opened in Naramachi in 2017 after about 20 years at Nara fusion restaurants and cafés, and moved to Kitamachi (near the women's university) on 20 September 2022. Eggs from Ōmiya Farm in Kashihara and Igeta soy sauce from Inoue Honten; after the move, the rice changed to Hitomebore. The signature is a lemon-butter-soy omurice.

ヒトサラによると、店主・長島正典は1969年愛知県生まれ、和食料理人の家に育ち、.en: According to Hitosara, owner Masanori Nagashima was born in Aichi Prefecture in 1969, grew up in a family of Japanese-cuisine cooks, and has cooked for over 40 years. Has gone to Yanagibashi Market every day for over 30 years, buying with a personal eye. Chooses wines by personally visiting Californian wineries (Beringer and others). After running the shop under its old name for about 20 years, moved to the ia Building in Marunouchi and renamed it. A5 wagyu and black-truffle rice are the specialties.

ヒトサラによると店主は呉市出身で、以前イタリアン店『夢跡人食道』を12年営んだ経.en: According to Hitosara, the owner is from Kure and previously ran an Italian restaurant for 12 years. Japanese × Italian, oysters from Kure (Ondo) and Osaki, white-grilled anago and T-bone confirmed. The owner's name is not public, so chef_name is null.

ヒトサラに寄稿した推薦シェフは「カジュアルながらも非常に繊細で美味しい。関東の有.en: A recommending chef writing for Hitosara says: 'Casual yet very delicate and delicious. The seasonal menus made by a chef trained at famous Kantō restaurants, and the careful preparation down to the details, are felt throughout.'

ヒトサラのシェフ紹介（person.html）で1982年岐阜生まれ、辻調卒、神.en: Hitosara's chef profile (person.html) confirms born in Gifu in 1982, a Tsuji graduate, Kobe → Taverna Visconti in Nagoya, training in the Veneto and the Marche, THE CUPS, and opening in February 2019. The shop page confirms game (from Gero and Gujo) butchered in-house, squid-ink spaghetti, venison cappelletti, venison ragù pappardelle and a designer space with hand-painted murals. The seat count could not be determined.

ヒトサラの人物ページによれば、藤原光章は1969年12月愛知県生まれ、大阪の日本.en: According to Hitosara's profile page, Fujiwara Mitsuaki was born in Aichi Prefecture in December 1969, trained for 16 years at the Japanese restaurant Sakuichi in Osaka, opened Fujiwara in 2004, and moved and renovated in 2016. Signatures are wild eel grilled two ways, amadai steamed wakatake-style and a seasonal sashimi platter, with over 100 dishes in the repertoire. A gourmand blog records a menu without prices and a 2024 visit at about ¥18,480.

ヒトサラの店舗ページが、店主・里中定弘(1970年10月生まれ、鳥羽市出身)、ホ.en: The Hitosara shop page confirms the owner, 里中定弘 (born October 1970, from Toba City), 18 years of training at hotels and izakaya, the owner's 72-year-old mother, a working ama diver, who supplies the shellfish, and live-fish sashimi chosen from the tank.

ヒトサラの料理人紹介は前多学(1980年生・石川県出身)が割烹たけしで約10年修.en: Hitosara's chef profile says Maeda Manabu (born 1980, from Ishikawa) trained about 10 years at Kappo Takeshi → a fishmonger → independent in August 2018. The official site (gorp) confirms 6–7 kinds of sashimi, blackthroat seaperch, salt-style stewed beef tendon (most popular) and private hire for 20.

ヒロシマ平和メディアセンターは、グアテマラシティ生まれ（1963年）・内戦体験・.en: The Hiroshima Peace Media Center reports in detail: born in Guatemala City (1963), civil-war experience, training in New Orleans, marrying Makiko, a native of Hiroshima, in Honolulu, the 1995 move to Hiroshima, opening in Yokogawa in 2000, and the world map and peace message. 4travel reports the training at Hassho in Yagenbori and selection for the Michelin Hiroshima Bib Gourmand.

ビジュアルは真っ黒だが、スープは見た目に反してあっさりとしており、鶏の旨味がたっ.en: It looks jet black, but the soup is described as surprisingly light for its looks, full of chicken umami.

ビスクやアメリケーヌはブール・マニエ（小麦＋バター）でとろみをつけることがある。.en: Bisque and américaine are sometimes thickened with beurre manié (wheat + butter).

ビストロシェフがつくる本格フレンチの惣菜。ドレッシングの成分は要確認。.en: Authentic French deli food made by a bistro chef. Ask about the dressing ingredients.

ビターブレンド（深煎り）／マイルドブレンド（中煎り）.en: bitter blend (dark roast) / mild blend (medium roast)

ビッグマウンテン カフェ＆ファームは奈良きたまちの健康・美容志向カフェ。健康をブ.en: Big Mountain Cafe & Farm is a health- and beauty-minded café in Nara Kitamachi. Rather than treating health as a fad, it serves food that's kind to the body, safe, low-calorie and high-protein. It uses house-made salt koji and soy-sauce koji and sprouted fermented brown rice, with vegetables from its own farm and contract farmers nationwide. The signature is the monthly 'gluten-free beauty set meal' (about ¥2,800, about 15 a day). All sweets are gluten-free, and there are vegan dishes of soy meat and jackfruit and dishes of Hawaiian origin.

ビーフをベースに約20種のスパイスを調合し、一から出汁を取って弱火でじっくり牛肉.en: A labour-intensive curry: about 20 spices blended on a beef base, stock made from scratch and simmered slowly on low heat until the beef dissolves, then rested — at least three days to finish. All meat and vegetables are domestic. Signature dishes include the 'Gariber Special Curry' with prawn, octopus, squid, bacon, mushroom and aubergine, and the 'Mountain Bounty Special' loaded with bacon, aubergine and mushroom.

ビールは大麦麦芽＝グルテン。モレッティ680円、本日のビール650円。.en: Beer is malted barley = gluten. Moretti ¥680, beer of the day ¥650.

ビール・ハイボールを含むため麦芽・大麦。.en: Includes beer and highballs, so malt and barley.

ビール＝麦芽。385円〜。中瓶ラガー赤星は748円。.en: Beer = malt. From ¥385. Akaboshi lager, medium bottle ¥748.

ビール＝麦芽。グルテン含有。価格の記載なし。.en: Beer = malt. Contains gluten. No price listed.

ビール＝麦芽。グルテン含有。食べログのドリンクタブに価格の記載なし。.en: Beer = malt. Contains gluten. No price on Tabelog's drinks tab.

ピカーニャ（ブラジル式300gステーキ）、ムケッカ（ブラジル伝統のココナッツミル.en: Picanha (a Brazilian-style 300 g steak), moqueca (a traditional Brazilian seafood stew based on coconut milk), and a beef-tongue curry lunch using tongue from the sister shop

ファミリーマート JA大北大町運動公園店.en: FamilyMart (JA Daihoku, Omachi Sports Park branch)

フィッシュカレー・チキンカレー・ベジタブルカレーなど本格スリランカカレー、パパド.en: Authentic Sri Lankan curries such as fish curry, chicken curry and vegetable curry; papad; falooda (dessert)

フォアグラとローストビーフ、ウニとイクラの冷製パスタ、ホールチーズクリームパスタ.en: Small plates devised by a French-trained chef, such as foie gras with roast beef, chilled pasta with sea urchin and salmon roe, and pasta in cream from a whole cheese

フォアグラ・バター・生クリームなど動物性食材がメニューの中核を担っており、ヴィー.en: Animal ingredients such as foie gras, butter and fresh cream are central to the menu, so separating vegan dishes is judged difficult. No official allergy information.

フライ＝パン粉、カレールウ、麺＝すべて小麦。看板オススメ。.en: Fried item = breadcrumbs, curry roux and noodles = all wheat. The shop's top recommendation.

フランス懐石のおまかせコースにつき、小麦（フランス料理の技法に由来するソースや揚.en: A French-kaiseki omakase course, so cross-contamination risk from wheat (sauces and frying batters from French technique) cannot be ruled out.

フレンチが主体のため通常の醤油使用は低いと考えられるが、野菜テリーヌのポシェに和.en: Being mainly French, regular soy sauce use is thought to be low, but Japanese dashi (bonito-based) is used to poach the vegetable terrine, so wheat in dashi-type seasonings cannot be ruled out.

フレンチベースのため醤油使用は限定的と思われるが、和風アレンジ料理（串焼き等）で.en: As the cooking is French-based, soy sauce use is probably limited, but whether tare or soy sauce is used in Japanese-style dishes (skewers etc.) is unconfirmed.

フレンドフーズ下鴨店.r: ふれんどふーずしもがもてん

フロランタンの土台は小麦のサブレ生地。乳・ナッツ。テイクアウト表では¥330。.en: The florentine base is a wheat sablé dough. Dairy, nuts. ¥330 on the takeaway list.

ブラックのコーヒーは豆と湯のみで小麦も動物性材料も含まない。ミルクを入れる場合は.en: Black coffee is just beans and hot water, with no wheat and nothing animal. With milk, dairy.

ブレンドの中身は要確認（麦入りの可能性）。.en: Ask what is in the blend (may contain barley).

ブロガーは外観を「銭湯みたい」と表現し、店内のレトロな食品サンプルや看板に「懐か.en: A blogger described the exterior as "like a public bath" and wrote of being "completely wrapped in nostalgia" by the retro food samples and signs inside.

ブログ(an-alcott)と名古屋めしが、丸の内駅徒歩5分・カウンター6席＋テ.en: A blog (an-alcott) and Nagoya Meshi support: 5 minutes on foot from Marunouchi Station, 6 counter seats + tables, queues before opening, salt kakiage-don as the signature, a choice of salt, tsuyu or miso, a tasting set at about ¥1,300, and a changing daily whim bowl (Hida beef tomato-salt beef bowl and others).

ブログレポートによると、開店直後から常連客が多く訪れ、予約が取りにくい状況が続い.en: A blog report says many regulars came from just after opening and it has stayed hard to get a reservation.

ブログ・ホットペッパー等によると、栄の中日ビル地下で40年以上営業した炭火うなぎ.en: According to blogs, HotPepper and others, a charcoal eel specialist that ran for over 40 years in the basement of the Chunichi Building in Sakae. With the Chunichi Building's demolition (2019), it moved to Marunouchi in April 2019. 45 years in business, grilling over charcoal with a topped-up sauce. The weekday-lunch eel bowl is affordable at about ¥1,050.

プリトミは近鉄奈良駅から北へ徒歩約10分、きたまち・法蓮町にある小さな喫茶。20.en: Pleased To Meet Me is a small café in Horen-cho, Kitamachi, about 10 minutes' walk north of Kintetsu Nara Station. Opened on 1 March 2017, it's a café, bar and record shop with a Shōwa-retro feel. The speciality is falafel (pita sandwich or plate), a meat-free dish with fried eggplant, tomato and lettuce. The weekend vegetable curry often sells out, and there's craft beer and house-made ginger ale too.

ベジタリアンカレーオプションの存在がTabelog上で言及されており、植物性食材.en: A vegetarian curry option is mentioned on Tabelog, which could be a starting point for eating that prioritises plant ingredients.

ベジタリアン・ビーガンメニューにも柔軟に対応.en: flexible with vegetarian and vegan menus too

ベジタリアン・ビーガン対応メニューを用意し、油控えめ・野菜中心の調理を掲げている.en: Offers vegetarian and vegan menus and promotes vegetable-centred cooking light on oil.

ベジタリアン（菜食主義者）の料理もご用意可能です。.en: Vegetarian dishes can also be prepared.

ベーコンの加工に小麦の可能性。味付けを要確認。.en: Bacon processing may involve wheat. Ask about the seasoning.

ベースがブランデーか焼酎かで異なる。要確認。.en: Depends on whether the base is brandy or shōchū. Ask.

ベースの焼酎が麦焼酎なら不可。銘柄要確認。.en: Not OK if the base shōchū is barley shōchū. Ask the brand.

ベースの甲類焼酎が麦原料のことがある。要確認。.en: The base kōrui shōchū is sometimes made from barley. Ask.

ベースの甲類焼酎は蒸留のためグルテン不含とされるが、原料は要確認。.en: The base kōrui shōchū is said to be gluten-free because it is distilled, but ask about the raw material.

ベーススープは牛骨出汁であるため、同じ鍋・調理器具で野菜具材を調理する場合、ビー.en: The base soup is beef-bone stock, so vegetables cooked in the same pot or with the same utensils are not vegan.

ペコマグが7店舗目・中四国初出店、平和公園近くのHiroPa、薪窯450℃約1〜.en: Pekomagu confirms the 7th shop and first in Chugoku-Shikoku, HiroPa near Peace Park, a wood-fired oven at 450 °C for about 1–1.5 minutes, the Bismarck (cream cheese / egg / cheese / cured ham), ricotta pancakes, and local sourcing and handmade cooking.

ホイル包みなので鉄板との接触は少ない。バター・醤油の有無を要確認。.en: Wrapped in foil, so little contact with the griddle. Ask about butter and soy sauce.

ホイル包み焼きなので鉄板との接触は少ない。バター・醤油の有無を要確認。.en: Cooked wrapped in foil, so little contact with the griddle. Ask about butter and soy sauce.

ホットペッパーが薬研堀の中華そば店として、細麺の醤油スープ（濃厚なのにあっさり）.en: HotPepper introduces it as a chūka soba shop in Yagenbori: thin noodles in shoyu soup (rich yet light), carefully made pork chāshū, and the signature grilled shumai (grilled instead of steamed, takeaway available). An Ameblo blog reports the switch during COVID from the former pork-bone salt ramen to mainly chūka soba, and a gentle, slightly sweet taste as a finishing bowl.

ホットペッパーグルメが味のやまもとを鳥羽駅徒歩5分の店主営業の居酒屋と紹介し、地.en: Hot Pepper Gourmet introduces Aji no Yamamoto as an owner-run izakaya 5 minutes' walk from Toba Station and confirms seasonal ingredients from the local market, the famous mackerel shiokara, and a free pick-up service within 4–5 km.

ホットペッパーグルメが弁慶を鳥羽駅近く(鳥羽2-1-15)の町中華、ランチ1,0.en: Hot Pepper Gourmet confirms Benkei as a town Chinese diner near Toba Station (Toba 2-1-15), lunch ¥1,000–1,999. Individual menu items rely on the Tabelog listing.

ホットペッパー等によると、2022年9月28日、愛知県体育館1階にオープンした土.en: According to HotPepper and others, a café open Saturdays and Sundays, opened on 28 September 2022 on the 1st floor of the Aichi Prefectural Gymnasium. In the Nagoya Castle area, family-friendly with a full kids' space. Fresh pasta such as mentaiko cream shiso pasta and hot-plate Napolitan, plus fluffy pancakes, are the signatures.

ホテル勤務時代にプロ野球選手向けの食事を担当。時間が経った料理は美味しくないと痛.en: Cooked meals for professional baseball players while working at a hotel. Feeling keenly that food left standing loses its flavour, made "live cooking in front of the customer" the core of the restaurant.

ホテル日航奈良3階（JR奈良駅西口直結）の和食処よしの。四季折々の会席・和食を「.en: Yoshino, the Japanese restaurant on the 3rd floor of Hotel Nikko Nara (directly connected to JR Nara Station's west exit). It serves seasonal kaiseki and Japanese dishes as 'fine dishes woven from carefully chosen ingredients and a hospitality that spares no effort', with a Nara local sake tour (3 to 6 kinds).

ホルモンだれは通常醤油・味噌ベース＝小麦。.en: Offal sauce is usually soy- and miso-based = wheat.

ホルモンだれ＝醤油／味噌＝小麦。.en: Offal sauce = soy sauce / miso = wheat.

ホワイトソースは小麦粉のルー。乳。.en: White sauce is a wheat-flour roux. Dairy.

ボカロスは、奈良市内でスペイン料理店『Gentry（ジェントリー）』を営んでいた.en: Bocarroz is a craft burger and tapas bar opened independently in Hanashiba-cho, Kitamachi, in April 2021 by an owner who had run the Spanish restaurant 'Gentry' in Nara City and closed it in March 2021. Drawing on a background as a Spanish-cuisine chef, it pairs burgers with Spanish small plates in a style all its own.

ボトム生地に珈琲豆を使用しふわりと香る、と店の説明。ボトム生地はビスケット＝小麦.en: Coffee beans are used in the base so it is gently fragrant, the shop says. The base is very likely biscuit = wheat. Ask.

ポン酢および煮込みだれ＝醤油＝小麦。.en: Ponzu and the simmering sauce = soy sauce = wheat.

ポン酢に小麦醤油が入ることが多い。要確認。.en: Ponzu often contains wheat soy sauce. Ask.

ポン酢は醤油製品＝小麦。.en: Ponzu is a soy-sauce product = wheat.

ポン酢・醤油＝小麦の可能性。かつお節が乗ればヴィーガン不可。.en: Ponzu and soy sauce may contain wheat. With bonito flakes on top, not vegan.

ポン酢併用＝小麦醤油。レモスコ単体は広島名物の唐辛子レモン酢。.en: With ponzu = wheat soy sauce. Remosco alone is Hiroshima's famous chilli-lemon vinegar.

ポン酢／三杯酢に醤油＝小麦。.en: Soy sauce in the ponzu / sanbaizu = wheat.

ポン酢／煮汁＝小麦醤油。.en: Ponzu / simmering liquid = wheat soy sauce.

マカロンは通常アーモンドプードル＋卵白で小麦粉不使用だが、店の表示がないため要確.en: Macarons are usually almond flour + egg white with no wheat flour, but the shop gives no labelling, so ask. Dairy, egg, nuts.

マクロビ商品等のこだわり食品.en: particular foods such as macrobiotic products

マゴワヤサシイ.en: magowayasashii (a mnemonic for beans, sesame, seaweed, vegetables, fish, mushrooms and tubers)

マスカルポーネたっぷりの手作りティラミス.en: hand-made tiramisu with plenty of mascarpone

マヨネーズは通常GFだが、市販品と和え調味料を要確認。.en: Mayonnaise is usually GF, but ask about the commercial product and the dressing seasonings.

マヨネーズ・ソース類。小麦の可能性が高い。.en: Mayonnaise and sauces. Very likely wheat.

マヨネーズ＝卵。在庫状況は店に確認を。.en: Mayonnaise = egg. Check availability with the shop.

マヨネーズ＝卵。市販マヨ・調味料に小麦の可能性。在庫状況は店に確認を。.en: Mayonnaise = egg. Commercial mayo and seasonings may contain wheat. Check availability with the shop.

マヨ・ソース類使用の可能性が高い。要確認。.en: Very likely uses mayo and sauces. Ask.

ミキモト真珠島公式が、御木本幸吉の生家であるうどん屋『阿波幸』の店名を受け継ぎ、.en: The Mikimoto Pearl Island official site states that it takes the name of the udon shop 'Awako', Mikimoto Kōkichi's birthplace, and serves akoya pearl-oyster adductors, normally on the market only in winter, all year round. A Tabelog review confirms the pearl plate (Ise udon and adductor dishes) and the view of Toba Bay.

ミツワお好みソースちょい辛.en: Mitsuwa okonomi sauce, a little spicy

ミニサーモン山かけ丼.en: mini salmon bowl with grated yam

ミニマグロ山かけ丼.en: mini tuna bowl with grated yam

ムサカはキッシュのように切り分けて提供され、ヨーグルトソースとの組み合わせで「コ.en: The moussaka is cut and served like a quiche, and with the yoghurt sauce it is said to 'gain depth'. The meat dishes are always grilled over charcoal.

ムスリムの方が安心して広島を観光できるよう、店内に礼拝スペースを無償で提供してい.en: So that Muslim visitors can sightsee in Hiroshima with peace of mind, a prayer space in the shop is offered free of charge (during opening hours, except 12:00–13:00; calling ahead is recommended).

ムスリム向けに無料の礼拝スペースを提供している。.en: Offers a free prayer space for Muslims.

メニューでグルテンフリーでもあります.en: it's gluten-free on the menu too

メニューに醤油の記載なし。イタリアン主体の調理のため醤油・味噌の使用は限定的と推.en: No soy sauce on the menu. Mostly Italian cooking, so soy sauce and miso use is presumed limited, but the seasonings used with Japanese ingredients (hamo, wagyu, sea urchin and so on) need checking.

メニューは中華そば・チャーシュー麺・わかめ中華そばの3種。基本トッピングはわかめ.en: The menu has three items: chūka soba, chāshū noodles and wakame chūka soba. The basic toppings are wakame, menma, spring onion and a boiled egg.

メニューは日本語のみ。英語対応の案内はなし。観光客も訪れるが、基本的に地元客向け.en: Menu in Japanese only. No English guidance. Tourists come too, but it is basically a diner for locals.

メニューや案内は日本語中心だが、カード決済対応・予約可能でアクセスしやすい環境。.en: Menus and guidance are mainly in Japanese, but cards are accepted and reservations possible, making it accessible. No explicit English service.

メンマの味付けは醤油＝小麦。.en: Menma is seasoned with soy sauce = wheat.

ヤマザキYショップ松屋白馬駅前店.en: Yamazaki Y Shop (Matsuya, Hakuba Station branch)

ユッケだれ＝コチュジャン・醤油で小麦。.en: Yukhoe sauce = gochujang and soy sauce, so wheat.

ヨーグルトを使った自家製ラッシーがスパイスの辛さを和らげる定番のお供。.en: A house-made lassi with yoghurt is the standard companion to soften the heat of the spices.

ラッコラは2022年7月29日、近鉄大和西大寺駅北口徒歩1分にオープンした、卵・.en: laccola opened on 29 July 2022, one minute from the north exit of Kintetsu Yamato-Saidaiji Station: a plant-based gluten-free and vegan sweets specialist with no egg, dairy, white sugar or wheat. Baked goods of rice flour, spices and herbs and unusual amazake are its signatures. The owner's name is not published.

ラム（サトウキビ）・テキーラ（アガベ）は穀物不使用。ジンは穀物スピリッツが多い。.en: Rum (sugar cane) and tequila (agave) contain no grain. Gin is often a grain spirit. Check each brand. Prices on a separate menu; +¥50 with soda.

公式 yakitori-midori.info。食べログ: 味鳥、大阪市中央区難.en: Official yakitori-midori.info. Tabelog: Midori, 1-5-21 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 30 seconds from Mizukake Fudo in Hozenji Yokocho; Mon–Sat 17:00–22:30 (L.O. 22:00); closed Sundays and holidays; may close early when sold out; reservations accepted (first-timers course only, à la carte can be added after; deposit and cancellation fee for 5 or more); cards accepted, no e-money; smoking allowed (with consent of the diners on either side); 12 seats (counter only); founded 1958; morning-slaughtered branded and local chickens such as Ise Akadori and shamo; Tajima chicken and shamo grilled over Kishu binchotan; a secret tare. Reviews (July–September 2026): 68 years in business; run by the second and third generations; the tare is only shoyu and sake, without needless sweetness; sake gets expensive unless you check prices; L-shaped counter; Matsu, Take and Ume courses; sashimi and skewers both good; Take course; skewers explained with a smile; negima; sasami with ume-shiso; Midori-yaki; asparagus wraps; burdock wraps; skin; tulip; shiitake stuffed with meat; one found the meat tough and had hygiene concerns; onsen egg and yamakake; ginkgo nuts; a tare that isn't too strong; ¥6,000 course; cartilage; junmai daiginjo.

公式 yoshitaka-osaka.jp。食べログ(店舗会員): 由堂、大阪市.en: Official yoshitaka-osaka.jp. Reviews (June–October 2026): the tantanmen alone is a little sweet but just right with the spicy mapo rice bowl; half sets; mapo ramen; busy at lunch; quiet at 8 p.m.; the reimen has a strong sesame sauce; sets with fried rice or tenshinhan; water spinach and gyoza; a wide menu; a soup you can finish; cold tantanmen (watercress, leek, cucumber, meat miso); mini mapo rice bowl (Chinma-han); tantanmen set (regular with half fried rice); mild even at heat 2; rich, creamy sesame; one found the thin noodles stuck together; light fried rice; spicy tantanmen ¥1,200, fried rice ¥880, draught beer ¥500; one says the heat comes from chili oil with little umami.

公式(chocolatta.jp): ショコラッタ、〒542-0066 大阪市中.en: Official (chocolatta.jp): Chocolatta, Matsuyamachi Grand Heights 1F, 2-12-15 Kawaramachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka 542-0066, 06-6761-6565; Mon–Sat 12:00–20:30, Sun 11:30–19:00; irregular closing days (announced on the blog); a gluten-free gâteau au chocolat specialist; no wheat flour; naturally grown domestic rice flour, cane sugar, French organic chocolate and Belgian chocolate; cultured butter; cafe and takeaway; online shop; Karahori area. FindMeGlutenFree: reported as dedicated gluten-free; October 2026 reviews: French toast; the whole menu is gluten-free; bacon, sausage, sandwiches, waffles; opens early; run single-handed, so it takes time; about ¥5,000 for 2 plates and 2 coffees; BLAT and eggs; chicken sandwich to take away; few seats.

公式(comeconoco.com): Comeconoco Laborator.en: Official (comeconoco.com): Comeconoco Laboratory Cafe, 2-2-3 Shimamachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka 540-0034; a gluten-free rice-flour cafe and baking school in Tenmabashi and Kitahama; a specialist in gluten-free sweets and bread made with domestic rice flour; eat-in and takeaway Wed–Sat 11:00–17:00; baking classes on irregular days; online shop. FindMeGlutenFree: reported as dedicated gluten-free; a dedicated gluten-free kitchen space reported; October 2026 reviews: French toast with bacon; matcha espresso latte; the best sandwich; croque-monsieur lunch set; desserts; small but quick turnover; takeaway available.

公式(crayonsite)・local-prime・tanosu・budou-.en: From the official site (crayonsite), local-prime, tanosu and budou-chan. The owner is a former pâtissier who developed asthma, a runny nose, hand eczema and itchy eyes from wheat, and opened a rice-flour workshop. The shop states: “We do not use wheat flour in the workshop”, “100% rice flour”, “No wheat, dairy, egg or nuts (breads)”. Moved and reopened at Tadera 8-13-52 on 28 September 2025. No source names the owner.

公式(genjisoba.co.jp): 源氏蕎麦、大阪市中央区難波1-2-19.en: Official (genjisoba.co.jp): Genji Soba, Hozenji Sando, 1-2-19 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6633-5402; 7 min walk from the subway Namba Station; 11:30–21:30 (L.O. 21:30), break 14:30–17:00; irregular Wednesday closings; ¥1,300–3,000; no smoking. Now operating in the new shop (Hozenji Sando shop); the old shop (4-5-8 Namba) is closed for a while (not a complete move). March 2026 new-shop notice: founded 1929, Genji Soba Hozenji Sando main shop, Torikura Soichi. Menu: lunch Genji gozen ¥3,300 and dinner Genji gozen ¥4,800 (by reservation, 2nd-floor seats, gluten-free and vegan on advance request); juwari zaru soba ¥1,300; Oyada daikon spicy juwari soba ¥1,620; grated-yam juwari soba ¥1,920; Tamba black-soybean natto juwari soba ¥1,620; Hozenji A lunch ¥1,850 (two kinds of juwari soba, small rice bowl, salad, pickles, soy-milk pudding); wild large prawn and vegetable tempura with juwari zaru soba ¥2,950 (batter of buckwheat and rice flour, dedicated gluten-free fryer). FindMeGlutenFree (101 recent ratings): gluten-free labelling, a section for celiac diners, 30 reports of a dedicated fryer, one says celiac-safe only at dinner; ordering by QR code; soba made in the window; one found the dashi fishy; asked about egg when ordering vegan soba (September 2026).

Tabelog: CoCo Ichibanya Namba Sennichimae, 10-14 Namba Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6649-0617; daily 11:00–23:00, delivery 11:00–22:00; open every day of the year; cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money and QR payment accepted; 35 seats. 2026 reviews (March–October): next to NGK; not very crowded; many overseas staff; a mistaken order; low-carb curry (cauliflower rice) with spinach; spinach curry with crispy chicken; limited summer-vegetable curry (aubergine, okra, tomato, chicken) with scrambled egg; mild; unfamiliar with coupons and gift vouchers; hayashi rice; 400 g rice.

公式(matsusaka-projects.com): 松阪牛焼肉M 法善寺店.en: Official (matsusaka-projects.com): Matsusaka Beef Yakiniku M Hozenji Hanare, Daruma Bldg 2F, 1-5-24 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6211-2904. From 21 June 2026, weekdays 12:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:30) and 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30), Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–23:00, no closing day. Shoes off at the entrance; 7 tables (6 semi-private, 1 private room); a 'gluten-free' tag. FindMeGlutenFree: shop's description 'Gluten-free requires advance booking. Every dish can be made gluten-free'; say so when booking. Reviews by diners with celiac disease: house-made gluten-free tare, shoyu and ponzu; checked again and again at the table; the grill net is changed; once another staff member brought the regular tare (2025); ¥8,800–12,000 per person; premium course ¥12,000; when full, guests are sent to another branch nearby. Manager's reply: there is a vegan menu as well.

公式(matsusaka-projects.com): 松阪牛焼肉M 道頓堀千日.en: Official (matsusaka-projects.com): Matsusaka Beef Yakiniku M Dotonbori Sennichimae, Kamigata Bldg 2F, 1-7-11 Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka 542-0074, 06-4963-2994; 3 min walk from Namba Walk exit B20; about 100 m east of the Hozenji Yokocho shop; dinner 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30), lunch Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:30); no closing day (may close occasionally); 14 tables (7 private rooms); a large hall for up to 32; lift; wheelchair accessible; a 'gluten-free' tag; cards and PayPay accepted; Lighthouse Co., Ltd. (authorised member No. 92 of the Matsusaka beef association). FindMeGlutenFree (30 recent ratings): 1-5-5 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 080-6217-5050; reported as dedicated gluten-free; about 4 seats; takeaway available; tarts ¥1,000 each (September 2026); mango, mixed-berry cheesecake, chocolate pistachio, matcha and white chocolate; cashew cream and almond crust; rice-flour and coconut-oil cookies; Italian espresso; was open 13:00–20:00 (August 2026); served in kimono; the oat milk carried a 'may contain gluten' label, so switched to soy milk (January 2026); one found it unfriendly (April 2026).

公式(ohmicho-inoya)・近江町市場公式(ohmicho-ichiba.en: Official site (ohmicho-inoya), the Omicho Market official site and hot-ishikawa: the shop where Omicho Market's seafood bowl was born (served since around 1989). Over 40 bowls, from under ¥1,000 for locals to high-end for tourists. Famous for the overflowing 'chirashi Omicho extra-large' and the gold-leaf 'Kinpika bowl'. Queue before opening for a 10% early-bird discount. Calls to passers-by in Kanazawa dialect.

公式(owst)が袋町産業ビル2F、肩ひじ張らないワイン食堂、気分と料理に合わせ.en: The official site (owst) confirms Fukuromachi Sangyo Building 2F, an unpretentious wine eatery, suggestions to suit your mood and the food, house-made oil sardines and hand-kneaded hamburger steak since opening, and vegetables from contract farmers and the company's own farm. Over 250 wines.

公式(roman-gp.com、株式会社ROMAN TALE): 茶屋しずく、鹿.en: Official (roman-gp.com, ROMAN TALE Co., Ltd.): Chaya Shizuku, a specialist in sweets made with organic matcha grown on the group's farm in Kagoshima Prefecture; the signature 'Matcha Fukashi Paun' freshly steamed from the seiro, lightly sweet, chewy, fluffy and light, made gluten-free without wheat flour; a rare organic matcha hardly grown anywhere in Japan; Namba shop 3-2-14 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; matcha × pistachio fair (19 October). Independent from Okayama Food Service Co., Ltd. FindMeGlutenFree: gluten-free menu; not dedicated gluten-free; gluten-free cones (October 2026); steamed matcha cake; matcha latte (soy milk); matcha confirmed gluten-free, no oat milk (September 2026); soft-serve; one visitor came every day. Opening hours not found.

Tabelog: 14 seats (ground-floor counter 7, 2nd-floor tables 7); allergen information available; vegan and gluten-free menu; opened 4 February 2023.

FindMeGlutenFree: not dedicated gluten-free; the gyoza is wheat and on the same griddle (October 2026); okonomiyaki ¥1,100; explained the fryer; ordering by app; an English-speaking chef-owner; gluten-free potato salad and pudding; no queue.

公式(yukou-kiyo.com)・osumituki・takemacheli.en: The official site (yukou-kiyo.com), osumituki and takemachelin confirm the move from Yatai Yukou in Kiyamachi to Shijo-Kawaramachi (two doors south of Takashimaya), the opening on 23 September 2021, and an owner from Jinrui Mina Menrui. Shellfish ramen (oyster, short-neck clam, freshwater clam) in Kyoto soy sauce, duck tsukemen limited to 15 a day, seared rare roast-pork rice bowl, and a café-like interior playing Mr. Children.

公式(アラカワフードサービス): 花丸軒 難波・法善寺店、〒542-0076 大.en: Official (Arakawa Food Service): Hanamaruken Namba Hozenji, 1-2-1 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka 542-0076, 06-6213-0131; open 24 hours, every day of the year; 5 min walk from subway Namba, Kintetsu/Hanshin Osaka-Namba and Nippombashi stations; 17 seats (counter 15, tables 2); completely non-smoking; cards and e-money accepted; ramen to its own carefully considered recipe; fried rice and gyoza popular too. Tabelog: lists closure over New Year. 2026 reviews: a 24-hour shop visited for years; the 2nd-floor toilet has narrow stairs; ticket machine taking many payment types; many inbound tourists; new garlic tonkotsu ramen (April); tonkotsu-shoyu base; rich but not heavy; medium-thin noodles; melting chashu; Hanamaruken after the sauna at Amza; toro-kotsu ramen (two big pieces of pork); nori, menma, naruto, leek; free kimchi; white rice; shorter queues now; champon; lighter than before; not piping hot; fried rice.

公式BASEショップ・Instagram・あまつしまっぷ・米パンなび・食べログよ.en: From the official BASE shop, Instagram, Amatsushimap, Komepan Navi and Tabelog: a rice farmer in western Owari (over 50 years of history) makes fully gluten-free bread, bagels and cakes from 100% home-grown rice with no wheat, egg, dairy or soy; the shop name means 'a fully gluten-free specialist run by a rice farmer'. A dog run is attached, in Yatomi.

公式Instagram habana_namba。食べログ: 葉花、大阪市中央区.en: Official Instagram habana_namba. October 2026 reviews: mega highball; 6-starter platter; crab-miso cream croquettes; plain omelette; black-pepper highball; potato salad on the 2nd floor; sanma confit with aubergine purée; rare wild boar with red-wine sauce; sashimi platter ¥600; 3 vegetable starters ¥450; spicy pork shumai with coriander, 2 for ¥430; fig, prosciutto and ricotta ¥500; black-tea and mixed-berry sour ¥550; grated-peach Bellini ¥600; mobile ordering on the 2nd floor; neck meat with black shichimi ¥380; carbonara-style pasta salad ¥400; smoked chikuwa with mayo ¥380; corn and mitsuba fried dumplings ¥450; Okinawan-style marinated squid guts ¥380; a back alley leading to Hozenji; self-serve bottled-beer fridge; many regulars.

公式PR Times（prtimes 057）と kyo-soku が2025年.en: The official PR Times (prtimes 057) and kyo-soku confirm the opening on 16 October 2025, Jurakumawari-minamimachi, Nakagyo-ku, right by JR Nijo Station, the menu (aged-soy ramen ¥900, chicken paitan, sesame tantan, A5 wagyu ¥1,800, various vegan bowls) and the ¥500 opening promotion. 公式X menno_yoji3rd。食べログ: 麺のようじ、大阪市中央区高津2-.en: Official X menno_yoji3rd.
