姫路城〜姫路駅 · ベジ・グルテンフリー.en: Himeji Castle to Himeji Station · vegetarian and gluten-free

姫路城下町という歴史的な街並みの中に、ブラックを基調とした都会的な外観とオレンジ.en: In the historic castle-town streets, the urban black exterior and orange neon tubes stand out, and passers-by drawn in by the sweet smell of baking have become a familiar sight.

姫路市亀井町、瀬戸内海の恵みを活かした海鮮料理店.en: Kameimachi, Himeji: a seafood restaurant making the most of the Seto Inland Sea

姫路市十二所前町、播磨灘産穴子を専門とする.en: Juniisho-mae-cho, Himeji; specialises in Harima-nada conger eel

姫路市本町68 家老屋敷B棟.en: Honmachi 68, Himeji; chief-retainer residence building B

姫路市本町（姫路城前）.en: Honmachi, Himeji (in front of Himeji Castle)

姫路店の「朝フレンチマン」（平日午前・10:00〜、¥770）はホットサンド＋サ.en: The Himeji shop's "Morning Frenchman" (weekday mornings from 10:00, ¥770) comes with a hot sandwich, salad and a drink. It drew attention as a morning menu unique to the Himeji shop, timed to the building's opening hours.

姫路経済新聞(3周年記事)・TANOSU取材・公式サイトより。店主貝塚暁子さんが.en: From the Himeji Keizai Shimbun (3rd-anniversary article), a TANOSU feature and the official site. The owner, 貝塚暁子, opened in 2019 (3rd anniversary on 8 August 2022). "Organic junkie" with homemade koji seasonings and organic ingredients. Wheat flour and sugar avoided as far as possible; sweets use barley flour and are gluten-free; the pound cake is 100% Kyushu barley flour.

姫路経済新聞・Kiss PRESS・Food Diversity・公式サイトより.en: From the Himeji Keizai Shimbun, Kiss PRESS, Food Diversity and the official site. A former izakaya owner opened on 21 March 2023 in Shirakuni-kitashinmachi. A fully vegan restaurant supervised by Tokyo's Saido. The signature "sai-men" are colourful noodles made from vegetables. Sweets are made by Ibuki of Okayama, free of animal ingredients and the 8 major allergens. The name comes from 菜 (vegetables), sai-men, Saido and sai (rhinoceros) (official).

姫路経済新聞・budou-chan: オーナー見満みなみは2012年に製菓学校卒.en: Himeji Keizai Shimbun and budou-chan: the owner, 見満みなみ, graduated from confectionery school in 2012, studied pastry and cooking in Germany and France for about 8 years, and on 1 October 2025 opened "Miinas", a gluten-free organic café, at Shikisai 638-1, Himeji (right by JR Yobe Station, Aoyama-kita Bldg). About 31 tsubo, 6 tables, 16 seats; everything available to take away. Serves bagels and burgers of 100% domestic organic rice flour. A pet-grooming salon (深山梨江) is attached, separated by a wall.

姫路経済新聞・tanosuで、2025年11月28日開業、店長 菅原早穂子、自家.en: The Himeji Keizai Shimbun and tanosu confirm: opened 28 November 2025; the manager; house-roasted, house-ground almond butter (Classic/Crunch); almond-milk soup; butter chicken curry with 18 spices, almond butter and almond dukkah.

姫路経済新聞：料理長・大庭拓哉（和食歴30年）、店長・松岡加奈子、2025年11.en: Himeji Keizai Shimbun: head chef 大庭拓哉 (30 years in Japanese cuisine); manager 松岡加奈子; opened 27 November 2025; in the Gran Festa basement; fish from the ports of Murotsu, Boze and Shikama; whole sea bream tempura, Himeji oden, live conger eel. KissPress: the name comes from the owner's surname, written in hiragana. Himeji Festa official site: Gran Festa 5-ban-gai, opened 27 November.

姫路駅直結の地下街グランフェスタ内にあり、雨の日でも濡れずにアクセスできる利便性.en: Inside Gran Festa, the underground mall connected to Himeji Station, so you can get there without getting wet on rainy days; popular with business people and travellers for the convenience.

季節に移ろい暦があるように.en: just as the seasons turn and the calendar moves on

季節のプリンは卵・乳を含む可能性。ぽりっと・米粉麺は植物性。.en: The seasonal pudding may contain egg and dairy. Poritto and the rice-flour noodles are plant-based.

季節の和菓子と選りすぐりの日本茶、抹茶。喫茶では季節の和菓子と薄茶のセットのほか.en: Seasonal Japanese sweets with selected Japanese teas and matcha. Besides sets of a seasonal sweet and thin tea, there's a 'whisk-your-own' matcha experience and a full tea seating (seasonal sweet, thick tea, dry sweets, thin tea), plus white shaved ice in summer. Takeaway thick-tea lattes too.

季節の商品。一晩かけて抽出したエルダーフラワーエキス、と店の説明。花・砂糖・炭酸.en: Seasonal. Elderflower extract steeped overnight, the shop says. Flowers, sugar and soda, with no animal ingredients. Ask about the house-made syrup's ingredients.

季節の野菜をたっぷり使い、20種類以上の食材を一皿に盛り込む『おばんざいランチ』.en: The 'obanzai lunch', with plenty of seasonal vegetables and over 20 ingredients on one plate. The 'low-salt lunch' with Hiroshima rice or brown rice, held to 2 g of salt or less, is also a signature.

季節の食材をふんだんに使用した特別コース。※要予約。11:30〜14:30。.en: A special course making generous use of seasonal ingredients. *Reservation required. 11:30–14:30.

季節の食材をふんだんに使用した贅沢なコース。18:00〜21:30、2〜4名様。.en: A luxurious course making generous use of seasonal ingredients. 18:00–21:30, 2–4 guests. The ¥13,200 course includes a cake with a message for birthdays and anniversaries.

季節の食材を活かしたフランス懐石おまかせコース。 烏賊を細麺状に仕立てた『烏賊の.en: A French-kaiseki omakase course built on seasonal ingredients. Memorable dishes lightly cross the line between French and Japanese, such as 'squid sōmen' with squid cut into fine noodles, spiny lobster gratin and sea bream chazuke.

季節の食材を生かした会席料理（¥3,800の「金城」から¥9,900の「福寿」ま.en: Kaiseki built on seasonal ingredients (from the ¥3,800 Kinjō to the ¥9,900 Fukuju). Starter, sashimi, grilled dish, seasonal dish and dessert, overseen by head chef Chikazawa, who is recognised as an Aichi Master Craftsman.

季節折々のおいしさを、くつろぎながら.en: each season's flavours, enjoyed at your ease

宇宙一のまぜそば.en: the best mazesoba in the universe

宇治金時ミルク.en: Uji matcha, sweet beans and milk

守り続け、磨き続けてきた老舗の味.en: an old shop's taste, kept and polished over the years

安くてうまい、気軽に立ち寄れる街の中華立ち飲み屋として地元に根付いてきた。.en: Rooted locally as a cheap, tasty neighbourhood Chinese stand-up bar you can drop into easily.

安心して食べられる.en: you can eat with peace of mind

安曇野のジャズファンブログが、店主自作管理のJBLランサーからジャズが流れ、オー.en: An Azumino jazz fan's blog backs up an owner who plays jazz through JBL Lancer speakers the owner built and maintains, and who talks about audio and the history of Zenkoji. ekiten and Retty back up hand-made soba (Nagano buckwheat) along Nakamise and entrances on two sides.

安曇野市に本拠を置く信州の郷土食専門店。 長野・善光寺の仲見世通り（参道）に漬物.en: A Shinshu local-food specialist based in Azumino City. It has a tenant shop on Zenkoji's Nakamise-dori (the temple approach) inside the long-established pickle shop Takahashi Shoten. The main shop is in Swan Garden Azumino, famous for letting you grill the oyaki you buy at an irori hearth where a charcoal fire burns all year.

完全なグルテンフリー専門店であるかどうかは確認が取れていません.en: it has not been confirmed whether it is a completely gluten-free specialist

完全な肉料理専門店のため、植物性食材のみのコースは提供されておらず、ヴィーガン対.en: A meat-only restaurant, so there is no plant-only course; vegan handling is impossible.

完全に独立した厨房で調理.en: cooked in a completely separate kitchen

完全グルテンフリー米粉パン専門店.en: a fully gluten-free rice-flour bread specialist

完全ヴィーガン。動物性原材料・乳製品・精製糖・うまみ調味料・アルコール調味料は不.en: Fully vegan. No animal ingredients, dairy, refined sugar, MSG or alcohol seasonings.

完全予約制かつ少人数対応の個室あり。食材は予約ごとに個別調達するスタイルで、事前.en: Reservations only, with private rooms for small groups. Ingredients are sourced individually per booking, making it easy to pass on detailed requests in advance.

完全予約制で少人数制のため、事前に食の制限を伝える余地がある。オーナーが素材を個.en: Reservation-only with small numbers, so there is room to explain dietary restrictions in advance. A small independent shop where the owner picks ingredients individually, so it may be flexible.

完全予約制のおまかせ懐石で、予約・来店ともに日本語対応が基本。英語メニューや英語.en: Reservation-only omakase kaiseki; booking and visiting are basically in Japanese. No information on an English menu or English-speaking staff.

完全予約制のため、事前にアレルギー・食材の希望を伝える機会が確保されている。少人.en: Reservations only, so there is a guaranteed chance to pass on allergies and ingredient requests in advance. Small (15 seats), so the chef can easily consider each guest's situation.

完全予約制の懐石料理店。英語メニューあり（訪日外国人向け対応）。靴を脱いで入店す.en: A reservation-only kaiseki restaurant. English menu available (for overseas visitors). Tatami rooms where you take your shoes off. Cards accepted and set up for overseas guests, but communication is mainly in Japanese.

完全予約制の高級イタリアン。日本語での事前コミュニケーション（アレルギー等の申告.en: An upscale reservation-only Italian. Advance communication in Japanese (declaring allergies and so on) is essential; no confirmed information on English service.

完全予約制の高級鉄板焼き店で、英語メニューや英語対応スタッフの情報は確認できず。.en: An upscale reservation-only teppanyaki; no information on an English menu or English-speaking staff could be found. Booking and visiting in Japanese seem to be assumed.

完全禁煙。個室あり（2〜4名・4〜6名・VIP 4〜8名）。テイクアウト・デリバ.en: Completely non-smoking. Private rooms (2–4, 4–6, VIP 4–8 people). Takeaway and delivery (Uber Eats) are available, so ingredients can be checked at home with a takeaway.

完全紹介制・会員制で、既存客からの紹介なしでは予約不可。日本語対応が前提の非常に.en: Introduction and membership only; cannot be booked without a referral from an existing guest. A very exclusive full-omakase restaurant that assumes Japanese.

完全紹介制・完全オマカーセのため、予約時に食の制約を細かく伝える機会があり、シェ.en: Being introduction-only and fully omakase, there is a chance to explain dietary restrictions in detail at booking, and the chef can consider individual handling.

官公式サイト(mu-sea.com)と伊勢志摩観光ナビ、食べログで確認：2013.en: Confirmed on the official site (mu-sea.com), the Ise-Shima tourism navigator and Tabelog: founded December 2013; the Toba Station branch opened on 7 March 2021; house-roasted coffee and spice-curry bread; a seaside roastery.

定休日（但し祝日の場合は翌日）」.en: closed (or the next day if a holiday)'

定番メニューがベジタリアンで、ヴィーガン対応もしてもらえます.en: the standard menu is vegetarian, and they can do vegan too

実家が魚屋兼仕出し業という食の環境で育ち、夫の病気を機に2000年に自身の店を開.en: Grew up around food in a family that ran a fish shop and catering business, and opening a shop in 2000 after a husband's illness was the starting point as a cooking expert.

客席にも持ち込み禁止をご協力いただいております.en: we also ask that outside items not be brought to the tables

宮島かき氷処.r: みやじまかきごおりどころ

宮島の海で獲れた新鮮な穴子と牡蠣を、訪れる人にその場で味わってもらうこと。.en: Letting visitors taste, on the spot, fresh anago and oysters caught in the sea off Miyajima.

宮島クラフトコーラ「Musetta Cola」。スパイス・レモンのシロップ。原材.en: Miyajima craft cola 'Musetta Cola'. A syrup of spices and lemon. Ingredient label not confirmed.

宮島・厳島神社のすぐ近く、賑わう商店街から少し離れた静かな一角に建つ古民家を生か.en: An ocean-view café in an old house in a quiet corner a little away from the busy shopping street, right by Itsukushima Shrine on Miyajima. In a characterful space that keeps the old beams and pillars, antique furniture, sofas and refined tables are arranged, and every seat looks out on the great torii and the Seto Inland Sea. The 1st floor is the café, and the 2nd floor is run as 'private inn lente' with two rooms.

宮島・表参道商店街（清盛通り近く、厳島神社参道）.en: Miyajima, Omotesando shopping street (near Kiyomori-dori, the approach to Itsukushima Shrine)

宮島博多屋ブログとnohgakuで、表参道で唯一の宮島牡蠣生産者直営店であること.en: The Miyajima Hakataya blog and nohgaku confirm it is the only shop on Omotesando run directly by a Miyajima oyster producer, relatively cheap because run by the producer, grilled fresh at the front (plump), the recommendation to eat them whole with a toothpick and no seasoning, and a creamy, pleasantly salty taste.

宮島名物のお好み焼きともみじ饅頭を組み合わせた独自のおやつ『おこもみじ』を考案し.en: Devised 'Okomomiji', an original snack combining Miyajima's famous okonomiyaki and momiji manjū, and registered it as the shop's trademark.

宮島産の穴子と牡蠣を使った郷土料理。看板はあなごめしや焼き牡蠣などの穴子・牡蠣料.en: Local dishes using Miyajima anago and oysters. The signatures are anago and oyster dishes such as anagomeshi and grilled oysters.

宮治グループ公式で運営会社・5店舗・四間道の隠れ家立地・『贅沢な大人のためのやき.en: The official Miyaji Group site confirms the operating company, 5 shops, a hideaway location in Shikemichi and the concept 'a yakitori shop for grown-ups who enjoy luxury'. nagoya-meshi confirms binchōtan grilling, Nagoya Cochin tataki, crisp / juicy skewers and a course with non-skewer dishes in between. Mikawa red chicken and a cheese starter could not be supported and were removed.

宮治グループ公式（miyaji-grp.net）で会社所在地・50年・5店舗・コ.en: The official Miyaji Group site (miyaji-grp.net) confirms the company address, 50 years, 5 shops and the concept. Gurunavi confirms 'Kawachi duck tataki = Fugetsu's signature', fully private rooms throughout and menu items such as duck shabu-shabu. Published sources do not explain the origin of the name Fugetsu.

宮治グループ直営.en: run directly by the Miyaji Group

家族経営（創業者一族が各店舗を分担）.en: Family business (the founding family shares the running of the branches)

家系ラーメン斎藤家.r: いえけいらーめんさいとうや

家老屋敷跡.en: site of a chief retainer's residence

寒い中体もあったまって美味しかった.en: it warmed me up in the cold and was delicious

寛ぎの時間は、緑とともに.en: time to relax, together with the greenery

寺粥御膳は根菜の煮物や豆腐など植物性食材を中心とした構成と複数のレビューが報告し.en: Several reviews report that the temple porridge set is built mostly from plant ingredients such as simmered root vegetables and tofu.

寺粥御膳（¥1,500）—精進のお粥に根菜や豆腐料理などが添えられるセット。小布.en: The temple rice-porridge set (¥1,500): shojin porridge with root vegetables, tofu dishes and more. Obuse-chestnut kuri-tsuzuri (Mont Blanc), seasonal Japanese sweets and oshiruko are also popular.

寺院：善光寺大勧進（天台宗本坊）.en: Temple: Zenkoji Daikanjin (the Tendai head lodging)

寿司屋の玉子焼きは味醂・薄口醤油・つなぎ粉を使うことが多い。要確認。.en: Sushi-shop tamagoyaki often uses mirin, light soy sauce and a binding flour. Ask.

専用グルテンフリー調理器具・フライヤーの分離使用に関する情報は公式サイト・各種レ.en: Neither the official site nor any review mentions dedicated gluten-free utensils or separate fryers. Cross-contamination risk is thought high in a kitchen that uses a lot of pasta, semolina and wheat-batter fritto.

専門店として全焼き菓子が米粉ベースの小麦不使用で、グルテンフリーの土産・スイーツ.en: As a specialist, all baked goods are rice-flour based and wheat-free, and it is introduced in Kyoto GF guides as a gluten-free souvenir and sweet.

小さなカウンター中心の小料理屋。英語メニューや英語対応スタッフの情報なし。日本語.en: A small counter-centred koryori restaurant. No information on an English menu or English-speaking staff. Communication is basically in Japanese.

小さなカウンター中心の店で英語メニューや英語対応の記載はなく、日本語での注文が基.en: A small counter-centred shop with no mention of an English menu or English service; ordering is basically in Japanese.

小さなランチ専門店でメニューは日本語のみ、英語対応の記録なし。.en: A small lunch-only shop with a Japanese-only menu; no record of English service.

小さな地元向け割烹居酒屋で、英語メニューや外国語対応の記載は一切なく、日本語のみ.en: A small local kappo izakaya with no mention of an English menu or other languages; Japanese only.

小さな町のなかのレストラン.en: a restaurant in a small town

小そばは+¥280、大うどん・大きしめんは+¥330、大そばは+¥390。.en: Small soba +¥280; large udon or large kishimen +¥330; large soba +¥390.

小チャーシュー煮玉子ラーメン.en: ramen with small chashu and simmered egg

小僧またおまえか。土佐堀店.en: Kozou Mata Omae Ka, Tosabori branch

小川真宏氏は約30年にわたり淵之坊の厨房を取り仕切り、善光寺の祭礼食をベースにし.en: 小川真宏 (Ogawa Masahiro) has run the Fuchinobo kitchen for about 30 years, creating seasonal menus based on Zenkoji's festival food.

小町記事(261229)で文政10年(1827)創業・八代目藤澤浩一が銀行員を経.en: A Komachi article (261229) confirms: founded in Bunsei 10 (1827); eighth-generation 藤澤浩一 took over in 1999 after working as a banker; trained under 片倉康雄 of Isshoan; kirishita buckwheat grown by 石川浩幸 in Shinano-machi; a 91% blend. The official site (fujikian.co.jp/en) states it was founded in 1827, in the time of the 11th shogun Tokugawa Ienari, is a soba shop of eight generations, and uses Kurohime kirishita buckwheat (no mention of katsudon). Saijiki confirms three dipping sauces (dashi, walnut, grated yam).

小菓子はほぼ確実に小麦・バター・卵。.en: Petits fours are almost certainly wheat, butter and egg.

小規模な古民家カフェで英語メニューや英語対応の記録はなく、日本語のみの環境と思わ.en: A small old-house café with no record of an English menu or English service; probably a Japanese-only setting.

小規模な就労施設の製造・直売所。米粉製品専用ラインか小麦と共用かは未確認。要確認.en: A small welfare-workplace production site and farm shop. Whether there is a dedicated rice-flour line or it is shared with wheat is unconfirmed. To be confirmed.

小豆と砂糖のみなら小麦なし。白玉／餅の有無を要確認。.en: If only azuki and sugar, no wheat. Ask whether shiratama / mochi is included.

小豆・白玉（もち米粉）・氷。いずれも小麦不使用。練乳の有無を要確認。.en: Azuki, shiratama (glutinous rice flour), ice. None use wheat. Ask about condensed milk.

小豆餡、小麦粉、砂糖、大豆油、そば粉、酵母、食塩.en: red-bean paste, wheat flour, sugar, soybean oil, buckwheat flour, yeast, salt

小麦。バターの有無を要確認。.en: Wheat. Ask whether butter is used.

小麦が食べられない人でも我慢せずに食べられるパン.en: bread that people who can't eat wheat can enjoy without holding back

小麦のパスタ。名古屋名物の鉄板イタスパ。.en: Wheat pasta. Nagoya's signature hot-plate Italian spaghetti.

小麦のパン。EAT IN 350円 / TO GO 300円。まとめ買いで200.en: Wheat bread. EAT IN ¥350 / TO GO ¥300. Bulk buy ¥1,000, ¥200 off. Originally from Genoa, Italy, scented with black olive and rosemary.

小麦の可能性。要確認。.en: May contain wheat. To be confirmed.

小麦の構成要素は見当たらないが、バルサミコ・生ハムの調味を要確認。乳・肉使用。.en: No wheat components visible, but ask about the seasoning of the balsamic and cured ham. Contains dairy and meat.

小麦を一切扱わない完全グルテンフリー＆ヴィーガンの菓子工房で、全商品が対象。添加.en: A fully gluten-free and vegan sweets workshop that handles no wheat at all, covering every product. Additives too are 'avoided as far as we can'.

小麦を使わないおいしいお菓子とパンを作っています。４０年以上作り続けていた栗せん.en: we make delicious sweets and bread without wheat. The chestnut senbei we kept making for over 40 years are crackers made without wheat, using white bean paste.

小麦アレルギーの人でも安心して食べられる.en: even people with a wheat allergy can eat with confidence

小麦アレルギーの方でも安心.en: safe even for people with a wheat allergy

小麦アレルギーの方も安心して食べられるそう」.en: apparently people with a wheat allergy can eat with peace of mind"

小麦・そば・卵・乳・落花生・えび・かに・くるみ.en: wheat, buckwheat, egg, milk, peanut, shrimp, crab, walnut

小麦・グルテン・卵・乳製品不使用.en: no wheat, gluten, egg or dairy

小麦・乳・卵不使用、有機豆乳使用.en: no wheat, milk or egg; organic soy milk

小麦・卵。2018-01の店頭札では90円。.en: Wheat, egg. ¥90 on the shop tag in 2018-01.

小麦・卵。2023-12の店頭値札。.en: Wheat, egg. Price tag in the shop, 2023-12.

小麦・卵・ごま。2018-01の店頭札では90円。.en: Wheat, egg, sesame. ¥90 on the shop tag in 2018-01.

小麦・卵・乳。2018-01の店頭値札のため現行価格は要確認。.en: Wheat, egg, dairy. Shop price tag from 2018-01, so check the current price.

小麦・卵・乳。2018-01の店頭札では90円。.en: Wheat, egg, dairy. ¥90 on the shop tag in 2018-01.

小麦・卵・乳・ごま。2023-12の店頭値札。.en: Wheat, egg, dairy, sesame. Price tag in the shop, 2023-12.

小麦・卵・乳・そば・落花生・えび・かに.en: wheat, egg, milk, buckwheat, peanut, prawn, crab

小麦・卵・乳不使用のランチ」.en: lunch free of wheat, egg and dairy'

小麦粉の生地＋お好みソース（小麦）。鉄板も共用。 イカ天は小麦衣。.en: Wheat-flour batter + okonomi sauce (wheat). Shared griddle too. Squid tempura has a wheat coating.

小麦粉や乳製品不使用で、安心の無添加（玄米粉シフォン）／ 小麦粉も乳製品も卵も不.en: Reassuringly additive-free with no wheat flour or dairy (brown-rice-flour chiffon) / vegan treats with no wheat flour, dairy or egg (white-rice-flour muffins) / a gluten-free snack specialist using rice flour from the prefecture…

小麦粉を一切つかわず.en: using no wheat flour at all

小麦粉不使用で調理。ただしソース/調味料の醤油・味噌の小麦要確認。.en: Cooked without wheat flour. But check the soy sauce and miso in the sauces and seasonings for wheat.

小麦醤油の割下。.en: Warishita made with wheat soy sauce.

小麦麺、あんは醤油だし。.en: Wheat noodles; the ankake is soy dashi.

小麦麺、かまぼこ・天ぷら・卵入りが標準。.en: Wheat noodles; comes with kamaboko, tempura and egg as standard.

小麦麺、つゆは醤油と鰹だし。.en: Wheat noodles; the broth is soy sauce and bonito dashi.

小麦麺、具にかまぼこ・麩。.en: Wheat noodles, with kamaboko and fu.

小麦麺と同じ鍋を使用しますので、アレルギーの保証は致しかねます.en: it's cooked in the same pot as wheat noodles, so we cannot guarantee against allergies

小麦麺を使用する専門店のため、厨房全体で小麦粉・小麦麺が常時使用されている。交差.en: A specialist shop using wheat noodles, so wheat flour and wheat noodles are in constant use throughout the kitchen. High cross-contamination risk.

小麦麺・小麦醤油つゆ・具の練り物にも小麦つなぎの可能性。.en: Wheat noodles, wheat-soy broth, and the fish-paste toppings may also have a wheat binder.

小麦麺＋かつお/むろあじ出汁＋小麦醤油つゆ。うどん・きしめん・中華そばは小麦麺。.en: Wheat noodles + bonito / muroaji dashi + wheat-soy broth. Udon, kishimen and chūka soba are wheat noodles. The soba also has a wheat binder + dusting flour. The broth is wheat soy sauce

小麦麺＋甘辛煮の牛肉（小麦醤油）。.en: Wheat noodles + sweet-savoury simmered beef (wheat soy sauce).

少しもの足りないあなたへ.en: for when it's not quite enough

尾張名古屋の食文化を次世代へつなぐことをテーマに、八百彦本店・菓匠花桔梗・なか又.en: With the theme of handing Owari-Nagoya food culture to the next generation, three brands come together: Yaohiko Honten, the confectioner Kashō Hanakikyō and Nakamata. In the dignified setting of a Noh theatre, it serves orthodox Japanese cuisine both as a casual food hall and as private-room kaiseki.

居酒屋の居抜き.en: in a former izakaya's fitted premises

屋台の味.en: the taste of a street stall

山の幸・川の幸.en: the bounty of the mountains and rivers

山廃純米。米と米麹のみ。.en: Yamahai junmai. Rice and rice kōji only.

山本屋総本家は大正14年（1925年）に創業し、2025年に創業100周年を迎え.en: Yamamotoya Souhonke, founded in Taisho 14 (1925) and celebrating its 100th anniversary in 2025, is Nagoya's leading old house for miso-nikomi udon. The Machida family took over from the founding couple, and today Machida, as president, keeps the noren.

岸田周三シェフ（1974年愛知県生まれ）は東京・品川の「カンテサンス」を19年連.en: The Quintessence chef (born in Aichi in 1974), after leading Quintessence in Shinagawa, Tokyo to 19 consecutive years of three Michelin stars, opened Brillance in Nagoya as the first regional restaurant of the chef's own making. Articles often stress the lineage Pascal Barbot's Astrance → Quintessence → Brillance.

工房には卵・乳製品・小麦を持ち込まない.en: no egg, dairy or wheat is brought into the workshop

工房全体が完全ヴィーガンで卵・乳製品を一切扱わないため、動物性食材との交差接触リ.en: The whole workshop is fully vegan and handles no egg or dairy at all, so there is no risk of cross-contact with animal ingredients.

市川家は祖父・父・兄が清水焼の陶芸家という家系。市川さんだけは学生時代から趣味で.en: The Ichikawa family is a line of Kiyomizu-yaki potters — grandfather, father and elder brother. Only Ichikawa loved coffee enough to roast as a hobby from student days, was drawn to the joy of people enjoying coffee made by hand, and after 18 years of training at the famous Inoda Coffee went independent.

市川屋珈琲は、京都・東山の清水焼の窯元が集まっていた界隈に2015年に開いた喫茶.en: Ichikawaya Coffee is a coffee shop opened in 2015 in the Higashiyama, Kyoto neighbourhood where Kiyomizu-yaki kilns once gathered. The building was the Kiyomizu-yaki workshop and home of owner Yosuke Ichikawa's grandfather, where Ichikawa also lived. This roughly 200-year-old Kyoto townhouse once faced demolition, but out of the wish 'to keep this place', Ichikawa decided on a full renovation costing about four times a new build. Rebuilt by the Kyoto townhouse builders (京町家作事組), it was reborn as a large townhouse café looking onto a courtyard garden. In the Ichikawa family, both the grandfather and father were Kiyomizu-yaki potters, and the elder brother has also followed the path of ceramics. Only Ichikawa loved coffee, enough to roast as a hobby from student days, and after 18 years of training at the famous Inoda Coffee went independent and opened this shop.

市販のたこわさは醤油ベースが多い。要確認。.en: Commercial tako-wasa is often soy-based. Ask.

市販エイヒレは味付けに醤油・みりんを含むものが多い。マヨネーズ添えも。.en: Commercial dried ray fin is often seasoned with soy sauce and mirin. Often served with mayonnaise too.

市販キムチの魚醤・アミ・調味料に小麦の可能性。.en: Commercial kimchi may contain wheat in its fish sauce, salted krill or seasonings.

市販キムチはアミの塩辛（動物性）や小麦入り調味料を含むことがある。要確認。.en: Commercial kimchi sometimes contains salted krill (animal) or wheat-containing seasonings. Ask.

市販ココアミックスに麦芽が入ることがあるため要確認。.en: Commercial cocoa mixes sometimes contain malt, so ask.

市長もこっそり食べに来るという噂も.en: there's even a rumour the mayor sneaks in to eat

席間隔を広く取り、世界遺産の島の風景を眺めながらゆったり寛いでほしいという思いで.en: Run with the wish that guests relax at leisure, with plenty of space between seats, while gazing at the scenery of a World Heritage island.

常連から『しっかりとしたタンドールがある』と評される本格設備を備える一方、〆カレ.en: Regulars say it has 'a proper tandoor', a serious piece of equipment, yet it is broad enough to work as a place for a finishing curry too.

干す前の漬けだれに醤油＝小麦の可能性大。.en: The marinade before drying very likely contains soy sauce = wheat.

平宗は文久元年（1861）、吉野・上市村で平井宗八が創業。明治35年に料理旅館化.en: Hiraso was founded in Bunkyū 1 (1861) in Kamiichi village, Yoshino, by Hirai Sōhachi. In Meiji 35 it became a culinary inn, and in 1962 (Shōwa 37) it introduced persimmon-leaf sushi widely at the Tennoji Station building. In 1951 (Shōwa 26) it presented ayu sushi to Emperor Shōwa. The Nara shop opened in 1968 (Shōwa 43) in Naramachi, by Sarusawa Pond, within earshot of Kōfukuji's bell, and also offers a hands-on persimmon-leaf sushi-making experience by reservation.

平日限定。日替わりで3種のおかずが変わります。小うどん付き＝小麦。.en: Weekdays only. The three side dishes change daily. Comes with a small udon = wheat.

平日限定。日替わりでメインおかずが変わります。小うどん付き＝小麦。.en: Weekdays only. The main dish changes daily. Comes with a small udon = wheat.

年5月に「小麦アレルギー」と判明し、体調回復を機に国産山田錦米粉100.en: in May (2019) a 'wheat allergy' was diagnosed, and with recovery came a switch to 100% Japanese Yamada Nishiki rice flour

広島レモンの輪切りのみ。他の材料を含まない単品トッピングのため小麦・動物性ともに.en: Just slices of Hiroshima lemon. A single topping with no other ingredients, so no wheat and nothing animal.

広島市出身（1956年生まれ）。実家は魚屋兼仕出し業を営んでいた。.en: From Hiroshima City (born 1956). The family ran a fish shop and catering business.

広島牛ローストビーフ穴子重.en: Hiroshima beef roast beef and anago rice box

広島産牡蠣100％。生食用は3月まで、以降は焼き等で通年提供と店が明記。ポン酢・.en: 100% Hiroshima oysters. The shop states raw oysters until March, after that served grilled and so on year-round. Ask whether ponzu or soy sauce goes on.

広島経済新聞が酔心運営、2021年10月開業、中の棚での立地、女性社員の声から誕.en: The Hiroshima Keizai Shimbun confirms operation by Suishin, the October 2021 opening, the location at Nakanotana, its birth from women employees' voices, no wheat even in the seasonings (soy sauce), rice flour instead of breadcrumbs, a vegan bento derived from shōjin cooking, and comments from director Tamura Megumi. Nakanotana Mall confirms the method for germinated enzyme brown rice.

広島経済新聞と公式サイトで、1966年に元鉄道員・船附丞氏が創業、四代目で孫の山.en: The Hiroshima Keizai Shimbun and the official site confirm founding in 1966 by former railwayman Funatsuki Masaru; the fourth generation, granddaughter Yamauchi Akiko (about 10 years at a Western pâtisserie), running it with the mother, Matsuo Michiko; 'grandpa's dark-roast coffee'; the Miyajima weekend citron with Miyajima honey and Setouchi lemon; about 10 kinds of bread and about 15 kinds of baked goods.

広島郷土料理.r: ひろしまきょうどりょうり

広島風お好み焼き.r: ひろしまふうおこのみやき

広島風お好み焼き。看板は『肉玉そば』。他店にはない中南米由来の青唐辛子ハラペーニ.en: Hiroshima-style okonomiyaki. The signature is 'meat-and-egg soba'. A topping of jalapeño, a Latin American green chilli found at no other shop, is the specialty, and there are Latin American sides too, such as fajitas and tortilla chips.

広島風お好み焼きは小麦粉の生地と中華そばが基本で、同一の鉄板で複数の品を調理する.en: Hiroshima-style okonomiyaki is basically wheat-flour batter and Chinese noodles, with several items cooked on the same griddle, so gluten cross-contamination is unavoidable. No mention of gluten-free handling could be found.

床の間に季節の花や軸をしつらえ、庭を望む町家の座敷で、スタッフの手ほどきを受けな.en: In a townhouse tatami room facing the garden, with seasonal flowers and a scroll in the tokonoma, guests can try 'whisk-your-own' matcha with guidance from the staff.

店が「塩とコショウでシンプルに味付け」と明記しており、タレを使わない。醤油・小麦.en: The shop states it is 'seasoned simply with salt and pepper', with no sauce. No soy sauce or wheat. But sauce skewers are grilled on the same grill, so with severe celiac disease, check whether a separate grill can be used.

店が「開店当初より不動の一番人気」と明記。つくねのつなぎに小麦粉・パン粉が入るの.en: The shop states it's been 'the unshakeable No. 1 since opening'. Tsukune usually has wheat flour or breadcrumbs as a binder, and the sweet-savoury sauce is soy sauce too. Single price not published.

店が『グルテンフリー』と明示。特別栽培米の米粉＋有機米油。卵使用の可能性あり要確.en: The shop states "gluten-free". Specially cultivated rice flour plus organic rice oil. May contain egg; to be confirmed.

店のボードの表記そのまま「小麦粉不使用のチョコレートケーキ」。ただし同じ厨房でホ.en: The shop's board says, word for word, "chocolate cake made without wheat flour." But the same kitchen handles hot sandwiches, quiche and bread, so check for trace contamination. Probably contains egg and dairy.

店のメニューが「ドレッシングなし（ハーフ）380円」と明記。葉物のみでドレッシン.en: The shop's menu states 'no dressing (half) ¥380'. Just leaves, so without dressing there's no wheat and nothing animal. The regular version is ¥580.

店のロゴはキッチンカー時代から使い続けている馬のモチーフ。「自由に動き回る」イメ.en: The logo is a horse motif used since the food-truck days. It embodies the image of 'moving around freely', and local media described the timing of opening in the 2026 Year of the Horse as 'a lovely coincidence'.

店の一番人気。自家製タレは醤油＝小麦。塩の串もタレ串と同じ焼き台のため要注意。.en: The shop's most popular. The house sauce is soy sauce = wheat. Salt skewers go on the same grill as sauce skewers, so take care.

店の公式サイトは「完全グルテンフリー米粉パン専門店」を掲げ、国産米粉のみ・小麦・.en: The shop's official site bills itself as 'a fully gluten-free rice-flour bread specialist' and states domestic rice flour only, with no wheat or egg. Ingredients include seaweed salt from an Inland Sea island and Amami Oshima cane sugar. komeko-palette explains it as a fully wheat-free environment that fundamentally eliminates the risk of wheat contamination from production equipment and utensils. Opened in Toshimatsu, Saeki-ku in November 2022.

店の公式サイト（hiroshimayaki.biz）と広島経済新聞、オタフクソー.en: From the shop's official site (hiroshimayaki.biz), the Hiroshima Keizai Shimbun and an Otafuku Sauce column: founded 1970, owner Nakagawa Ken. Developed an okonomiyaki free of the 7 major allergens in 2013, gluten-free in 2015 and low-carb on 1 October 2017. The gluten-free type uses batter and noodles with no wheat flour or wheat-derived ingredients. All require reservations.

店の原材料表示：国産生姜をたっぷり、シナモン・クローブ・スターアニス・赤トウガラ.en: Shop's ingredient note: lots of domestic ginger, slowly simmered with cinnamon, cloves, star anise and red chilli. No grain and no animal ingredients. The iced version is carbonated.

店の注意書き「1辛でも辛いです。個人差あり」「かなり辛いです！ご注意」。.en: The shop's warnings: 'Even level 1 is spicy. It varies by person' and 'Very spicy! Be careful.'

店の看板おすすめ。塩か醤油ダレかを要確認。.en: The shop's top recommendation. Ask whether it's salt or soy sauce.

店の看板オススメ。やわらかジューシー。.en: The shop's top recommendation. Tender and juicy.

店の紹介文が「広島県産のレモンでつくった生搾りのサワー」と明記。ベース焼酎が麦焼.en: The shop's description states 'freshly squeezed sour made with Hiroshima lemons'. If the base shōchū is barley shōchū it's barley-derived, so check the brand. Price not published.

店の英文表記が SWEET BEANS WITH RICE FLOUR DUMP.en: The shop's English label states SWEET BEANS WITH RICE FLOUR DUMPLING AND CHEST NUT = the shiratama is rice flour, no wheat. Only azuki, sugar, chestnut and rice, with nothing animal. ¥1,000 in a 2026/03 review, ¥1,100 in 2025/11.

店の表記どおり3杯目は「？」（当日のおまかせ）。.en: As the shop writes it, the third glass is '?' (the day's choice).

店の記載どおりパン付き＝小麦。フレンチのソースはブイヨン・ルウに小麦を使うことが.en: Comes with bread, as the shop states = wheat. French sauces often use wheat in the bouillon and roux. The shop states, 'Please be sure to tell us about allergies and other foods you cannot eat when booking' (also stating that same-day changes are not possible and that 'no fish at all' or 'no meat at all' cannot be accommodated).

店の説明：JSA SAKE DIPLOMAでもある燗番が厳選。酒蔵を訪ねて仕入れ.en: Shop's description: chosen by the kanban (sake-warming master), who also holds the JSA SAKE DIPLOMA, and bought by visiting the breweries. Junmai sake is only rice and rice kōji, so gluten-free, but pairings with the food need checking separately.

店の説明：和風だしで炊いた旬のお野菜。和風だし＝かつお・白だしの可能性が高くヴィ.en: Shop's description: seasonal vegetables simmered in Japanese dashi. Japanese dashi = very likely bonito or shiro-dashi, so not vegan; with shiro-dashi or soy sauce, wheat as well. Also ask about gelatine.

店サイト表記：ｱﾐｭｰｽﾞ／ｽｰﾌﾟ／ﾃﾘｰﾇ／メイン料理／パン／ﾃﾞｻﾞｰﾄ／.en: As on the shop's site: amuse / soup / terrine / main / bread / dessert / coffee / petits fours. Tabelog: 'a short course with terrine and a choice of fish or meat'. Bread comes as standard, and French sauces often use a wheat roux. 11:30–14:30, 2–4 guests.

店サイト表記：ｱﾐｭｰｽﾞ／ﾃﾘｰﾇ／ｵｰﾄﾞﾌﾞﾙ2品目／お魚料理／お肉料理／.en: As on the shop's site: amuse / terrine / second hors d'oeuvre / fish / meat / bread / rice / dessert / coffee / petits fours. 11:30–14:30, 2–4 guests.

店サイト：「当店は『OMAKASE』コースのみのご案内となります」。会員制・完全.en: Shop site: 'We offer only the OMAKASE course.' Members only, by introduction only; no entry under 18. 17:30–22:30, irregular closing days. The shop site says 'we accommodate allergies and disliked foods as far as possible', but 'we cannot accommodate on the day of the booking, so please consult us when booking'. If you want gluten handled, be sure to say so when booking.

店サイト：「揚げたてや最高の油・衣の状態に拘る為におまかせコース一本、一斉スター.en: Shop site: 'Because we are particular about freshly fried food and the best state of oil and batter, there is one omakase course only, in two seatings that start all at once.' Tempura batter = wheat. *Please tell us about allergies in advance (same-day ingredient changes are difficult). Dinner in two seatings, 17:30– / 20:30–.

店主さんご夫妻の2名体制.en: run by the owner couple, two people

店主の武田香織さんは関東（神奈川県）出身。会社員をしながら調理師免許を取得し、大.en: Owner 武田香織 is from Kanagawa in the Kanto region. While working at a company, the owner qualified as a cook and trained for about two years at a French restaurant in Osaka. Moved by Miwa sōmen from Sakurai, the owner decided to move to Nara and in April 2019 opened a sōmen specialist in a renovated Naramachi townhouse. The signature is sea-bream-broth sōmen using the French technique fumet de poisson, with unusual variations such as tomato sōmen of wholemeal noodles.

店主の高齢により閉店予定だったが、餃子家龍などを展開する会社が事業を引き継ぎ.en: It was due to close because of the owner's advanced age, but the company behind Gyozaya Ryu and other shops took over the business

店主はカフェ商品開発時に食物アレルギーを研究し、3大アレルゲン不使用スイーツの製.en: The owner researched food allergies while developing café products, and the business began with making and selling sweets free of the three major allergens. Allergy handling is at the core of the business.

店主はグアテマラ出身で英語・スペイン語も通じやすく、店内に世界地図を掲げて旅行者.en: The owner is from Guatemala and gets by easily in English and Spanish, and chats with travellers using the world map in the shop, so even foreign students can drop in casually with basic Japanese greetings.

店主は世代を超えて愛される地域の店を目指している――「幼い頃に親に連れられて来て.en: The owner aims for a local shop loved across generations: 'A child who came here with the family grows up and comes back bringing a family. I want it to be a shop rooted in the community and loved across generations like that.'

店主は人見知りが激しく愛想も無く無口ですが怒っているわけではございません。とても.en: The owner is very shy, unsmiling and quiet, but not angry. A very gentle soul.

店主は元スペイン料理店『Gentry』のオーナーシェフで、2021年3月に同店を.en: The owner is the former owner-chef of the Spanish restaurant 'Gentry', which closed in March 2021; Bocarroz opened in April the same year.

店主は全国のわらび餅を食べ歩き、ミシュランシェフとタイアップして「ぜいみ」を完成.en: The official site says the owner ate warabi mochi all over Japan and completed "Zeimi" in a tie-up with a Michelin-starred chef.

店主は大阪の有名店ラーメン人生.en: the owner is from the famous Osaka shop Ramen Jinsei

店主は米粉マイスター・五ツ星お米マイスターの有資格者で、グルテンフリーを明確に掲.en: The owner is a certified rice-flour meister and five-star rice meister, and clearly promotes gluten-free (

店主自身の言葉によれば「私が学生の頃、べた焼き節ちゃんと言う名で母がやってました.en: In the owner's own words: 'When I was a student, my mother ran it under the name Betayaki Setsu-chan. My mother is Setsuko. Out of respect and gratitude to my mother, I took over the name Setsu-chan.' The owner says the shop opened on 27 July 2024.

店側は河内鴨について、脂の融点が低く（20℃以下で溶けるとされる）不飽和脂肪酸を.en: The shop explains that Kawachi duck fat has a low melting point (said to melt below 20 °C), is high in unsaturated fatty acids and does not sit heavy. Kawachi duck is known as a rare brand duck originating in Osaka.

店全体が100%プラントベースで動物性食材を扱わないため、ヴィーガンの交差接触リ.en: The whole shop is 100% plant-based and handles no animal ingredients, so the vegan cross-contact risk is low.

店全体が小麦粉を一切使わない100%グルテンフリー方針のため、店内に小麦を持ち込.en: The whole shop follows a 100% gluten-free policy with no wheat flour at all, so no wheat is brought into the kitchen. No dedicated fryer or strict celiac protocol is stated, so with severe celiac disease it's safest to check when you visit.

店公式のシェフ紹介（don-antonio.jp/profile）が、1960年.en: The shop's official chef profile (don-antonio.jp/profile) states: born in 1960 in Calabria, southern Italy; moved to Milan in 1963; culinary school in Milan in 1975; came to Japan in 1985; private chef to the Brazilian Embassy in 1989; opened the trattoria in Shirakabe in October 2009.

店内にはハイドンなどクラシックの楽曲が流れ、ヨーロッパの古城のような雰囲気をつく.en: Classical music such as Haydn plays in the shop, creating the atmosphere of an old European castle.

店内には水引アートや繊細なバラン細工が飾られており、そのうちの一つは姫路城を模し.en: The interior is decorated with mizuhiki cord art and delicate baran cut-leaf work, one piece modelled on Himeji Castle. Traces of the owner's honed handiwork can be seen throughout.

店内に世界地図を掲げ、自国グアテマラを指し示すことで旅行者と対話する。『戦争にな.en: A world map hangs in the shop, and pointing out Guatemala on it opens conversations with travellers. 'Once it becomes war, it's too late. I want people who come to Hiroshima to become people who can judge whether one's own country is heading in the right direction,' the owner says, valuing passing on the memory of Hiroshima, the bombed city, and an understanding of the root causes of war.

店内の全てのメニューが小麦、卵、乳製品不使用.en: every item on the menu is free of wheat, egg and dairy

店内の商品はすべて小麦不使用.en: everything in the shop is wheat-free

店名「OLMO」は、店側の説明ではイタリア語で「ケヤキ（欅）」を指す言葉とされ、.en: The name 'OLMO', by the shop's own explanation, is an Italian word for zelkova, and expresses a will toward food rooted in place: enjoying warm Italian food and natural wine around a zelkova table.

店名「カナック」はヒンディー語で金・小麦を意味し、収穫期の小麦のように控えめに輝.en: The name 'Kanak' means gold or wheat in Hindi, and carries the wish to shine modestly like wheat at harvest time.

店名『ボカロス』は、スペイン語で『ボカディージョ（サンドイッチ）』のボカと、米料.en: The name 'Bocarroz' is a coinage combining 'boca' from the Spanish bocadillo (sandwich) and 'arroz', meaning a rice dish.

店名『ボカロス（BOCARROZ）』はスペイン語のボカディージョ（サンドイッチ）.en: The name 'Bocarroz (BOCARROZ)' combines 'boca' from the Spanish bocadillo (sandwich) and 'arroz', meaning a rice dish.

店名の「カナック（Kanak）」はヒンディー語で「金（gold）」または「小麦（.en: The name 'Kanak' means 'gold' or 'wheat' in Hindi. Wheat, the raw material of naan — a staple in India — is a cultural presence on a par with rice in Japan. The name carries the wish 'to shine, yet stay modest, like wheat at harvest time'.

店名の「マーガレット」（デイジー）はオーナーの好きな花に由来し、スプーンの上に花.en: The name "Marguerite" (a daisy) comes from the owner's favourite flower, with the image of a flower resting on a spoon.

店名の由来でもある「べた焼き」が看板。豚肉・脂かす・生卵・刻みネギをのせた京都な.en: The signature is 'betayaki', the source of the shop name. A Kyoto-style thin bake topped with pork, fat scraps, raw egg and chopped spring onion; griddle dishes such as grilled squid, potato cheese, chicken neck with plum paste and yuzu kosho, and tofu steak are also popular.

店名は、芝居に憧れた初代・原田邦雄が東京の前衛劇団『築地小劇場』にちなんで名づけ.en: The name is said to come from the Tokyo avant-garde company 'Tsukiji Shogekijo', named by the first owner, who longed for the theatre.

店外の食券機で先に食券を購入するシステムを採用。夕方の口頭注文との使い分けがユニ.en: Meal tickets are bought first from the machine outside. The switch to verbal ordering in the evening is unusual.

店改め、三条烏丸店リニューアル.en: renamed from the slurp shop, renewed as the Sanjo Karasuma branch

店舗情報サイト(gorp)でJR広島駅エキエ内の立地、看板の福ちゃん焼き、広島産.en: A shop-information site (gorp) confirms the location inside ekie at JR Hiroshima Station, the signature Fukuchan-yaki, Hiroshima oyster okonomiyaki and oysters in butter-soy. Unconfirmed menu items such as sea urchin with spinach and wagyu were generalised or removed.

店表記：アイスクリーム状の冷菓です。アルコールとクルミを使用しています。乳・ナッ.en: Shop's wording: an ice-cream-like frozen dessert, made with alcohol and walnuts. Dairy, nuts.

店表記：コーヒーの香り付けをした、柔らかいミルクプリンのようなデザート。乳。.en: Shop's wording: a soft, milk-pudding-like dessert scented with coffee. Dairy.

店長の平村さんは、子どもが卵や牛乳のアレルギーだと分かったことがきっかけで、グル.en: Manager Hiramura began self-teaching how to make gluten-free sweets and bread after learning a child was allergic to egg and milk.

店頭の貼り紙にて告知致します」.en: and on the notice at the shop'

建物は明治期築の古民家を改装。改装した内装に組み込まれた圧巻のワインセラーが目の.en: The building is a renovated Meiji-era old house. A spectacular wine cellar built into the renovated interior spreads out before you, and the atmosphere is described as 'time stood still'.

建物オーナーは「先人や地域への愛情のかたち」として歴史建造物の保存を重視し、地域.en: The building owner values preserving historic buildings "as a form of love for our predecessors and the community", and aims to make a place where local people gather. For food, many tenants focus on "body-gentle" cooking with pesticide-free, organic vegetables.

建築を学んだわけではない初代が、自らの感性を職人に伝えてつくり上げた内装。色とり.en: An interior created by the first owner, who had never studied architecture, conveying a personal sense to craftsmen. Colourful irregular tiles and carving on the pillars and skirting boards decorate the space.

廿日市の地域メディア nh-times.jp と Vegewel（日本語）が、オ.en: The Hatsukaichi local medium nh-times.jp and Vegewel (Japanese) report owner Guru Maiko's background, the spring 2023 opening, curry with no wheat-flour roux, gluten-free cakes, and that it is fully vegan.

強いコシと太麺.en: thick noodles with a strong bite

当店では事前にアレルギーなど召し上がれない食材を伺っております.en: we ask in advance about allergies and any ingredients you can't eat

彩り美しく、日本海の幸をたっぷり盛りつけた様々な海鮮丼.en: all kinds of colourful seafood bowls generously piled with the bounty of the Sea of Japan

彩色ラーメンきんせい.r: さいしきらーめんきんせい

御客前会席.en: kaiseki finished in front of guests

御用菓子司.en: purveyor of sweets (to the domain lords)

御食国.en: Miketsukuni (a province that supplied food to the imperial court)

心が満たされるかわいらしく美味しいヴィーガンスイーツ.en: cute, delicious vegan sweets that fill the heart

心が満たされるかわいらしく美味しいヴィーガンスイーツを目指します.en: we aim for cute, delicious vegan sweets that fill the heart

心と体にやさしいごはん.en: food kind to heart and body

心に笑顔の種を撒く.en: sowing seeds of smiles in the heart

情報通・食べログ・ヒトサラで、2020年11月開業、築約90年の古民家、約320.en: Jōhōtsū, Tabelog and Hitosara confirm the November 2020 opening, the roughly 90-year-old house, the roughly 320-year-old Japanese garden, Nikomaru rice from Gifu, binchōtan and the unajū (中黄金). Hitosara confirms the chef's name (Ohmori Kouki). The official Matsuri Group site confirms three shops — the Nagono main shop, Sakae and Ikeshita — and the Ikeshita opening in July 2021. The neighbouring restaurant is Kaiin.

情熱と幸せ溢れるアツアツの一枚を.en: a piping-hot one, overflowing with passion and happiness

愛媛媛っこ地鶏.r: えひめひめっこじどり

愛知みかわ豚の特製焼豚.r: あいちみかわぶたのとくせいやきぶた

愛知県一宮市出身。会社員を辞めて調理師専門学校へ進み、中華料理店での修業を経て大.en: From Ichinomiya, Aichi Prefecture. Left an office job for culinary school, trained at a Chinese restaurant and then sharpened skills at a gyoza specialist in Osaka. After about a year and a half of training at the Osaka branch of a renowned Fukuoka motsunabe house, opened Motsu Fuji in Marunouchi, Nagoya in 2007 as a licensed offshoot.

愛知県体育館の1Fという珍しいロケーションで、キッズスペースを完備しファミリー層.en: An unusual location on the 1st floor of the Aichi Prefectural Gymnasium, with a full kids' space that makes it popular with families. The Nagoya Castle area surroundings are a feature.

愛知県体育館内のカジュアルなカフェで、スタッフとのやり取りは日本語が基本。英語対.en: A casual café inside the Aichi Prefectural Gymnasium; communication with staff is basically in Japanese. English service has not been confirmed.

愛知県優秀技能者表彰／あいちの名工.en: Aichi Prefecture Outstanding Skilled Worker Award / Aichi master craftsman
愛知県優秀技能者表彰／あいちの名工.r: あいちけんゆうしゅうぎのうしゃひょうしょう／あいちのめいこう

愛知県名古屋市中区丸の内（堀川沿い）.en: Marunouchi, Naka-ku, Nagoya, Aichi (on the Hori River)

懐石料理では醤油（小麦含有）が煮物・焼き物・たれ類に幅広く使われる。グルテンフリ.en: Kaiseki cooking uses soy sauce (contains wheat) widely in simmered dishes, grilled dishes and sauces. No mention of gluten-free soy sauce (wheat-free soy sauce or tamari labelled gluten-free).

懐石料理の標準的な調理で醤油（小麦含有）が煮物・タレ・だし等に使用されると推定さ.en: Standard kaiseki cooking presumably uses soy sauce (contains wheat) in simmered dishes, sauces and dashi. No explicit use of gluten-free soy sauce (tamari etc.).

戦後間もない時代から続く牛煮込みの名店.en: a renowned beef-stew shop going since just after the war

戸田家公式FAQが、夜食処とまゑを嬉春亭2階・営業18〜24時、ルームサービス受.en: The Todaya official FAQ confirms the late-night eatery Tomae on the second floor of Kishuntei, open 18:00–24:00, room service orders 19:00–23:00, a 'stylish little eatery' serving ramen, udon, soba, snacks and beer.

戸田家公式が、ゆっくり回転する展望レストランで鳥羽湾の夕景を望み、和洋の職人が御.en: The Todaya official site describes a slowly revolving observation restaurant looking over the evening view of Toba Bay, with Japanese and Western chefs cooking in front of guests (Ise lobster, abalone), home-grown hydroponic vegetables and a breakfast buffet of about 50 dishes. Tabelog states 'OPEN 21 July 2017!' and the south-wing location. Booking sites confirm it is 'the only revolving observation restaurant in Tokai'.

戸隠産・信濃町石臼挽きの十割そば.en: 100% buckwheat soba from Togakushi buckwheat, stone-milled in Shinano-machi

扇達磨グループ.r: おきなだるまぐるーぷ

手が届く価格で本格的な料理を。 シェフとゲストの距離感を大切にした親密なダイニン.en: Proper cooking at affordable prices. An intimate dining experience that values closeness between chef and guests. Over 100 wines, chosen to suit your taste.

手作りシュウマイ（蒸し・焼き）と、昆布と煮干しベースの和風だしがきいた中華そば。.en: Handmade shumai (steamed or pan-fried) and chuka soba with a Japanese dashi of kombu and niboshi. The house way to eat shumai is with Worcestershire sauce and hot mustard, not soy sauce.

手打うどん春日井.r: てうちうどんかすがい

手打ちの生麺にこだわったパスタを、体育館という日常的な空間で気軽に楽しんでもらう.en: Aims for pasta made with hand-made fresh noodles to be enjoyed casually in the everyday setting of a gymnasium.

手打ち蕎麦で蕎麦がなくなったらお店も閉店.en: Hand-made soba: when the soba runs out, the shop closes

手打ち蕎麦・サクサク天ぷら・自家製わらび餅.en: Hand-made soba, crispy tempura, homemade warabi mochi

手打釜揚うどん.r: てうちかまあげうどん

手揉み多加水麺を使ったあっさり中華そば（¥900）。豚・鶏・野菜を10時間かけて.en: Light Chinese soba (¥900) with hand-crumpled, high-hydration noodles: a clear golden soup of pork, chicken and vegetables simmered slowly for ten hours, paired with the distinctive wavy, creased hand-crumpled noodles.

手間ひまかけた出来たて.en: made fresh with time and care

手間ひまかけた出来たてを食べて欲しい.en: I want people to eat food made fresh with time and care

打ち粉もつけつゆも小麦。.en: Both the dusting flour and the dipping sauce are wheat.

打ち粉＋つなぎ小麦、つゆは小麦醤油。.en: Dusting flour + wheat binder; the broth is wheat soy sauce.

抹茶シロップと氷。小麦不使用。練乳を掛けるかどうかを要確認。.en: Matcha syrup and ice. No wheat. Ask whether condensed milk goes on.

抹茶・小豆・白玉（もち米粉）。小麦不使用。練乳の有無を要確認。.en: Matcha, azuki, shiratama (glutinous rice flour). No wheat. Ask about condensed milk.

抹茶＋牛乳＋砂糖。小麦は使わないが乳製品を含む。.en: Matcha + milk + sugar. No wheat, but contains dairy.

担々麺・らぁ麺ともに小麦麺・小麦醤油使用.en: both tantanmen and ramen use wheat noodles and wheat soy sauce

推しの一杯.en: the bowl I'm a fan of

揚げ出しの衣＝小麦粉・片栗粉、つゆ＝小麦醤油。.en: Agedashi coating = wheat flour and potato starch; broth = wheat soy sauce.

揚げ物・麺・ソースを含む食べ放題のため小麦回避は不可能。.en: An all-you-can-eat including fried food, noodles and sauces, so avoiding wheat is impossible.

揚げ物専門店のため、小麦パン粉を使用したフライが主力メニュー。共用の揚げ油で複数.en: A fried-food specialist, so the core menu is fried items in wheat breadcrumbs. Many ingredients are very likely fried in shared oil, so gluten cross-contamination risk is high.

揚げ物屋さんとは思えない.en: it hardly seems like a fried-food shop

揚げ物（天ぷら・フライ）を主力とする店で、小麦粉の衣を使用する調理が常時行われて.en: A shop centred on fried food (tempura, fritters), with flour-batter cooking going on all the time. Whether fryers are shared is unknown, but the risk of gluten contamination is extremely high.

揚げ玉は天ぷら衣そのもので純粋の小麦。.en: Agedama is tempura batter itself, pure wheat.

揚げ玉は天ぷら衣のかけら＝純粋の小麦。.en: Agedama are bits of tempura batter = pure wheat.

揚げ玉は小麦、つゆも小麦。.en: Agedama is wheat, and the broth is wheat too.

播磨灘の新鮮な穴子を多彩な調理法で提供し、素材本来の風味を最大限に引き出す.en: Serving fresh Harima-nada conger eel in many styles, bringing out the natural flavour of the fish as far as possible

支配人の尾関伸二氏は、客の様子や好みをくみ取りながら素敵なディナーになるよう最善.en: The manager says of doing the utmost to make a lovely dinner by reading each guest's mood and preferences, suggesting flexibility with the course contents.

支配人・尾関伸二氏のもと、記念日や特別な日の客を丁寧にもてなすことを大切にする。.en: Under the manager, it values caring hospitality for guests on anniversaries and special days. Particular about seasonal Japanese ingredients, the chef visits producing areas in person to select them. A wide range of select Italian wines.

文化財的な街の食堂.en: a town eatery like a cultural asset

松本生まれ、幼少期に長野市へ転居したオーナーの和田幸夫氏は、大学卒業後に内装デザ.en: Owner Wada Yukio, born in Matsumoto and moved to Nagano City as a child, went to Tokyo after university, drawn by interior design. Back home, the owner worked 6–7 years in construction as a scaffolder, then entered food service at a hotel restaurant. Borrowing the daytime hours of a counter bar that opened only at night, the owner ran lunch three days a week for four years, building funds and regulars, then went independent in the property next door. The business philosophy: realise the ideal step by step.

松本経済新聞と Web-Komachi が、ねんりん（社長・宮下祥次）が2025.en: The Matsumoto Keizai Shimbun and Web-Komachi report that Nenrin (president Miyashita Shoji) opened Hibi Donut Matsumoto Nakamachi on 11 March 2025 in the former Oimo Biyori site, using rice flour and wheat flour from its own farm in Sakaki; the rice-flour old-fashioned uses no wheat flour; limited to 650 a day. Wheat doughnuts are made in the same shop, so safety for celiac diners is not guaranteed.

松本経済新聞（2025-06-06）と Web-Komachi のオープン記事、.en: The Matsumoto Keizai Shimbun (2025-06-06), a Web-Komachi opening article and the Nakamachi shopping-street member page report that on 13 April 2025 Matsuoka Izumi opened a gluten-free, white-sugar-free rice-flour café in 'Nakamachi no Naka Nakamuraya'; training by borrowing the kitchens of Antares and Fernando; the origin of the name, 'spring is next door'; antique furniture (a table made from a treadle sewing-machine stand, chairs from a European church); and plans for rice-flour bread and evening opening.

看板ではグラノーラ、公式サイトの説明では雑穀米。どちらも麦類の可能性（押麦・もち.en: Granola on the sign, mixed-grain rice in the official site's description. Either may contain barley or oats (pressed barley, mochi barley, oats).

看板に「昼ランチ 各種ラーメン ライス サービスします」。サービスのライスは白飯.en: The sign reads 'Lunch: rice free with any ramen'. The free rice is plain white rice only, with no wheat and nothing animal-derived (the ramen itself is not OK). The free lunchtime rice is plain white rice.

看板の『まきさだラーメン』は、母体の創作中華店『京中華 牧定』でまかないとして出.en: The signature 'Makisada ramen' is the spring-onion soba once served as a staff meal at the parent creative-Chinese restaurant 'Kyo Chuka Makisada', rebuilt as ramen.

看板の『亮昌ぎょうざ』。鰹だしをベースにした合わせ和だしで上品に仕立てた京もち豚.en: The signature 'Sukemasa gyoza'. Minced Kyoto mochi pork refined with a blended Japanese dashi based on bonito, combined with fragrant Kujo negi, with a hint of miso from the old shop 'Yamari' as a hidden seasoning, wrapped in special chewy wrappers.

看板のまきさだラーメンは醤油ラーメンで、醤油（しょうゆ）ベースのタレを用いる。通.en: The signature Makisada ramen is a shoyu ramen using a soy-based tare. Regular soy sauce contains wheat, so it doesn't suit those avoiding gluten.

看板のウインナー珈琲は珈琲＋ホイップ生クリームで、乳製品を含みます。植物性ミルク.en: The signature Viennese coffee is coffee + whipped fresh cream, so it contains dairy. No mention of plant-milk substitutes or vegan handling could be confirmed. Check directly before visiting.

看板のカルニータスバーガーは豚肩肉をオレンジとスパイスで低温コンフィ風に火入れし.en: The signature carnitas burger is pork shoulder cooked confit-style at low temperature with orange and spices, also served as a rice bowl.

看板の季節のフルーツサンドは月替わりで旬の果物を使い、開店前から行列ができるほど.en: The signature seasonal fruit sandwich uses the fruit of the month and is so popular that a queue forms before opening. It is widely known as 'the fruit sandwich shop'.

看板の汁なし担々麺は『芳醇醤油』と『濃厚ゴマ』の2系統で、香り高さが評判。親店『.en: The signature brothless dandan noodles come in two lines, 'aromatic shoyu' and 'rich sesame', praised for their aroma. There are sides such as Singapore aubergine curry, inherited from the parent shop 'Himawari'.

看板の熟成醤油らぁ麺に加え、濃厚鶏白湯、自家製胡麻だれと香味油の胡麻担々、A5ラ.en: Besides the signature aged-soy ramen, it offers a wide range from rich chicken paitan and sesame tantan with house-made sesame sauce and aromatic oil to 'A5 wagyu ramen' topped with A5 wagyu roast beef. It also has a permanent 'vegan paitan ramen' and 'vegan tantan ramen' with no animal ingredients, catering for plant-based visitors.

看板は、月ごとに移ろう旬のフルーツをふんわりした食パンとコクのある生クリームで挟.en: The signature is the 'seasonal fruit sandwich': seasonal fruit that changes each month, between fluffy white bread and rich fresh cream. Carefully made, from choosing and cutting the fruit to the sweetness of the cream, it's so popular that a queue forms before opening. The coffee is roasted in-house daily on the shop's roaster and slowly brewed by flannel drip. There are three blends — Ichikawaya Blend, Seiji (celadon) Blend and Umamachi Blend — each served in Kiyomizu-yaki cups made by the father or brother. Even the cups are designed for each blend: the Ichikawaya Blend cup has a thin rim and thick base for ease of drinking and heat retention, and the Seiji Blend cup a wide mouth to lift the aroma. There are also items such as an egg sandwich and demi-glace omurice.

看板は「京のあさごはん」。焼き鮭か焼き鯖を選べる京の朝ごはんセット、地元の豆腐店.en: The signature is 'Kyoto breakfast'. A purely Japanese menu made with care from the morning: a Kyoto breakfast set with a choice of grilled salmon or grilled mackerel; soy-milk yuba porridge topped with plenty of rich soy milk and fresh yuba from a local tofu shop; and a dashimaki set starring a fluffy rolled omelette. At lunch the signature is a set of colourful obanzai, letting you taste Kyoto home cooking with care put into every dish, down to the dashimaki, soup, seasonal small dishes and pickles. In the afternoon, gentle sweets such as handmade pudding, pudding parfait and seasonal cakes are popular too.

看板は『熟成醤油らぁ麺』。国産鶏からていねいに引いた澄んだ鶏清湯に、鰹節・煮干し.en: The signature is 'aged-soy ramen'. A bowl of clear chicken broth carefully drawn from domestic chicken, layered with a Japanese dashi of bonito flakes, niboshi and kombu, with a mellow aged-soy kaeshi. Clear yet deep umami and the rich aroma of aged soy sauce are the essence.

看板はずばり『べた焼き』。たっぷりの刻み九条葱をのせるのがこの店の流儀で、油カス.en: The signature is simply 'betayaki'. Piling on plenty of chopped Kujo negi is this shop's way, and you can add toppings such as aburakasu, egg and kimchi. It comes out crisp, fragrant and light. For starters there are griddle dishes such as tecchan (offal) with vegetables, salt-grilled yam and thin-grilled beef.

看板はカルニータスバーガー。豚肩肉をオレンジとスパイスで低温コンフィ風にじっくり.en: The signature is the carnitas burger: pork shoulder slowly cooked confit-style at low temperature with orange and spices until tender and falling apart, also served as a rice bowl. Others include a bacon cheeseburger, double cheeseburger and BBQ cheeseburger. The buns are house-made brioche, the patties hand-chopped beef, and bacon, smoked brisket and the sauces are all made in the shop. House-made cola and ginger ale too.

看板はデンマーク産ナチュラルクリームチーズを使ったクリームチーズもみじ饅頭で、な.en: The signature is a cream-cheese momiji manjū made with Danish natural cream cheese; its smooth, rich flavour is popular and it often sells out. There is a wide range of others, such as smooth bean paste, coarse bean paste, custard cream, chocolate and rum-soaked raisin, and 'Okomomiji' (the shop's registered trademark), crossing Miyajima's famous okonomiyaki with momiji manjū, is a specialty too.

看板は一杯の中華そば。澄んだ黄金色のクリアな豚骨醤油スープで、豚骨の力強い旨味を.en: The signature is a bowl of chūka soba. A clear, golden pork-bone shoyu soup that lets you feel the powerful umami of pork bone while holding back the salt and soy, a bowl that isn't heavy even in the morning. The noodles are high-hydration, flat, medium-thick, with a springy bounce and smooth slurp. The chāshū is pork belly cut to order, so you can enjoy thin and thick slices.

看板は油そば。中太のちょい縮れ麺を醤油ベースのタレと植物油で和えたスープのない一.en: The signature is abura soba. A soupless bowl of medium-thick, slightly curly noodles tossed with a soy-based sauce and plant oil, topped with menma, spring onion, shredded nori and chāshū. The standard way to eat it is to change the flavour midway with vinegar and chilli oil — 'delicious twice'. Choose soy sauce or salt sauce.

看板は特製チャーシューラーメン。真っ黒に見える濃色の醤油スープ（鶏の旨味も効いた.en: The signature is the special chāshū ramen. A dark shoyu soup that looks jet black (brown, with chicken umami), thin-sliced chāshū arranged like petals, plenty of green onion, and thin straight noodles.

看板は鰹昆布水つけそば。北海道産がごめ昆布と土佐清水の鰹（宗田節）からとった昆布.en: The signature is bonito-kombu-water tsuke-soba: custom medium-thin noodles with whole-grain flour steeped in kombu water drawn from Hokkaido gagome kombu and Tosashimizu bonito (sōda-bushi), eaten with a dipping sauce of aged soy sauce and domestic duck fat. The regular aged-soy chūka soba (¥900–1,000) is a light, refined bowl of clear yet powerful soup drawn from domestic chicken, bonito and niboshi, scented with yuzu.

看板デザートの固めの『サンデーレトロプリン』には、シナモンまたは八幡屋礒五郎の七.en: The signature firm 'Sunday Retro Pudding' can be topped with cinnamon or Yawataya Isogoro shichimi: an unexpected mix of sweet and spice.

看板メニュー「中黄金うな重」は、炭焼きうなぎと名古屋コーチン卵のだし巻き玉子を一.en: The signature unajū (中黄金) is popular as a dish combining charcoal-grilled eel and a rolled omelette of Nagoya Cochin eggs in one go.

看板メニュー「大名つづら」の中身は仕入れた食材によって毎日変わる。胡麻豆腐は手作.en: The contents of the signature "Daimyo Tsuzura" change daily with what is bought. The sesame tofu is handmade and praised as needing no sauce.

看板メニューに豚肉・卵・中華そば・かつお出汁が使われ、同じ鉄板で肉や卵を焼くため.en: The signature dish uses pork, egg, Chinese noodles and bonito dashi, and meat and egg are cooked on the same griddle; no information on separate plant-only cooking could be found.

看板メニューは『熟成醤油』のかえしを用いる。一般的な醸造醤油は小麦を含むため、醤.en: The signature menu uses an 'aged soy' kaeshi. Ordinary brewed soy sauce contains wheat, so it's reasonable to judge on the assumption of wheat from the soy sauce.

看板メニューは約10品を盛り合わせた「Vegan Delight」プレート（タコ.en: The signature is the 'Vegan Delight' plate of about 10 items (tacos, soy-meat karaage, a hamburg, chili con carne, daikon mochi and more). Among sweets, a matcha chocolate cake using naturally grown matcha from the Yamato highlands, a dairy-free vegan Basque cheesecake and beautiful tarts are popular.

真心むすびます.en: made with heartfelt sincerity (a pun on 'tying' rice balls)

矢場とん公式沿革によると、1947年に鈴木義夫が『矢場のとんかつ』として創業（南.en: According to Yabaton's official history, founded in 1947 by Suzuki Yoshio as 'Yaba no Tonkatsu' (near a tram stop on Otsu-dori; the name comes from Yaba, today's Osu area). Incorporated in 1953; opened the Yaba-cho main shop in 1970 and became 'Yabaton'. About 30 shops nationwide, plus Thailand (2014) and Taiwan. Miso katsu was inspired by a customer dipping tonkatsu into a doteni pot. A stall at Nagoya Stadium for 27 years, 1972–96. The Kinshachi Yokocho shop is in the Yoshinao Zone.

知ればもっと美味しくなる.en: the more you know, the tastier it gets

知多牛のシャトーブリアンを中心とした完全オマカセコース。シャトーブリアンの海苔巻.en: A full omakase course centred on Chita beef chateaubriand. The signature is chateaubriand rolled in nori (with spring onion and miso). One course uses about 500 g of meat, including rare cuts such as the pointe (a rare part of the fillet).

石川県唯一の五ツ星お米マイスター、米粉100.en: Ishikawa's only five-star rice meister, 100% rice flour

石窯で焼き上げた全粒粉バンズ.en: whole-wheat bun baked in a stone oven
石窯で焼き上げた全粒粉バンズ.r: いしがまでやきあげたぜんりゅうふんばんず

磨き抜かれた技とおもてなしの心.en: polished skill and a spirit of hospitality

祖父の工房だった築200年の町家が取り壊されかけたとき、市川さんは『この場所を残.en: When the 200-year-old townhouse that had been the grandfather's workshop was about to be demolished, Ichikawa, out of the wish 'to keep this place', went ahead with a full renovation at about four times the cost of a new build.

神徳特製の中太麺を魚介と豚骨のＷスープで提供.en: Jintoku's special medium-thick noodles served in a double soup of seafood and pork bone

神戸新聞（1959年創業・駅地下・まねき食品継承・2019年10月前経営者死去・.en: Confirmed by the Kobe Shimbun (founded 1959; in the station basement; taken over by Maneki Foods; the previous operator died in October 2019; reopened March 2020; a sauce-then-dashi style started by customers; four kinds of bonito dashi; 松本恵美子), himeji.jp (Takopia became Takopii; Gran Festa) and kisspress (about 800 servings on weekdays, about 1,200 at weekends; tendinitis; three months' training).

福井ソースカツ丼と越前おろしそば。薄く大きなロース肉にきめ細かいパン粉をまとわせ.en: Fukui sauce katsudon and Echizen oroshi soba. The standard is to have them as a set: a thin, large pork-loin cutlet in fine breadcrumbs, dipped in rich Worcestershire sauce and laid on rice, together with a refreshing Echizen oroshi soba piled with bonito flakes, green onion and grated daikon.

福井出身者が試食して「本物の味」と太鼓判を押したと地元ブロガーが報告している。.en: A local blogger reports that people from Fukui tasted it and vouched for it as 'the real taste'.

福岡・博多の名門もつ鍋から暖簾分け（2007年開業）.en: A licensed offshoot of a renowned motsunabe house in Hakata, Fukuoka (opened 2007)

私しか作られんからね.en: "nobody but me can make it, you know"

移転前の情報は最新のものとは異なります」.en: The information from before the move differs from the latest'

税サ別、サービス料500円/人。鉄板フレンチのおまかせ。2025年の食べログ投稿.en: Tax and service extra; service charge ¥500/person. Teppan-French omakase. A 2025 Tabelog post shows a deeply flavoured soup, fish on a corn base, abalone, a small hamburger, milt and more (the hamburger bun is wheat). Mention gluten when booking.

税サ別。牛肉づくし。焼くだけなら小麦なしだがソース・付合せに小麦が入りうる。20.en: Tax and service extra. All beef. Just grilled means no wheat, but sauces and sides may contain wheat. On the 2019 board there were two courses: 'all-beef course ¥15,000' and 'all-fish course ¥15,000'.

税サ込。2日前までの予約が必要、予約時間でのOPENになります、と板書。鉄板フレ.en: Tax and service included. Must be booked at least 2 days ahead, and opens at the booked time, says the board. It is teppan French, so dishes with bread and wheat flour are cooked on the same griddle — beware of cross-contact. A note says dinner courses are also available.

税サ込〜。お客様のご希望食材等のアレンジコースもご用意いたします。記念日・誕生日.en: Tax and service included, from. Custom courses with ingredients of your choice are also available. Please use us for special days like anniversaries and birthdays, says the board.

税込。おでん・タレ串・餃子を含むためグルテン回避は不可。滞在2時間、カウンター席.en: Tax included. Includes oden, sauce skewers and gyoza, so avoiding gluten is impossible. 2-hour stay, counter seats.

種子島産安納芋使用。毎日20個限定。.en: Uses Annō sweet potato from Tanegashima. Limited to 20 a day.

種日替わりおばんざい定食.en: kinds of daily-changing obanzai, as a set meal

穴子のツメ・タレは醤油＝小麦。.en: Anago tsume / sauce is soy sauce = wheat.

穴子丼のたれや各種料理には通常の醤油（小麦含有）が使用されていると推定される。グ.en: The conger-eel bowl sauce and other dishes presumably use ordinary soy sauce (contains wheat). No information at all suggests gluten-free soy sauce.

穴子天ぷら九条葱まみれ.en: conger eel tempura smothered in Kujo green onion

立ち呑み屋（株）公式サイト confirms 2009年創業、1号店・串酒場 大.en: The Tachinomiya Co. official site confirms: founded 2009; first shop the skewer bar Daisho; representative 肥後雅之's training in Osaka; the ideal of smiles that never end on both sides of the noren; the gyoza shop = 'a father's warmth'. Kanazawa Jikan, tacsp and others confirm Honmachi, about 7 minutes' walk from Kanazawa Station east exit; over 7 gyoza such as Daisho gyoza, coriander gyoza and stamina gyoza; fried rice and ramen; gyoza and beer as the golden combo.

第12回姫路市都市景観賞（建造物部門）を受賞。漆喰・窓・木製建具など当時の素材を.en: Won the 12th Himeji City Urban Landscape Award (buildings). The renovation was praised for keeping original materials such as plaster, windows and wooden fittings.

第2週水曜日・木曜日以外の週の月曜日・木曜日.en: Mondays and Thursdays, except in weeks with a 2nd Wednesday / Thursday

箸袋には大勧進の僧侶が一枚一枚手書きした漢字の言葉が記されており、会計後にお客自.en: Each chopstick sleeve carries a word in kanji handwritten one by one by a Daikanjin monk, and after paying, guests choose a favourite and take it home. The chopsticks are solid wood, and are said to feel almost like a charm (the writer chose 'wisdom' and 'sincerity').

築100年以上の古民家（元酒蔵とも伝わる）を改装した建物を発見したオーナーが、そ.en: The owner found a renovated old house over 100 years old (said to be a former sake brewery), fell in love with the space and opened the restaurant. It stands along Himeji Castle's walls, in a quiet corner northwest of the castle.

築約140年の町家を改装した「粟 ならまち店」。オーナー・農業家の三浦雅之さんと.en: 'Awa Naramachi', in a renovated townhouse about 140 years old. Owner and farmer Masayuki Miura and manager and chef Atarashi Daisuke, among others, grow and harvest Yamato heirloom vegetables. Awa Co. and the NPO Kiyosumi no Sato, among others, work together to serve dishes of Yamato heirloom vegetables and Yamato beef.

築約380年の土蔵を内覧した瞬間に「ここでレストランをやろう」と直感。床の張り替.en: On first viewing the roughly 380-year-old earthen storehouse, an instant conviction: 'I'll open a restaurant here.' The owner took part in the renovation, from replacing the floor to plastering, and still maintains it every year.

米こうじを多く使い、長期間熟成させた濃厚な味とコクが特徴です」.en: uses a lot of rice koji and is aged long, giving it a rich, deep flavour"

米と米麹のみ。地元愛知の名酒。.en: Rice and rice kōji only. A well-known local Aichi sake.

米ぬか漬けの燻製大根。商品によっては調味液に小麦。要確認。.en: Smoked daikon pickled in rice bran. Depending on the product, the pickling liquid contains wheat. Ask.

米ベース。出汁・醤油は要確認。カニカマなら小麦でんぷんの可能性。.en: Rice-based. Ask about the dashi and soy sauce. If imitation crab, wheat starch is possible.

米ベース。卵とじの可能性、出汁はかつお。醤油の小麦は要確認。.en: Rice-based. Possibly bound with egg; bonito dashi. Ask about wheat in the soy sauce.

米ベースだが出汁・醤油に小麦の可能性。うなぎのタレも。要確認。.en: Rice-based, but the dashi and soy sauce may contain wheat. The eel sauce too. Ask.

米・米麹。醸造アルコールの有無は蔵により異なるが小麦は通常不使用。.en: Rice, rice kōji. Whether brewer's alcohol is added depends on the brewery, but wheat is usually not used.

米屋なので小麦製品を扱わず、カフェのお菓子・パンはすべて米粉100％（.en: Being a rice shop, it handles no wheat products; the café's sweets and bread are all 100% rice flour (

米屋の米粉シフォンケーキ, お米パン（こめやパン）, 米粉ラスク.en: rice-shop rice-flour chiffon cake, rice bread (Komeya bread), rice-flour rusks

米料理だがブイヨン・醤油に小麦の可能性。.en: A rice dish, but the bouillon and soy sauce may contain wheat.

米料理だがブイヨン・醤油に小麦の可能性。要確認。.en: A rice dish, but the bouillon and soy sauce may contain wheat. Ask.

米焼酎。米と米麹のみ。.en: Rice shōchū. Rice and rice kōji only.

米粉 100% のため、モチモチふわふわ♪ (of the 米粉パン on th.en: Made with 100% rice flour, so it's chewy and fluffy♪ (of the rice-flour bread on the Corpo plate, itself described as a gluten-free dish made without wheat flour)

米粉100％の身体に優しい.en: 100% rice flour, kind to the body

米粉から特製ライスカスタード.en: special rice custard from rice flour

米粉か小麦か要確認。.en: Check whether it is rice flour or wheat.

米粉ではなくお米から.en: from rice grains, not rice flour

米粉のシュー生地＋豆乳クリーム。乳製品不使用・グルテンフリー。.en: Rice-flour choux pastry + soy-milk cream. Dairy-free, gluten-free.

米粉の他に、きび砂糖や有機豆乳、米油などこだわりの食材で作られた.en: made with carefully chosen ingredients besides rice flour, such as cane sugar, organic soy milk and rice oil

米粉の生地に無添加チーズをトッピングしたジェノベーゼピザ.en: genovese pizza on rice-flour dough topped with additive-free cheese

米粉の食パンと焼菓子のグルテンフリーカフェ。独自ブレンドの国産米粉を100％使用.en: A gluten-free café of rice-flour loaves and baked goods. It uses 100% of its own blend of Japanese rice flour, and everything, including bread and cakes, is hand-made. Lunch dishes such as pasta and quiche are popular too.

米粉を100％使用したグルテンフリーのパン.en: gluten-free bread made with 100% rice flour

米粉を使ったグルテンフリーのカヌレ（外はカリッと、中はふわふわ）が少なくとも一時.en: Gluten-free canelés made with rice flour (crisp outside, fluffy inside) are confirmed to have been offered at least for a time.

米粉を使ったケーキやタルトなど、3、4種類.en: three or four kinds, such as cakes and tarts made with rice flour

米粉スポンジ。チーズ部分の乳有無を要確認。.en: Rice-flour sponge. Check the cheese part for dairy.

米粉スポンジ。卵乳小麦不使用のアレルギー対応ライン。要個別確認。.en: Rice-flour sponge. Allergy-friendly line with no egg, dairy or wheat. Check each item.

米粉スポンジのグルテンフリーケーキを常設・オーダーメイド対応。.en: Rice-flour-sponge gluten-free cakes always available; made to order.

米粉チキンは小麦粉の代わりに米粉を使いグルテンフリー。ハンバーガーのバンズはプラ.en: The rice-flour chicken uses rice flour instead of wheat flour and is gluten-free. Hamburger buns can be changed to gluten-free buns for ¥200 extra; only 5 counter seats.

米粉チキン専門店です。米粉チキンは、小麦粉の代わりに米粉を使っており、グルテンフ.en: 'We are a rice-flour chicken specialist. Our rice-flour chicken uses rice flour instead of wheat flour and is gluten-free' — rated ★★★★ by JP GF guide.

米粉パンの店 香米豆 Kagome ／愛知・豊橋 … グルテンフリー度 ★★★★.en: Rice-flour bread shop 香米豆 Kagome / Toyohashi, Aichi … Gluten-free rating ★★★★★ Point: a shop of rice-flour bread with no wheat, dairy or egg. — and the list preamble: '90 shops bring no wheat flour at all into the workshop or shop and all their products are gluten-free.' 'This page lists 90 bakeries that offer only gluten-free rice-flour bread and rice bread. Everything in the shop is wheat-free and gluten-free.'

The brand name 'BEIKA = rice confectionery' refers to rice-flour sweets (not an actual rice-cracker maker). The story begins with 'the curiosity of one confectioner', and the workshop and shop is in a renovated Kyoto townhouse over 100 years old. It buys raw rice from farmers and bakes baumkuchen with rice flour freshly milled in-house. Freshly milled rice flour holds a different amount of moisture, and the moist texture is its greatest point of pride. On 29 March 2023 it had a limited-time stand at JR Kyoto Isetan, selling gluten-free rice-flour baumkuchen.
