食べログ(店舗会員): 麺ファクトリー ジョーズ、大阪市中央区上本町西2-1-1.en: Tabelog (shop member): Men Factory Jaws, Kusumoto Bldg 1F, 2-1-11 Uehommachi-nishi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Tanimachi-Rokuchome Station exit 3; daily 11:00–15:30 and 17:30–22:30; no cards, e-money or QR; 20 seats (counter 6, two tables for 4, one for 6); no smoking; a stylish space; opened 21 July 2014; blog ameblo.jp/factory-jaws; Tabelog Ramen OSAKA Hyakumeiten 2023, 2024 and 2025. Reviews (August–October 2026): a 20th visit; rich tsukemen ¥1,200; ticket machine outside; large curry; full quickly; chewy medium-thick straight noodles; a pork and chicken base with sardine flakes and niboshi plus curry; spice aroma and faint heat; pork-loin and seared pork-belly chashu; soup-wari and rice for a soup-curry finish; menu: rich tsukemen (shoyu, curry), spicy rich tsukemen, maze-soba (shoyu, curry), ramen (shoyu, salt); large free; pepper and shichimi on the table; 3 staff; maze-soba ¥1,150; flat medium-thick noodles; chashu, soft-boiled egg, cheese, fried onion, nori, nira, leek; dashi rice to finish; thick chewy noodles; yuzu-kosho; fish powder; special rich tsukemen; house-made noodles; change the flavour with lemon; comes with small rice.

食べログ(店舗会員): 麺屋 やまひで 堺筋本町店、大阪市中央区久太郎町1-9-.en: Tabelog (shop member): Menya Yamahide Sakaisuji-Hommachi, Eight Bldg 1F, 1-9-2 Kyutaromachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Sakaisuji-Hommachi Station exit 6; Mon–Fri 11:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:30) and 18:00–2:00 next morning (L.O. 1:30), Sat 11:30–14:30; closed Sundays and holidays; announcements on Instagram; no cards, e-money or QR; counter seats; opened 15 April 2016. Reviews (June–October 2026): Taiwan maze-soba; a bright, friendly owner; clean inside; the spicy soup is lighter than it looks; seared chashu and menma; Taiwan maze-soba ¥900, regular or small; less garlic; rice to finish ¥50; leek, nira, garlic, chili and Taiwan mince; egg; thick chewy noodles; put the spoon in the empty bowl and set it on the counter for rice; often goes to the Nara shop too; rice to finish now costs extra; change the flavour with kombu vinegar; lighter than usual.

食べログ(店舗会員): 麺屋 九兵衛、大阪市中央区南本町2-4-15 南本町若林.en: Tabelog (shop member): Menya Kyubee, Minamihommachi Wakabayashi Bldg 1F, 2-4-15 Minamihommachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Sakaisuji-Hommachi Station exit 8; Mon–Thu 11:00–16:00, Fri 11:30–20:00; closed weekends and holidays; no cards, e-money or QR; 20 seats; no smoking; a stylish, calm space; opened 1 November 2021. Reviews (May–September 2026): izakaya menu from 15:00 on Fridays; bean-sprout namul; toro liver (low-temperature); chicken sashimi yukhoe; seared rare chashu; dashimaki; fried rice; salt ramen; leek chijimi; salt-grilled chicken breast; karaage; chuka soba and half fried rice set; plenty of chicken fat and shoyu aroma; chewy medium-thick noodles; rare chashu; one says the fried rice isn't fluffy; fresh chicken; toro liver ¥400; chicken sashimi ¥400; 2 karaage ¥150; highball ¥350; one found the salt seasoned-egg ramen with mini fried rice heavy on fat and salt; a clean shop; a confusing ticket machine; one says the karaage was pre-made and lukewarm, the soup lukewarm too; cold soba; kumquat; kombu and bonito dashi; chicken soboro; firm medium-thick noodles.

食べログ(店舗会員): 麺食堂 コハクドリ、大阪市中央区本町4-8-6、本町駅か.en: Tabelog (shop member): Men Shokudo Kohakudori, 4-8-6 Hommachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Hommachi Station; Mon–Sat and holidays 11:00–15:00 and 17:30–23:00, Sun 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–22:00; no cards, e-money or QR; 9 seats; no smoking; opened 5 June 2023. Reviews (December 2025 – October 2026): abura soba and maze-soba with plenty of chashu, with small rice; a clear-soup ramen; chashu rice bowl; one says it's the same group as Subarushinbashi in Sakaisuji-Hommachi; diners even at 22:00; a clear taste like a blend of 3 soups; jidori umami and a sharp shoyu; thin straight noodles; low-temperature chashu; soft menma; seared diced-chashu rice bowl with leek and shredded nori; salt shijimi ramen; shiso; light; salt shijimi ramen ¥880; medium-thick wavy noodles; special salt shijimi; 2 kinds of thick chashu; one found it sweetish and monotonous later on; made carefully, so it takes a little time.

食べログ(英)・ヒトサラで、香林坊の町家居酒屋、座敷と内庭、治部煮(鴨・麩・わさ.en: Tabelog (EN) and Hitosara confirm: a townhouse izakaya in Korinbo with tatami rooms and an inner garden; jibuni (duck, fu, wasabi) served cheaply as a single dish (rare in the city); Ishikawa seafood, Kaga vegetables and local sake.

食べログ/HAMONI/autoreserve等が東区泉・2018年1月11日開.en: Tabelog, HAMONI, autoreserve and others confirm Izumi, Higashi-ku; opened 11 January 2018; reservations only and must be accompanied by the introducer; address not public; photos and social-media posts prohibited; courses only. The wooden-box ingredient display and handmade chocolates are based on blog accounts.

食べログ: 17MAP、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋2-3-7 ROYAL KITAGA.en: Tabelog: 17MAP, ROYAL KITAGAWA Bldg 1F, 2-3-7 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 8 seats (counter 6, one table for 2); Mon–Thu and days before holidays 19:00–3:00 next morning (L.O. 2:30), Fri–Sat 19:00–4:00 next morning (L.O. 3:30); closed Sundays and holidays; no smoking (smoking area outside); cards and e-money accepted; features: vegetables, vegan menu, vegetarian menu; shop introduction: tacos of the moment, burritos. Reviews (March 2025 – April 2026): a hidden bar 'AREA51' behind the kitchen (22:00–3:00); smallish burritos; a colourful, cute shop; one-drink minimum; well-filled tacos; tortillas; Mexican music; tequila; soft tacos (beef, chicken, pork, veg); all-you-can-eat taco events; takeaway.

食べログ: 39チキン 日本橋本店、大阪市中央区千日前1-2-8、日本橋駅から1.en: Tabelog: 39 Chicken Nippombashi main shop, 1-2-8 Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 109 m from Nippombashi Station; daily 12:00–2:00 next morning (L.O. 1:30); no reservations (no phone bookings); cards, e-money and QR accepted; no smoking; 8 seats; takeaway; delivery. Reviews (2018 – November 2025): Korean fried chicken; fried to order; bone-in or boneless; the shop says aged 24 hours with 12 medicinal ingredients; yangnyeom; shoyu; half & half ¥1,950 (November 2025); 4-kind set; pickled radish and aurora sauce; cheese balls; tteok and sausage skewers; Korean steamed egg in a stone pot; one found it a little pricey for takeaway; a second shop exists.

食べログ: 512 CAFE＆SWEETS、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋2-1-24 2.en: Tabelog: 512 CAFE & SWEETS, 2F, 2-1-24 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 378 m from Shinsaibashi Station; daily 9:00–17:00; open every day of the year; opened 16 July 2020; reservations accepted; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; no smoking; 10 seats; children welcome; takeaway; official site. Reviews (June–October 2026): a pancake shop; order by QR on your phone; self-serve water; fluffy, wobbly pancakes with a caramelised top and custard inside; whipped cream; vanilla ice cream; berry sauce; bittersweet caramel sauce; matcha pancakes ¥1,800 (before tax); matcha custard and mascarpone; peach and mascarpone; summer chocolate mint about ¥2,600; 512 lunch plate of French toast with bacon and eggs; house lemonade; eggs from Kannan Farm in Hyogo in the batter; served in about 10 minutes; quiet at weekday lunch; the tables for 2 nearly full at holiday lunch; one gives hours as 10:00–17:00 (L.O. 16:00).

食べログ: 8ppy麻辣湯、大阪市浪速区難波中2-10-70 なんばパークス 6.en: Tabelog: 8ppy Malatang, Namba Parks 6F, 2-10-70 Nambanaka, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 215 m from Namba; daily 11:00–21:30; cards (AMEX), e-money and QR accepted; no smoking. Reviews (July–September 2026): could eat it every day; a regular for years; molokhia, white wood-ear, king oyster mushroom, tomato, coriander; thick sweet-potato noodles; heat 2; 7 items for ¥1,500; choose your heat; flavour changers on the table; order by filling in a form at the table; the total is hard to read in the small print; a medicinal-herb flavour; here since before the boom; garlic, black vinegar, Sichuan-pepper oil; smallish portions; full of young women; glass noodles; cramped like a standing soba bar; about ¥1,500; pork-shabu rice; mochi.

食べログ: AMBER、大阪市西区北堀江2-4-20 ハイフォレスト1、四ツ橋・.en: Tabelog: AMBER, High Forest 1, 2-4-20 Kita-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Yotsubashi and Nishi-Ohashi stations, 11 from Shinsaibashi Station; Tue–Sun and holidays 11:30–15:30 (L.O. 14:30) and 17:30–23:00 (L.O. food 22:00); closed Mondays (Tuesday if Monday is a holiday); irregular closures (Instagram highlights); cards, e-money and QR accepted; 20 seats (tables). Reviews (September–October 2026): bright and warm; at lunch pasta with potage, bread and salad (swordfish and spinach tomato sauce); courses and à la carte at night (braised beef cheek, sea-urchin cream pasta, Kuroge wagyu, sirloin-cap steak, crab risotto, baguette with fig butter, house tiramisu); birthday plates; friendly staff; good for lunch with children; always full, book ahead; a sister cafe; one found portions small for 4 to share.

食べログ: AWA SUSHI 泡鮨、大阪市中央区南船場2-6-7 Cuvée.en: Tabelog: AWA SUSHI, Cuvée J2 Hôtel Osaka, 2-6-7 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 1 min from Nagahoribashi Station via the Crysta Nagahori north lift 4; daily 17:00–22:30 (last entry 20:30, everyone starts together); lunch for private hire only; cards, transit IC, iD and QR (PayPay, Alipay, WeChat Pay) accepted; no service charge; 10 counter seats. Reviews (April–September 2026): a champagne and sushi restaurant; reservations; omakase (several dishes and 10–12 nigiri, soup, seasonal dessert); abalone steamed 6 hours with liver sauce (a little rice at the end); surf clam; anago; sea urchin; chutoro; aged preparations; fried young ayu; kamochi ayu; dobin-mushi; a pairing of one glass for every 2–3 dishes from over 200 champagnes; a different producer each month; courteous service; for anniversaries; one found the grilled fish watery.

食べログ: BANCO、大阪市中央区西心斎橋1-9-26 はり重大宝寺店1F、心.en: Tabelog: BANCO, Harijyu Daihoji Shop 1F, 1-9-26 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk west of Shinsaibashi Station; daily 12:00–2:00 next morning; cards and e-money accepted; smoking allowed; 20 seats; terrace seats. Reviews (June 2023 – July 2026): north side of Amemura, on Daikokubashi-suji; double espresso; espresso ¥363, doppio ¥440, cappuccino doppio ¥583 (2024); house tiramisu; panini; doria; desserts about ¥500; beer from midday; plenty of alcohol; widely spaced tables; the ease of being left alone; smoking allowed inside; no toilet, staff point you to one nearby; one found the interior getting cluttered; PayPay accepted.

食べログ: Bon、大阪市中央区道頓堀1-10-7 ギャラリー香ビル5F、06-.en: Tabelog: Bon, Gallery Kaori Bldg 5F, 1-10-7 Dotonbori, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6212-7760; reservations accepted; daily 11:30–19:00 (L.O. 18:30); QR (PayPay) accepted; 15 seats; site kdtp400.gorp.jp. Reviews (2011–2026): up the lift to the 5th floor, the bustle of Dotonbori feels far away; a quiet, calm space; a half-cheese, half-chocolate cake set; diagonally opposite Shochikuza; a gallery on the ground floor and paintings inside too; for meeting before a show; mixed juice; one member of staff; in December 2025 the home-made pudding was good and the staff kind; in August 2026 iced tea and matcha milk for ¥600–700; one found it unfriendly.

食べログ: CASABLANCA NAMBA RIVERSIDE、大阪市中央区西.en: Tabelog: CASABLANCA NAMBA RIVERSIDE, S-Front Dotonbori 1F, 2-6-7 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 050-5570-2869; reservations accepted (mention allergies, vegan or vegetarian requests, or wanting the terrace with a dog when booking); daily 7:00–24:00 (food L.O. 23:00, drinks L.O. 23:30); cards, e-money (iD, QUICPay) and QR payment accepted; 52 seats (terrace 24); no smoking; English menu and English-speaking staff; opened 10 July 2025. Shop's description: authentic Middle Eastern and Mediterranean food, a vegan menu too, plenty of vegetarian, gluten-free and vegan dishes, house-roasted coffee. 2026 reviews (August–October): falafel pita sandwich; grilled-chicken shawarma; house-made fries; river view; English breakfast; bacon-and-egg croissant; domestic-corn tartine (rye bread, grilled corn, hummus, avocado, tomato, marinated onion; vegan); caffè latte; lunch even before 16:00; a foreign atmosphere.

食べログ: CHIKAPPA 谷4店、大阪市中央区常磐町1-3-18 谷4ビル.en: Tabelog: CHIKAPPA Tani 4, Tani 4 Bldg 1F, 1-3-18 Tokiwamachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 241 m from Tanimachi-Yonchome Station; daily 11:00–14:30 and 18:00–23:00; opened 14 May 2025; cards, PayPay and Rakuten Pay accepted; children welcome. Reviews (October 2025 – October 2026): Hakata tonkotsu; white tonkotsu; black tonkotsu with black mayu; RED; thin straight noodles (soft to bari-kata); wood-ear; leek; nori; thick, tender chashu; unlimited takana and red pickled ginger on the table; half fried rice and 2-karaage set; fried rice; lively service; one found it bland and the karaage oily.

食べログ: COLAVOLTA、大阪市天王寺区生玉前町4-20 レナジア四天王寺.en: Tabelog: COLAVOLTA, Renazia Shitennoji 1F, 4-20 Ikutamamaemachi, Tennoji-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk south from Tanimachi-Kyuchome Station exit 5; Sun, Mon and holidays 18:30–0:30 next morning (L.O. 0:00), Tue 11:45–14:30 and 18:30–0:30, Wed–Thu 11:45–14:30 and 18:30–1:30 (L.O. 1:00), Fri–Sat 11:45–14:30 and 18:30–2:30 (L.O. 2:00); daily opening on Instagram; 20% late-night surcharge from 22:00; no cards; PayPay and Alipay accepted; 34 seats (counter 9, tables 24). Reviews (January–October 2026): tomato ramen made with 8 tomatoes; curry ramen; keema-curry ramen (thin or thick noodles); tsukemen (choose a dipping soup, such as a rich spicy one; a limited mushroom tsukemen with balsamic); summer cold salt-lemon ramen; evening set ¥1,000 (keema-curry ramen and seared chashu rice bowl); winged pan-fried gyoza; karaage with tartare; grilled salted tomato with garlic chips; fries with a choice of salt; butter-shoyu potatoes; fried rice; private-hire party course (2-hour all-you-can-drink ¥3,980); coupons; one found the dipping soup salty.

食べログ: Cafe Morning Box(旧店名 コーヒーポート大阪スタンド.en: Tabelog: Cafe Morning Box (formerly Coffee Port Osaka Stand), HOTEL MORNING BOX 1F, 1-10-3 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6243-0777; no reservations; daily 8:00–22:30 (L.O. 22:00); cards and QR (PayPay, d-barai) accepted, no e-money; 33 seats (1F 7 tables; 2F counter 5, tables 14, sofas 4); no smoking; opened 7 July 2020. Shop's description: specialty coffee in a hotel lobby; spend ¥600 or more to use the hotel lounge (power outlets); organic and vegan deli lunch plates; additive-free baked goods by an artisan (changing daily); the carrot cake is popular. 2026 reviews (July–October): weekend-only peach and black-tea rice-flour French toast (mascarpone, caramel sauce; bookable in the afternoon); vegan baked goods and meals; seasonal carrot cake (cinnamon); banana caramel salt muffin; rice-flour canelé; hojicha latte; eggs Benedict ¥1,800 (one likened it to ham and eggs); two floors; people working on laptops; a calm atmosphere by Nagahoribashi Station.

食べログ: Cafe NooNe、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-14-14 T.Kビル.en: Tabelog: Cafe NooNe, T.K Bldg 1F, 1-14-14 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi and Nagahoribashi stations; daily 11:00–20:00; opened 31 May 2021; no reservations; cards and e-money accepted, no QR; no smoking; 20 table seats; terrace seats. Reviews (March–July 2026): a stylish Korean-style cafe; claim a seat first, then choose from the case; Dubai chocolate mochi ¥740 (springy outside, pistachio and crunchy texture inside; check Instagram stories for sold-out days); Dubai cookie ¥920; brûlée cheesecake with ice cream ¥980; pumpkin Basque cheesecake ¥820; brownie cheesecake; blueberry cheesecake; strawberry-matcha shortcake ¥900; Earl Grey shortcake; bear sablé ¥400; iced coffee ¥550; orange and grapefruit ades; on Uber Eats too; an Amemura shop too; one found service slow; one found a cookie a little stale.

食べログ: Café Hapje、大阪市西区北堀江1-1-25 1F、四ツ橋駅3.en: Tabelog: Café Hapje, 1F, 1-1-25 Kita-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Yotsubashi Station exit 3; daily 10:00–18:00 (food L.O. 17:30); no reservations; cards, e-money and QR accepted; no smoking; 13 seats; children and pushchairs welcome; takeaway; power and Wi-Fi; opened 15 May 2016; Brussels waffles baked with Belgian ingredients; an unsweetened batter with Belgian butter; official site. Reviews (July–October 2026): photo captions say 'Brussels waffle (¥600)', 'Americano (¥540)', '(¥100 off as a set)'; baked to order; crisp and light rather than chewy; icing sugar; cold sweet-potato brûlée waffle ¥1,400; espresso shake ¥600; waffle with pudding and vanilla ice cream; choice of chocolate; seasonal fruit; an butter; caffè latte; one found the cream below expectations.

食べログ: G.L.B(グリーン・ライフ・ビギニング)、大阪市西区北堀江1-9-.en: Tabelog: G.L.B (Green Life Beginning), Oceans Bldg 1F, 1-9-15 Kita-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka, 06-6536-2236; no reservations; daily 10:00–19:30, open every day of the year; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; no cover charge; 29 seats (counter 5, tables 12, sofas 12); no smoking; opened 1 August 2017; dogs allowed on the terrace and near the entrance inside. Shop's description: a salad specialist committed to additive-free and vegan food; vegetables bought in daily from around the country; all house-made dressings additive-free and vegan (no white sugar, eggs, dairy, honey or animal products); MCT oil in the coconut dressing; gluten-free lemon cake (domestic lemons, pistachio); vegan chocolate-chip cookies; plant-based lattes with soy, oat or almond milk; roast-beef 'ANGE'; avocado 'IRIS'; eco-friendly containers. 2026 reviews (April–August): sofa seats; takeaway available; breakfast plate (salad, eggs, sausage, prosciutto, 2 kinds of bread, soy-milk soup); self-service, order at the counter; gapao rice and herb-chicken bowl (multigrain rice); Miranda salad (salmon and boiled egg) with coconut-lemon oil dressing; a 28-ingredient plate; dogs welcome.

食べログ: GREEN BAR 心斎橋店、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋2-7-4、20席.en: Tabelog: GREEN BAR Shinsaibashi, 2-7-4 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 20 seats; daily 11:00–21:00 (L.O. 20:30); closed only on 1 January; no smoking; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; features: vegetables, healthy, vegetarian menu; opened 14 November 2014. 2023–2026 reviews: run by Urban Research; matcha crêpe ¥700 (shiratama); caffè latte; hojicha latte; green smoothie of komatsuna, apple and banana; seasonal peach smoothie; run single-handed, so sometimes a wait; a hideaway-like eat-in space; one found the till service curt; smoothies of fresh vegetables and fruit; bagels; the inside is small, better for takeaway.

食べログ: GUFO、大阪市西区北堀江1-11-9 U+ビル 1F、四ツ橋駅から.en: Tabelog: GUFO, U+ Bldg 1F, 1-11-9 Kita-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 162 m from Yotsubashi Station; Mon, Tue and Thu–Sun 12:00–18:00; closed Wednesdays; cards (JCB, AMEX) and e-money accepted, no QR; no smoking; 6 seats; children and pushchairs welcome; takeaway; opened 29 April 2016; official site. October 2026 reviews: a light soft-serve full of fine air; milk ¥420; Japanese chestnut ¥540; hazelnut cup ¥520; daily gelato ¥420 (salted vanilla, dried fig and cheese, pumpkin, hojicha, Earl Grey chocolate); one says the portion is generous enough to share; an interior of wood and white tile; short queues form quickly at weekends; photo captions say 'Japanese-chestnut soft-serve', 'pumpkin and pistachio', 'today's ice cream', 'Earl Grey chocolate ¥420'.

食べログ: Gion Duck Noodles 難波店、大阪市中央区千日前2-4.en: Tabelog: Gion Duck Noodles Namba, Sennichimae Bldg, 2-4-10 Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 11:00–22:00; closed Wednesdays; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted. 2026 reviews (August–October): a popular shop from Gion, Kyoto; Kishu duck soup; light and rich versions; the salt (clear broth) is amber; budo sansho; house-made noodles blended with German rye; duck breast and leg chashu, choose the number of slices; seasoned egg; Namba-only duck skewers (budo sansho, yuzu, black shichimi); GION DUCK BEER; free refills of Kyoto hojicha; the menu uses emoji; staff explain carefully; tsukemen with sauces of Kishu mikan or cherry; Madeira-wine sauce; flat rye noodles; pink sprouts and edible flowers; one review gives lunch 11:00–16:00 and dinner 18:00–22:00, no cash.

食べログ: Gluten-Free Healthy Cafe SEREN Pec.en: Tabelog: Gluten-Free Healthy Cafe SEREN Peche Shinsaibashi, Osaka Fukutani Bldg 1F, 2-4-20 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 070-2424-3975; reservations accepted; Mon and Wed–Sun 7:30–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); closed Tuesdays; changes for events (Instagram opening calendar); cards (VISA, Master) accepted, no e-money or QR; 20 seats; opened 3 April 2022. Shop's description: a health-minded cafe, gluten-free, additive-free and without white sugar; rice-flour craft burgers and nourishing sweets by day; casual French-style dinner at night. Reviews (April 2025 – February 2026): lemon cake and cheesecake to take away; gluten-free curry; introduced as recipes devised by a physical therapist; fermented-vegetable Buddha bowl; kinako chocolate cake; brown-rice-flour chiffon cake ¥700; oat-milk coffee ¥650; curry with well-balanced spices; rice with quinoa; gluten-free desserts.

食べログ: Gyokotsuya 道頓堀店、大阪市中央区宗右衛門町4-10 大京.en: Tabelog: Gyokotsuya Dotonbori, Daikyo Bldg 2F, 4-10 Soemoncho, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-7777-6068; 16 seats (tables 12, counter 4); Mon and Wed–Sun and holidays 18:00–1:00 next morning (L.O. 0:30); closed Tuesdays; no smoking; cards and e-money accepted; opening date 20 July 2026. October 2026 reviews: one says it opened 12 September; the third shop of 'Gyokotsuya', a members-only ramen shop from Fukuoka, with no membership needed in Ginza and Dotonbori; 2nd floor of a building with luxury-brand shops; fish-bone ramen, fish-bone tsukemen, spicy fish-bone ramen, spicy fish-bone tsukemen; hot pots and sides; rich sea-bream paitan soup; chewy noodles; fried sakura shrimp; grilled rice balls; overseas staff; some ask whether it's worth ¥1,450, one found the soup thin; a modern Japanese space of black and vermilion lattice; 'the sixth taste'; evening-only medicinal hot pot and grilled liver; spicy fish-bone tsukemen ¥1,550; small rice and a flask of dashi; 5 min walk from Nippombashi Station; risotto-style with the leftover soup.

食べログ: HATENA、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-17-2、06-4704-81.en: Tabelog: HATENA, 1-17-2 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-4704-8107; reservations accepted; daily 17:30–2:00 next morning; open every day of the year; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; 100 seats; private hire for 20–50; opened 2 December 2000. 2026 reviews (August–October): a toast with Singha beer; kor moo yang (charcoal-grilled pork jowl); yum woon sen (seafood and glass noodles, lots of vegetables); the last stop of a bar crawl; hot-pot pho; mango pudding and coconut ice cream; fresh spring rolls; stir-fried water spinach; pad thai; spicy even when meant to be mild; sweet milk tea; a short wait when full; prawn crackers; chai; one thinks prices rose a little and portions shrank; gai yang (spicy fish-sauce dip); ground floor counter and tables, 2nd floor large tables; sharing among 2–3 recommended; one wished there were khao man gai.

食べログ: HOME STYLE バル 1416、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-13-.en: Tabelog: HOME STYLE Bar 1416, Marine Bldg 1F, 1-13-5 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6281-0107; reservations accepted; Mon–Fri 12:00–14:00 (L.O. 13:30) and 18:00–2:00 next morning (L.O. 1:30), Sat, Sun and holidays 18:00–2:00 next morning; open every day of the year; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; 21 seats. Shop's description: 'tasty and cheap' standing-bar prices; gluten-free dishes at reasonable prices; for health-minded diners, gluten-free okonomiyaki, ramen and pasta recommended; wines chosen by the owner and seasonal sake; vegan menu. Reviews (April 2023 – December 2025): karaage and egg; sold out at lunch; fried rice; stir-fried offal; nanban; all-you-can-drink ¥980 an hour; karaage and dashimaki set meal ¥800 (large rice free); roast beef; risotto; edamame; chicken dishes and oden; beef tetchan and karaage set meal ¥800; smoking at all seats; oden (daikon, aubergine, egg); fried rice with oden dashi poured over.

食べログ: Honeysuckle Rose (ハニーサックルローズ)、大阪市中.en: Tabelog: Honeysuckle Rose, 2-3-19 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 212 m from Nagahoribashi Station; Tue–Thu 11:30–15:00; closed Mondays, Fridays, Saturdays and Sundays; no cards, e-money or QR; no reservations; 20 seats; smoking allowed; official site. Reviews (2023 – February 2026): open 3 days a week, Tuesday to Thursday (February 2026); lunch is a single daily 'Suikazura lunch', ¥1,100 or ¥1,300 with a drink; mains such as Japanese-style hamburg (grated daikon and shiso, ponzu); small dishes (vegetable tempura, simmered dishes, coleslaw, omelette); white or multigrain rice; soup; yuzu tea; café au lait; add a mini parfait or cake; a dim room of antique furniture and stained glass; one was given hot water in winter; drinks sometimes unavailable when busy.

食べログ: IKR51、大阪市中央区南船場3-11-27 日宝シルバービル1F、.en: Tabelog: IKR51, Nippo Silver Bldg 1F, 3-11-27 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min north of Midosuji Line Shinsaibashi Station exit 1, right at the Doutor corner; Mon–Fri 11:30–14:30 (L.O. 14:00) and 18:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30), Sat–Sun 11:30–15:00 and 18:00–22:00; closes when sold out; irregular closing days; no reservations; no cards or e-money; 17 seats; opened 17 January 2012, renewed 6 October 2020. October 2026 reviews: the tsukemen is in a class of its own; harmony of noodles and soup; top of one diner's tsukemen ranking; oyster shoyu ramen (oyster extract); the soup was lukewarm; softish noodles; fast service; many overseas diners; special tsukemen and chashu rice bowl (rich seafood dipping soup, chewy thick noodles, plenty of moist rare chashu, seasoned egg and menma); late-night ramen; English signage; seafood rice bowls too; jet-black shoyu ramen (not as salty as its colour; shoyu depth with garlic umami); chuka soba with shellfish dashi stronger than the chicken; chashu with the sweetness of pork; firm menma; a rich creamy tori paitan that seems to include vegetables; hamaguri-dashi ramen large with mini chicken-tataki rice bowl ¥1,710; one finds it a bit pricey; a menu aimed at overseas visitors.

食べログ: J BOWL 心斎橋店、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-18-14 ミドウ心.en: Tabelog: J BOWL Shinsaibashi, Mido Shinsaibashi Bldg 1F, 1-18-14 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station exit 5; Mon 19:00–23:00, Tue–Sun and holidays 19:00–4:00 next morning; irregular closing days; an açaí bowl and Greek yogurt shop; seating layout changes between day and night; 14 seats; cards, e-money and QR accepted; separate smoking; children and pets welcome; takeaway and delivery; listed as able to cater for vegans. Reviews (April–August 2026): rich açaí with lots of fruit and honey; about ¥1,680, a bit pricey; toppings of honey, granola, kiwi, coconut, nuts, pineapple, mango; nut bowl; mini orange and lemon bowls; Greek yogurt with comb honey; hojicha float; peach tea; a bar-like interior with sofas; two call it the best açaí bowl ever; one says on a second visit it was smaller and the mango unripe; one says it was closed at the booked time and staff made it to take away.

食べログ: KAMINARI BURGERS、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-18-2.en: Tabelog: KAMINARI BURGERS, 2F, 1-18-2 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station; daily 13:00–22:00; opens early when ready; closes when sold out; closures on Instagram; no reservations; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; no smoking; 10 seats (counter 2, tables 8); English menu; children welcome; opened 20 September 2022; official site. Reviews (January–August 2026): patties of Kuroge wagyu and domestic branded pork; thick and juicy; fragrant buns; restrained sauce; pickles; KAMINARI burger Comple; classic burger; recommended triple patty; B set ¥2,500 (fries and drink); crisp fries; coleslaw; one says it's big, so wrap it in paper and bite in; a monthly lottery, bring a losing ticket for a free fried egg.

食べログ: KAMUKURA 御堂筋店、大阪市中央区難波1-7-14、なんば駅か.en: Tabelog: KAMUKURA Midosuji, 1-7-14 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 108 m from Namba Station; Mon–Thu and Sun 10:00–23:00, Fri, Sat and days before holidays 10:00–7:00 next morning; reservations accepted; counter; opened 21 January 2025; official site kamukura.co.jp. 2026 reviews (September–October): hot-and-sour noodles with fried rice and karaage set; amid weekend queues, the only place with no wait (the front door is heavy); limited hot-and-sour noodles with a big chili; napa cabbage, pork belly and chashu; a pork-and-vegetable soup, not tonkotsu; cold KAMUKURA; Oishii Ramen ¥820; half fried rice and gyoza set ¥1,370; nira and chili self-serve; the black-vinegar hot-and-sour noodles were sold out; sweetness of napa cabbage; medium-thin straight noodles; thick chashu.

食べログ: KOTAN THE KITCHEN、大阪市中央区千日前1丁目 なんば.en: Tabelog: KOTAN THE KITCHEN, Namba Walk 3-bangai, 1-chome Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 30 counter seats and 7 tables for 4; daily 11:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); closed on Namba Walk closing days; no smoking (Namba Walk smoking area); cards and e-money accepted; opened 29 July 2023; official ramen-kotan.co.jp. 2026 reviews (June–October): miso ramen and tenshinhan set; a tenshinhan unlike the usual Chinese kind; miso ramen and mini fried rice; KOTAN ramen (shoyu) and mini fried rice; chashu-and-egg set meal (pickles and miso soup); KOTAN ramen miso ¥820; gyoza set meal ¥500; lemon sour ¥380; stir-fried meat and vegetables set meal; reimen; a new form of KOTAN Ramen, founded 1968; limited spicy reimen (pork-belly chashu, smoked egg, napa-cabbage kimchi, bean sprouts, leek); in front of Plaza 1 at Nippombashi Station.

食べログ: LINK、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-13-19 NT BLD. 1F、.en: Tabelog: LINK, NT BLD. 1F, 1-13-19 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; east from Shinsaibashi Station exits 5 and 6, left at the FamilyMart corner for about 20 m; also 5 min walk from Nagahoribashi Station; daily 10:00–21:00 (L.O. 20:30); cash only; fully non-smoking including e-cigarettes from October 2025; 17 seats (tables 12, counter 5); takeaway; coffee beans from around the world for sale (orders also by web, phone and fax); official site. Reviews (February–October 2026): house roasted; brewed cup by cup; the feel of a Showa kissaten and mid-century America; jazz; Mandheling; Mocha; strong blend; baked cheesecake; coffee jelly; you can ask the owner for a recommendation; one called the taste ordinary, found the washing-up noisy and was told stays are limited to 60 minutes.

食べログ: Le Nez、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-3-29 East心斎橋KMビ.en: Tabelog: Le Nez, East Shinsaibashi KM Bldg 2F, 1-3-29 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Nagahoribashi Station, 5 from Shinsaibashi Station; daily 12:00–15:00 (L.O. 12:30) and 18:00–22:00 (L.O. 19:00); irregular closing days; 10% service charge; cards (VISA, Master, JCB) accepted, no e-money or QR; 12 seats; semi-private room for 4. Reviews (September 2025 – September 2026): French at a white counter on the 2nd floor of a building near Nagahoribashi; Wakayama ingredients (Kumano beef, Nanko ume, Kaneyama miso, binchotan); a shichirin in the open kitchen; a seasonal miniature-garden dish; lunch course about ¥10,000 (carrot mousse with ikura; fish with turnip and olive; house bread; octopus quenelle with scallop, mussel and clam chowder; Iwate duck with fig, aubergine and Kaneyama miso; fromage blanc and rum-raisin ice cream; freshly baked brown-sugar financier); dinner Kumano Beef & Foie Gras Course ¥18,700; 7-glass pairing ¥9,900; house ume soda; Colombian Geisha coffee; friendly service.

食べログ: M&H COFFEE、大阪市西区北堀江1-4-11 1F、四ツ橋駅か.en: Tabelog: M&H COFFEE, 1F, 1-4-11 Kita-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 136 m from Yotsubashi Station; Mon–Fri 8:30–16:30, Sat–Sun 8:30–17:00; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 14 seats. Reviews (February–October 2026): a cafe open from early morning; a surf-style interior; bacon, egg and cheese bagel ¥980; ham and avocado; salmon, avocado, prosciutto and cream cheese; one found the generous fillings hard to eat; one found the bagel itself firm; hand drip from 3 beans (ground on the spot); hand-drawn illustrations on takeaway cups; caramel latte; vanilla matcha latte; osmanthus latte; waffle-batter tiramisu; warm sweet-potato cake; chocolate cheesecake; orange juice ¥550; pineapple juice; beer; merchandise; eat-in, order at the seat and pay on leaving; takeaway, pay first at the till; one found it nearly full on a Saturday afternoon.

食べログ: MAREN 心斎橋、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-17-5、06-4560.en: Tabelog: MAREN Shinsaibashi, 1-17-5 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-4560-7887; no reservations; daily 11:00–6:00 next morning; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; 23 seats; opened 1 June 2026. 2026 reviews (September–October): no wait even on a Saturday night; many overseas diners (about 80%, one says); chashu shoyu maze-soba ¥1,180 (block, chicken-breast and thin-sliced chashu with egg; strong garlic, punchy); shoyu maze-soba ¥1,050 (chashu, menma, onion, radish sprouts, mitsuba, egg yolk; a sauce of special shoyu, tori paitan and chicken fat); chewy thick noodles from Tsurumi Seimen; mini rice into the leftovers; main shop in Kita-Shinchi, another in Shibuya; open until 6 a.m.; electronic ticket machine; late-night prices a little higher; chicken-salt maze-soba with shiso oil; seafood tori-paitan soba ¥1,100; sweet onion; lively staff; paper aprons from the ticket machine too.

食べログ: MAREN 肥後橋、大阪市西区江戸堀1-15-7、四つ橋線肥後橋駅9.en: Tabelog: MAREN Higobashi, 1-15-7 Edobori, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 69 m from Yotsubashi Line Higobashi Station exit 9; daily 10:30–22:00; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 11 seats; opened 1 April 2023. Reviews (August–October 2026): shoyu maze-soba ¥980; thick noodles in a rich but not too heavy sauce; niboshi vinegar partway; mix in the small rice at the end; the chicken-salt maze-soba (with mini rice) has a shiso flavour and chewy noodles; seasoned egg ¥150; touch-panel ordering; the chicken-shoyu chashu maze-soba looks stylish and is mild; plenty of sauce; queues after 12:00; go off-peak at lunch; merchandise; one says the tori paitan was made by mixing powder into a clear liquid in a small IH pot; one came here because nearby Zagin had a queue.

食べログ: MARL 鍋とおばんざい、大阪市西区北堀江1-6-4 欧州館ビル 2.en: Tabelog: MARL Nabe to Obanzai, Oshukan Bldg 2F, 1-6-4 Kita-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Yotsubashi Station exit 4; Mon 11:30–16:00, Tue–Thu 11:30–16:00 and 18:00–22:00, Fri 11:30–16:00 and 17:00–23:00, Sat 12:00–17:00, holidays 12:00–16:00; closed Sundays; occasional closures; daily menu on Instagram stories; seasonal vegetable-and-fish set meals from 17:00 on Fridays; cards and PayPay accepted; 14 seats (counter 8, tables). Reviews (May–October 2026): at lunch choose a main with 3 obanzai, rice (choose the amount), miso soup, salad and house pickles (bitter melon, daikon, onion, low-salt) for ¥1,300; shrimp mayo; chicken nanban with house tartare; fish days too; dinner priced about the same as lunch; obanzai, sashimi platter, sake; a queue before opening; book ahead; a little hard to find; attentive service even alone.

食べログ: MENYA MITSUKI、大阪市天王寺区玉造元町3-30、玉造から.en: Tabelog: MENYA MITSUKI, 3-30 Tamatsukuri-motomachi, Tennoji-ku, Osaka; 111 m from Tamatsukuri; daily 11:00–21:30; no cards, e-money or QR; opened 28 November 2025. Reviews (January–October 2026): kombu-water tsukemen (shoyu and salt); start with salt; a chicken-and-salt dipping soup; warm honkatsu dashi; lemon; the special ¥1,430 (pork and chicken chashu, seasoned egg, menma); chicken shoyu ramen ¥890 (clear broth of minced chicken with chicken fat, thin straight noodles, pork and chicken-breast chashu, thick menma, radish sprouts, white leek); seared chashu mayo rice bowl (2 kinds of chashu); ticket machine; 8 counter seats; run by two people; cramped when busy; one found the chashu underwhelming; some days the noodles were unevenly cooked.

食べログ: MITHILA(ミティラー)、大阪市中央区道頓堀1-6-14 平松扇.en: Tabelog: MITHILA, Hiramatsu Ogiya Bldg 2F, 1-6-14 Dotonbori, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 45 seats; Mon–Tue 17:00–23:00, Wed–Sun 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–23:00; L.O. 22:00; no lunch Mon–Tue; dinner every day of the year; smoking allowed; cards accepted; opened 1 September 1999; features: vegetables, healthy menu, vegetarian menu. Reviews (December 2022 – September 2026): South Indian dishes (dosa with potato masala, rasam); Kingfisher; masala chai; Indian staff, English needed; butter chicken; crisp naan; heat 1–5; tandoori chicken; spinach curry; chicken biryani set; Mithila set ¥880 → ¥1,650 (August 2025); dal curry; keema; standard heat is almost none; rather salty; the biryani is enough for two and can be taken away; papad; mango lassi; mild curries.

食べログ: MONDIAL KAFFEE 328 GUT WOLF、大阪市西区南.en: Tabelog: MONDIAL KAFFEE 328 GUT WOLF, Osakaya Bldg 1F, 1-1-20 Minami-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Yotsubashi Station exit 5; the table gives daily 11:00–18:00 (L.O. 17:30); irregular closing days; an older listing gives Mon–Thu 10:00–21:00, Fri, Sat and days before holidays 10:00–23:00; opened 23 November 2015; no reservations; cards, e-money and QR accepted; smoking on the terrace only; 10 seats (5 inside, 5 terrace); takeaway; house-roasted specialty coffee; a large roaster; house baked goods made daily. Reviews (December 2025 – August 2026): the roasting base of the MONDIAL KAFFEE 328 group; the smell of coffee on entering; Ethiopian hand drip; many order dark roasts; brewed to your stated taste; caffè latte ¥600; iced Americano ¥600; chili con carne sandwich; salad lunch with drink ¥1,650; Wi-Fi; beans for sale; few seats, better for takeaway.

食べログ: MUGEN NEXT 無限ラーメン by NEXT Halal、大阪.en: Tabelog: MUGEN NEXT Mugen Ramen by NEXT Halal, 1-19-22 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; daily 10:00–23:00; cards (VISA, Master) accepted; no smoking; opened 20 August 2026. 2026 reviews (August–October): the halal-certified shop of Mugen Ramen Namba Nakamoto; 100% halal ingredients; beef-bone tori-paitan ramen (shoyu) ¥1,180; truffle beef-bone tori paitan ¥1,680; MUGEN NEXT special ¥2,980; beef-bone spicy noodles ¥1,480; meat maze-soba ¥1,150; grilled sea bream and hamaguri salt soba ¥990; roast beef 2 slices ¥360, 4 slices ¥690; melting beef belly 2 slices ¥480, 4 slices ¥890; soft-boiled seasoned egg ¥130; noodle refill ¥150; vegetable gyoza 3 for ¥330; thin straight noodles (2.75 mm) from Mori Seimen Factory; espuma-style foam; roast-beef and chicken-breast chashu; red radish, paprika, broccoli, lemon, menma; free grated garlic; pepper and chili oil on the table; slow at the till; prices on the high side; most diners from overseas.

食べログ: Mr.R、大阪市中央区高津2-1-15、日本橋駅・谷町九丁目駅から徒.en: Tabelog: Mr.R, 2-1-15 Kozu, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Nippombashi and Tanimachi-Kyuchome stations; Mon, Thu and Fri 18:00–6:00 next morning, Tue 11:00–18:00, Wed, Sat and Sun 11:00–6:00 next morning; also listed as bookable from 20:00 and open until 10:00; cards and QR accepted, no e-money; 8 seats (counter 5, tables 3); heated-tobacco-only smoking area; opened 21 November 2023. Reviews (December 2024 – August 2026): black tantanmen with soup ¥1,000, heat 4; a rich black-sesame soup; numbing; thin straight noodles; meat miso, dried shrimp, mizuna, takuan; open 22:00–10:00; white at level 5 with seasoned egg; soupless white tantanmen with thick wavy noodles; level 5 +¥100; 20:00–10:00 next morning; plenty of ground sesame; shrimp makes it laksa-like; garlicky karaage; cold versions in summer; a night-shift break; orange-peel water; house chili oil and Sichuan pepper; noodle refills; an izakaya cum tantanmen shop; 20:00–8:00; friendly staff; black tantanmen ¥1,100; just off Matsuyamachi-suji.

食べログ: NEXT□(ネクストシカク)、大阪市中央区難波千日前9-12 道具屋.en: Tabelog: NEXT□ (Next Shikaku), Doguyasuji shopping street, 9-12 Namba Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6643-7787; no reservations; Mon–Fri 10:30–23:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 10:00–23:00 (food L.O. 22:30); open every day of the year (closed 30 December – 3 January); welcome even just before closing; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; 15 seats (counter 6, large table 8); opened 1 August 2021; Hyakumeiten (Ramen OSAKA 2025); site silver-grape.com. October 2026 reviews: oyster paitan; drinks every drop of the oyster-infused soup each time; oyster shoyu ramen; 3 groups waiting at weekend lunch; ticket machine out front; special 'Koeru' (rich oyster, chashu that isn't greasy, change the flavour with spices); oyster paitan ramen with seasoned egg; projection mapping; wait outside and enter when called; those queuing mostly from overseas; the triple-soup 'Koeru' and the oyster-dashi 'Ikasu'; fried oysters with salt and lemon; soft noodles; creamy soup with citrus; shirasu rice bowl (sesame and sauce).

食べログ: Niku Teria カルネバッカ、大阪市西区北堀江1-22-26、.en: Tabelog: Niku Teria Carne Bacca, 1-22-26 Kita-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Nishi-Ohashi Station, 5 from Shinsaibashi and Yotsubashi stations; Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun and holidays 17:00–24:00 (L.O. 23:00); closed Wednesdays; cards and QR (PayPay, d-barai, au PAY) accepted; smoking allowed; 20 seats (counter 6, tables 14). Reviews (February–October 2026): an Italian meat bar; starter platter ¥1,500 (pumpkin and sweet-potato salad, potato salad, ham); house charcuterie; chicken, pork and beef platter ¥2,280; the signature beef-tongue stew Hebereke ¥2,600; sirloin-cap carpaccio; beef-tataki salad; shungiku salad; natto ajillo; hamburg; Butcher's Bolognese; meat-topped butter rice to finish; 2-hour all-you-can-drink course ¥5,500; friendly staff; birthday plates arranged; one found a group course underwhelming and a Tabelog booking unconfirmed.

食べログ: OBRA 心斎橋店、大阪市中央区南船場4-12-9 1F、心斎橋駅か.en: Tabelog: OBRA Shinsaibashi, 1F, 4-12-9 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station; Mon–Thu 10:30–19:00 (L.O. 18:30), Fri–Sun and holidays 10:30–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); opened 4 May 2026; cards, e-money and QR accepted; no smoking; 20 seats; power and Wi-Fi; takeaway. Reviews (September–October 2026): rich Uji-matcha pudding ¥900 (firm and strong); rich matcha gelato topping +¥250; matcha sauce; matcha Basque cheesecake; hojicha baked cheesecake; Uji matcha latte 'Zuiun' ¥850 (no syrup); mango matcha latte; matcha strawberry latte; iced sencha; peach pudding in peach season; order first, then sit; a calm wooden interior; one found it pricey; one waited a long time.

食べログ: OSARU Coffee (オサル コーヒー)、大阪市浪速区元町1-.en: Tabelog: OSARU Coffee, 1-7-15 Motomachi, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 308 m from JR Namba Station; daily 8:00–17:00; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money and QR accepted; no smoking; 11 seats; no reservations; opened 22 August 2016; official site. Reviews (September–October 2026): the ground floor is a coffee-only stand where you sit shoes-off on wooden boxes; iced coffee of the dark roast 'Slow Boat'; 'Magic Hour'; hot Ethiopian; a light Americano without acidity; caffè latte. Plates at the cafe upstairs in the next building: onion and bacon croque-monsieur ¥1,400; hot coffee ¥700; ham and egg sandwich plate (salad, potato salad, yogurt with honey); French toast; croissant; cheesecake. A line of about 15 before Saturday opening; queue on the stairs; don't queue in front of Kumon next door; slow to order when busy; the entrance a little hard to find.

食べログ: Old Cairo Cafe、大阪市中央区西心斎橋2-3-21 吉本.en: Tabelog: Old Cairo Cafe, Yoshimoto Bldg 3F, 2-3-21 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 30 seats; daily 12:00–17:00 (L.O. 16:30) and 18:00–1:00 next morning (L.O. 0:30); opening days and private hires announced on Instagram; no cards or e-money; QR payment accepted; no smoking by day (smoking area on the balcony), smoking allowed at night; features: vegetables, healthy, vegan, vegetarian, halal menus; opened 23 August 2020. 2024–2026 reviews: a shisha cafe with an Egyptian atmosphere; shish tawook about ¥1,600; chicken plate ¥1,800; shisha ¥2,200; koshari; service slowed one day by a dance show; lunch plate with rice; learned of it from an Expo food magazine; molokhia soup; ta'ameya (falafel); hummus and pita; kahk; baklava; hibiscus juice; found closed on several visits; booked for the evening; garlic vinegar and chili oil; mint tea.

食べログ: PANAME CREPES DE PARIS 大阪店、大阪市中央区西.en: Tabelog: PANAME CREPES DE PARIS Osaka, 1-10-41 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station (behind Hotel Nikko); daily 10:00–23:00; irregular closing days; no reservations; cards, e-money and QR accepted; heated tobacco only; 15 seats; listed as able to cater for vegetarians; English menu; children welcome; takeaway; opened 26 April 2023. Reviews (September–October 2026): a stylish Parisian interior and pretty tableware; salmon royale; a slightly spicy minced-meat galette; lots of cheese; filling enough for a meal; fifty-fifty; chocolate crêpe with lightly sweet cream; chewy with crisp edges; Dubai chocolate (one found it too sweet); sugar, butter and lemon; one-drink minimum for eat-in; cashless only.

食べログ: PRESTAU、大阪市西区新町2-17-17、西大橋駅から徒歩5分、.en: Tabelog: PRESTAU, 2-17-17 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Nishi-Ohashi Station; Tue–Sun and holidays 12:00–15:00 (L.O. food 13:30) and 18:00–22:00 (L.O. food 20:00); closed Mondays (Tuesday if a holiday) and one Sunday a month; cards and e-money accepted, no QR; 12 seats. Reviews (July–October 2026): a pale blue frontage; an interior of grey stone and concrete; care over tableware; monthly lunch course ¥7,700 (cuttlefish, water aubergine and okra squid-ink risotto with sudachi; sardine with summer turnip and Shira-Kaga ume; linguine of hamo and karasumi; house conchiglie with beef-tongue ragù; charcoal-grilled Moulard duck; pineapple and sansho; petits fours; coffee or herbal tea); short dinner course with drink pairing; swordfish; quail; venison; purple carrot; dessert in three stages; dislikes accommodated if mentioned in advance; delicate seasoning; one found drink service inattentive; one says the venison knife was blunt.

食べログ: PROTEIN LAB 北堀江店、大阪市西区北堀江1-15-19 1.en: Tabelog: PROTEIN LAB Kita-Horie, 1F, 1-15-19 Kita-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka, 050-5596-8859; reservations accepted; daily 10:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); closed over New Year; cards, e-money (transit IC, iD, QUICPay) and QR (PayPay) accepted; 18 seats; opened 11 June 2017; official protein.co.jp; allergen and calorie labelling. Shop's description: salads and original bowls planned around protein, fat and carbohydrate; choose your toppings; gut-health menu; 'STYLECHOICE' bases with 6 concepts (one a high-protein option for vegans). 2026 reviews (May–September): PROTEIN LAB bowl ¥1,600 (tender chicken breast); Mexican bowl ¥1,480; açaí bowl ¥1,600 (banana, strawberry, blueberry, coconut, kiwi, granola; honey on request); jerky and dried vegetables for dogs; pay first at the till; self-serve water; quinoa; calorie and PFC labelling; many gym-goers; Instagram coupons; also on Uber; even the S size satisfies.

食べログ: Pivot BASE Cafe & Bar @Dotonbori、大.en: Tabelog: Pivot BASE Cafe & Bar @Dotonbori, Nakaza Kuidaore Bldg 1F, 1-7-21 Dotonbori, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 40 seats; daily 11:30–22:30; open every day of the year; no smoking; fully cashless; features: vegetables, vegan menu, vegetarian menu; opened 3 September 2022; site dotonbori-night.com/pivot. Shop introduction: a cafe & bar for new travel experiences; vegan-friendly takoyaki and yakisoba. Reviews (November 2023 – June 2026): lots of drinks; spacious and quiet; ordering by QR; beer and takoyaki set; soup; cold summer-vegetable salt ramen ¥1,780 (no animal ingredients and no dashi; fried aubergine, okra, pumpkin, tomato, mizuna, pickled ginger); rice-flour takoyaki (konnyaku instead of octopus); a vegan restaurant; comes with salad and soup; with a friend allergic to dairy, chocolate ice cream ¥650 and iced tea ¥680; prices on the high side.

食べログ: RAMEN えびの女神、大阪市浪速区元町1-3-12、JR難波駅から.en: Tabelog: RAMEN Ebi no Megami, 1-3-12 Motomachi, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 148 m from JR Namba Station; Mon–Wed and Fri–Sun 11:00–15:00 and 18:00–22:00; closed Thursdays; no reservations; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; no smoking; opened 12 June 2024. Reviews (March–October 2026): an ise-ebi sign and a stylish interior; Megami set (ise-ebi miso); a rich, creamy soup; seasoned egg, wood-ear, slivered onion; free noodle refills; put rice and cheese into the leftover soup and sear it with the table burner for risotto; ise-ebi powder and chili oil; rice small, medium or large; Kiwami set ¥5,500; shrimp-miso ramen with abalone topping ¥3,000; a soup of 100% ise-ebi; pricey but the staff are kind; Megami set ¥2,000 from the ticket machine (shrimp miso or shrimp shoyu); about 10 counter seats and one table; milky-white soup; medium-thick noodles; bok choy; lemon to finish; rumoured to be the most expensive ramen in western Japan; the ramen is like a starter for the risotto.

食べログ: ROCO、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-17-1、毎日17:30〜24:0.en: Tabelog: ROCO, 1-17-1 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; daily 17:30–24:00 (L.O. 23:30); cards accepted; smoking allowed; 20 seats (counter 6, tables 14). Reviews (September 2018 – June 2025): an interior like an Italian bar; small, chewy, rustic pizzas, formerly ¥500–600 each; margherita; basil pizza; quattro formaggi with honey; mentaiko pizza; ajillo; prosciutto; starter platter; cheap wine; one-drink minimum; one says pizzas were served one at a time to keep them hot; one found the service curt; one found the backless wooden stools tiring; the latest review is from June 2025.

食べログ: Ramen KURUMU、大阪市西区北堀江1-9-11 1F、四ツ橋.en: Tabelog: Ramen KURUMU, 1F, 1-9-11 Kita-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Yotsubashi Station exit 4; daily 8:00–15:00 (ends when the soup runs out; announced on Instagram); irregular closing days; no cards, e-money or QR; 11 seats (counter); no smoking; opened 6 October 2023. Reviews (May–October 2026): a queue at 8 a.m. on weekends, about 20 minutes; meat and shrimp wonton noodles (black) ¥1,200; seasoned egg ¥100; meat-based soup and aroma oil with shoyu; medium-thin noodles; leek, menma, nori, thin-sliced chashu; chili oil on the shrimp wontons, black pepper on the meat wontons; 2 meat wontons in the black; light yet good; straight noodles; in at noon, 5 waiting on leaving; two shoyu, black and white; wide chashu; one says the pepper is unnecessary; seasoned-egg salt ramen (white) ¥1,100; yuzu; a little oily; noodles possibly flat; the owner trained at a famous wonton-noodle shop in Tokyo; the name means cloud; ticket machine; 11 counter seats; the black is a clear broth of 100% jidori with shoyu; many overseas visitors; one calls it on the light side.

食べログ: Ramen 兼田、大阪市中央区難波3-2-18 エディオンなんば本店.en: Tabelog: Ramen Kaneda, Edion Namba main store 9F, 3-2-18 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 23 seats; daily 11:00–22:00 (food L.O. 21:30); open every day of the year; no smoking; cards and e-money accepted; opened 1 April 2025. 2026 reviews: chuka soba ¥980, seasoned egg ¥200, seared chicken yukhoe rice bowl ¥500; a strong chicken-based shoyu; smooth, slightly thin straight noodles; pork-belly and rare roast chashu; limited cold bonito-kombu-water tsukemen ¥1,100; one felt the salt tori paitan was thinner than before; spicy tori paitan large ¥1,350; Ramen Ichiza; the cold bonito and kombu water is silky-thick; medium-thick noodles; moist chicken chashu; quiet at weekday lunchtime; strong umami and salt; rich tori paitan; many overseas diners, a short wait; tori-paitan shoyu with egg about ¥1,280; on the salty side.

食べログ: Ramen 華、大阪市西区新町1-33-16 日宝新町ビル 1F、西.en: Tabelog: Ramen Hana, Nippo Shinmachi Bldg 1F, 1-33-16 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Nishi-Ohashi Station; daily 11:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:30) and 17:00–21:30; open every day of the year; no cards, e-money or QR; 27 seats; children welcome. Reviews (July 2023 – October 2026): a clean, stylish, spacious shop; tori-paitan ramen ¥1,000 (thick as potage, truffle sauce, radish sprouts, low-temperature chashu, menma; change the flavour with lemon and black pepper); special; rich shoyu; aged salt; tsukemen; summer cold tori paitan ¥1,050; evening beer set ¥800 (karaage, draught beer, menma); fried rice; thin whole-wheat noodles; noodle refills; one found the chashu tough.

食べログ: SAVATOMY、大阪市中央区安土町1-4-11、堺筋本町駅12番出.en: Tabelog: SAVATOMY, 1-4-11 Azuchimachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Sakaisuji-Hommachi Station exit 12; Mon–Fri 11:30–14:00 (L.O. 13:30) and 17:00–22:30 (L.O. 22:00), Sat 17:00–22:30; closed Sundays; cards and QR accepted; 20 seats. October 2026 reviews: a stylish, popular creative-Chinese bar; small plates for two to share; the signature bonito tataki in red sauce (smoky, nicely hot); drool chicken; chicken thigh; anago; corn spring rolls; seasonal oyster spring rolls; shrimp in chili sauce; dim sum; the menu changes with the seasons; weekly lunch; mapo tofu; tantanmen lunch; a premium lunch +¥1,000 (about ¥2,000); 18-year Shaoxing wine (neat or with soda); Italian beer; book for dinner; sometimes a time-limited table; seasoning easy for those who don't like heat; one found a reply to an order check curt.

食べログ: SEIDAKO、大阪市中央区西心斎橋2-16-7 ミフネセントラルベ.en: Tabelog: SEIDAKO, Mifune Central Bear Dotonbori 101, 2-16-7 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 6 min walk from Namba Station; Mon–Thu 12:00–2:00 next morning, Fri–Sun 12:00–3:00 next morning; cash only; smoking allowed; 20 seats. Reviews (October 2025 – October 2026): a takoyaki izakaya in Amemura; dashi-rich takoyaki, crisp outside and molten inside; salt mayo, salt butter, sauce mayo; lots of snacks; good for daytime drinking; Masachan highball; takoyaki flour to take home (sometimes sold out); cheerful staff; lots of stickers.

食べログ: SHUN SAI KA NAKA、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-6-12.en: Tabelog: SHUN SAI KA NAKA, Asano Bldg B1, 1-6-12 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Nagahoribashi Station exit 7; Mon, Tue, Thu and Fri 18:00–2:00 next morning, Sat 17:00–2:00 next morning, Sun and holidays 17:00–24:00 (food L.O. an hour before closing); closed Wednesdays; temporary closures on social media; opened 4 April 2014; smoking at all seats; cards and QR accepted, no e-money; 18 seats (counter 6, sunken kotatsu). Reviews (September 2025 – August 2026): a daily menu; seasonal ingredients and lots of vegetables; one says hotel-style Chinese at izakaya prices; roast chashu ¥1,100; squid in Hong Kong sauce ¥1,400; spicy stir-fried oysters ¥1,500; whole steamed Shanghai crab with abalone-liver sauce ¥4,000; sweet-and-sour spare ribs; chicken-neck kara-age; green pepper and beef stir-fry; braised beef; beef tataki; clams with thick glass noodles; water spinach; noodle soup; off-menu fried rice or ramen on request; New Year course with all-you-can-drink ¥6,600; portions just right for 2–3 to share.

食べログ: Salon de The Plaisir (サロン・ド・テ・プレジー.en: Tabelog: Salon de The Plaisir, GATO DM Minami-Horie Koen-mae ground-floor north unit, 2-5-19 Minami-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Sakuragawa Station exit 5; Wed–Sun 12:00–20:00; closed Mondays and Tuesdays (open on holiday Mondays, closed the next day); latest on Instagram; reservations accepted; no cards, e-money or QR; 14 seats (up to 4 per party); no smoking; opened 24 March 2014; official site. Reviews (June–September 2026): seasonal fruit parfaits; Shine Muscat and assorted-grape parfait ¥2,600, ¥2,900 with a drink; Melba-style peach (vanilla and raspberry); melon; blood-orange brûlée; ruby-grapefruit and pistachio brûlée; strawberries in spring; swap milk gelato for deep-steamed sencha gelato +¥50; pistachio-ice-cream crêpe (sold out some days); afternoon-tea set (sandwiches, desserts, freshly baked scones, tea); spicy duck pastrami and cream-cheese sandwich; tomato and cream-cheese sandwich; tea in a pot; one item per person minimum; parfaits come as a drink set; drinks over ¥800 cost extra; one found the glasses smaller than in photos; some days run single-handed.

食べログ: Steak＆Pizza BLAZE、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋2-3-2.en: Tabelog: Steak & Pizza BLAZE, Queens Court East Bldg 1F, 2-3-2 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka; Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun and holidays 15:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); closed Wednesdays; temporary closing days listed for September; reservations accepted; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 20 seats; English menu and English-speaking staff; opened 27 November 2025; courses (BLAZE course ¥6,930 and Manpuku course ¥9,350, both for even numbers; solo course ¥4,290); Neapolitan pizza with dough supervised by a world-class pizzaiolo, and A5 wagyu. Reviews (August–September 2026): many overseas diners; jamón serrano and caprese ¥1,210; 3-starter platter ¥1,200; wagyu tougarashi steak; truffle-scented mushroom and bacon pizza; baked quickly in an oven over 400 °C; Caesar salad with house dressing; pesto pasta salad ¥880; tuna rillettes ¥770; spinach and bacon Spanish omelette ¥880; steak with salt, wasabi, garlic, shoyu and truffle; quattro formaggi with honey; 12 table seats and an L-shaped counter; menu in Japanese and English; a chef who speaks English and Japanese; tougarashi and fillet; about 7 pizzas, 22–24 cm; QR ordering by smartphone; one says value is on the high side.

食べログ: THE 9X OSAKA、大阪市北区天満3-1-2 TSビル 1F、.en: Tabelog: THE 9X OSAKA, TS Bldg 1F, 3-1-2 Tenma, Kita-ku, Osaka; 8 min walk from Tenmabashi Station; Mon 11:30–14:30, Wed 11:30–15:00, Thu 11:30–14:30 and 18:30–21:00, Fri 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–21:00, Sat–Sun 11:30–15:00 and 16:00–18:00; closed Tuesdays; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 33 seats (counter 9, terrace 8, tables 16); opened 15 December 2022; official site. Reviews (February–October 2026): shops in Tokyo and Kyoto too; banners promise 'ramen with French elements'; salmon tantanmen (choose heat; like a soup pasta); white salmon ramen (espuma, thin chashu, thick smoked salmon, mizuna, carrot, croutons, burdock chips, balsamic, chili, slightly wavy flat noodles); the white salmon ramen is beautifully colourful; pour soup over the salmon rice in the set; summer cold salmon ramen; basil-and-cheese Genovese maze-soba; basil aedama; seasoned egg; a bar-like frontage; one found it saltier than salmony; staff explain carefully.

食べログ: Wine Bar NOAM、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-17-27 日宝.en: Tabelog: Wine Bar NOAM, Nippo New Columbus Bldg 2F, 1-17-27 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station, 6 from Nagahoribashi Station; Mon–Sat 17:00–2:00 next morning (L.O. food 1:00, drinks 1:30), Sun and holidays 17:00–24:00 (L.O. food 23:00, drinks 23:30); irregular closing days; service charge ¥880; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 20 seats (counter 8, high tables, booths for 2–6); opened 7 April 2019; official site. Reviews (May 2025 – September 2026): champagne by the glass, white, red; soba crackers and coconut chips; strawberry and mascarpone caprese; can't see in from outside but staff are kind and calm; plenty beyond wine; egg sandwich; for a second stop; a pairing course with dinner, a choice of 2 each time; about 10 by the glass; a calm counter; tartare; abalone bruschetta; cold pasta; 3 wine staff; easy to visit alone.

食べログ: Yabu Distillery Restaurant 養父蒸溜所、大.en: Tabelog: Yabu Distillery Restaurant, Nasa Prime House annex 1F, 4-10-18 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station north exit 12 and Yotsubashi Station exit 1-A; Wed–Sat 18:00–22:00, Sun 12:00–14:00 and 18:00–22:00; closed Mondays and Tuesdays; reservations only (phone 13:00–17:00 on open days, or Instagram DM); entry from 10 minutes before the course; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) accepted, no e-money or QR; no service or cover charge; 11 counter seats; no smoking; English menu; no sandals or shorts; children from an age able to eat the course; opened 11 January 2024; official site. Reviews (February–September 2026): a pairing chosen per dish from whisky, wine or non-alcoholic; careful explanations; finger food of red shrimp and sea urchin (yuzu); chilled corn soup with prosciutto; ayu; sea bream with grilled scales; winter melon with green-onion oil; Yabu venison with chimichurri; bluefin tuna aged in Tajima red vinegar; Ezo abalone with escargot butter; Tajima beef rib roast or Tajima duck; Tajima duck ramen to finish, in a size of your choice; 2 desserts; 'Yabu', the distillery's young whisky; Sunday lunch ¥7,800 (August 2026).

食べログ: bird's nest、大阪市中央区難波千日前9-17 千日前セント.en: Tabelog: bird's nest, Sennichimae Central No. 2 Bldg 2F, 9-17 Namba Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Namba Grand Kagetsu, 4 from Nippombashi Station; daily 17:00–24:00; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 15 seats; opened 20 August 2022; official site. Reviews (September–October 2026): the sister shop Bird on the ground floor, a calm white-wood counter upstairs; a central grill; courses by reservation only until 20:00, à la carte too after 20:00; courses ¥5,500, ¥8,250 and ¥9,680; Hinai chicken thigh, breast, gizzard, wing, negima, tsukune; Kawachi duck with melon; Awaodori neck; big red aubergine; white mushrooms; chawanmushi with turnip sauce; red-cabbage palate cleanser; onion-gratin croquette mini burger; liver-pâté monaka; fried green pepper with dashi; oyakodon or ramen to finish; corn and chicken kama-cooked rice; Basque cheesecake; skewers firmly salted; good for business entertaining too.

食べログ: conoji、大阪市西区新町2-18-19 三洋ハイツ 101、西長.en: Tabelog: conoji, Sanyo Heights 101, 2-18-19 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Nishi-Nagahori Station and Nishi-Ohashi Station exit 1; Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun and holidays 11:30–15:00 (L.O. food 14:00) and 18:00–23:00 (L.O. food 22:00); closed Wednesdays and over New Year; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 20 seats (counter 14, 3 tables). Reviews (July–October 2026): a U-shaped counter; a calm, stylish shop; at lunch a platter of about 6 starters, bread and a pasta from 2 daily choices (paccheri with minced chicken and aubergine ragù; tagliatelle with meat sauce; pasta with pecorino, black pepper and garlic); about ¥2,000 with tiramisu and cappuccino; at night summer-truffle cream, clams and mussels in tomato and more; chicken-shaped water jugs; one found the explanations hard to hear.

食べログ: gelamu. 心斎橋、大阪市中央区南船場2-6-29 鴨川ビル10.en: Tabelog: gelamu. Shinsaibashi, Kamogawa Bldg 101, 2-6-29 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 251 m from Nagahoribashi Station; Mon–Wed, Fri–Sun, holidays and days before and after holidays 12:00–22:00; closed Thursdays (may change); no reservations; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money and QR (PayPay, d-barai, au PAY, Alipay, WeChat Pay) accepted; 10 seats; terrace; dogs allowed inside; takeaway and delivery; children and pushchairs welcome; opened 12 July 2025. Reviews (July–October 2026): open until 22:00, handy for dessert after dinner; mango; caffè latte; Latte Noir; pistachio; matcha; Earl Grey; strawberry; walnut; DUO, 2 flavours in a cone; Earl Grey Blanc ¥1,300 (bergamot aroma); matcha affogato; no tasting; a clean, elegant frontage and interior.

食べログ: italy_zoo、大阪市中央区南船場1-7-8 ダイアパレス順慶町.en: Tabelog: italy_zoo, Dia Palace Junkeimachi 1F, 1-7-8 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 6 min walk from Nagahoribashi Station; Mon–Wed, Sat and Sun 11:30–14:30 (L.O. 13:30) and 18:00–22:30 (L.O. 21:00), Fri 18:00–22:30; closed Thursdays; irregular closures (Instagram or Google calendar); starter and coperto ¥400 at night; cards and PayPay accepted; 12 seats. Reviews (December 2024 – October 2026): a cafe-like space at the back of the ground floor; antique furniture and dried flowers; animals hidden all over the shop; weekday lunch A set ¥1,300 (salad plate with about 7 vegetable starters and mini soup, pasta); B set ¥1,800; lunch course ¥3,200 (main, dessert, drink; one-drink minimum); spaghettini with house sausage and mushrooms in tomato sauce; linguine with shrimp and zucchini; amatriciana with house ricotta; Chami pork; at night a course of about 11 dishes (chicken consommé, salami and house ham platter, kuruma prawn, hairy crab, hamaguri sformato like chawanmushi, salad with whey dressing, peach cappellini, surf-clam risotto, straw-seared wagyu rump); dessert extra; one found portions small; careful explanations.

食べログ: mill pour (Mill Pour Coffee、ミルポア)、.en: Tabelog: mill pour (Mill Pour Coffee), Cypress Shinsaibashi 1F, 3-6-1 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi and Nagahoribashi stations; weekdays 9:00–18:00 (L.O. 17:30); weekends and holidays given as 9:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30), but the same page notes weekends and holidays shortened to 9:00–18:00 too; open every day except New Year; no cards; e-money and QR (PayPay, d-barai, Rakuten Pay, au PAY) accepted; 10 seats (terrace 8 outside, counter 2 inside); smoking on the terrace, not inside; English menu; pets allowed; children welcome; takeaway; official site. Reviews (January–August 2026): a hot, strong long black; black cold brew (M) ¥750, some bitterness, clean, hardly any acidity; iced Americano; iced caffè latte; hot dogs; beans for sale too; a small sign; benches under an awning facing the road; one minded smoke from people smoking outside.

食べログ: motti.cafe、大阪市浪速区難波中3-7-8 難波リーガルハウ.en: Tabelog: motti.cafe, Namba Regal House, 3-7-8 Nambanaka, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 405 m from Namba; daily 9:00–18:00, Fridays until 20:00; irregular closing days (check Instagram); no reservations; cards (VISA, Master, JCB), iD and QR (PayPay, d-barai, Rakuten Pay, au PAY) accepted; 11 seats (counter 3, tables for 2); no smoking; opened 20 January 2023. Reviews (August 2025 – August 2026): a small, bright all-white cafe; rounded tables and chairs; white-chocolate cheese terrine; chocolate terrine; brownie; at a lemon fair, lemon cake ¥890 (with honey) and Aid Lemon ¥800; strawberry-milk soda; royal milk tea; café au lait; seasonal fruit menus; messages written on request; one found the seats a bit cramped; one waited about 15 minutes outside.

食べログ: no 29、大阪市西区新町1-31-6、西大橋駅から徒歩5分、精肉販.en: Tabelog: no 29, 1-31-6 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Nishi-Ohashi Station; butcher counter 11:30–20:00; lunch 11:30–14:30 (L.O. 13:30); dinner reservations only, kappo courses (first sitting 18:00–20:00, second 20:30–22:30); irregular closing days; 10% service charge at dinner; cards and PayPay accepted; 8 seats; private room for 8. Reviews (March 2024 – October 2026): a counter behind a heavy door at the back of a butcher's shop; a yakiniku kaiseki; starters; smoked yukhoe and ikura rice; grilled liver; sukiyaki; yakiniku (loin, tongue, leg, intestine, skirt); some courses include all-you-can-eat meat; careful explanations; at lunch skirt 150 g (¥1,580), ichibo 150 g ¥1,980, lean steak, with salad; free refills of rice and soup; extra sauces ¥150 (grated-daikon ponzu and more); one was bothered by the lunchtime service.

食べログ: nöjd ICE CREAM、大阪市西区南堀江2-1-15 スプラン.en: Tabelog: nöjd ICE CREAM, Splendid Horie unit 1, 2-1-15 Minami-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Nishi-Ohashi Station; Mon and Wed–Sun 11:00–18:00 (L.O. 17:30); closed Tuesdays; phone reservations accepted; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money and QR accepted; 10 table seats; no smoking; wheelchair accessible; pets allowed; English menu; takeaway; allergen labelling and vegan, vegetarian and gluten-free options; opened 13 September 2024; official site. Shop introduction: Swedish for 'content'; ingredients and methods kind to the body; lunch too. Reviews (June–October 2026): about 14 flavours; tasting allowed; 1 scoop ¥640, 2 scoops ¥790, 3 minis ¥840; matcha and salted black-cocoa cookie; pistachio and caramel walnut; strawberry and berries; caramel banana with oat milk; corn and caramel popcorn; mango and cardamom sorbet; peach and Earl Grey sorbet (one found the spice weak); quiche-plate lunch with dessert plate ¥1,950 (rich soup, dill salad); chicken-rice plate; Friday–Saturday 8:00–11:00 morning plate ¥1,190 (rice-flour bread or pancakes, Tanba vegetables, soft-boiled egg, Greek yogurt, hand-made juice); carrot cake; pound cake; hojicha latte; in a building set back a little from the main road.

食べログ: otto. coffee and sweets、大阪市中央区南船場3.en: Tabelog: otto. coffee and sweets, K's Bldg Shinsaibashi 1F, 3-6-18 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Crysta Nagahori north exit 10; daily 9:00–19:30; no cards or e-money; PayPay accepted; no smoking; 12 seats (counter 6, tables 6); opened 19 March 2022. Reviews (June–October 2026): terrace-like seats facing the Shinsaibashisuji shopping street (air-conditioned); a bright white-toned shop; firm, eggy pudding with bittersweet caramel; pudding with vanilla ice cream or Mont Blanc cream; Halloween sweet-potato-ice-cream pudding ¥780; purple-potato Mont Blanc mille-feuille (mochi and custard); sweet-potato tart; sugar-butter crêpe; soufflé cheesecake; tacos and Corona; coffee from 2 beans; hojicha latte; Earl Grey ¥550; brunch; dog cookies +¥250; drinks from about ¥500; one says efficient even run single-handed.

食べログ: over the over (オーバー ザ オーバー)、大阪市浪速区.en: Tabelog: over the over, Kunieda Bldg 2F, 2-8-86 Nambanaka, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Nankai Namba Station; Mon–Sat 18:00–24:00 (L.O. 23:00); closed Sundays; reservations accepted (phone after 12:00); table charge ¥550; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX), e-money and QR (PayPay, Rakuten Pay) accepted; no smoking; 19 seats; private hire for 20–50; BYO allowed; takeaway; vegetarian menu; opened 16 April 2018. Reviews (May–October 2026): ¥8,000 course and anniversary course; a charcoal-batter corn dog (spiced meat inside); yellowtail carpaccio; charcoal-grilled sawara; sweet-potato soup with stracciatella; sansho bolognese; charcoal-grilled Kyoto Hiyoshi pork; black fig with canelé; à la carte crab-miso toast, porcini omelette, grilled-vegetable salad, pork sauté; non-alcoholic gin and tonic; birthday plates; sofa seats first-come even with a booking.

食べログ: patisserie accueil (パティスリー アクイユ)、大.en: Tabelog: patisserie accueil, 102, 1-17-18 Kita-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Nishi-Ohashi Station exit 4, 5 from Yotsubashi Station; Wed–Sun 11:00–19:00; closed Mondays and Tuesdays; cakes can be reserved by phone, eat-in can't; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 4 counter seats; no smoking; takeaway; children welcome; opened 13 June 2014; official site.
