食べログ: どうとんぼり神座 心斎橋PARCO店、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋1-8-3.en: Tabelog: Dotonbori Kamukura Shinsaibashi PARCO, Shinsaibashi PARCO B2F, 1-8-3 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6121-6456; no reservations; daily 11:00–22:00; until 18:00 on 31 December; closed 1 January; cards and e-money (Edy, iD) accepted, no QR; 24 seats; opened 1 October 2022; official kamukura.co.jp. Reviews (October 2025 – September 2026): Shinsaibashi Neon Shokudo-gai; a line of overseas diners at the ticket machine; simmered-egg ramen (a light consommé-like soup, slightly wavy thin noodles); garlic, doubanjiang and nira on the table for a punchier bowl; soft-boiled simmered egg; about 70% full at 19:00 on a Saturday; prices up but still satisfying; winter limited edition; Oishii Ramen under ¥1,000; chewy thin noodles; plenty of vegetables; busy at lunch but quick turnover.

食べログ: どうとんぼり神座 心斎橋店、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋2-8-26、50席.en: Tabelog: Dotonbori Kamukura Shinsaibashi, 2-8-26 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 50 seats (counter only); daily 0:00–6:30 and 10:00–24:00; no smoking; cards and e-money accepted (transit IC, Rakuten Edy, iD); meal-ticket system; official kamukura.co.jp. 2026 reviews (July–September): cold Oishii Ramen (a little salty, because the ice doesn't dilute it); small chashu; plenty of vegetables; first visit in 15 years; seasoned-egg ramen ¥980; sweetness of napa cabbage; light and warming; the cold version is designed so the fat doesn't set; comes with yuzu juice; nearly full even late at night.

食べログ: どうとんぼり神座 戎橋店、大阪市中央区難波3-2-30、67席、月〜.en: Tabelog: Dotonbori Kamukura Ebisubashi, 3-2-30 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 67 seats; Mon–Fri 9:00–23:30, Sat–Sun 0:00–1:00 and 9:00–23:30; no smoking; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; opened 28 June 2024; official kamukura.co.jp. 2026 reviews: on a shopping-street corner; ordering by touch panel; automatic payment machine; gyoza and beer set; extra-large beer; app points for free toppings; yuzu topping on cold ramen; one mentioned a smell at the ground-floor counter and a dirty fan (August); light, with plenty of napa cabbage; fried rice and karaage set; first visit in 30 years; ramen with lots of vegetables; near NGK; light yet deep in flavour; limited hot-and-sour noodles with coriander; Oishii Ramen; 2 soft-boiled eggs; app coupons.

食べログ: どうとんぼり神座 道頓堀店、大阪市中央区道頓堀1-7-25、なんば駅.en: Tabelog: Dotonbori Kamukura Dotonbori, 1-7-25 Dotonbori, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Namba Station; 71 seats; daily 10:00–8:00 next morning; no reservations; official site kamukura.co.jp. 2026 reviews: a distinctive light soup with napa cabbage; the set is large and filling; one found it too salty; visited thinking it was the main shop; small chashu & simmered-egg ramen ¥1,270 and karaage ¥430 ordered by tablet; savoury-sweet soup and crisp napa cabbage; busy with tourists; side dishes differ by branch; empty beside the queue at Kinryu next door; Oishii Ramen ¥850 and a highball ¥430; a national chain; eaten since student days 35 years ago; secret soup, napa cabbage and thin-sliced pork; many women diners in Osaka; udon-like noodles; seasonal hot-and-sour noodles (Zhenjiang black vinegar, coriander, steamed chicken) and gyoza.

食べログ: どろそば将 堺筋本町店、大阪市中央区淡路町1-6-4、北浜駅5番出口.en: Tabelog: Doro Soba Masa Sakaisuji-Hommachi, 1-6-4 Awajimachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 4 min walk from Kitahama Station exit 5, 6 min from Sakaisuji-Hommachi Station exit 12; Mon–Sat 11:00–23:00, Sun 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–23:00; irregular closing days; closed 1 January; no cards, e-money or QR; no cover charge; 15 seats (counter 11, one table for 4); opened 15 October 2020. Reviews (August–October 2026): looks rich and heavy but drinks easily; a thick, sludgy soup; smooth, chewy noodles; red pickled ginger for sweetness and a change; lunch set of doro soba with mini chashu rice bowl; strength 2; a potage-like soup of chicken and vegetables simmered until they dissolve; a clean finish; not greasy; thin flat noodles; fried leek and king oyster mushroom; a Nara shop too; ticket machine; kind staff; full on Saturday; spicy doro soba ¥1,500; orange; clings to the noodles; doro tsukemen; big chashu; leek and heat; one says 6 shops at its peak, now only Sakaisuji-Hommachi and Nara; Oni Kyoku doro soba ¥1,600; mini karaage rice bowl ¥100 (lunch); LINE coupons; medium-thick wavy noodles; thin chashu; 2 fried toppings; chili threads; one says the thickness is impressive but the taste ordinary.

食べログ: なにわ 麺次郎、大阪市中央区難波4-1-17 近鉄大阪難波駅 改札内.en: Tabelog: Naniwa Menjiro, inside the ticket gates of Kintetsu Osaka-Namba Station, 4-1-17 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 12 seats (counter); daily 11:00–22:30 (L.O. 22:00); closed third Tuesday; no cards, e-money or QR payment; no smoking; opened 4 July 2019; Tabelog Ramen OSAKA Hyakumeiten 2025; without a commuter pass, buy an entry ticket with service voucher (¥180) at the machine and show it for the same amount off. 2025–2026 reviews: price up to ¥1,150; many overseas diners; special golden shellfish ramen (extra meat and seasoned egg); sweetish, like a shoyu ramen; yuzu and caramelised onion; firm menma; golden shellfish ramen with seared chashu rice bowl ¥1,490 (October 2025); local-chicken shoyu ramen with seasoned egg and seared chashu rice bowl set ¥1,690; cash only; oily but not too strong; rare chashu and pork-belly chashu; mitsuba; a confusing two-step system where the ticket machine issues a QR and you pay at a payment machine; a clear shellfish dashi; an Umeda shop too; small gyoza.

食べログ: なにわの五味八珍ラーメン、大阪市浪速区恵美須東2-6-20 1F、新.en: Tabelog: Naniwa no Gomi Hatchin Ramen, 1F, 2-6-20 Ebisu-higashi, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shin-Imamiya Station; daily 10:00–4:00 next morning; open every day of the year; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 17 seats (counter 6, tables 11); the back table feels like a hideaway. Reviews (June–September 2026): at the foot of Tsutenkaku; leek ramen ¥1,150 (large ¥1,300; a shoyu base heavy on napa cabbage with chili and garlic, Tenri-ramen style, thin wavy noodles, a mound of leek); regular ramen; spicy ramen; half fried rice ¥300; omu fried rice set; bone-in karaage; Kanazawa curry from Go Go Curry (katsu curry); ticket machine; one found the service curt; open late.

食べログ: なにわ新風 日本橋総本店、大阪市浪速区日本橋5-5-19、恵美須町駅.en: Tabelog: Naniwa Shinpu Nipponbashi head shop, 5-5-19 Nippombashi, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; right by Ebisucho Station exit 2; Mon–Wed and Fri–Sun 18:00–2:00 next morning; closed Thursdays; no cards; no cover charge; 28 seats (counter 8, two tables for 2, four for 4); no smoking 11:00–17:00; smoking area. Reviews (December 2025 – September 2026): shoyu tonkotsu ¥980; sesame miso ¥980 (choose heat); salt chicken-tonkotsu ¥980 (lightly frothy); seafood tonkotsu with thin noodles; seafood tsukemen ¥1,100 (thick noodles, a strong bonito dipping soup); cold bukkake with house chili oil and myoga; abura soba with chashu, menma, egg yolk and shredded nori; spend over a set amount for a free croquette, fried shumai, karaage or gyoza; queues late at night; a bowl after drinking.

食べログ: なみ一 (旧店名 七三一)、大阪市中央区難波千日前7-4、南海なんば.en: Tabelog: Nami Ichi (formerly Shichisanichi), 7-4 Namba Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; about 5 min walk from Nankai Namba Station; Mon, Tue and Thu 10:30–15:00, Fri–Sat 10:30–20:00, Sun and holidays 10:30–17:00; closed Wednesdays; set meals at lunch, a soba shop at night; cards and QR accepted, no e-money; no smoking; 9 seats; official site. Reviews (April–October 2026): founded 2000; a Showa-retro shop down an Ura-Namba alley; hand-made soba; grilled-duck soba with Kujo leek; duck nanban soba set meal ¥1,800; duck rice bowl and small soba set ¥1,800; eel mixed rice and small soba ¥2,100; free refills of clay-pot mixed rice; house pickles; unlimited tenkasu; finish with soba broth or tea poured over; queues at weekend lunch; sister shop 'Namiichi Seven'; photo captions say 'light mixed rice, freshly cooked' and 'plenty of house-made pickles too'; one found ¥1,800 pricey for a casual lunch.

食べログ: にほん酒や一路、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-7-12 ホワイトビル302.en: Tabelog: Nihonshu-ya Ichiro, White Bldg 302, 2-7-12 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; Mon–Fri 19:00–2:00 next morning, Sat–Sun 14:00–24:00; irregular closing days; QR accepted, no cards or e-money; 10 seats (standing when full); smoking allowed; opened 27 November 2015. Reviews (October 2025 – October 2026): 3rd floor of the White Bldg, between Tatamiyamachi and Kasayamachi; counter by the entrance, tables at the back; baseball on TV; Heartland bottled beer; a range of sake; firefly squid and pumpkin tempura; Sake Day; simmered tamahimo; chashu; a limited Kujiranami sake; simmered Saga beef offal; tripe; 4 diners already in at 15:00 on a holiday; horse racing on TV; Ishizuchi; simmered sardines with Utsukushihime; regulars and overseas diners; the owner says weekdays are regulars and weekends mostly overseas visitors; sake ¥800–1,000; about one go in a masu; whisky too; opens 14:00 on weekends and holidays; a door you can't see through makes it hard to enter; a warm welcome; good value; a superb selection.

食べログ: にんにくらーめん 天洋 新町店、大阪市西区新町1-29-8、西大橋駅.en: Tabelog: Ninniku Ramen Tenyo Shinmachi, 1-29-8 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Nishi-Ohashi Station exit 2; Mon–Sat 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–23:00; closed Sundays; QR (PayPay, Alipay) accepted, no cards or e-money; 22 seats (counter 10, tables 12); no smoking; opened 22 April 2021. Reviews (June–October 2026): spicy miso K ramen ¥1,100 with garlic; usually the miso ramen; the miso without garlic is ordinary; freshly cooked rice and the famous takana; kimchi; spacious, clean inside; miso garlic ramen; tonkotsu base; wavy noodles; strongly seasoned chashu; set meals too; Kyoto Kujo Negi ramen; less garlic; garlic miso chashu-men; extra garlic can come on a separate plate; extra leek costs more; boiled egg; mellow miso; rich tonkotsu; ¥900; drank all the soup.

食べログ: にんにくらーめん 麦吉、大阪市西区立売堀3-7-13、阿波座駅から3.en: Tabelog: Ninniku Ramen Mugiyoshi, 3-7-13 Itachibori, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 301 m from Awaza Station; Mon–Fri 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–0:30 next morning, Sat, Sun and holidays 11:00–0:30 next morning; closures on social media; opened 7 January 2024; PayPay accepted, no cards; children and pushchairs welcome. Reviews (January 2024 – October 2026): on Amidaike-suji; a bright, clean, spacious shop; ticket machine; asked how much garlic (less, regular, more); tonkotsu shoyu ramen ¥950 (mellow and creamy); miso ramen; garlic shoyu ramen; medium-thin wavy noodles; thick pork-belly chashu; chashu-men; seasoned egg ¥120; bean sprouts; half fried rice set with kimchi ¥350; gyoza and rice set ¥1,250; free rice and pickles at lunch; earlier some found the soup thin, but in July 2026 one found it just right; open late.

食べログ: のの屋、大阪市中央区千日前1-6-6、日本橋駅から徒歩3分、火〜日1.en: Tabelog: Nono Ya, 1-6-6 Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Nippombashi Station; Tue–Sun 18:00–24:00; closed Mondays; opened 5 June 2019; reservations accepted; seat charge ¥250; cards AMEX only, no e-money or QR; smoking allowed; 16 seats (counter 8, tatami private room 8); chicken yakiniku of Tajima chicken over charcoal; hot pots and courses too. Reviews (December 2023 – May 2025): grill it yourself at the table; neck, thigh, skin, old hen, the heart cut 'kokoro no kori'; chicken sashimi platter; liver sashimi; chicken sashimi with grated yam; thigh tataki; chicken nanban; salt-stir-fried liver; chicken tempura; leek salad; chicken, potato and cheese; chicken hot pot and chicken shabu-shabu; bean-sprout namul; omelette; chat with staff at the counter; the tatami room at the back fills with bookings; lots of smoke, mind your clothes; two entrances.

食べログ: びじねす食堂、大阪市北区中之島3-2-30 MINAMO B1F、京.en: Tabelog: Business Shokudo, MINAMO B1F, 3-2-30 Nakanoshima, Kita-ku, Osaka; directly connected to Keihan Watanabebashi Station; Mon–Fri 11:00–15:00 and 18:00–22:00; closed weekends; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 12 seats (counter 4, tables); opened 20 June 2018. Reviews (June–September 2026): maze-soba (original, shoyu, Sichuan, sea-bream salt); 100–500 g; garlic or not; heat level; with rice at lunch; staff recommend the sea-bream salt cold; Exquisite shoyu ramen (medium-thin straight noodles, 3 slices chashu, thick menma, wontons); blended shoyu ramen; sweetish tori-paitan ramen; Nakanoshima black ramen; tori-paitan tsukemen; spicy tsukemen; sweet and spicy tantanmen; seasonal stamina ramen and cold tsukemen (order verbally); ramen in regular and DX; ticket machine to the right of the entrance; queues at lunch; one found the maze-soba sweetish and not hot even at heat 3.

食べログ: ふら～っと。カレー家、大阪市浪速区稲荷1-7-30、JR難波駅から約.en: Tabelog: Fura~tto. Curry Ya, 1-7-30 Inari, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; about 10 min from JR Namba Station; Mon and Thu–Sat 11:30–21:00, Tue–Wed 11:30–17:00 (L.O. 16:00); closed Sundays and holidays; closes in the evening when the rice runs out; no cards; PayPay and d-barai accepted; smoking allowed; 13 seats. Reviews (April–September 2026): a small shop on a quiet street; open past lunchtime; chicken-katsu curry ¥980 (crisp, tender chicken-breast katsu; a mild European-style curry sweet with onion); spicy curry too; one found too little roux for the rice; run single-handed at busy times, so sometimes a wait; a tobacco smell; hot inside in summer; a warm atmosphere.

食べログ: ぼっかけや、大阪市西区新町1-2-13 新町ビル 1F、四ツ橋駅北1.en: Tabelog: Bokkake Ya, Shinmachi Bldg 1F, 1-2-13 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Yotsubashi Station north exit 1A and Hommachi Station; Mon–Sat 11:30–14:30 (L.O. food 14:00) and 17:30–22:00 (L.O. food 21:30), until 21:30 on holidays; closed Sundays; holiday closures on Tabelog or Instagram; cards and PayPay accepted; 20 seats (counter 5). Reviews (2008 – October 2026): a small soba shop busy at lunch, a soba izakaya at night; thin, fragrant juwari soba, good even with salt; bokkake soba; Iso Karami Soba (seaweed, sudachi, spicy grated daikon); cold oroshi bukkake (very spicy grated daikon); Yamato Tororo Soba ¥1,450; walnut soba; at lunch a set of soba with miso tendon (burdock tempura); nozawana rice balls; at night a 5-small-dish platter; dashi omelette; beans; salt-grilled iwana; omakase sake snacks; courses; sakes such as Daishinshu and Igarashi; Yona Yona Ale; a cramped counter.

食べログ: ぼてぢゅう本店 道頓堀、大阪市中央区道頓堀1-6-15 Comrad.en: Tabelog: Botejyu main shop Dotonbori, Comrade Doton Bldg 2F, 1-6-15 Dotonbori, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 94 seats (live teppan counter 10, counter 8, 18 tables with 76 seats); daily 11:00–1:00 next morning; no smoking; cards and e-money accepted; features: vegan menu. Shop introduction: okonomiyaki and mayonnaise handed down for over 78 years since the founding; the original modan-yaki. 2026 reviews (August–October): half the diners from overseas; menu in about 4 languages; dishes cooked elsewhere are brought to the teppan seats; rich and strong-flavoured; large portions; modan-yaki, Akashi-yaki, Kaku highball; staff from overseas too; modan-yaki ¥1,850 (pork, shrimp, squid); cheese-tama (potato, mentaiko sauce) ¥1,350; sweet sauce and mayonnaise; edamame in garlic oil; garlic rice; one says it differs from the Botejyu in Namba; prices have gone up.

食べログ: まぜそば 寿寿寿、大阪市西成区萩之茶屋1-2-24、新今宮から34m.en: Tabelog: Mazesoba Jujuju, 1-2-24 Haginochaya, Nishinari-ku, Osaka; 34 m from Shin-Imamiya; daily 11:00–23:00; cards (VISA, Master), transit IC, e-money and QR accepted; opened 25 October 2022. Reviews (July–October 2026): one found it hard to feed cash into the ticket machine; one calls the taste ordinary; one says the closing rice was yellowed; close to the station; rice offer; right by the Nankai Shin-Imamiya Station gate; the chuka ramen is a nostalgic shoyu (chashu, menma, leek, nori); children's plates and cups; counter and tables; the popular one is the seafood maze-soba of tonkotsu and seafood; one says the noodles are 'Jumian', once made for celebrations by an old Shin-Imamiya noodle maker; karaage; gyoza; Taiwan maze-soba; seafood-dashi maze-soba regular ¥900, large +¥100; boiled egg; menma; diced chashu; fish powder; leek; chewy noodles; one wanted more seafood; chili oil and shichimi on the table; a new, clean shop; ticket machine; choose with or without rice (default is without); a sweetish sauce; plenty of noodles; change the flavour with kombu vinegar and chili oil.

食べログ: まほろば囲炉裏 心斎橋、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-16-32 BE'S.en: Tabelog: Mahoroba Irori Shinsaibashi, BE'S50 Bldg 1F, 1-16-32 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station; Mon–Sat and holidays 18:00–24:00 (food L.O. 23:00); closed Sundays; starter ¥1,000; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; heated tobacco only; 16 seats; private room; à la carte changes with season and supply. Reviews (July–August 2026): an irori restaurant down a Shinsaibashi back alley; Kishu binchotan, so little smoke or smell; a seasonal course (small fish, big shellfish, live lobster and abalone, wagyu, wild boar, duck, vegetables); charcoal-grilled in front of you; one says you grill it yourself; wagyu scented with XO sauce; thick-cut wagyu sirloin rice bowl; honey before the meal; told of a disliked ingredient, staff made abalone-liver sauce on the spot; budget ¥20,000–30,000.

食べログ: まんかい 天満橋店、大阪市中央区谷町1-5-9、天満橋駅4番出口から.en: Tabelog: Mankai Tenmabashi, 1-5-9 Tanimachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Tenmabashi Station exit 4; Mon, Wed and Sat 11:00–23:00, Thu–Fri 11:00–16:00 and 17:30–23:00, Sun and holidays 11:00–22:00; closed Tuesdays and over New Year; no cards, e-money or QR; 17 seats (counter 8, tables 9); opened 29 July 2015; official site. Reviews (2024–2026): Hakata Junkei Tonkotsu Ramen; Jun Ton with seasoned egg ¥1,130; a soup without off-smell from pig's head bones, knuckles, backbones and back fat boiled 15 hours; extra-thin straight low-hydration noodles; bari-kata; belly and leg chashu; wood-ear; Tomaton (tomato tonkotsu) with rice ¥1,250; ¥1,400 with seasoned egg and rice; in 2024 Tomaton ¥1,050 and rice ¥200; spicy tomato sauce; garlic; like a soup pasta; one called it ordinary; salt tonkotsu; half noodle refill ¥140; unlimited spicy takana (some days not on the table, had to ask); ground sesame; red pickled ginger; ticket machine inside; a big shared table.

食べログ: まんまる食堂、大阪市中央区道頓堀1-7-10 日宝バイストリート横丁.en: Tabelog: Manmaru Shokudo, Nippo By-Street Yokocho Bldg, 1-7-10 Dotonbori, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from subway Namba Station exit 16; Fri 17:30–22:30, Sat and days before holidays 15:30–22:30, Sun and holidays 15:30–21:00; closed Mon–Thu and the day after holidays (the same page also says 'open every day of the year'); reservations accepted, with the special 7-dish course ¥3,000 (before tax) recommended; cards, e-money and QR accepted; smoking allowed; 14 seats (counter 8, tables 4–6); opened 24 April 2015. Reviews (March–September 2026): dishes built on study of the basic seasonings, neither authentic Sichuan nor neighbourhood Chinese; chatting with the owner at a round counter; stir-fried green pepper and pork; black-vinegar sweet-and-sour pork; mapo tofu; mouth-watering chicken; stir-fried water spinach; Sichuan mapo potatoes with seared cheese; scallion-oil noodles; a Chinese tavern at the far end of Hozenji Yokocho; about 10 counter seats and one table for 4; run by a married couple; booking recommended, and hard to find; nira-and-egg rice bowl; homely, the owner smiling; Hakata-style nira and egg (with takana); spicy la zi ji (peanuts, coriander); look for the shop's sign rather than the building name; cumin pork skewers; fried horse mackerel.

食べログ: みな都、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-15-25 リッツビル 1F、心斎橋.en: Tabelog: Minato, Ritz Bldg 1F, 1-15-25 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi and Nagahoribashi stations; Tue–Sat 17:30–22:00 (L.O. 21:00); closed Sundays and Mondays; opened 1 October 1999; starter ¥500 (none with courses); cards accepted, no e-money or QR; no smoking; 15 seats (counter 7, 2 tables); primary-school age and up; no sandals or shorts; loud voices and strong fragrances please refrain; first-visit discount for registering on LINE; proud of its dashi; sashimi of fish, crab, sea urchin, abalone, Yamagata beef, whale and horse; Rosanjin-style tableware; 4 courses and about 70 à la carte dishes; over 12 sakes. Reviews (August 2023 – June 2026): Kumamoto horse sashimi; abalone liver; steamed abalone; crab miso and crab; grilled sesame tofu; salt-grilled ayu; white fish fried with its scales; aubergine and yuba in ginger sauce; lotus-root manju; tempura rice ball; sea-bream chazuke with sesame sauce; warm duck soba; no prices shown for à la carte; one says about ¥16,000 per person.

食べログ: みな麺 なんばウォーク店、大阪市中央区難波2丁目 なんばウォーク1番.en: Tabelog: Minamen Namba Walk, 1-bangai Kita-dori, Namba Walk, 2-chome Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 14 seats; daily 11:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); 2026 closing days 1/1, 1/21, 3/18, 5/20, 7/15, 9/16, 11/18 (third Wednesday of odd months, second Wednesday in March); until 18:00 on 12/31 and 20:00 on 1/2; no smoking (use the facility's smoking area); cards and e-money accepted; opened 14 April 2023. Shop introduction: the first shop of the next brand from the queue-famous 'Jinrui Mina Menrui'; shoyu ramen made only from 'water and shoyu', without dashi. 2026 reviews (September–October): ice-cold noodles ¥970 (thin straight noodles, 3 slices chicken breast, chili oil, bonito soup); seared chashu rice bowl ¥330; special shoyu ramen; an explosion of umami in a clear soup; low-temperature chashu; pay at the entrance; clear shoyu ramen ¥990; free rice refills; with the special or premium topping a half noodle refill is free; whole-wheat noodles; rare chashu; chicken chashu; one says the bowl is only about half full.

食べログ: むかいの 五八、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-6-23 清水町会館 3F、.en: Tabelog: Mukaino Gohachi, Shimizumachi Kaikan 3F, 1-6-23 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 4 min walk from Nagahoribashi Station; from 18:00; irregular closing days; reservations only (same-day bookings OK; seat-only bookings not accepted); yakitori course ¥3,500; drinks ¥400–700; no cards, e-money or QR; 12 counter seats; opened 1 October 2020. Reviews (April–September 2026): a hideaway in a quiet corner of the building; simple seasoning that lets the ingredients speak; an owner easy to talk to; cheese and quail-egg tsukune; grilled rice balls; the sign is hard to see; turn left out of the lift; course only; grilled at the pace you eat; potato salad; reasonably priced drinks; cooked on a teppan for each group; on full days one person runs it, so drinks are slow; large portions; Gohachi in the building opposite; yakitori grilled on a teppan; 3 sauces and salt; about ¥4,000 each; from 2 people (unconfirmed, one says).

食べログ: もんじゃ 麦、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-17-1 コスミビル 2F、心.en: Tabelog: Monja Mugi, Cosmi Bldg 2F, 1-17-1 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station, 5 from Nagahoribashi Station; Mon–Thu 17:00–2:00 next morning, Fri–Sat 17:00–5:00 next morning, Sun 17:00–24:00; irregular closing days; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 16 seats; private hire up to 20; smoking allowed. Reviews (August–October 2026): shoyu ramen and rice; one found the seafood fishy; good firm noodles; 2 kinds of chashu, pork and chicken; shoyu chashu-men; seafood shoyu and seafood tori paitan; maze-soba too; chicken-and-seafood shoyu ramen; chicken umami and sweetness tightened by seafood; thin noodles; Kanade shoyu ramen ¥1,050; seared chashu rice bowl ¥450; garlic for punch; the most popular, chicken Kanade ramen ¥1,000; a triple soup of tori paitan, seafood and shoyu; rich but not cloying; slightly sweet; medium-thin low-hydration noodles; big fatty chashu; regulars go for the limited editions; counter seats only; ticket machine; lighter than it looks.

食べログ: らーめん香澄 阿波座本店、大阪市西区京町堀2-12-13、阿波座駅1.en: Tabelog: Ramen Kasumi Awaza main shop, 2-12-13 Kyomachibori, Nishi-ku, Osaka; about 5 min walk from Awaza Station exit 1; Mon–Wed, holidays and days before holidays 11:00–15:00 and 18:00–23:00, Thu 8:00–15:00 and 18:00–22:00, Fri 8:00–15:00 and 18:00–23:00, Sat 9:00–15:00 and 18:00–23:00, Sun 9:00–23:00 continuous; open every day of the year; cards, e-money and QR (including Alipay and WeChat Pay) accepted; 7 counter seats; opened 7 May 2012; Tabelog Ramen Hyakumeiten 2017–2025. Reviews (September–October 2026): seasoned-egg niboshi ramen; slightly thick wavy noodles; many order maze-soba with rice; waiting chairs outside; ticket machine inside; special niboshi chuka soba ¥1,250; self-serve water; paper aprons; niboshi mellowed by back fat; medium-thick wavy noodles; light chashu; special niboshi maze-soba ¥1,300; strong niboshi on a shoyu base; ichimi; wide wavy noodles from Menya Teigaku, a long-established Kyoto noodle maker; block and rare chashu; white and green leek; menma; seasoned egg; a queue of 5–6 even late at night; no wait after rain; a Nakazakicho shop too; niboshi ramen ¥950; a gentle shoyu base with a bittersweet niboshi finish; one likens it to Yamagata ramen.

食べログ: れんげラーメン、大阪市天王寺区上本町6-3-31 うえほんまちハイハ.en: Tabelog: Renge Ramen, Uehommachi Haihai Town B1F, 6-3-31 Uehommachi, Tennoji-ku, Osaka; 4 min walk from Kintetsu Uehommachi and Tanimachi-Kyuchome stations; Mon–Thu and Sat 11:15–14:30, Fri 11:15–14:30 and 18:00–20:20; closed Sundays, holidays and days before holidays; no cards, e-money or QR. Reviews (September 2018 – September 2026): a long-running shop in Haihai Town; 9 counter seats; run by two people; a gentle Kumamoto-style tonkotsu; Renge ramen ¥800 (free up to 1.5 portions); Renge soup, miso, tonkotsu; tashi-dama; set with sarameshi ¥1,000 (lightly seasoned mixed rice); half fried rice set; spicy pickled ginger; soft high-hydration noodles (one says still soft even when ordered firm); tender chashu; a friendly owner.

食べログ: ろばた 風炉式、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-13-10 大宝共栄ビル 3.en: Tabelog: Robata Furoshiki, Daiho Kyoei Bldg 3F, 1-13-10 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Nagahoribashi Station; Mon, Tue and Thu–Sun 18:00–5:30 next morning (L.O. food 4:30, drinks 5:00); closed Wednesdays; cards, iD, QUICPay and QR accepted; 20 seats (counter 12, two tables for 4); opened 12 March 2023; official site. Reviews (September 2025 – October 2026): shirasu with grated daikon as the starter; sashimi platter (tuna, hamachi, squid, swordfish, sea bream); salt-grilled sanma with grated daikon and ponzu; grilled-vegetable platter; Chinese yam grilled with butter shoyu; spear squid and sea urchin; charcoal-grilled sirloin cap; straw-grilled; meat-wrapped zucchini with Kaneyama miso; dashimaki with mentaiko and grilled anago; several kamameshi; lightly pickled cucumber; water aubergine and tomato pickles; pasta; omurice; plenty of drinks; smoking allowed at tables; one says the sashimi took a while; late-night Minami crowd; a stylish interior when the lift doors open.

食べログ: わびすけ 難波本店、大阪市中央区難波4-8-3、なんば駅から徒歩3分.en: Tabelog: Wabisuke Namba main shop, 4-8-3 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Namba Station, 80 m from Osaka-Namba; Mon–Sat 11:30–15:00 (L.O. 14:30, ends when sold out) and 17:30–23:30 (L.O. 23:00), Sun 17:30–23:30; reservations accepted; no cards or e-money; PayPay accepted; 12 counter seats; opened 1 August 2020. Reviews (August 2020 – October 2026): a counter izakaya in Ura-Namba; obanzai platter of 5 (always 6); thick ham cutlet; highball; mentaiko and aosa spaghetti salad; chikuwa tempura with shibazuke tartare; rice ball and tonjiru set; squid-leg tempura with aosa mayo; dashimaki; nikusui; red shrimp with vinegared miso; fried horse mackerel; white fish with yukari and bonito flakes; niku-dofu; grilled tongue; Hachijojima shochu; queues at lunch; a friendly master and staff; the famous dashimaki; Kuro Kirishima with soda; meat dashimaki set meal ¥900 (main, 4 daily obanzai, pickles, tonjiru); a 30-minute wait; about 20 people at 11:45 on a Sunday, 40-minute wait; party size and order checked while queuing; 6 mains; a little sashimi; rice refills; no wait at night; wagyu omelette; 8 people at 11:10 on a Saturday; a set with beer instead of rice; karaage beer set meal ¥900; 10 people 10 minutes before opening.

食べログ: ゑび真、大阪市中央区西心斎橋2-8-33、月11:30〜14:30、.en: Tabelog: Ebishin, 2-8-33 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; Mon 11:30–14:30, Tue–Thu 12:00–14:40 and 18:00–22:50, Fri–Sat 12:30–14:40 and 18:30–23:45, Sun 12:30–14:40 and 18:30–23:30; no cards or e-money; QR payment accepted; opened 12 April 2023. Reviews (December 2024 – October 2025): rich lobster ramen; Japanese and English menu; heat 0.5; creamy like tonkotsu; plenty of vegetables; burdock chips; lobster topping ¥4,200, normally from ¥1,100; tuna set meal (with crab-miso soup) ¥1,550; wavy noodles; ¥1,600 is on the high side; tsukemen and tuna rice bowl; no ticket machine, pay afterwards; one found the ramen soup lacking depth; lobster tsukemen ¥1,000; heat 0–4; tuna cutlet set meal; thick wavy noodles.

食べログ: アルバロンガ、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-19-15 Unagidani.en: Tabelog: ALBALONGA, Unagidani Block 2F, 1-19-15 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station; Tue–Sat 11:00–15:00 (L.O. food 13:30) and 17:30–22:00 (L.O. food 20:30); closed Sundays and Mondays; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 19 seats; official site. Reviews (September–October 2026): a popular Italian restaurant on the 2nd floor; lunch course ¥5,200 with one drink (starter platter with bread and olive oil; the signature chilled cappellini of snow crab and fruit tomato; a main of Mochi pork or hamo fritto; dessert platter); dinner course (long prawns, cutlet, pasta of hamo and karasumi); Sardinian Vermentino; delicate, careful seasoning; one found the baguette hard; book for lunch.

食べログ: アンティカ オステリア ダル スペッロ、大阪市中央区難波4-7-5.en: Tabelog: ANTICA OSTERIA DAL SPELLO, Koei Bldg 1F, 4-7-5 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Namba Station exit 13; Mon, Wed, Fri–Sun and holidays 11:30–15:00 (food L.O. 14:30) and 18:00–22:30 (food L.O. 21:30), Thu 12:00–14:00; closed Tuesdays and 1st and 3rd Wednesdays; opened 9 June 2018; reservations accepted; cash only; no service or cover charge; no smoking; 10 seats (counter 4, 2 tables); particular about wine; official site. Reviews (January–July 2026): a sister shop of SPELLO in Sakaisuji-Hommachi; chewy hand-made pasta; carpaccio; seafood and seasonal vegetables; meat dishes; over 30 Italian wines; lunch ¥1,800; lunch course by reservation ¥2,500, ¥4,800 with drinks (starters with crab, onion and corn soup, onion focaccia, oyster and bottarga pasta, poêléed sea bream, coconut tiramisu); Shogoin turnip soup; oyster pasta; roast chicken; one person in the kitchen, so service is unhurried; tables close together; one found it good value but ordinary in taste.

食べログ: イルピアット、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-6-30 清水町ビル1F、長堀.en: Tabelog: Il Piatto, Shimizumachi Bldg 1F, 1-6-30 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Nagahoribashi Station exit 7; Mon, Wed–Sat and days before holidays 17:00–1:00 next morning, Sun and holidays 17:00–22:00; closed Tuesdays; booking recommended; seat charge ¥200 per person (¥250 for online bookings); cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; no smoking (ashtray at the entrance); private hire for 8–10; opened 28 July 2004; official site. Reviews (2021 – October 2026): the famous starter platter (over 10 items); roast duck; risotto to finish; cod roe grilled with herb butter; pasta loaded with cheese; a large counter extended into the next unit; a lively atmosphere; one found the freshly grated Genovese light on basil with firm noodles; four-cheese pizza; roast Kuroge wagyu; wines off the list if you state your taste; limited fresh-porcini peperoncino; seafood bouillabaisse and squid-ink pasta in big portions; seats a little cramped; attentive staff; anchovy and garlic pizza; a send-off; hard to find; good value.

食べログ: イワシトルネード、大阪市中央区北浜東5-4 コーシン北浜 B1F、北.en: Tabelog: Iwashi Tornado, Koshin Kitahama B1F, 5-4 Kitahama-higashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 353 m from Kitahama Station; Mon–Sat 11:30–14:30 (L.O. 14:00) and 19:00–23:00, Sun 11:30–14:30; no cards or e-money; PayPay accepted; children welcome. Reviews (January–October 2026): a hidden basement spot in the office district; ramen at lunch, the bar BULLSEYE at night; a counter lined with whisky; the menu changes weekly, check Instagram; order verbally, no ticket machine; shellfish-dashi salt ramen with mixed rice ¥1,200; leftover soup over the rice, chazuke-style; curry-flavoured tori-paitan ramen ¥1,100; Heartland beer ¥700; cold clear salt broth of seafood dashi (cold or hot, shoyu too); slightly wavy medium-thick noodles; chicken breast; grilled pork; shredded nori; onion; radish sprouts; the deep, clear umami of the cold shellfish-dashi ramen; nira and ginger oil; cold grated-yam ramen ¥1,100 (flat medium-thick noodles, grated yam, chicken breast, grilled gizzard, red onion, radish sprouts; one disliked the finishing powder); cold ume-kombu edition (gizzard confit, chicken thigh, fish powder); shrimp-miso paitan ramen ¥1,200 with a curry note; a free seasoned egg for the first anniversary; some days run single-handed; 10–15 minutes until served.

食べログ: ウエストウッドベーカーズ、大阪市西区南堀江1-16-9、四ツ橋駅・な.en: Tabelog: WEST WOOD BAKERS, 1-16-9 Minami-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka; from Yotsubashi and Namba stations; daily 9:00–16:00; open every day of the year; doughnuts on weekends and holidays only; no reservations; cards, e-money and QR accepted; no smoking; 18 seats; English menu; children welcome; opened 8 May 2013; official site. Reviews (September–October 2026): an American bakery cafe; 20–60 minutes' wait at weekends; parasols lent to those queuing; bacon-and-egg pancakes ¥1,250; iced caffè latte ¥500; croque madame breakfast set on house natural-yeast bread ¥1,485; avocado mozzarella cheeseburger; truffle fries (one didn't care for them); rocket, prosciutto and strawberry salad; French toast with vanilla ice cream; order 2 burgers and staff will cut them; weekend doughnuts about ¥300–400; English-speaking staff; no queue at 9:00 on a weekday.

食べログ: オラ タコス バー、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-17-1 コスミビル 1.en: Tabelog: Ola Tacos-bar, Cosmi Bldg 1F, 1-17-1 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; from Shinsaibashi Station exit 6, at the FamilyMart corner, look for the neon 'Tacos'; Tue–Thu 18:30–1:00 next morning, Fri–Sat 18:30–3:00 next morning, Sun 18:30–24:00 (food L.O. 23:00); closed Mondays; opened 5 April 2001; about 20 seats; terrace; cards accepted, no e-money; smoking allowed; listed as able to cater for vegetarians; hand-made tortillas; about 30 salsas; tequila and mezcal bought direct from Mexico; official site. Reviews (October 2025 – September 2026): chorizo tacos; braised pork-sparerib tacos ¥880; refried-bean and pulled-pork tacos; cheese tacos; chicken tacos; garlic-mushroom quesadilla (half ¥880); shrimp and avocado cocktail ¥1,320; habanero sauce; tequila soda; non-alcoholic Virgin Chi Chi and cranberry cooler ¥600; dishes may run out late; booking recommended.

食べログ: カドヤ食堂 クリスタ長堀店、大阪市中央区南船場2 クリスタ長堀B1F.en: Tabelog: Kadoya Shokudo Crysta Nagahori, Crysta Nagahori B1F, 2 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 114 m from Nagahoribashi Station; daily 11:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); cards, e-money and QR accepted; 28 seats (counter); no smoking; opened 1 April 2020. October 2026 reviews: a tangy tsukemen; strong soup; not as moving as the main shop but good; superb seasoned egg; in without waiting, no time limit; tsukesoba; glossy noodles; a branch of a famous shop; order verbally; melting pig's trotters (salt, garlic, doubanjiang); chewy high-hydration noodles; a slightly sweet shoyu dipping soup; plenty of chashu; large size; takes about 15 minutes; wheat flavour; soup-wari; tsukesoba ¥1,550; chashu mayo ¥300; one says the noodles are softer and thinner than at the main shop.

食べログ: カドヤ食堂 総本店、大阪市西区新町4-16-13 キャピタル西長堀.en: Tabelog: Kadoya Shokudo head shop, Capital Nishi-Nagahori 1F, 4-16-13 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Nishi-Nagahori Station exit 4-A; Mon and Thu–Sun 10:00–15:00; closed Tuesdays and Wednesdays; no cards, e-money or QR; 14 seats (counter 6, two tables for 4); no smoking; opened 6 November 2001, renewed 30 June 2010; Tabelog Ramen WEST Hyakumeiten 2018–2022, OSAKA Hyakumeiten 2023–2025. October 2026 reviews: a 55th visit; Nagoya Cochin chicken rice, weekends and holidays only, 10–15 a day; aroma of burdock; chuka soba; tsukemen extra-large ¥2,680; regular 200 g, large 300 g (+¥700), extra-large 400 g (+¥800), with more in the dipping soup too; hand-made wonton salt; hand-made medium-thick noodles; 16 people at 12:05 on a weekday, seated 12:44; tsukesoba regular ¥1,880; Nagoya Cochin seasoned egg ¥350; strong Cochin umami; shoyu with vinegar tang and chili; smooth house-made medium-thick noodles; 40 people at 13:30 on a Sunday, a 2-hour wait; golden-gleaming noodles; Ramen Walker Hall of Fame; sunshade umbrellas; a 30-minute wait; hand-made wonton noodles; chashu, wontons, seasoned egg, menma, leek, nori, naruto.

食べログ: カフェ コロンビア、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-11-15 1F・B1F.en: Tabelog: Cafe Colombia, 1F and B1F, 1-11-15 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 218 m from Nagahoribashi Station; daily 11:00–20:00 (L.O. 19:30); no cards, e-money or QR; smoking allowed; 16 seats; takeaway. Reviews (January–June 2026): a simple white-toned cafe; big windows; easy alone; upstairs, a shop of the bag brand BAG'n'NOUN; Colombian coffee ¥600; frothy Colombian mocha latte; affogato; spiced hot chocolate; iced Earl Grey; cream chiffon cake ¥450; rare cheesecake with lemon and berry sauce; cash only; e-cigarettes allowed (one says up to 3 per person); Wi-Fi; entrances from both Nagahori-dori and the street north of Unagidani; friendly staff.

食べログ: カポ・クラッセ、大阪市中央区南船場1-17-5 2F、長堀橋駅から2.en: Tabelog: CAPO CLASSE, 2F, 1-17-5 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 205 m from Nagahoribashi Station; Mon–Sat 11:30–14:00 and 18:00–23:00; closed Sundays; online reservations; cards accepted (one says cash only at lunch); 16 seats. Reviews (November 2025 – October 2026): an Italian restaurant up the stairs on the 2nd floor; run single-handed, and efficiently; always busy at lunch; A lunch ¥1,200 (today's starter platter, e.g. Spanish omelette, potato salad, chicken breast; house bread; pasta with tomato, oil or cream sauce); tuna and mushroom cream sauce; shirasu and okra cabbage oil sauce; coffee ¥100; Italian dried pasta cooked firm; à la carte and courses at night; blue-cheese caprese.

食べログ: カレーや デッカオ、大阪市中央区南船場3-8-5 南船場ビル 2F、.en: Tabelog: Curry Ya Dekkao, Minamisenba Bldg 2F, 3-8-5 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station; Mon, Wed, Fri, Sat and holidays 11:30–15:30 (L.O. 15:00), Tue and Thu 11:30–15:30 and 18:00–21:00 (L.O. 20:30); closed Sundays; no cards; PayPay accepted; 13 seats (counter 9, one table for 4). Reviews (September–October 2026): 2nd floor up a hard-to-spot entrance; Sri Lankan curry adapted for Japanese palates; Dekkao special ¥1,300 (chicken and a daily curry); mini ¥1,250 (3 side dishes); greedy Dekkao special ¥1,650 (chicken, 2 daily curries, 4 sides); 4–5 daily curries (komatsuna and pork keema, coconut tuna, clam and tomato, spicy squid +¥100, a vinegared pork dish); one chicken drumette in the chicken curry; sides (coconut furikake, stir-fried aubergine, tomato salad, coconut mizuna); try each first, then mix it all; smiling staff; a queue before opening.

食べログ: カレー屋 みーやん、大阪市中央区難波4-8-11、近鉄大阪難波駅8番.en: Tabelog: Curry Ya Miyan, 4-8-11 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Kintetsu Osaka-Namba Station exit 8 and Namba Station exit 13; Fri–Sun 11:30–15:00 (ends when sold out); no cards, e-money or QR; 13 seats (counter 8, tables 5). Reviews (March 2025 – August 2026): weekend-only combination curry; 3 kinds ¥1,300; beef-pork and spring-cabbage keema; new-potato and new-onion potage; pork green keema; grilled cheese +¥100; gentle yet deep; may underwhelm heat lovers; spinach potage; beef-pork tomato keema; a pop-up curry in borrowed premises, Fri, Sat and Sun only; the main shop is Rakurakuza; seasonal ingredients; Chinese-yam achar; one item sold out, so charged ¥1,200; a kind owner; behind Shochikuza; scallop potage; beef-pork-shrimp tomato keema; beef-pork citrus keema; corn potage; grilled corn ¥200; mix it all together; not hot; sweetness and depth; nori potage; beef-pork red-miso keema.

食べログ: クセが強い麺屋 れいわ、大阪市中央区博労町4-7-1、本町駅から36.en: Tabelog: Kuse ga Tsuyoi Menya Reiwa, 4-7-1 Bakuromachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 364 m from Hommachi Station; Tue–Sat 12:00–14:00 and 19:00–23:00 (lunch sometimes skipped); closed Sundays and Mondays; no cards, e-money or QR; 9 counter seats. Reviews (March–October 2026): a shop full of JoJo figures; the owner serves in character, draining the noodles with flourishes and lines; every ramen ¥2,000 (noodle refills and toppings free, such as cheese and nori); miso tonkotsu (rich and creamy); coriander ramen; maze-soba ¥1,500 (tomato maze-soba with free rice, cheese and kimchi); a ¥1,000 lottery with no blanks; one group at a time, about an hour per group; no reservations, 1–2 hours' wait; cash only; in September 2026 no lunch, open from 19:00 until sold out.

食べログ: クレープリー・アルション、大阪市中央区難波1-4-18、50席(5名.en: Tabelog: Creperie Alcyon, 1-4-18 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 50 seats (no bookings for 5 or more); Mon–Fri 11:30–21:30, Sat, Sun and holidays 11:00–21:30; L.O. 20:30; lunch 11:30–15:00 (Sat, Sun and holidays 11:00–17:00); cafe and takeaway until 20:30; no cards, e-money or QR payment; no smoking; features: vegetables, healthy, vegetarian menu; Tabelog Sweets WEST Hyakumeiten 2023 and 2026; French wheat flour, Échiré butter and salt. 2025–2026 reviews: avocado and roast-pork quiche; milk-jam crêpe set ¥1,480; today's starter ¥770; Échiré butter and sugar crêpe; about a 10-minute wait for takeaway; crisp outside and chewy inside; sweet-potato crème brûlée; crêperie lunch ¥2,200 (today's galette on the blackboard: beef stew, mashed potato and cheese); cash only; salad set; steep stairs; tandoori-chicken galette; Mont Blanc.

食べログ: グリル南風、大阪市中央区西心斎橋2-7-4、地下鉄なんば駅25番出口.en: Tabelog: Grill Nanpu, 2-7-4 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk north from subway Namba Station exit 25 across the Dotonbori River; Mon–Sat 12:00–21:00 (L.O. 20:30), Sun 12:00–14:00; no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; 20 seats; no smoking; counter seats. Reviews (July–October 2026): a long-established Western-style diner near Amemura; read 'Nanpu'; a retro atmosphere; local regulars; tonkatsu ¥1,600 (salad, curry-flavoured bean sprouts, yakisoba-like spaghetti); a batter fried crisp at high heat; hamburg steak ¥1,600 and rice ¥250 (spaghetti, fried egg, bacon); Familia lunch ¥1,100 (bite-size katsu, fried shrimp, omelette); comes with mini somen; counter on the ground floor, tables on the 2nd; weekday lunch is good value; a proper demi-glace; ¥1,000 with rice and somen; head-on fried shrimp; 74 years since founding; crab cream croquettes; easy to visit alone.

食べログ: スタイリッシュグリル Tyu、大阪市中央区博労町3-3-13、心斎橋.en: Tabelog: Stylish Grill Tyu, 3-3-13 Bakuromachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 8 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station; Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun and holidays 11:00–15:30 (L.O. 15:00); closed Wednesdays; PayPay only (no cards or e-money); 7 seats. Reviews (January 2025 – September 2026): in Semba's textile district; queues at weekday lunch; coarse-ground hamburg seared on the teppan; Japanese or Western (demi-glace) sauce; wasabi and grated daikon; shiso grated daikon; cheese; bacon; mushrooms; house tomato sauce ¥1,300; hamburg set ¥1,350; +70 g; egg on rice with Oita Ran-oh eggs +¥100; hamburg and pork set ¥2,000; free refills of rice and ginger beef-tendon soup; chicken dishes and limited specials too; friendly staff; before opening or after 14:00 recommended.

食べログ: ステーキ 鉄板焼き Teppan&grill R 心斎橋、大阪市西区.en: Tabelog: Steak Teppanyaki Teppan&grill R Shinsaibashi, Yotsubashi GTC Bldg 2F, 1-7-5 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Yotsubashi Station exit 2; lunch 12:30–17:00 (courses only, 2 or more, online booking 3 days ahead); dinner 18:00–23:30 (food L.O. 21:30); closed Mondays plus two consecutive days a month; reservations take priority; counter for course orders only; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay) and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 10% for private rooms, counter hire and New Year; 14 seats (counter 10, sofa private room for up to 5); no smoking; English and Chinese menus; children's course by coupon; opened 16 June 2014; official site. Reviews (December 2024 – May 2026): courses priced by the seafood; starters such as roast beef; sashimi of itoyori or fatty sea bream (white shoyu and ginger); lobster with Américaine sauce; abalone grilled in front of you; flambéed with whisky; the top course has chateaubriand (salt only); garlic rice; white-miso fish soup; dessert; meat and seafood shown on a big platter before cooking; order abalone and get the decorated shell; plenty of wine.

食べログ: ストライク軒 中之島フェスティバルプラザ店、大阪市北区中之島3-2-.en: Tabelog: Strike Ken Nakanoshima Festival Plaza, Nakanoshima Festival Tower West B1F, 3-2-4 Nakanoshima, Kita-ku, Osaka; 106 m from Watanabebashi; daily 11:00–21:00; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; opened 16 June 2025. Reviews (June 2025 – October 2026): a new branch of a popular Tenjimbashi-suji 6-chome shop; Nakanoshima Straight (shoyu, medium-thick straight noodles, wheat aroma, big chashu, thin menma; also with leek); Nakanoshima Curve (a Sapporo-style miso ramen with a tare blended in Sapporo, egg noodles, a little stronger than Straight); Kamisori Drop (a special salt tare, egg, a mound of leek, like a warm hiyashi chuka); garlic ¥80; karaage and karaage-rice set; highball set; LINE coupons; a clean shop; courteous service; one felt the noodles and soup didn't match.

食べログ: タイ料理専門店 TAI THAI なんば本店、大阪市浪速区難波中2-.en: Tabelog: Thai restaurant TAI THAI Namba main shop, U-I Bldg 1F, 2-6-15 Nambanaka, Naniwa-ku, Osaka, 050-5868-6983; reservations accepted (recommended at night; may close early); Mon and Wed–Fri 11:30–15:00 (L.O. 14:30) and 17:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30), Tue 17:00–22:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 11:30–22:00; 43 seats; opened 29 April 2001; official taithai.jp. Shop's description: certified by the Thai Ministry of Commerce; Thai chefs; over 100 dishes; som tam pu pla ra; caters for vegetarian and halal diners too; weekday courses with all-you-can-drink. 2026 reviews (July–October): poo pad pong curry (rich crab flavour); jasmine rice; glass-noodle salad (spicy); coconut mango ice cream; khao man gai ¥1,280 (Isan-style house sauce); gai pad med mamuang; stir-fried water spinach ¥1,380; pad see ew; tom yum goong ¥1,680; laksa; pad thai lunch ¥1,100 (with spring roll, chicken, salad, soup); coriander only on request; Japanese menu with photos; warm desserts; sticky-rice sweets.

食べログ: タコタコキング 本店のちょっと西店、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-8-28.en: Tabelog: TAKOTAKO KING Honten no Chotto Nishi Ten, 1F, 2-8-28 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min from Shinsaibashi Station; daily 18:00–3:00 next morning; cards and QR accepted, no e-money; smoking allowed; 20 seats; takeaway; official site. Reviews (August–October 2026): teppan tables on the 2nd floor; a toy train; an octopus-shaped smoke machine; salt-garlic takoyaki; sauce; fried takoyaki (salt, shoyu, sauce); 2 each of 4 kinds; a set of 16; cheese tororo-yaki; Chinese-yam special; mixed-seafood special; modan-yaki; grilled squid legs; dried-squid tempura; extra-large kara-age; cheese corn; king oyster butter; honey cream cheese; omurice; lively even at 1 a.m.; one says in October a new staff member couldn't get the teppan hot.

食べログ: チキン南蛮専門店 なみ一セヴン、大阪市中央区難波千日前7-4、なんば.en: Tabelog: Chicken Nanban Senmon Ten Namiichi Seven, 7-4 Namba Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 278 m from Namba Station; Mon, Tue and Fri 10:30–15:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 10:30–17:00; closed Wednesdays and Thursdays; online reservations; no cards; e-money and QR accepted; 16 seats. Reviews (May–September 2026): a chicken-nanban-only shop in Ura-Namba; ¥1,700; 3 sauces, sweet vinegar, lemon basil and mala; 2 sauces with the large (+¥600); free refills of clay-pot rice, black-pepper pasta, pickles and tartare; miso soup and salad; ¥100 off for following on Instagram; served in about 5 minutes; sometimes a wait at Sunday lunch; run by two people; it used to be about ¥1,000.

食べログ: ツケメン ロッキー、大阪市中央区谷町1-3-19、天満橋から126m.en: Tabelog: Tsukemen Rocky, 1-3-19 Tanimachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 126 m from Tenmabashi; daily 11:00–21:00; no cards or e-money; QR (PayPay, Rakuten Pay) accepted; opened 11 February 2022. Reviews (August–October 2026): a rich seafood-tonkotsu dipping soup; chashu in the dipping soup too; thick chewy noodles; tsukemen ¥1,000; chashu ¥350 (grilled and cut thick); large ¥100 (formerly free); special tsukemen (2 slices chashu, 2 sheets nori, seasoned egg); spicy tsukemen (Kara); leek topping; yuzu shichimi on the table; soup-wari; ticket machine; tell staff for PayPay; two say the dipping soup cools quickly; a sister shop exists; one says for tsukemen in Tenmabashi, it's this one; one likens it to Ramen Jet.

食べログ: ディッシュカリー＆レリッシュ、大阪市中央区南船場1-6-16、火〜土.en: Tabelog: Dish curry & relish, 1-6-16 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; Tue–Sat 11:30–16:00 and 16:30–21:00 (until sold out); closed Sundays and Mondays; events and temporary closures; no cards, e-money or QR; 7 seats. Reviews (January–July 2026): a one-person counter; open from lunch to evening; 3-curry platter ¥1,500 (fried egg and 3 pickles); dry keema (numbing like Sichuan pepper); squid legs and basil; potato curry; dry keema curry with turmeric rice; burnt-garlic chicken; menu changes weekly (Instagram); well-balanced spices.

食べログ: トラットリア バール ジョルノ、大阪市西区北堀江1-16-17 アメ.en: Tabelog: Trattoria Bar Giorno, Amenity Kita-Horie 1F, 1-16-17 Kita-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka; about 2 min walk from Nishi-Ohashi Station, about 4 from Yotsubashi; dinner Tue–Sun 17:30–22:00 (quiet around 18:00); lunch Wed, Thu and Sun 12:00–13:30 (until sold out); closed Mondays (sometimes open on holidays); coperto ¥330 at night (Italian salami, grissini, nuts; not for courses); cards and PayPay accepted; 20 seats (counter 12, tables 8). Reviews (March–September 2026): about 17 years since opening; a calm, grown-up trattoria; detailed notices on the tables and menu; a minimum order per person at night; dishes slow when busy; careful pasta; wine chosen with the staff (bottles from about ¥4,000); fresh-fish carpaccio; ajillo; gratin; motsu nikomi; steamed vegetables; seafood pasta; steak; duck; Sangen pork; Ibérico pork (not every day); courses from ¥6,000; lunch pasta ¥1,300–1,600 with salad, baguette and Italian omelette (anchovy, potato and broccoli in oil sauce; tagliatelle of Mizuho pork belly and Brussels sprouts in tomato sauce).

食べログ: トレボン、大阪市中央区西心斎橋2-9-5 日宝三津寺ビル1F、毎日1.en: Tabelog: Trebon, Nippo Mitsudera Bldg 1F, 2-9-5 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; daily 17:00–23:00; no cards, e-money or QR; 10 seats; smoking allowed; counter. Reviews (January–September 2026): a favourite in Amemura; heart; cartilage; grilled lettuce; tonpei-yaki; grilled squid legs; tofu; pickles; booked 2 seats by phone for a second stop; a friendly owner; the teppan right in front; heart ¥500; leek modan ¥1,400; pork and egg ¥1,000; yakisoba ¥1,000; no reservations, got in only 2 times out of 5; staff recommend the heart; a long-established teppanyaki; counter only; lively even at 18:00 on a weekday; popular with locals; yakisoba with aonori and red pickled ginger; grilled meat with plenty of leek; the smell of sauce clings to clothes; first time in 10 years; no reservations, cash only, irregular closing days; phone to check; magic seasoning; Moroccan green beans; konnyaku with ponzu; the grilled lettuce strongly seasoned; cartilage and skin with salt; cabbage tonpei-yaki; off-menu kasu and cabbage stir-fry; tofu; Chinese yam; okonomiyaki; 17:00–22:00.

食べログ: ニューベイブ 難波店、大阪市浪速区難波中1-14-12、なんば駅から.en: Tabelog: New Babe Namba, 1-14-12 Nambanaka, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Namba Station; Mon–Thu 11:00–20:00 (L.O. 19:30), Fri–Sun and holidays 11:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); no service charge; cards, transit IC, e-money and QR accepted; 18 seats. Reviews (June 2025 – October 2026): thick, tender tonkatsu; loin set meal ¥2,800 (over 2 cm); fillet (regular) ¥3,200; extra fillet ¥1,000; half set meals; Dream Assorted Set Meal of tonkatsu and garlicky pork ginger-yaki; rice in a wooden ohitsu; refills of rice, cabbage and pork miso soup; a range of sauces and condiments; katsu sandwich; up to an hour's wait at lunch; book on Tabelog; staff explain kindly; one found prices a little high; one had hygiene concerns such as glove use at the counter (October 2026).

食べログ: ニューヨークのラーメン屋 アメリカ村本店、大阪市中央区西心斎橋1-7.en: Tabelog: New York no Ramen-ya America-mura main shop, 1-7-2 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6243-0666; no reservations; Mon–Fri 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–23:00, Sat–Sun 11:30–23:00; cards, e-money (transit IC, iD) and QR (PayPay) accepted; 12 seats; opened 19 November 2024. 2026 reviews (April–June): 'suppin ramen', a plain base to which you add the toppings you like, over a trillion combinations; once still locked past opening time; Ari Red; soft-boiled egg and rare chashu; sukiyaki ramen (sweet-sour, rich tonkotsu); cheese chashu rice bowl; the standard double chashu (block and thin-sliced chashu, boiled egg, rich creamy soup); one found it slightly salty; chewy noodles; suppin ¥550; fried scallops ¥280; rare chashu ¥100; red New York-style interior.

食べログ: ヌードルヤ MEーCHAーKUーCHA、大阪市西区新町3-9-9、西.en: Tabelog: Noodleya ME-CHA-KU-CHA, 3-9-9 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; about 8 min from Nishi-Nagahori Station; Mon–Sat 11:30–15:00; closed Sundays and holidays; no cards, e-money or QR; 8 counter seats. Reviews (April 2025 – September 2026): run single-handed; tom yum noodles ¥990 (creamy, sour and spicy, lots of coriander, straight noodles); porcini salt ramen; tantanmen; sudachi shoyu ramen; tsukemen; daily rice dishes (chicken teriyaki bowl, chashu bowl, green curry); one says no chemical seasonings; the ticket machine takes coins and old ¥1,000 notes; drinks offered to those queuing; sometimes closes without notice.

食べログ: ハードロマンチッカー、大阪市中央区難波1-7-15 江戸安ビル1F、.en: Tabelog: Hard Romanticker, Edoyasu Bldg 1F, 1-7-15 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from the Namba stations; Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun and holidays 18:00–2:00 next morning (L.O. 1:30); closed Wednesdays (may vary); no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; 20 seats; heated-tobacco-only smoking area; Tachinomi Hyakumeiten 2025; opened 9 December 2024; official page (peraichi). Reviews (August–October 2026): a sister shop of Oishi Stand; about 8 at the counter and 3 tables; small dishes and fried food; rare Ezo venison steak; a hamburger limited to 3 a day; good value; cream cheese (faintly sweet, with crackers); just off Midosuji near Namba HIPS; no sign, so Instagram says 'please find us'; full inside, regulars made room; ume sour; Shine Muscat and prosciutto shira-ae; komatsuna ohitashi; house-made satsuma-age (cheese, corn, edamame; fried to order); many women diners; orange wine; blue cheese.

食べログ: バル DAKEジャナイ中華 心斎橋店、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-14-.en: Tabelog: Bar DAKE Janai Chuka Shinsaibashi, Kawamura Bldg 1F, 1-14-21 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 050-5590-3436; reservations accepted (courses by the day before); Mon–Sat 16:00–2:00 next morning (L.O. 1:00); closed Sundays and holidays; cards and QR (PayPay, d-barai, au PAY) accepted, no e-money; 28 seats (including terrace); opened 11 November 2022. 2025–2026 reviews: you choose your own table-charge starter; quick turnover, easy to get in without booking; fluffy freshly steamed shumai; mapo tofu; generous fried rice; gyoza; shrimp mayo; found while looking for somewhere to smoke; friendly staff who use first names even on first meeting; events; a creative-Chinese bar; a casual atmosphere; the light dishes taste good even at the end of a bar crawl.

食べログ: パプリカ食堂 Vegan、大阪市西区新町1-9-9 アリビオ新町1F.en: Tabelog: Paprika Shokudo Vegan, Alivio Shinmachi 1F, 1-9-9 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka, 06-6599-9788; reservations accepted; 11:30–15:00 (food L.O. 14:00, drinks 14:30) and 17:30–21:30 (L.O. 21:00) except Wednesdays and irregular days (announced on Instagram); cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; 41 seats (counter 2, hall 25, deck 14); no smoking; opened 17 February 2014; Instagram @paprika_vegan; natural food with organic vegetables; organic wine and smoothies. Reviews (December 2025 – August 2026): popular, so book; the most popular is the soy-meat karaage set meal (fried in good rapeseed oil, with house-made Japanese-style sauce, organic soy-milk mayo and organic sesame); organic salad; low-salt miso soup; pesticide-free brown rice; ordering by QR code; vegan-cheese hamburg steak; soy-meat cheese hamburg lunch plate; goods sold at the front; terrace seats; with a vegan friend; with a vegetarian friend from Australia after 10 years; many overseas diners.

食べログ: ビストロ＆バー ヴィスコ、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-4-23、長堀橋駅.en: Tabelog: Bistro & Bar VISCO, 1-4-23 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Nagahoribashi Station; Mon, Thu and Sun 17:00–23:00, Fri–Sat 17:00–2:00 next morning; closed Tuesdays and Wednesdays; cover charge ¥450; cards and e-money accepted, no QR; 11 counter seats. Reviews (October 2025 – October 2026): just south of Nagahori-dori; a narrow entrance easy to miss; 21st anniversary in 2026; à la carte of seasonal ingredients; starter of pumpkin soup (chilled in summer) and pâté; starter platter; carpaccio; marinated fish; caprese; quiche of the day; foie-gras omelette; sautéed shirako; prosciutto; karasumi; cutlet; porcini pasta; chewy galette; state your taste and get 2 wines to choose from (Muscadet, Chablis); friendly staff; good for a second stop too; book ahead.

食べログ: ピッツェリア ダ ティグレ、大阪市西区新町1-18-13、西大橋駅2.en: Tabelog: Pizzeria da Tigre, 1-18-13 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Nishi-Ohashi Station exit 2, 5 from Yotsubashi; Wed and Fri–Sun 11:30–14:30 and 17:00–21:00, Thu 11:30–14:30; closed Mondays and Tuesdays; no cards, e-money or QR; 13 counter seats. Reviews (April–October 2026): Neapolitan pizza only; wood-fired oven; meal tickets; no reservations; cash only; run single-handed; dough stretched and baked in front of you; done in minutes; margherita ¥1,000; marinara; Ricotta e Cipolla ¥1,500; served uncut with a note on how to eat it; cola ¥300; lots of takeaway; queues at weekend lunch; right after opening is the time to go.

食べログ: ファンサパロット、大阪市中央区日本橋1丁目17-23、06-6631.en: Tabelog: Fansa Parrot, 1-17-23 Nippombashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6631-6872; reservations accepted; Mon and Wed–Sun 11:00–14:00 and 16:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); closed Tuesdays; cards and e-money accepted; 24 seats (ground floor counter 8 and tables 4, 2nd floor tables 12; private hire up to 15). Reviews (September 2025 – October 2026): a similar Thai restaurant two doors down; a corner shop; the smile of a Thai male staff member; larb sen; yum woon sen; D lunch (green curry, Thai noodles, boiled egg and vegetable salad) ¥1,100; C set (gapao rice, vegetable salad, braised pork soup) ¥1,100; just before the entrance to Kuromon Market; run by Thai people, Thai heard all around; tom yum goong; green curry; Thai omelette; prices a little high; lunch sets recommended; slow when busy; a Thai Select restaurant; poo pad pong curry suspended; shrimp fried rice; Singha beer; heat not toned down for Japanese palates; many Thai diners too; prices raised.

食べログ: ホット クロス 南堀江店、大阪市西区南堀江2-2-11 GATO D.en: Tabelog: Hot Cross Minami-Horie, GATO D.M Minami-Horie, 2-2-11 Minami-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 405 m from Nishi-Ohashi Station; Mon and Wed–Sun 8:00–19:30; closed Tuesdays (open on holidays, closed the next day); closed over New Year; no reservations; cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money and QR accepted; 16 seats; no smoking; takeaway; official site. Reviews (July 2025 – September 2026): a bakery cafe known for curry bread; crisp minced-meat curry bread (like a menchi-katsu inside); egg curry bread; curry cabbage dog; curry lunch; bacon baguette; pizza bread; mixed nuts ¥268; cheese fromage ¥328; anpan; sandwiches and a morning menu; eat-in requires a drink order; one says the coffee is good too; a Kita-Horie shop too; one says prices have risen.

食べログ: ホルモンらーめん 8910 千日前店、大阪市中央区千日前1-8-16.en: Tabelog: Horumon Ramen 8910 Sennichimae, 1-8-16 Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; open 24 hours; irregular closing days; no cards, e-money or QR payment; no smoking; opened 8 October 2022; site 8910.sunlar333-pinoko.com. 2026 reviews (August–October): offal ramen and kalbi rice bowl (salt); the feel of a place where risotto or porridge from the soup is recommended; rich soup without off-smells; piping hot; the Sennichimae shopping arcade; the main shop is in Shimoshinjo, Higashiyodogawa-ku; not a big shop and often quiet; seems thin at first but is just right; choice of red or white (red is popular); bubbling in a clay pot; tender offal; like a hot pot for one; opens early in the morning; heat and fluffy offal; 24 hours; corn topping; after drinking.

食べログ: ホルモンラーメン 8910 ヨーロッパ通店、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-.en: Tabelog: Horumon Ramen 8910 Europe-dori, Ookini Kinikini Bldg 1F, 1-16-17 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; open 24 hours; no smoking; e-money accepted; no cards or QR payment; opened 1 April 2023. Reviews (March 2025 – October 2026): limited spicy offal maze-soba ¥1,280 (large at the same price); thick wavy noodles; offal like at a yakiniku restaurant; fried onion; shoyu ramen ¥1,050 (faint sweetness); one said it tastes like instant; spicy kalbi ramen ¥990 (thin noodles, smallish portion); set meals on Saturdays too; one likened it to ramen abroad; the overseas staff are polite; one found the beef-bone paitan lacking; adjust with pepper and shichimi; 8 a.m.; hotter than expected, so an egg was added.

食べログ: ホルモン・ジビエ 明星、大阪市中央区千日前1-2-9 ST千日前ビル.en: Tabelog: Horumon & Gibier Myojo, ST Sennichimae Bldg 1F, 1-2-9 Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 116 m from Nippombashi; Mon and Wed–Fri 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:00), Sat–Sun 15:00–23:00; closed Tuesdays; check Instagram for opening; no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; standing for 16; opened 23 August 2022; Tabelog Tachinomi Hyakumeiten 2025. Reviews (September 2023 – October 2026): kangaroo with shungiku namul; no gamey smell to the kangaroo; horse liver safe to eat raw; seared loin yukhoe with egg; more kinds of liver the earlier you go; grilled liver; beef-tongue sashimi; cheek sashimi; venison thigh; wild boar; Matsusaka beef liver; bottled beer; chuhai where you pour your own soda; return empty bottles to the crate yourself; smallish portions; curry at weekends; camel (tenderloin), arrivals announced on Instagram; a queue right after opening; sea-lion sashimi with ginger; badger hot pot in winter; pig's uterus; often full and items sell out; quiet on rainy days; small intestine; lemon sauce; teriyaki heart; pheasant thigh; salt and yuzu-kosho; Nishinari offal; Akaboshi; beef tongue with plenty of leek; garlic small intestine; tsukami; Miyazaki and Matsusaka beef offal; about 100 m north of Gyokusei Ya; a vinyl-curtain entrance; U-shaped counter; videos of 80s–90s kayokyoku; sweet-potato shochu with water ¥500; offal stew ¥480; Matsusaka garlic small intestine ¥580; Miyazaki loin yukhoe ¥980; kangaroo tenderloin ¥720; one says prices weren't marked as pre-tax; plastic cups.

食べログ: ボタ、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-8-20、長堀橋駅から徒歩3分、月・木.en: Tabelog: Buttah, 1-8-20 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Nagahoribashi Station; Mon and Thu–Sun 12:00–15:30 (L.O.) and from 18:00, Tue 12:00–15:30; closed Wednesdays; phone to check after 21:30; no cards, e-money or QR; 16 seats (counter 4, two tables for 2, one for 4, raised area 4); official site. Reviews (November 2025 – October 2026): an old wooden house down an alley; bare bulbs; cute illustrations; Asian knick-knacks; daily curries (aubergine keema, butter chicken, keema, shrimp coconut, pumpkin butter, squid green curry, vegetable coconut); 2-curry combination; on Sundays a 3-curry plate ¥1,380 (saffron or turmeric rice, dal, pickles); about ¥1,550–1,750 with fried egg and chai; achar; raita; iced cardamom chai; heat can be increased; not too hot, easy to eat; cash only.

食べログ: マイティルゥ、大阪市中央区高津3-2-20、日本橋駅から徒歩5分、火.en: Tabelog: Mighty Luu, 3-2-20 Kozu, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Nippombashi Station; Tue–Sun 11:30–15:00 and 18:00–23:00; closed Mondays; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 18 seats; smoking area. Reviews (February 2025 – June 2026): curry at lunch, a bar at night; chicken curry ¥880 (regular; small, regular, large); slow-simmered tender chicken; a light spice curry with tomato tang; can be made milder; lentil curry; lentil and spinach curry; salmon and potato curry; combinations A, B and C (B is chicken curry with hamburg); hamburg topping; lunch last order 14:30; near the National Bunraku Theatre; one minded a tobacco smell at lunch.

食べログ: メッゼ堀江 トルコカフェ&レストラン、大阪市西区北堀江1-9-14.en: Tabelog: Mezze Horie Turkish Cafe & Restaurant, Pan1914 Bldg 2F, 1-9-14 Kita-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka, 06-6543-1233; reservations accepted; lunch 11:30–15:00, dinner 17:00–22:30 (L.O. 22:00); closed Wednesdays; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; 24 seats (3 tables for 4, counter 6, 3 terrace tables for 2); smoking on the terrace only; opened 26 April 2024; official mezzehorie.com. Shop's description: Mediterranean food by a chef from Turkey; halal ingredients in line with Islamic law; for halal and vegetarian diners too; plenty of spices and vegetables; charcoal-grilled kebabs; Turkish desserts. 2026 reviews (August–October): chicken kebab lunch set ¥1,200 (salad, bean and tomato soup, butter rice); an owner-chef with good Japanese; rice refills available; course ¥4,500 (starter platter with hummus, soup, Turkish bread, chicken, lamb and köfte kebabs, Turkish ice cream, baklava and Turkish pudding, Turkish chai); chickpea croquettes; marinated seafood; many overseas diners; a friendly chef; Turkish beer and red wine; the same tomato soup as eaten in Turkey.

食べログ: ユーミン、大阪市天王寺区空堀町6-1、玉造から227m、毎日11:0.en: Tabelog: Yuming, 6-1 Karahoricho, Tennoji-ku, Osaka; 227 m from Tamatsukuri; daily 11:00–14:00 and 17:30–21:00; closed 1st and 3rd Sundays; no cards, e-money or QR; 6 counter seats; smoking area inside; opened 15 June 2012. Reviews (2019 – July 2026): a neighbourhood Chinese diner one block south of Nagahori-dori; run by two people; TV; 15 noodle dishes (ramen, tanmen, gomoku noodles, champon, yakisoba, tsukemen); gyoza; chukadon; fried rice; sets and daily specials; champon (medium-thin straight noodles, a piping-hot rich chicken-bone shoyu soup, pork, shrimp, cabbage, bean sprouts, carrot, onion, leek); half fried rice + champon set ¥1,000; service set (champon and half fried rice) ¥750; gomoku ramen (chicken-bone salt); Kyushu ramen with half fried rice set ¥800 (some days curry fried rice); fried rice ¥600–700 (roast pork, sausage, bacon); 5 gyoza hand-made from the skins up ¥350, gingery; karaage ¥400; yakisoba with a rich sauce; order verbally, pay afterwards; pepper, chili oil and gyoza sauce on the table.

食べログ: ラ・ゴロセッタ、大阪市中央区南船場2-8-13、心斎橋・長堀橋駅から.en: Tabelog: La Golosetta, 2-8-13 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; walk from Shinsaibashi and Nagahoribashi stations; Tue–Fri and Sun 11:30–14:00 and 18:00–21:00, Sat 18:00–21:00; closed Mondays; cards (VISA, JCB) accepted; 18 seats (ground-floor counter 6, 2nd-floor tables 12). Reviews (June 2023 – October 2026): a cute detached house; an Italian wood-fired oven at the back; pizza stained glass; baked in a few minutes; a chewy, fragrant crust with twisted edges; at lunch from a little over ¥1,000 with salad (watercress and more); about 12 kinds including 2 daily; margherita ¥1,200; diavola ¥1,300 (marinara with spicy salami, chili, garlic; heat adjustable); capricciosa; quattro formaggi; bianca of porcini and smoked mozzarella; anchovy; buffalo mozzarella; bases margherita, marinara (no cheese) and bianca (no tomato); marinated octopus; salami; tiramisu ¥500; beer ¥500; wine; busy after 12:00; one found the salad dressing on the salty side.

食べログ: 一轍、大阪市西区京町堀1-12-23、本町駅28番出口から西へ徒歩7.en: Tabelog: Ittetsu, 1-12-23 Kyomachibori, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 7 min walk west from Hommachi Station exit 28; Nishi-Semba Park; 476 m from Higobashi; Mon and Wed 11:30–14:30, Tue, Thu and Fri 11:30–14:30 and 18:00–21:30; closed weekends and holidays; closes when sold out; no cards, e-money or QR; 14 counter seats; opened 12 July 2010. Reviews (February 2025 – October 2026): ramen heaped with chili ¥950; soft-boiled egg ¥50; restrained heat; niboshi ramen; menma; niboshi ramen (niboshi and tonkotsu shoyu); seafood ramen (bonito-flake and tonkotsu shoyu); sea-bream soba (sea bream and tonkotsu salt); chuka soba; No. 1 most popular is niboshi; medium-thin noodles; nori, menma, white leek, radish sprouts, 2 slices chashu and half a soft-boiled egg for ¥900; the seafood ramen is rich and creamy; plum seafood salt ramen with free wasabi; a 10-year regular; lent an umbrella in the rain; founded 2010; the owner recommends the seafood ramen shoyu; in front of Nishi-Semba Park; down a lane; counter only; stylish chairs; touch-panel ordering; check evening hours; the bill comes with the food; pay at the machine at the back; niboshi ramen large with mentaiko rice; refined and sweetish.

食べログ: 三田製麺所 なんば店、大阪市中央区千日前2-11-3 樋口建物1F、.en: Tabelog: Mita Seimenjo Namba, Higuchi Tatemono 1F, 2-11-3 Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 54 seats (counter 24, tables 30); daily 10:00–3:00 next morning (food L.O. 2:30); no smoking; cards and e-money accepted; opened 21 July 2012; official mita-seimen.jp. 2026 reviews (August–October): limited niboshi chuka soba ¥1,100 and extra niboshi ¥200; salty, strong niboshi; softish thick noodles; cold spicy tantanmen (soy-milk soup) ¥1,150; ordering by QR code; mizuna, menma, chicken, egg yolk, nuts; Sichuan pepper; cold sea-bream salt tsukemen with everything ¥1,340 (500 g noodles); a chain; busy at lunch; self-serve water; black-bonito tsukemen; a strong dipping soup; soup thinned with broth at the end; limited menu right after opening; noodles free up to 500 g; bonito-flake salt and garlic shichimi; limited niboshi tsukemen; near Amza.

食べログ: 上方レインボー、大阪市天王寺区勝山4-6-3、JR桃谷駅南口から徒歩.en: Tabelog: Kamigata Rainbow, 4-6-3 Katsuyama, Tennoji-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from JR Momodani Station south exit; Mon–Wed and Fri–Sun 11:00–15:00 and 18:00–22:00; closed Thursdays; temporary closures announced on social media; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 6 seats; opened 24 February 2020. Reviews (November 2025 – October 2026): Shoyu Animal ¥1,600 (the rich umami and sweetness of a meat soup); iriko shoyu ¥1,000; salt ramen ¥1,000; Antoki no Shio ¥1,600 (tangy red onion); Neo Shio Ramen Apple; curry ramen (seafood dashi and beef fat); house-made thick flat noodles (fettuccine-like); limited tsukemen (Aka Buta DDX with autumn-pear tsukemen ¥1,600; Kurobuta and eel-dashi wasabi tsukemen ¥1,400; fig and octopus summer salt tsukemen ¥1,600; tantan tsukemen); tori paitan now and then; Aka Buta DDX 2 slices of chashu ¥500; Ajitama Arokana ¥200; Kurobuta rice ¥400; Rainbow wonton; large ¥200 (free some days); tablet ordering; staff suggest trying the noodles first with salt and lemon; one found the eel tsukemen a little fishy; doesn't look like a ramen shop from outside.

食べログ: 世界一暇なラーメン屋、大阪市北区中之島3-3-23 中之島ダイビル.en: Tabelog: Sekaiichi Himana Ramen Ya, Nakanoshima Daibiru 2F, 3-3-23 Nakanoshima, Kita-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Keihan Watanabebashi Station, 8 from Higobashi Station; daily 11:00–22:00; closed over New Year; no cards, e-money or QR; 42 seats; opened 11 February 2014; official site. October 2026 reviews: a sister shop of Jinrui Mina Menrui; a stylish, spacious room on the 2nd floor of an office building; Mr. Children songs and music videos; queues at lunch but fast turnover; smartphone ordering at each table (menus only in the waiting area); Witch's Red ¥957 (sweetish shoyu with shellfish umami, chewy medium-thick whole-wheat noodles, thin-sliced chashu); seasoned egg ¥105; a light bonito-dashi ramen; 5 gyoza ¥200; one found it heavy by the end; kind staff; open all day.

食べログ: 両忘、大阪市中央区西心斎橋1-10-17 心斎橋ロヂビル 1F、心斎.en: Tabelog: Ryobo, Shinsaibashi Roji Bldg 1F, 1-10-17 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station exit 7 and Yotsubashi Station; Mon–Fri 17:00–23:00, Sat 12:00–23:00, Sun and holidays 12:00–22:00; irregular closing days; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 10 counter seats; private hire possible (up to 20); opened 29 April 2023. Reviews (July 2024 – October 2026): Tabelog Yakitori WEST Hyakumeiten 2025; course only ¥13,200; dislikes asked first; Kumano jidori (Mie) and Date chicken (Fukushima); starters include smoked thigh tataki, breast tataki, Senshu fruit tomatoes, grilled aubergine, liver pâté with baguette, donko shiitake; skewers of negima, heart, neck, tsukune with mustard, kinkan with liver, gizzard, thigh, furisode, ume-shiso roll; to finish, 2 kinds of clay-pot rice (chicken soboro; lotus root, hiratake and green pepper; corn in July) with refills; pickles, small dishes, soup; house lemon sour; L-shaped counter; one found the heart tasted burnt; at the end of a passage; a calm atmosphere.

食べログ: 中国四川 旬菜 酒肆 楽山、大阪市中央区北浜3-5-19 淀屋橋ホワ.en: Tabelog: China Sichuan Shunsai Shushi Rakusan, Yodoyabashi White Bldg B1F, 3-5-19 Kitahama, Chuo-ku, Osaka; right by Yodoyabashi Station exit 8; Mon–Fri 11:30–14:00 (L.O. 13:45) and 18:00–21:30 (L.O. 21:00); closed weekends and holidays; closed the evening of 2 November for renovation; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 21 seats; private hire up to 20. Reviews (January–October 2026): mapo tofu or tantanmen at lunch (6:4, mapo slightly ahead); a queue from 11:00; quick turnover; house chili oil and numbing Sichuan pepper; mapo tofu with minced meat and douchi; yunbai rou; twice-cooked pork; spicy stir-fried shrimp and cashews; big prawns in chili sauce; chicken breast and zucchini stir-fried with chili; pork fillet stir-fried with douchi; black-vinegar sweet-and-sour pork; Hong Kong shumai; spring rolls; century egg; Shaoxing wine tasting; Heartland beer; a dim basement in an old building; counter and tables; full with bookings at night; fine for drinking alone too.

食べログ: 中国料理 孫悟空、大阪市中央区南船場1-13-15 長堀三栄ビル1F.en: Tabelog: Chinese cuisine Son Goku, Nagahori San'ei Bldg 1F, 1-13-15 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Nagahoribashi Station; no opening hours listed; no cards, e-money or QR; no smoking weekdays 11:00–13:00. Reviews (January–October 2026): a queue after noon on weekdays; shrimp and egg rice bowl ¥800–880 (fluffy egg with Tianjin-style sauce, fried shrimp); beef and egg rice bowl ¥800; seafood and egg rice bowl ¥800; champon with thick sauce ¥880; shoyu yakisoba; sara udon; daily specials (mapo tofu and others); salt, pepper, vinegar, sauce and shoyu on the table; opens 11:30; one says closed Sundays, holidays and Mondays; after price rises the menu and prices may differ a little.

食べログ: 中華そば うえまち、大阪市中央区上町A番22号、谷町六丁目駅7番出口.en: Tabelog: Chuka Soba Uemachi, A-22 Uemachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 4 min walk from Tanimachi-Rokuchome Station exit 7; Tue–Sun 11:00–14:30 and 18:00–21:00; closed Mondays (holidays too); some days no evening service when ingredients run out; closes when sold out; temporary closures on X; no cards, e-money or QR; 8 counter seats; opened 17 December 2012; Tabelog Ramen WEST Hyakumeiten 2018–2022, OSAKA Hyakumeiten 2023–2025. Reviews (March–October 2026): a 63rd visit; tsukemen; a dipping soup balancing sweet, spicy and sour; chewy noodles; melting chashu; the best of the Kadoya line; house-made noodles; shoyu umami with tang and faint heat; 5 people at 13:00 on a weekday, 10 minutes; 11 people at 12:15 on a Sunday, 24 minutes; cash only; tsukemen ¥1,450; glossy flat whole-wheat noodles; 3 kinds of chashu; white leek; menma; in the Kadoya Shokudo tradition but its own; shoyu chuka soba; a sharp shoyu and clear soup; limited chicken-pork and maze-soba; 6 people before 13:00 on a weekday, 30-minute wait; the shoyu ramen a little salty; one says it may move soon.

食べログ: 中華そば しゅき、大阪市天王寺区大道4-10-6、寺田町から105m.en: Tabelog: Chuka Soba Shuki, 4-10-6 Daido, Tennoji-ku, Osaka; 105 m from Teradacho; daily 11:00–24:00; no cards, e-money or QR (one says PayPay worked); opened 12 April 2026. Reviews (September–October 2026): affiliated with Raa-men Shuki in Tsuruhashi; reopened after refitting from Menji Shuki; chashu chuka soba ¥930 (a regular shoyu, thin noodles, overflowing thin-sliced chashu, shredded white leek); spicy mala jan-men ¥1,200 (thick chewy noodles, bean sprouts, chashu, chili, egg yolk; add garlic); cold tantanmen ¥1,200 (thin noodles, spicy meat miso, bok choy, bean sprouts); white-sesame soy-milk cold tantan soba ¥1,380; cold leek edition; noodle refill ¥110 (free for students); gyoza sets; half fried rice ¥530 at lunch; counter only; a few groups waiting even on weekdays; order verbally, pay on leaving.

食べログ: 中華そば なんば楼、大阪市浪速区難波中1-18-14、なんば駅から1.en: Tabelog: Chuka Soba Nanbaro, 1-18-14 Nambanaka, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 111 m from Namba Station; daily 11:00–23:00; no reservations; cards, transit IC, PayPay and au PAY accepted; opened 1 June 2025. Reviews (June 2025 – October 2026): run by Yoshinoya Holdings; signature clear tonkotsu broth; niboshi paitan ramen ¥900; special clear tonkotsu ¥1,200; light, with chewy thick wavy noodles (July 2025); with the menu revision of 17 September 2026, back-fat chuka soba with rice ¥880 and tsukemen discontinued; savoury-spicy soba ¥1,000 and 5× heat ¥500; chan-kei clear tonkotsu; clear and smooth; medium-thin flat straight noodles; 6–7 slices chashu; thin menma; a perk for following on Instagram; free toppings such as garlic or yuzu-kosho; clear tonkotsu noodles ¥1,000; bottled beer ¥500; snack platter ¥500; one found it salty; a bright yellow sign; close to Nankai Namba Station; change the flavour with table condiments; follow the shop's guide to changing the flavour.

食べログ: 中華そば アサヒ製麺 なんばラーメン一座店、大阪市中央区難波3-2-.en: Tabelog: Chuka Soba Asahi Seimen Namba Ramen Ichiza, Namba Ramen Ichiza, 3-2-18 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; daily 11:00–21:30; no cards, e-money or QR payment; listed as smoking allowed; opened 23 June 2022; site ramen-ichiza.edion.com. 2026 reviews (June–October): spicy ramen ¥1,150 (with seasoned egg, nira); shoyu ramen ¥980 plus fried rice set ¥400 (light with deep shoyu, thin wavy noodles); shoyu-based tonkotsu; for a hangover; the favourite at Ichiza; Edion's ramen street; one found it rich and greasy; a sweet shoyu aroma; Yoshimoto comedians' autographs; ramen on the 9th floor after the 7th-floor toy department; children's chairs; minced-meat ramen with small rice; curry ramen (big pieces of meat, lots of fat).

食べログ: 中華そば トライ、大阪市天王寺区大道1-7-11、天王寺から522m.en: Tabelog: Chuka Soba Try, 1-7-11 Daido, Tennoji-ku, Osaka; 522 m from Tennoji; Mon–Sat 19:00–3:00 next morning (L.O. 2:30); closed Sundays; no cards, e-money or QR; opened 1 May 2016. Reviews (March–October 2026): 19:00 until 3 a.m.; Takaida-style chuka soba; after drinking; self-serve drinks; chuka soba ¥700; seasoned egg ¥150; canned beer ¥400; the owner runs it single-handed; chashu-men (regular) ¥900; strong shoyu; medium-thick to thick noodles; leek cut in big pieces; a cheerful owner; on Tanimachi-suji, 6–7 min walk from Tennoji Station; a local ramen of Osaka and Higashi-Osaka; strong shoyu and thick noodles; thick straight noodles; one found the soup lukewarm and the chashu tough and smelly; one says not as strong as it looks; rice balls on the counter; plenty of chashu.

食べログ: 中華そば ニューまるちゃん、大阪市中央区道修町4-7-7 新横堀ビル.en: Tabelog: Chuka Soba New Maruchan, Shin-Yokobori Bldg 2F, 4-7-7 Doshomachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Higobashi Station, 5 from Yodoyabashi Station; Mon–Fri 11:00–14:00 (L.O. 13:30); closed weekends and holidays; reservations accepted; no cards, e-money or QR.
