食べログ: 現代割烹 法善寺momo、大阪市中央区道頓堀1-7-10 日宝バイス.en: Tabelog: Gendai Kappo Hozenji momo, Nippo By-Street Yokocho Bldg 1F, 1-7-10 Dotonbori, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Namba Station; Mon and Wed–Sun 12:00–14:30 and 16:00–22:00; closed Tuesdays (some Tuesdays à la carte by reservation only from 17:00); irregular closures over New Year, Golden Week and Obon; reservations accepted (preschool children in private rooms only); cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 18 seats (counter, private rooms, tatami, sunken kotatsu); no smoking; jazz playing; opened 1 October 2021; weekday-only lunch mini course with seasonal clay-pot rice ¥3,000. Reviews (April–October 2026): beautiful tableware and careful cooking; ¥5,000 is good value; the private room is a bit small; choose the main from 2; fried chicken and fish; fried okra; seasonal clay-pot rice (corn, scallop, shiso), leftovers made into rice balls; at the back of a building down an alley; Japanese food and sake in a private room; ¥5,000 course; lotus-root manju with broccoli sauce; fried sanma salad; seconds of chestnut rice and rice balls to take home; prepared ahead and pre-plated; a harsh review that the egg on rice had set; sashimi (sea bream, amberjack, raw octopus); fried sanma or chicken thigh; chestnut rice; mainly counter with one private room; fast service; Japanese creative cooking; affordable under ¥10,000.

食べログ: 甘党 もぐらや、大阪市中央区難波5丁目 NAMBAなんなん、大阪メト.en: Tabelog: Amato Moguraya, NAMBA Nannan, 5-chome Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; directly connected to Osaka Metro Namba Station; daily 10:00–21:00 (L.O. 20:00); closing days follow Nannan; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 20 seats. Reviews (March–October 2026): takeaway ¥90 a skewer, 3 for ¥270; inside, drinks from ¥500; Moheji-yaki; kintsuba; Fukumochi is coarse bean paste in a chewy skin; the kintsuba is lightly sweet and tastes of azuki; sells out late in the day; takeaway from 10:00; mitarashi dango 3 for ¥270; parfaits; warm mitarashi dango; hojicha; moist dorayaki; mitarashi soft-serve; a 10-minute wait; order while waiting; recommended set B ¥880 (mitarashi dango, kinako kanten, bean paste, shiratama, soft-serve); 4 waiting at 14:00 on a weekday, seated in 5 minutes; courteous, quick service.

食べログ: 相合餅、大阪市中央区千日前1-7-3(千日前1-5-14から移転)、.en: Tabelog: Aioi Mochi, 1-7-3 Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka (moved from 1-5-14 Sennichimae); 209 m from Nippombashi Station; Mon–Sat 17:30–1:30 next morning; closed Sundays; cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners) and QR accepted; 7 seats. Reviews (October 2025 – August 2026): mochi in nighttime Dotonbori; a friendly owner; from 17:00; a break after drinking or a souvenir; one says nearly 70 years of history; additive-free, so it doesn't keep; vacuum-packed mochi; white mochi; shiso mochi; yomogi mochi; grilled mochi (yomogi) ¥200; ohagi 5 for ¥900 (kinako, smooth bean paste, coarse bean paste); nights only; cash or PayPay; founded 1961; Aioibashi-suji shopping street near Hozenji; until 1:30 a.m.; inbound visitors; kusa mochi; takeaway from one piece; a nostalgic atmosphere; grilled mochi piping hot; warabi mochi ¥350; sticks to the bag when taken away.

食べログ: 真夜中キッチン うさぎ、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-16-19 日宝周防.en: Tabelog: Mayonaka Kitchen Usagi, Nippo Suomachi Kaikan 1F, 1-16-19 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 389 m from Shinsaibashi; Tue–Sun 0:00–8:00; closed Mondays; reservations accepted; no cards, e-money or QR; 10 counter seats. Reviews (April 2022 – May 2026): open until early morning; omurice; macaroni salad; U-shaped counter; a wide menu; potato salad; red sausages; pork kimchi; sweet-potato highball; one says 23:00–8:00 (2024); no big sign; a noren and sliding door; spotlights; one-drink minimum; lemon chuhai ¥560; omurice ¥700; macaroni salad ¥300 (curry-flavoured); full at 5:30 a.m.; octopus sausages; soup; some have come for over 10 years; stamina; the owner's character; cured mackerel; octopus sashimi; midnight to 8 a.m.; blackboard menu; omurice ¥780; the owner says it's a casual izakaya and a drink order is required; cash only; average spend about ¥1,400.

食べログ: 神虎 肥後橋店、大阪市西区江戸堀1-14-12 オリザ肥後橋 1F、.en: Tabelog: Kami Tora Higobashi, Oriza Higobashi 1F, 1-14-12 Edobori, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Yotsubashi Line Higobashi Station; daily 10:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); may close early when busy; closed 30 December – 3 January; no cards, e-money or QR; 19 seats (counter 5, three tables for 4); opened 11 December 2019; official site. Reviews (September–October 2026): tonkotsu ramen from the GIN NO BUDOU group, which runs Zagin and others; three kinds, standard, black (burnt garlic) and red (spicy miso); Kami Tora ramen ¥890; seasoned egg ¥150; leek ¥130; wood-ear ¥130; chashu rice bowl ¥410; 4 gyoza ¥280; noodle refill ¥100 whenever you like; extra fat; noodle firmness; a free chashu rice bowl for new app sign-ups; spicy takana, red pickled ginger, garlic, sesame, chili and Akuma sauce on the table; ticket machine outside; 5 waiting even after 14:00 on a weekday; one found it too strong; one wished the soup were hotter; one says Akatora isn't hot; a courteous apology for a mistaken order; brisk service and a send-off outside.

食べログ: 福太郎 なんばダイニングメゾン店、大阪市中央区難波5-1-18 なん.en: Tabelog: Fukutarou Namba Dining Maison, Namba Dining Maison 8F (Osaka Takashimaya), 5-1-18 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; daily 11:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:00); on weekdays L.O. 14:30, reopening at 17:00; closed on Takashimaya closing days; no reservations; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; no smoking; 15 counter seats; takeaway; free partner parking for ¥3,000 or more; official site. Reviews (September–October 2026): come here when the main shop is crowded; orders taken while queuing; cooked on the teppan in front of you; a fluffy, melting batter; beef-tendon negiyaki; mixed okonomiyaki; pork okonomiyaki; seafood okonomiyaki (shrimp, squid, scallop); squid yakisoba; mixed yaki; kimchi; salad; takes time to cook; many takeaway customers.

食べログ: 立ち呑み クック オッソ オッセョ!、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-1-1.en: Tabelog: Tachinomi Cook Osso Osseyo!, Osakaya Jumbo Bldg 1F No. 7, Jumbo Yokocho, 2-1-13 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; about 5 min walk from Nagahoribashi Station; the table gives Tue, Wed, Fri and Sat 18:00–24:00, the note says 3 days a week, Tuesday or Wednesday plus Friday and Saturday; closed Mondays, Thursdays, Sundays and holidays; no basic charge (¥500 for drinks only); no cards; e-money, PayPay and au PAY accepted; smoking allowed; standing for about 10; Korean-speaking staff; listed as able to cater for vegetarians; opened 28 January 2010; blog; the name is Korean for 'welcome'. Reviews (2018 – July 2025): a Korean and Italian standing bar; napa-cabbage kimchi ¥350; water kimchi; spicy jjukkumi ¥780; spicy nakji bokkeum (shirako on days without octopus); shrimp jeon; raw oysters with 3 sauces (including gochujang); steamed pork; strawberry makgeolli cocktail; mapo tofu; easy for drinking alone; one found it a little pricey for a standing bar.

食べログ: 笑心、大阪市浪速区難波中3-3-10 清水ビル1F、なんば駅・南海な.en: Tabelog: Egokoro, Shimizu Bldg 1F, 3-3-10 Nambanaka, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Namba and Nankai Namba stations; Mon–Fri 11:30–14:30 and 18:00–21:30, Sun 11:30–15:30; closed Saturdays and holidays; no cards, e-money or QR; 16 seats (two tables for 4, one for 2, counter 6); smoking allowed; opened 24 September 2008; famous for champon, a place to drink at leisure at night. Reviews (May–September 2026): white champon set meal ¥950; a rich, mellow tonkotsu soup with finely chopped ingredients; ¥50 for rice to make it a set meal; porridge from the leftover soup; red champon set meal; white champon with fried rice set ¥1,200; vinegar and chili oil as the table guide suggests; sara udon; champon is the thing; order verbally; the red is chicken bones with Sichuan doubanjiang, mildly hot; chewy medium-thick champon noodles; the best champon in Namba; visited for years; a neighbourhood-Chinese atmosphere; near Namba Parks; red and white ¥900 each; white is creamy, red mildly spicy.

食べログ: 紀州和歌山ラーメン きぶんや 道頓堀店、大阪市中央区宗右衛門町1-6.en: Tabelog: Kishu Wakayama Ramen Kibunya Dotonbori, Kibunya Bldg 1F, 1-6 Soemoncho, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6211-8055; no reservations; Mon–Thu and Sun 9:00–5:00 next morning, Fri, Sat and days before holidays 9:00–6:00 next morning; no cards; e-money and QR payment (PayPay, Alipay) accepted; 20 seats (counter 12, tables 8); no smoking. 2026 reviews (July–October): the aged ramen has just the right strength of flavour and fat, good after drinking; no half fried rice, but half karaage; keen staff; the shrimp tsukemen is rich in shrimp aroma and umami; limited Japanese-style grated-yam cold ramen ¥1,210 (¥1,200 per another); watch out for the large pre-tax price and small tax-inclusive price; cold thin noodles (listed as both wavy and straight); grated yam, chicken chashu, tempura egg, myoga; pay cash on leaving; Kishu Wakayama ramen ¥950 (before tax), price raised; one found it bland with lukewarm soup; another says the soup is good enough to drink in one go; many overseas diners too.

食べログ: 老四川、大阪市中央区島之内2-8-18、日本橋駅から419m、月〜土.en: Tabelog: Lao Sichuan, 2-8-18 Shimanouchi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 419 m from Nippombashi Station; Mon–Sat 12:00–14:30 and 17:30–20:30; closed Sundays; no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; no smoking. Reviews (November 2025 – September 2026): braised beef noodles; premium beef noodles and pork-intestine noodles; beef tripe; extra-hot and extra-numbing recommended; a shop run by a cook from Sichuan; always busy; sweat-inducing even at mild; no rice to finish; most diners Chinese and the staff from China too; Chinese on the ticket machine; about an hour from entering to being served; authentic and aromatic; the numbing of Sichuan pepper; tender tripe; full even 30 minutes before closing; each bowl made with care; mala beef noodles; tender beef; chewy noodles; medium numbing, medium hot; one came all the way from Kobe; full even in the rain, a 10-minute wait.

食べログ: 肥後橋ラーめん亭、大阪市西区江戸堀1-14-1 平和総合肥後橋ビル.en: Tabelog: Higobashi Ramen Tei, Heiwa Sogo Higobashi Bldg 2F, 1-14-1 Edobori, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Yotsubashi Line Higobashi Station; Mon–Sat 11:00–2:00 next morning; closed Sundays; no cards or e-money; QR accepted; no service charge; 24 seats (counter 8, tables 16). Reviews (January 2025 – September 2026): opposite APA Hotel Higobashi; up the stairs to the 2nd floor; busy with nearby office workers at lunch; garlic ramen in the Satsumakko lineage; a light, slightly thick tonkotsu; garlic none, less or more; medium-thick wavy egg noodles; tender, juicy pork-belly chashu; bean sprouts; leek; kimchi and rice included at lunch; the last stop after drinking; spicy miso ramen; some days few kitchen staff, so slow; kind service; one found it too light.

食べログ: 自家製ミートソース potto、大阪市中央区南船場3-6-1 サイプ.en: Tabelog: House Meat Sauce potto, Cypress Shinsaibashi 1F, 3-6-1 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station exit 2; weekdays 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–22:00, weekends and holidays 11:00–22:00; occasional irregular closures; no lunch reservations; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money and QR (PayPay) accepted; 18 seats (counter 12, terrace 6); smoking and pets on the terrace only; opened 4 March 2013; official site. Shop introduction: house meat sauce of slow-simmered senbon-suji; meatballs of 100% Australian grain-fed beef with cream meat sauce; carbonara; arrabbiata. Reviews (September–October 2026): limited dashi meat sauce (topped with bonito flakes); chewy fresh pasta; whole-wheat noodles available; avocado cream of the month; weekday lunch large free with soup; drink +¥200; QR ordering; one found the oyster and karasumi pasta light on karasumi and the service pushy, with requests to add the LINE account.

食べログ: 若水、大阪市西区南堀江1-1-20、06-6541-8951、予約不.en: Tabelog: Wakamizu, 1-1-20 Minami-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka, 06-6541-8951; no reservations; Mon–Fri 11:00–20:00 (L.O. 19:00), Sun and holidays 11:00–17:00; closed Saturdays; no cards or e-money; 8 seats (counter only). 2026 reviews (April–October): a neighbourhood Chinese diner in Amemura; 5-item set meal ¥1,000 (Chinese omelette, happosai, 3 karaage, 2 slices chashu, cabbage); large portions; salt butter-corn ramen and gyoza; long-established; tenshinhan and half shoyu ramen; a short wait when full; mostly male diners and quick turnover; half tantanmen and half shoyu ramen ¥800 (slightly wavy thin noodles, a nostalgic shoyu with sweetness, bean sprouts, nori, thick chashu; tantanmen with a soft-boiled egg); chukadon ¥650; 8 seats; cheap; quick; the atmosphere of an old-style ramen shop; slippery noodles.

食べログ: 華、大阪市西区新町1-8-3、四ツ橋駅2番出口から徒歩2分、月〜土.en: Tabelog: Hana, 1-8-3 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Yotsubashi Station exit 2; Mon–Sat 11:30–14:30 and 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30), holidays 11:30–14:30 and 17:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); closed Sundays; no cards, e-money or QR; smoking allowed; 60 seats; semi-private rooms. Reviews (March 2025 – October 2026): a back-street Chinese restaurant since around 2006; full of office workers at lunch; mapo-tofu rice bowl set meal ¥600; green pepper and pork stir-fry set meal ¥800 (rice, soup, mini ramen, spring roll); happosai set meal; miso ramen and fried rice set ¥850; spicy miso ramen set meal (ask for heat); tenshinhan and chukadon set meals; all-you-can-eat-and-drink with table ordering at night ¥3,580; small dishes may differ from the menu photos; one calls the taste ordinary.

食べログ: 華うさぎ、大阪市中央区南船場3-2-28 日宝タイヨービル 1F2号.en: Tabelog: Hana Usagi, Nippo Taiyo Bldg 1F No. 2, 3-2-28 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station exit 1; Mon–Fri 11:30–13:20 (ends when the rice runs out; no lunch reservations) and 18:00–22:00, Sat 18:00–21:00; closed Sundays and holidays; courses by the day before; 100% same-day cancellation fee; à la carte only ¥550 per person; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 10 seats (counter 6, tables 4); smoking allowed; official site. Shop introduction: affordable kaiseki of seasonal ingredients; fish chosen at Kuromon market. Reviews (February 2025 – October 2026): Hana Usagi tendon (2 shrimp and 3 vegetables) ¥700; kakiage rice bowl ¥800; special tendon A (2 shrimp) ¥1,000; special tempura set meal 'Matsu'; chicken-tempura set meal with mini sashimi; large rice free; with miso soup; pay first at lunch; a light batter with a dashi-rich Kansai-style sauce; one found it a little oily; full after 12:00 at lunch; 'Koi Usagi' set at night ¥3,300; plenty of sake; served sake-lees soup on a cold day.

食べログ: 薬膳担担麺 胡仙、大阪市西区北堀江1-2-16 103、予約不可、月.en: Tabelog: Yakuzen Tantanmen Kosen, 1-2-16-103 Kita-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka; no reservations; Mon–Sat 11:30–15:30 and 18:00–20:30, Sun 11:00–16:00; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; 25 seats; no smoking; opened 17 March 2026. 2026 reviews (July–October): Kyoto-style tantanmen; drank all of the medicinal soup; careful explanations for first-timers; summer-only Kyoto-style cold tantanmen ¥1,300 and lettuce fried rice (small) ¥500; a strong presence of sesame and a medicinal-herb flavour; thin noodles; the medicinal vinegar staff recommend; house-made doubanjiang and chili; tastes like a shop in Shijo-Omiya, Kyoto; one says the Sichuan tantanmen tastes of soy milk and is thin; one calls it ordinary; Kyoto style (white) and Sichuan style (red); Sichuan tantanmen regular ¥1,200, large ¥1,400; ordering by QR; over 20 medicinal ingredients; condiments on the table; house-made doubanjiang sold for ¥300; a clean shop.

食べログ: 藍丹らーめん、大阪市中央区瓦町2-3-15、堺筋本町から404m、月.en: Tabelog: Rantan Ramen, 2-3-15 Kawaramachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 404 m from Sakaisuji-Hommachi; Mon–Sat 11:30–15:00; closed Sundays and holidays; no cards, e-money or QR; opened 7 January 2019. Reviews (September 2025 – September 2026): set back in a building, hard to find; counter only; ticket machine outside; water and oshibori self-serve; shoyu ramen; the only side is rice; seems to be a seafood and pork soup; salty but not harsh; thick grilled chashu; vegetable noodles large ¥950 (crab sticks, wood-ear, roast pork); quieter around 12:30; tantanmen ¥900, not too hot; a big sign; about 15 counter seats facing the wall; bright and clean; Chinese-style lanterns; salt ramen (2 slices chashu, menma, wood-ear, leek, egg, spinach, nori); salty with a kick of pepper; one likens it to a premium Sugakiya; not a bad finish; hot-and-sour noodles ¥900 with fresh tomato; not too hot, just the right tang; one says it's known for reimen; courteous service.

食べログ: 蛸焼とおでん 友の、大阪市浪速区難波中1-8-13、四つ橋線なんば駅.en: Tabelog: Takoyaki to Oden Tomono, 1-8-13 Nambanaka, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 30 seconds from Yotsubashi Line Namba Station exit 32; daily 18:00–5:00 next morning (L.O. 4:00); open every day of the year; table-charge starter ¥440; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 20 seats; opened 26 April 2019. Reviews (July 2024 – October 2026): shellfish-dashi oden; small portions, cut to suit the party size; comes with the shellfish used for the dashi; unusual items such as pea shoots and bean sprouts; konnyaku with mustard miso; takoyaki made to order; eat them with salt to taste the dashi; takoyaki with shellfish dashi poured over; a range of seasonings; water octopus; snapping-turtle hot pot in winter; seats fill fast; calm even alone; a Shinsaibashi shop too; one prefers it to famous shops.

食べログ: 西心斎橋 ゆうの、大阪市中央区西心斎橋1-10-35、四ツ橋駅から1.en: Tabelog: Nishi-Shinsaibashi Yuno, 1-10-35 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 174 m from Yotsubashi; from 18:00 (two sittings); L.O. 19:00; closed Mondays; course ¥23,880 (tax and service included); 10% service charge; cards accepted, no e-money; 16 seats; private rooms for 4, 6 and 8. Reviews (September 2025 – October 2026): a Naniwa kaiseki omakase course; seasonal ingredients; matsutake and snapping-turtle wontons; ayu soup; grilled eel topped with sea urchin; Inaniwa udon with abalone-liver sauce; shellfish shinjo; sea-bream milt and thin udon with karasumi and firefly squid; shrimp and bamboo-shoot rice; 3 kinds of sea urchin from Hokkaido, Aomori and Awaji; depth of dashi; antique tableware matched to the season (chrysanthemum-shaped plates); sake to wine; for business entertaining too; one says a last-minute booking was accommodated.

食べログ: 豆ルンルン、大阪市浪速区難波中3-4-40 南大阪ビル 1F、南海な.en: Tabelog: Mame Runrun, Minami-Osaka Bldg 1F, 3-4-40 Nambanaka, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Nankai Namba Station; Tue–Sun 8:00–18:00; closed Mondays; cards and QR (PayPay, d-barai, au PAY) accepted, no e-money; no smoking; 12 seats (tables 8, counter 4); children and pushchairs welcome; takeaway; opened 20 November 2023. Reviews (August 2025 – June 2026): a Taiwanese-style soy-milk shop; a cute interior with bean characters; near Edion Arena; plain soy milk (hot or iced); oolong soy milk; black-sesame soy milk; mixed-berry soy milk ¥660; choose sweetness (one says 25% is just right); Taiwanese pork bun ¥320; pork bun and soy milk ¥500; tapioca kakigori in summer; free sunflower seeds; order at the till, then sit; some wanted more richness.

食べログ: 豚になる、大阪市西区江戸堀1-23-27、肥後橋から378m、毎日1.en: Tabelog: Buta ni Naru, 1-23-27 Edobori, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 378 m from Higobashi; daily 11:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:30) and 18:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); no cards, e-money or QR; 13 counter seats; opened 24 November 2024. Reviews (September 2025 – October 2026): Jiro style in Tosabori; soupless 200 g ¥1,100; meal tickets, no calls; beginner-friendly; chewy noodles; a mountain of bean sprouts; mayonnaise; pork offcuts; thick chashu; raw egg; black pepper; soupless tantanmen (meat miso, onsen egg, bok choy); no garlic, extra vegetables, extra fat; no batch system, served in ticket order; hardly any wait at lunch; standard 200 g of noodles; vegetables up to double extra; a sharp shoyu; sweetness of noodles and vegetables; the fat unseasoned; smallish pork with little fat and a firm texture; chashu rice set; cold TKM; rice to finish.

食べログ: 超豚骨 濃度8、大阪市中央区高津2-7-3 バーリービル1F、日本橋.en: Tabelog: Cho Tonkotsu Noudo 8, Barley Bldg 1F, 2-7-3 Kozu, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Nippombashi Station exit 7; daily 11:30–1:00 next morning (L.O. 0:30; extended from 15 December 2025); no cards, e-money or QR; 11 seats (counter); no smoking; opened 11 October 2013. Reviews (September–October 2026): fill in the meal ticket and hand it over: firmness, garlic, heat; rice to finish; two noodles, thin straight and slightly thick wavy; open late; overseas solo diners too; strength 8 and limited strength 27; even 27 is only a little stronger; after a gig; not that rich; everything-on with a soup swap (double soup); easy to eat; write in noodle firmness, leek, back fat, garlic and spicy miso; lighter and creamier than it looks; thin noodles; chashu and seasoned egg; visits often; a consistent taste.

食べログ: 趣味焼肉ばばあ、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-17-3 Groove心斎橋.en: Tabelog: Shumi Yakiniku Babaa, Groove Shinsaibashi East 3F, 1-17-3 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Nagahoribashi and Shinsaibashi stations; Mon and Thu–Sun 17:00–5:00 next morning, Tue 17:00–24:00; closed Wednesdays; cards and QR (PayPay, d-barai) accepted, no e-money; 12 counter seats; smoking allowed; opened 16 September 2022. Reviews (September–October 2026): a sister shop exists; à la carte; many raw-meat dishes (skirt yukhoe, heart sashimi, senmai sashimi, grilled liver); thick-cut tongue (and an off-menu premium thick cut); skirt; sagari; loin; Tsunami; rare-shabu loin with sweet-savoury sauce and egg yolk, grilled by staff into a mini rice bowl; Urute no Yubiki; napa-cabbage kimchi; offal stew; Morioka reimen with sudachi to finish; ramen; skirt fried rice; choice of sauces; plenty of drinks; a lively counter; reachable even after the last train; booking recommended; good value; kind staff.

食べログ: 進化驀進 京町堀本店、大阪市西区京町堀1-3-1 京清ビル 2F、肥.en: Tabelog: Shinka Bakushin Kyomachibori main shop, Kyosei Bldg 2F, 1-3-1 Kyomachibori, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 414 m from Higobashi; Mon–Thu 11:00–16:00 and 18:00–24:00, Fri–Sun 11:00–14:30; cards (including UnionPay), transit IC, iD, QUICPay and QR (including WeChat Pay) accepted; 25 seats (counter 7, three tables for 2, three for 4); opened 20 April 2012. Reviews (May–September 2026): tonkotsu ramen; black tonkotsu is popular; free rice refills; tonkotsu ramen ¥950; self-serve rice and pickles; seems a pork and seafood soup; 2 kinds of chashu; smoky block chashu; rice sold out, but staff served what was left; one wanted garlic on the table; flashy decor; rich but not salty; gritty fat; thick, firm noodles; quiet on a Sunday lunchtime; pork aroma; change the flavour with garlic and ichimi; chewy noodles; the belly block has sweet fat, the loin meaty umami; two bowls of rice; pickles and takana; tsukudani and garlic free; lunch under ¥1,000; tsukemen too.

食べログ: 進辛正麺、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-8-5 日宝ニューグランドビル3F.en: Tabelog: Shinkara Seimen, Nippo New Grand Bldg 3F, 2-8-5 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 12 seats (counter 7, one table for 4); Mon–Sat 20:00–6:00 next morning (food L.O. 5:30); closed Sundays and holidays; separate smoking area; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; opened 25 April 2025. Reviews (August–September 2025): soupless tantanmen; a special sauce of chili oil and Sichuan pepper; meat-miso mayo rice bowl; a dim bar-like interior; change the flavour with sansho and niboshi vinegar; pan-fried gyoza; soy-milk tantanmen (mild); gyoza-buns like pan-fried xiaolongbao (4 for ¥700); soy-milk tantanmen with soup ¥1,100; soupless tantanmen ¥1,100; meat-miso mayo rice bowl ¥450; no sign, hard to find; a popular Kita tantanmen shop come to Minami.

食べログ: 酒パンつつみ、大阪市中央区南船場1-13-15 長堀三栄プラザ 2F.en: Tabelog: Sake Pan Tsutsumi, Nagahori San'ei Plaza 2F, 1-13-15 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Nagahoribashi Station; Wed, Thu and Sun 18:00–24:00, Fri–Sat 18:00–2:00 next morning; closed Mondays and Tuesdays; irregular closing days; no cards, e-money or QR; 20 seats (including standing). Reviews (May–October 2026): a bread and drinks bar; CHE sandwich ¥800 (cheese, hash brown, egg); baguette with aosa butter; salted kombu and cream cheese; prosciutto and new-onion yukhoe ¥600; duck and cheddar; sausage pizza toast ¥800; corn-potage toast; house egg sandwich; water-aubergine and prosciutto salad ¥550; mushrooms grilled with nori mayo ¥650; namul; carrot cake ¥350; wine chosen from the fridge (bottles from ¥3,800, including Japanese ones such as Hitomi Winery); craft gin; shochu; grape beer; one person working, so it can take time.

食べログ: 酒場 音色 定食と路地裏の酒場、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋1-5-19 し.en: Tabelog: Sakaba Neiro Teishoku to Rojiura no Sakaba, Shinbura-gai 1F, 1-5-19 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station exit 6; the hours table gives Tue 18:00–22:30, Wed–Sun 11:30–14:30 (L.O. 14:00) and 18:00–22:30 (food L.O. 21:45), closed Mondays; a note in the same listing also says closed Sundays and 1st and 3rd Mondays; opened 15 November 2025; 10 seats; cards, iD, QUICPay and PayPay accepted; heated tobacco only (evenings); official site. Reviews (August–October 2026): a quiet counter down an alley off the Shinsaibashisuji shopping street; the same owner as the former Wabisuke; an Okinawan atmosphere; at lunch a set meal with a choice of main (niku-dofu ¥1,100, chicken nanban with mentaiko tartare, fried horse mackerel); free rice refills; miso soup; small dish; raw egg; lunch bookable too; at night 3-obanzai platter ¥990, rafute tacos ¥550, tako-wasa and nagaimo salad ¥580, crab gratin ¥500, shrimp gyoza ¥580.

食べログ: 酒場スナフキン、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋2-3-5 日宝ファインプラザ2.en: Tabelog: Sakaba Snufkin, Nippo Fine Plaza 2F, 2-3-5 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 050-5869-6942; reservations accepted (call for availability); Tue–Sun and holidays 18:00–23:30 (L.O. 23:00); closed Mondays and 29 December – 5 January; cards accepted, no e-money; 14 seats. 2026 reviews (January–September): tomato oden and avocado wasabi; pork-wrapped baby corn; nanohana; risotto to finish; Italian-style oden; staff made room at a crowded counter; oden and fried oysters; gyoza platter and soy-milk sake-lees oden (not as good as hoped; a price comparison); creative dishes are the draw; light seasoning; an impressive sake list; a local feel; sake gathered from all over Japan (some brands rare in Osaka); left of the blackboard chilled sake, right room-temperature to warmed; obanzai; friendly owner and staff; the owner made it non-smoking.

食べログ: 酒菜屋 なないろ、大阪市中央区島之内1-14-15 天野ビル 1F、.en: Tabelog: Sakanaya Nanairo, Amano Bldg 1F, 1-14-15 Shimanouchi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Nagahoribashi Station exit 6; Tue–Sat 18:00–1:00 next morning (enter by 22:30), Sun and holidays 18:00–23:30 (enter by 21:00); closed Mondays; some days opens 17:30; entry by 21:30 includes dashi and 3 small dishes ¥1,650–2,200, later entry and courses dashi and 1 small dish ¥770; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; 20 seats (counter 10, 2 low tables with a footwell); Instagram @sakanaya.nanairo. Reviews (September 2025 – October 2026): a hideaway in a quiet spot; sea-bream dashi and small dishes; sashimi platter of wild fish (bluefin tuna, seared sawara, yellowtail, sweet shrimp with salt and sudachi); autumn aubergine in hairy-crab sauce; simmered octopus and vegetables; matsutake dobin-mushi; shrimp cream croquettes; lotus-root manju with crab; oysters grilled on kombu; shrimp sake-lees gratin; duck; wagyu; winter kue hot pot with zosui; Korean reimen; horumon jjigae; sweet-and-sour pork; spring rolls; sea-bream clay-pot rice; Dewazakura; Tenpo Ichi; courteous, friendly service; fine alone; one says portions are very modest and the air quiet.

食べログ: 金久右衛門 道頓堀店、大阪市中央区道頓堀1-4-17、41席(1階カ.en: Tabelog: Kin'emon Dotonbori, 1-4-17 Dotonbori, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 41 seats (ground-floor counter 23; basement counter 6 and tables 12); Mon–Thu 11:00–8:00 next morning, open 24 hours Fri, Sat, Sun and days before holidays; closes when sold out; open every day of the year; opened 29 December 2011; official site king-emon-dotonbori.com. 2026 reviews (English edition): a 34th morning ramen with 'Osaka Kinjou Shoyu' (clear chicken-bone and light-shoyu soup, thin noodles, garlic, leek, menma, soft-boiled seasoned egg); one said a large 'Osaka Black' and pork bowl topped ¥2,000, pricey and aimed at tourists; ticket machine in front; 'Osaka Black' without egg ¥1,000; glossy black, a bittersweet shoyu with the buttery aroma of chicken fat; thin noodles recommended; noodle refills available; basic bowl ¥1,200; one found the staff curt; 'Red Shoyu'; 'King Shoyu'; one noticed a tonkotsu aroma; 'Osaka Black' with seafood umami; the shop next to Kinryu with no queue; 'Osaka Black' ¥1,200 at 5 a.m., thin noodles firm.

食べログ: 金麦 難波店、大阪市浪速区難波中2-8-91 中川ビル1F、なんば駅.en: Tabelog: Kinmugi Namba, Nakagawa Bldg 1F, 2-8-91 Nambanaka, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 200 m from Namba Station; daily 11:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:30) and 17:30–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); cards, e-money and QR accepted; 18 seats; opened 1 September 2025. Reviews (August–October 2026): ticket machine; cold corn-soup noodles ¥1,400 (sweet potato, broccoli, corn, chopped chicken, rich corn potage, thin straight noodles); tori-paitan ramen ¥1,000; mouth-watering chicken rice bowl ¥300; near Namba Parks; touch-panel ticket machine; a rich, creamy, stew-like soup; soft-boiled egg; chicken and pork chashu; tori-paitan tsukemen ¥1,100, large ¥150, seasoned egg ¥150; a light, frothy dipping soup; thick noodles chilled in cold water; 2 kinds of slightly rare chashu; a refined interior despite the back street; good service; curly noodles; a gentle, sweet chicken soup; firm noodles; overseas diners too; the second shop after Amemura; Mugikyu Co., Ltd.; PayPay.

食べログ: 金麦、大阪市西区北堀江1-2-16 おおきにサイタ・サイタビルヂング.en: Tabelog: Kinmugi, Ookini Saita Saita Bldg side building 1F, 1-2-16 Kita-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka; no reservations; daily 11:00–14:30 and 18:00–21:30; irregular closing days; no cards, e-money or QR; 7 seats (counter); opened 7 July 2024. 2026 reviews (June–October): creamy tori paitan and mouth-watering chicken rice bowl; fine bubbles, smooth; rich yet the chicken stands out and isn't heavy; low-temperature pork-loin and chicken-breast chashu; shredded white leek; mizuna; onion; menma (thick, tender, well seasoned, superb); the ticket machine is now touch-panel; more beef dishes added; the previous owner has gone, now young staff; one says something is missing; one found the chewy medium-thick noodles underboiled; few seats, so a queue; many overseas diners; hot inside; always a queue; medium-thick straight noodles; 3 kinds of chashu; drank all of the light tori paitan; between sets at MINAMI WHEEL.

食べログ: 金龍ラーメン 御堂筋店、大阪市中央区難波1-7-12、なんば駅徒歩3.en: Tabelog: Kinryu Ramen Midosuji, 1-7-12 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Namba Station; open 24 hours; no reservations; smoking allowed; counter. 2026 reviews: in business for over 35 years; a simple old-fashioned flavour; help yourself to garlic, kimchi and nira; one was disappointed not to taste rich tonkotsu; self-serve garlic and spicy nira; the big dragon sign; standing; ramen ¥900; tonkotsu-based and lighter than it looks; fast turnover even at 2 a.m.; tables along the pavement and an open kitchen; free kimchi, garlic and nira; good chashu; rich yet clean; street-stall style: buy a ticket and eat standing.

食べログ: 金龍ラーメン 戎橋店、大阪市中央区難波3-3、毎日9:00〜22:0.en: Tabelog: Kinryu Ramen Ebisubashi, 3-3 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; daily 9:00–22:00; no cards, e-money or QR payment; smoking allowed. Reviews (October 2025 – October 2026): ramen ¥900 (¥800 in 2025); plenty of chashu; unlimited white rice, nira kimchi and napa-cabbage kimchi; firm noodles; chairs covered in tatami fabric; only two choices on the ticket machine, ramen and chashu-men; four free extras: garlic (chopped), kimchi, spicy nira and rice; gentle tonkotsu; cloudy but not heavy; medium-thin straight noodles; thin-sliced chashu; meal ticket swapped for a number tag; some days ¥700 for the Hanshin victory sale; table seats only; one found the rice soft; 3 slices chashu; self-serve water.

食べログ: 金龍ラーメン 本店、大阪市中央区道頓堀1-1-18、38席(立ち席あ.en: Tabelog: Kinryu Ramen main shop, 1-1-18 Dotonbori, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 38 seats (standing places; partly closed late at night); open 24 hours; no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR payment; smoking allowed. 2025–2026 reviews: the classic main shop; a 10-minute wait; big chashu; unlimited garlic, nira and kimchi unchanged for half a century; king of light Osaka tonkotsu (once a one-coin ¥500, ¥800 in 2022); chashu-men; kimchi, garlic, nira; free rice; a 30-minute wait with meal ticket; several slices of chashu and offcuts even in the plain ramen; lighter than Kyushu tonkotsu; unlimited rice instead of noodle refills; after the second round of drinks; rich tonkotsu with rice and kimchi; the reviewer's son was impressed too.

食べログ: 金龍ラーメン 道頓堀店、大阪市中央区道頓堀1-7-26、なんば駅14.en: Tabelog: Kinryu Ramen Dotonbori, 1-7-26 Dotonbori, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Namba Station exit 14; open 24 hours; no reservations; counter and tatami seating; children welcome. Shop introduction: a Minami landmark open 24 hours, known for its giant dragon sculpture; rich tonkotsu simmered from pork bones and chicken feet (momiji) with a secret tare; house-made straight noodles; kimchi, garlic and nira chives free and unlimited. 2026 reviews: many inbound tourists; medium-thin, slightly wavy noodles; shoyu-based tonkotsu with restrained saltiness, one said it was lukewarm; the menu is only ramen and chashu-men; light tonkotsu; the free kimchi and nira are spicy; pepper suits it; ramen ¥900 (up ¥200; ¥600 in the reviewer's twenties); the main shop is under construction; a chicken-and-pork blend with a sharp finish; the aroma of chili oil; called by numbered ticket and you carry it yourself; fast turnover.

食べログ: 金龍ラーメン 難波千日前店、大阪市中央区難波千日前11-20、06-.en: Tabelog: Kinryu Ramen Namba Sennichimae, 11-20 Namba Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6649-1448; no reservations; open 24 hours; no cards or e-money; QR (PayPay) accepted; no smoking. October 2026 review: a light pork-and-chicken soup (cloudy pork-bone and chicken-bone soup with shoyu); smooth with no off-smell; 24 hours, a last stop after drinking; free kimchi, nira and garlic at the counter; free rice; ticket machine left of the entrance; the menu is only ramen and chashu-men; Kinryu ramen ¥900; collect it yourself; small tatami seats without backrests; unsure whether to take shoes off; two kinds of chashu; good as a morning ramen too; done in about 10 minutes.

食べログ: 釜上げうどん 二葉、大阪市中央区日本橋2-12-27、日本橋駅から徒.en: Tabelog: Kamaage Udon Futaba, 2-12-27 Nippombashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Nippombashi Station; Tue and Thu 11:30–15:30 and 18:30–21:00, Wed 11:30–15:00, Sat 11:30–15:30; closed Mondays, Fridays and Sundays; no cards, e-money or QR; 16 seats (two tables for 4, counter 8). Reviews (April–August 2026): just outside Kuromon Market; run by Futaba Seimenjo, a noodle maker founded in 1910; the signature kamaage udon ¥680 (thin house noodles in their cooking water, lots of bonito flakes, with Yuasa shoyu and ground sesame), originally the noodle maker's staff meal; cold mentaiko raw-shoyu udon ¥830 (shiso and nori); grated-daikon udon; dashi udon; curry udon; meat udon; soba too; noodles thin, extra-thin, thick or kishimen; 1.5 portions; small rice balls; weekly rice (bamboo-shoot rice); house tenkasu and leek on the table, help yourself; clean and calm.

食べログ: 鉄板Osaka、大阪市中央区宗右衛門町6-26、大阪難波駅・なんば駅.en: Tabelog: Teppan Osaka, 6-26 Soemoncho, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 6 min walk from Osaka-Namba, Namba and Shinsaibashi stations; Mon–Sat and holidays 18:00–3:00 next morning (L.O. food 2:00, drinks 2:30); closed Sundays; reservations accepted (listed as able to accommodate allergies and vegetarians); cards and QUICPay accepted, no QR; 19 seats (counter 11, two tables for 4); opened 29 June 2020; most popular, the limited domestic Kuroge wagyu fillet steak; second, Kuroge wagyu rump roast beef; third, Hokkaido scallops and asparagus in rich butter shoyu. Reviews (May–September 2026): two women at the counter; reasonable prices; fillet with 2 sauces; Camembert fondue; white fish; A5 chateaubriand; rosemary; finished with residual heat; squid and scallop seafood yakisoba; rump roast beef; cooked slowly on the teppan and in the oven; mashed potato; opposite Queens Court; meat and fish; truffle-scented salad; starters (shrimp sashimi, roast beef, Chinese-yam kimchi, bean-sprout namul); white fish with Genovese sauce; rump and fillet; wasabi, salt, shoyu, garlic chips, truffle oil.

食べログ: 鉄板焼き Oribe、大阪市西区新町1-6-18 タカラハウス四ツ橋.en: Tabelog: Teppanyaki Oribe, Takara House Yotsubashi 1F, 1-6-18 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Yotsubashi Station exit 2; Tue–Sun 18:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:00); closed Mondays and 3rd Tuesdays (Tuesday if Monday is a holiday); reservations accepted; starter ¥550; cards (JCB, AMEX) only, no e-money or QR; 15 seats (counter 11, tables 4); no smoking; primary-school age and under, check when booking; official site. Reviews (November 2025 – August 2026): teppanyaki with French technique; à la carte served like a course; pork rillettes with red cabbage and baguette; Canadian lobster and scallop with salted-onion mousse and lobster-consommé jelly ¥3,960; wild red shrimp and snow crab with carrot mousse; cabbage steak with Gorgonzola (half available); sautéed cod milt with Shimonita leek and port-onion sauce; Black Wagyu sirloin-cap steak 100 g; wagyu tendon and garlic rice; mixed okonomiyaki to finish; chocolate cake with vanilla ice cream; portions for 2 as standard, leftovers could be taken home; run by 2 people, so dishes take time; one says the party was pressed hard to order from starter to dessert.

食べログ: 鉄板神社 道頓堀店、大阪市中央区道頓堀1-6-4 道頓堀エリカビルB.en: Tabelog: Teppan Jinja Dotonbori, Dotonbori Erika Bldg B1F, 1-6-4 Dotonbori, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 33 seats; Mon–Wed and Fri–Sun 12:00–3:00 next morning (L.O. 2:30), Thu 12:00–2:00 next morning (L.O. 1:30); smoking allowed; cards and e-money accepted; features: vegetables, fish, vegetarian menu; shop introduction: the true flavour of the ingredients, more than just yakisoba skewers, group bookings accepted. 2026 reviews (March–July): all-you-can-drink course ¥7,700; an American colleague loved it; loin steak; staff with fluent English; skewers omakase; shrimp toast; cold beer; friendly Osaka-style staff; smoking allowed; 10-skewer omakase; highballs; skewers grilled on the teppan; vegetables and meat; 2nd-floor and ground-floor counters.

食べログ: 韓湯 みっちゃん、大阪市中央区難波4-3-13 富士ビル1F、予約は.en: Tabelog: Kantan Micchan, Fuji Bldg 1F, 4-3-13 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; reservations for dinner only; Mon–Wed and Fri–Sun 11:30–15:00; closed Thursdays; no cards, e-money or QR; no cover charge; 10 seats; smoking allowed; opened 21 December 2020. 2026 reviews (June–October): Ura-Namba, behind Hotel Royal Classic Osaka; queues form; yukgaejang noodles ¥1,200 (lots of chunky meat, sweet and spicy enough to make you sweat); with seasoned egg; seared rare skirt-steak rice bowl set (small or large; even small is packed with rice); pour the soup over the leftover rice; soft-boiled egg softens the heat; thin noodles; Korean reimen too; yakiniku and à la carte at night; learned of it on Instagram.

食べログ: 頂賢麺、大阪市中央区日本橋1-7-4、日本橋駅から155m、毎日11.en: Tabelog: Chokenmen, 1-7-4 Nippombashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 155 m from Nippombashi Station; daily 11:00–2:00 next morning; irregular closing days (currently open every day of the year); no reservations; no cards or e-money; QR accepted; counter seats; opened 21 August 2017. Reviews (December 2024 – August 2026): special rich seafood tsukemen from the ticket machine outside; the owner runs it single-handed; noodle amount asked when the ticket is handed over, large at the same price; whole-wheat extra-thick noodles in a rich tonkotsu-and-seafood dipping soup; a modest owner; a big sheet of nori; rice refill ¥100; thick, tender chashu; after a show; special rich seafood tsukemen ¥1,200 (incl. tax); thick noodles like soba; the cold noodles cool the dipping soup; ticket machine cash only (change inside); black tonkotsu ramen and chashu mayo rice bowl; the owner alone at 1 a.m.; the tonkotsu ramen has very firm thin noodles and is surprisingly mild.

食べログ: 食堂RUTA、大阪市中央区南船場2-2-21 life&design.en: Tabelog: Shokudo RUTA, life&design Bldg 2F, 2-2-21 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Nagahoribashi Station; Mon–Thu 11:30–15:00 (L.O. food 13:00), Fri–Sun and holidays 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–22:00 (L.O. food 19:00); irregular closing days; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 13 seats (tables). Reviews (August–September 2026): a warm, calm wooden room on the 2nd floor of a building; run single-handed; seasonal ingredients and beautiful presentation; lunch A (soup, 3 breads, starter, pasta, dessert, after-meal drink); lunch B adds a toast drink and a main; dinner course with 2 pastas (chilled corn soup; curry-scented salmon fricassée; orecchiette of octopus, aonori and mushrooms; beef cheek braised in red wine; spaghetti of Ryukyu black pork, beetroot and Parmigiano; peach Melba); vegetables and desserts well received.

食べログ: 餃子の王将 心斎橋店、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋1-4-27、06-624.en: Tabelog: Gyoza no Ohsho Shinsaibashi, 1-4-27 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6241-9011; reservations accepted; daily 11:00–22:30; closed only over New Year; cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money and QR payment accepted; 40 seats; opened 2 November 2012; official ohsho.co.jp. 2026 reviews (June–August): self-serve water; 3 servings of garlicky gyoza; comes when craving tenshinhan; reimen in summer; right by the Shinsaibashisuji shopping street; goes with beer; Wednesday half-price gyoza coupon; gyoza with and without garlic; chukadon (light starch thickening, quail eggs, shrimp, squid, scallops, plenty of vegetables); the lively voice of what seemed to be the manager; 'Gyoza no Ohsho lunch' under ¥800; burnt-miso ramen (aroma of roasted miso, thick noodles).

食べログ: 餃子工房ちびすけ 南心斎橋店、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋2-2-10 新日.en: Tabelog: Gyoza Kobo Chibisuke Minami-Shinsaibashi, Shin-Nihon Mitsudera Bldg 1F-9, 2-2-10 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 399 m from Namba Station; 34 seats (2 tables for 2, 4 tables for 4, 3 private rooms for 4); hours 18:00–11:00; irregular closing days; reservations accepted; opened 25 October 2021. 2025–2026 reviews: cheap set meals; taste merely 'not bad'; friendly staff; a lunch crowd of inbound tourists; ginger-pork set meal ¥900; junky menu, cheap and fast; shiso gyoza; gyoza and tantanmen; Jiro-style ramen ¥1,100 (rich miso on a tonkotsu base, slightly thick flat straight high-hydration noodles, pork belly, cabbage, bean sprouts); smoking allowed inside; Osaka gyoza (sauce, mayo, leek, bonito flakes); garlic gyoza; dashimaki omelette; shrimp chili mayo; weekday afternoons mostly overseas diners; open late, good for a second stop.

食べログ: 香吾芽、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-6-5 エイトワンビル 1F、日本橋.en: Tabelog: Kagome, Eight One Bldg 1F, 2-6-5 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 437 m from Nippombashi Station; Mon–Sat 18:00–1:30 next morning; closed Sundays and holidays; no cards, e-money or QR; 12 counter seats; no smoking. Reviews (January–July 2026): thin-noodle curry udon with the dashi as the star; north across Aioibashi, just before Yawata-suji; a clean glass-fronted shop; counter only; run by two people; kizami curry udon ¥1,200; kayaku rice ¥350; tempura curry udon; busy with families and regulars at 18:30 on a weekday; a light curry and extra-thin noodles; good beef; the last stop after drinking; more overseas diners now; first time in 5 years; kizami udon; gentle; curry udon ¥1,100; sudachi udon; egg-drop nyumen.

食べログ: 馬肉専門店 喜心、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-15-11 日宝周防町エレ.en: Tabelog: Basashi Senmonten Kigokoro, Nippo Suomachi Elegance Bldg 1F, 1-15-11 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station, 343 m from Nagahoribashi; Mon–Sat 18:00–24:00 (L.O. 23:00); closed Sundays; bookings cancelled 10 minutes after the time; parties of 2 may be seated at the counter; smoking allowed, so no entry under 20; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 20 seats; opened 1 July 2020. Reviews (January 2025 – June 2026): sakura yukhoe; 5-kind horse sashimi platter; soba to finish the horse shabu; bought direct from producers; horse-shabu salad; zosui; sweet-potato ice cream; with all-you-can-drink; visits almost monthly; dashi shabu; thick, soft soba; squid shiokara; booking essential Fri–Sat; 7-kind horse sashimi (adds heart and tongue); horse tsukune; tsuke soba; horse-meat nyumen; saiboshi; miso-pickled tofu; horse-meat gyoza; no gamey smell; a noren at the back of the building; carpaccio salad; yukhoe rice bowl; clean; kind staff; horse salami; sushi platter; horse yakiniku; koune; Kumamoto hitomoji guruguru; horse tataki; thigh, heart, tongue, fillet, futaego, loin, mane fat; 5-skewer platter with salt or sauce by cut.

食べログ: 魁力屋 イオンモール大阪ドームシティ店、大阪市西区千代崎3-13-1.en: Tabelog: Kairikiya Aeon Mall Osaka Dome City, Aeon Mall Osaka Dome City 4F, 3-13-1 Chiyozaki, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Dome-mae Station; daily 10:00–21:00; opened 11 December 2020; cards and e-money accepted, no QR; food court; kids' menu; official site. Reviews (August–September 2026): a ramen chain born in Kitashirakawa, Kyoto; Kyoto back-fat shoyu ramen; seasoned-egg ramen ¥1,001; extra back fat; thin straight noodles; chashu, leek, menma; tonkotsu shoyu; fried rice and karaage set; fast service; lighter than it looks; half-price fried rice via the app; one found the soup lukewarm; good before a game at Kyocera Dome too.

食べログ: 魚屋 UOTACHI、大阪市西区新町3-9-7 塚口ビル 1F、西長.en: Tabelog: Sakanaya UOTACHI, Tsukaguchi Bldg 1F, 3-9-7 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Nishi-Nagahori and Awaza stations; Mon, Tue, Thu and holidays 11:30–15:00 (L.O. 14:00) and 16:30–20:00 (L.O. 19:15), Fri–Sun 11:30–15:00 and 16:30–21:30 (L.O. 20:30); closed Wednesdays and 1st and 3rd Tuesdays; closes early if no diners after last order; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 15 seats (counter 9, tables 6). Reviews (November 2024 – August 2026): a counter at the back of a fishmonger; lunch comes with 2 small dishes, fish soup and dessert; daily sashimi bowls and the Hokkaido bowl (salmon, ikura, scallop, crab) ¥1,400; seafood bowl (¥1,200 in 2024; large rice +¥200); 8 nigiri on red-vinegar rice (¥1,300 in 2024; bluefin tuna, salmon, houbou, sea bass and more); sashimi set meal; UOTACHI Taiyori Don; plenty of fish dishes at night; bento, fresh fish and deli items to take away.

食べログ: 魚菜屋 常峰、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-14-23 住吉ビル2F、心斎.en: Tabelog: Sakanaya Tsunemine, Sumiyoshi Bldg 2F, 1-14-23 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 4 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station, 5 from Nagahoribashi Station; Mon–Sat 17:00–24:00; closed Sundays; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 12 seats; smoking allowed; official site. Reviews (January 2025 – September 2026): sashimi platter; salt pork with miso; sukiyaki-style spring rolls; karasumi; pork ponzu; beef tataki ponzu; fruit tomatoes; dashimaki; sashimi platter with fugu; a heap of crab meat; course of pink-tagged crab with crab miso; ume-shiso white-fish tempura; grilled yellowtail collar; fried shrimp; beef steak; anglerfish hot pot; burdock tempura; broccoli namul; plenty of sake; baby-corn tempura fried in the husk; whiskies such as Yamazaki, Chita and Macallan; hamo hot pot; eel kabayaki; shrimp mayo; stuffed fried lotus root; sukiyaki with udon to finish; 6 counter seats and 4 tables; booking recommended; calm; a friendly manager; about ¥7,000–10,000 each.

食べログ: 魚重、大阪市中央区西心斎橋1-4-17 シゲタニビル 1F、心斎橋か.en: Tabelog: Uoshige, Shigetani Bldg 1F, 1-4-17 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 250 m from Shinsaibashi; Tue–Sat 11:30–20:00; closed Mondays, Sundays and holidays (holidays closed since November 2019); no cards, e-money or QR; 6 counter seats. Reviews (April–October 2026): a tekka-don specialist; 7 slices ¥900; 7 slices with large rice ¥1,000; 10 slices ¥1,100; 10 slices with large rice ¥1,200; a regular of 27 years; at the back of a building; 3 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station exit 7; a wooden counter; red miso soup (wakame); pickles (shibazuke, lightly pickled napa cabbage); shredded nori on warm rice; 10 slices of marinated lean tuna; quail egg yolk and wasabi; a secret sauce; sesame aroma; chutoro tekka-don on Thursdays and Fridays; full from opening but quick turnover, in within about 15 minutes; comes with the sauce on; one found the sauce strong and saltyish; softish rice; clean; pleasant service; run by two people; ends when sold out, so go early.

食べログ: 鮨 Shizuku 心斎橋、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-1-27 周防町.en: Tabelog: Sushi Shizuku Shinsaibashi, Suomachi Wings 1F, 2-1-27 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min west of Nagahoribashi along Suomachi-dori (Europe-dori); Mon, Tue and Thu–Sun 18:00–23:00 (first sitting 18:00–20:30, second 21:00–23:00); closed Wednesdays; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 10 seats (counter 6, one table for 4); opened 27 July 2016; official sushi-shizuku.com; The Tabelog Award 2025 and 2026 Bronze; Tabelog Sushi WEST Hyakumeiten 2021, 2022 and 2025. Reviews (September–October 2026): creative sushi, not Edomae; house sauces and condiments for each topping; hidden knife cuts; aubergine, green pepper and sweet shrimp; flounder; red sea bream; aori squid topped with sea urchin; Beni Haruka chawanmushi; charcoal-grilled mackerel; bonito pickled in shuto; akamutsu; chutoro; lean tuna; sardine; anago nori roll; new-season kanten jelly; hard to book; a year's wait; salt-grilled cutlassfish; grouper; sea bream and water-spinach hot pot; Kanazawa mackerel sushi; toro-taku roll; pear; Amakusa (Kumamoto) kuruma prawn grilled with karasumi; yuzu sea bream; course ¥22,000; one found ¥40,000 in total with a ¥10,000 sea-urchin hand roll expensive; 6 counter seats; toro-taku and 'grown-up shrimp mayo'; one says extras weren't explained well.

食べログ: 鮨 あまと 裏難波、大阪市中央区日本橋1-19-6 福喜ビル 2F、.en: Tabelog: Sushi Amato Ura Nanba, Fukki Bldg 2F, 1-19-6 Nippombashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Nippombashi Station, 7 from Midosuji Line Namba Station; daily 12:00–14:00 (L.O. food 13:00, drinks 13:45) and 16:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); 10% service charge from 1 July 2026; cards, e-money and QR (including Alipay and WeChat Pay) accepted; 15 counter seats; opened 7 July 2025; official site. October 2026 reviews: near Kuromon Market; the second shop of Sushi Amato; a hinoki counter; aged Edomae sushi; lunch Tensho omakase 10 pieces ¥4,500 (shijimi soup, otoro, kombu-cured sea bream aged 6 days with sudachi salt, aged salmon, horse mackerel, scallop, marinated bluefin tuna, ponzu chawanmushi, squid, yellowtail aged 5 days, ikura, eel, red miso soup, unlimited oolong and green tea); Tensho omakase 15 pieces ¥6,800; the exclusive Ten Sho [Goku] omakase 15 pieces ¥8,300 (otoro and chutoro, kinmedai, kinki, kombu sweet shrimp, snow crab, sea urchin, toro-taku roll, dessert); red-vinegar rice; slightly firm rice; Mimuro Sugi sake; lunch is popular, booking recommended.

食べログ: 鮨 かぜのぎ、大阪市中央区南船場3-8-2、長堀橋駅から徒歩5分、心.en: Tabelog: Sushi Kazenogi, 3-8-2 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Nagahoribashi Station, 5–8 from Shinsaibashi and Hommachi stations; daily two sittings 18:00–20:00 and 21:00–23:30; irregular closing days and New Year; no cards, e-money or QR; 6 counter seats. Reviews (February–September 2026): omakase ¥28,000 (February 2026); starters (young bamboo shoot and wakame); ankimo; Miyazaki beef spring roll; flounder sashimi; house half-dried karasumi; otoro with ikura and egg yolk; sea urchin with caviar and honey; cod-roe cream chawanmushi; red miso soup; hojicha ice cream; nigiri (sea bream, scallop, shimaaji, otoro, kuruma prawn, fugu milt, charcoal-seared saba bozushi, anago, tamago, otoro topped with sea urchin); to finish, sea urchin and gold leaf on the back of your hand, without gold leaf if preferred; draught beer ¥1,000; Kyoto highball ¥1,500; a quiet shop; slightly soft rice; courteous, friendly hospitality.

食べログ: 鮨 よつ葉、大阪市西区北堀江1-15-9 輝栄ビル 1F、四ツ橋駅6.en: Tabelog: Sushi Yotsuba, Kiei Bldg 1F, 1-15-9 Kita-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Yotsubashi Station exit 6; Tue–Sun 18:00–23:00 (last entry 20:30); closed Mondays; irregular closures on weekends, with lunch from 12:00 and 12:30; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX) accepted, no e-money or QR; 8 seats. Reviews (August–October 2026): same group as Sushi Shinnosuke and Homura in Sakaisuji-Hommachi; Edomae nigiri; book any time you like; lunch omakase nigiri ¥6,600 with chawanmushi; careful knife work; a wall of wine cellars; sake and wine; clean and refined; a friendly counter; one found the rice a little dry and the chawanmushi underwhelming; good value.

食べログ: 鮨 樋口、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-4-30 グランドジャニスビル 1.en: Tabelog: Sushi Higuchi, Grand Janis Bldg 1F, 2-4-30 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Nagahoribashi Station, 5 from Shinsaibashi and Nippombashi stations; Mon–Wed, Fri and Sat 17:00–22:30 (L.O. 22:00, last entry 20:30); closed Thursdays and Sundays; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 8 counter seats; opened 17 July 2009; Tabelog Sushi WEST Hyakumeiten 2022. Reviews (July 2023 – September 2026): 17th year; long-time regulars; 'Higuchi Theatre'; not wedded to Edomae; no course, order what you like; no fixed start time; non-drinkers can enjoy plenty of sushi too; sashimi and small dishes; good value; a pleasant, attentive owner; small bowls; grilled fish; small dishes and sake; a memorable shiitake nigiri; eel with crisp skin; flounder and striped-jack collar; Harushika; an unpretentious atmosphere; one calls the owner lively; book any time you like; softly pressed rice that sinks under the topping's weight; sake chosen by the owner; same-day phone bookings; choose from the small bowls on view; choose how it's grilled too.

食べログ: 鮨 滉心、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-17-5 東心斎橋ブルースタービル.en: Tabelog: Sushi Koshin, Higashi-Shinsaibashi Blue Star Bldg 3F, 1-17-5 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 4 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station; daily 17:30–22:00 (first sitting 17:30–19:30, second 20:00–22:00); cards (VISA, Master, JCB) accepted, no e-money or QR; 8 counter seats; private hire possible (up to 20); opened 5 January 2026. October 2026 reviews: an 881 Group shop; omakase ¥4,400 only; all-you-can-drink +¥2,200 (up to 2 bottles of Sapporo Lager Akaboshi); snapping-turtle soup with mitsuba; bonito tataki with Ishigaki salt and pickled shima rakkyo; mackerel aged 4 days; kombu-cured sea bass; water octopus with suckers; marinated tuna; vinegared sardine; nodoguro; mackerel bo-zushi; barracuda; sea bream with grated-daikon sauce; tuna and herring-roe hand roll; steamed anago; kanpyo roll; omelette; toro-taku roll; a seafood salt ramen to finish, in large, medium or small; up the emergency stairs from the 2nd floor to the 3rd; an unsigned door; good value; surprises accommodated; lively and casual.

食べログ: 鮨し禅、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-14-15 アルスビル 4F、心斎橋.en: Tabelog: Sushi Zen, Ars Bldg 4F, 1-14-15 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station; daily two sittings from 18:00 and 20:30 (until 23:00); lunch from 12:00 on weekends and holidays; irregular closing days; book by the day before; 5% service charge; cards, e-money and QR (including Alipay and WeChat Pay) accepted; 10 counter seats; opened 18 November 2025. Reviews (November 2025 – October 2026): course ¥18,000 including alcohol or soft drinks; sea bream aged 4 days and bonito sashimi; house sesame tofu; carbonara-style chawanmushi with mascarpone; yuba and fresh cream; Densuke anago shabu-shabu; Saikyo-grilled aburabouzu; abalone with liver sauce; chutoro; marinated bluefin tuna; otoro; kombu-cured kisu; sweet shrimp; sea-urchin bowl of purple and bafun urchin; toro-taku; fried mehikari roll; eel; milk pudding; red-vinegar rice; tuna from Teramoto Shoten in Osaka; a calm counter; well-paced dishes and attentiveness.

食べログ: 鮨朗、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-7-14 NIPPO心斎橋トライアンフ.en: Tabelog: Sushi Rou, NIPPO Shinsaibashi Triumph 1F, 2-7-14 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 7 min walk from Shinsaibashi and Namba stations; daily 17:00–24:00 (L.O. 22:30); reservations accepted (mention allergies and preferences when booking; everyone starts together, so be punctual); cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 7 seats (counter only); no smoking; opened 14 June 2025; a calm black-toned shop; children welcome; reasonably priced drinks; a creative sushi course by a young taisho, 'brighter and freer'. September 2026 reviews: good creative dishes; seasonal omakase course ¥12,500; the shop name takes one character from the taisho's name; aged tuna (lean, 13 days); aged sea bream; sawara; red sea bream; rare-fried hamo; striped jack; short-farmed tuna from Oki, Shimane; cola or green tea ¥400; rare-fried eel sandwich; striped jack aged 4 days; firm rice; run single-handed; some French-like dishes; Oki chutoro aged 7 days.

食べログ: 鰻師玄斎、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-1-14 ZOOMビル 2F、長堀.en: Tabelog: Unagi Shi Gensai, ZOOM Bldg 2F, 2-1-14 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Nagahoribashi, 7 from Nippombashi, 10 from Shinsaibashi and Namba; daily 12:00–21:00 (L.O. food 20:00, drinks 20:30); mention allergies in advance; cards (including UnionPay), transit IC, e-money and QR (including Alipay and WeChat Pay) accepted; 8 counter seats; opened 31 August 2026. Reviews (September–October 2026): toro and eel nigiri; hand rolls; live eel filleted in the shop; full from lunch to night; red-vinegar rice; 3-piece sushi; eel rice bowl ¥4,800; shirayaki like potato chips; fresh kimchi; fluffy kabayaki; the rice sauce is separate from the eel sauce; female eels; not steamed, grilled the house way, crisp skin and juicy inside; Kansai style; eel shabu-shabu; phoned 4 days ahead to add sushi; Irish tuna; ¥7,700 course (yuba tofu, 2 pieces eel shabu, 2 crisp shirayaki, 2 kabayaki, bettarazuke, fresh kimchi, unaju with a whole eel, liver soup); fierce heat; premium course ¥9,900; sesame tofu with fresh cream and yuba; 3 kinds of sansho; Yamagata Tsuyahime rice; one found the liver soup a little salty; friendly staff.

食べログ: 鳥しん、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-4-19 玉屋町ギャラクシービル3号.en: Tabelog: Tori Shin, Tamayacho Galaxy Bldg No. 3 1F, 2-4-19 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 7 min walk from Midosuji Line Shinsaibashi and Namba stations, 5 min from Nippombashi Station, 393 m from Nagahoribashi; Mon–Sat and days before and after holidays 18:00–24:00 (from 17:00 for bookings); closed Sundays and holidays; may close when ingredients run out; 2 hour 30 minute limit when busy; online bookings confirmed by phone; 3-item starter ¥660; cards (including UnionPay), QUICPay and QR accepted; 19 seats (counter 7, tables 12); opened 10 October 2007. Reviews (September 2025 – October 2026): hot pots full of chicken umami; rice or noodles to finish; reliable yakitori too; the hot-pot soup comes solid and turns rich as it melts; fried gizzards; pleasant service; the popular Hakata mizutaki by reservation; a rich paitan; 5 kinds of sashimi with no off-smell; salt skewers; tsukimi tsukune with egg yolk; yuzu-kosho and ponzu; two people were stuffed; a hideaway at the end of an alley; collagen hot pot; popular and hard to get into; big dishes; tulip; zosui; got a same-day booking; tataki; grilled rice balls; fast service; loud staff.

食べログ: 鳳凰楼、大阪市中央区千日前1-8-6 シンズ千日前ビル1F、28席、.en: Tabelog: Hooro, Shins Sennichimae Bldg 1F, 1-8-6 Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 28 seats; Mon–Sat 17:00–5:00 next morning (L.O. 4:30), Sun and holidays 17:00–3:00 next morning (L.O. 2:30); closed 2nd and 3rd Mondays; reservations by phone; no cards or e-money; QR payment accepted; smoking allowed; genre Chinese, gyoza, knife-cut noodles. Reviews (December 2023 – July 2026): a neighbourhood Chinese diner; gyoza; all-you-can-eat ¥3,500 (December 2023); many Chinese diners; nira and liver set meal; a Chinese-language menu; lots of delivery orders; adjustable heat; a back alley off the Aioibashi-suji shopping street; seafood ramen ¥900 (salt); gomoku noodle soup ¥800; karaage; spare ribs; stir-fried water spinach; large prawns in chili sauce; Japanese hard to get across; mapo tofu set meal (cabbage and zha cai); chili oil and black vinegar.

食べログ: 鴻翔、大阪市中央区島之内1-21-32 田舎ビル1F、堺筋線長堀橋駅.en: Tabelog: Koushou, Inaka Bldg 1F, 1-21-32 Shimanouchi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 30 m east of Sakaisuji Line Nagahoribashi Station; Mon–Fri 11:30–15:00 (L.O. 14:30) and 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:00); closed weekends and holidays; no cards or e-money; 24 seats (counter 4, five tables for 4); smoking allowed (lunch only). Reviews (May 2025 – October 2026): one person working at lunch, so it takes time; Sichuan tantanmen; Sichuan pepper; full at lunch; karaage and mapo tofu set meals in summer; the signature is white-sesame tantanmen; closed weekends; gyoza at night; menma; the mapo tofu is thick and oily, mild in heat and strongly numbing; under ¥1,000; nira; hot inside; bok choy stir-fried with ginger; a friendly owner; previous diners' dishes left on tables; yu lin chicken ¥850, freshly fried; large portions; large rice free; citrus sauce; cash only; Sichuan-style mapo; the soup a little salty.

食べログ: 鶏soba 座銀 本店、大阪市西区江戸堀1-19-2、四つ橋線肥後橋.en: Tabelog: Tori Soba Zagin main shop, 1-19-2 Edobori, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Yotsubashi Line Higobashi Station exit 8; daily 10:30–22:30 (L.O. 22:00); welcome even just before closing; closed 30 December – 3 January; no cards, e-money or QR; 12 counter seats; opened 26 May 2014; official silver-grape.com; Tabelog Ramen Hyakumeiten (WEST 2020–2022, OSAKA 2023–2025). Reviews (January–October 2026): a rich dipping soup for the chicken tsukesoba; one says the fried burdock is gone, another that it's there; an 11-visit regular's favourite ramen in Osaka; 2 kinds of chashu; salt tori paitan; one found the shoyu salty and the toppings and service worse than before; one says the bok choy dilutes the rich salt; over ¥1,000; 1 person waiting before 18:00; served in 7–8 minutes; chicken and pork chashu; queues from before noon; ticket machine at the entrance; staff guide the queue; polite language from the kitchen; a frothed creamy soup; the fried burdock goes from crisp to soft as it soaks; chicken salt soba ¥1,000; large +¥150; counter only; collect your bowl from the high counter; thin noodles; frothed just before serving; 2 slices of low-temperature chashu; tori soba shoyu ¥1,000; just-right saltiness.

食べログ: 鶏soba 鶏と麺、大阪市大正区三軒家東1-18-9 2F、大正から.en: Tabelog: Tori Soba Tori to Men, 2F, 1-18-9 Sangenya-higashi, Taisho-ku, Osaka; 193 m from Taisho; daily 11:00–14:00 and 17:00–2:00 next morning; irregular closing days; no cards, e-money or QR; opened 4 August 2023. Reviews (July 2025 – September 2026): special yuzu-salt chicken ramen ¥1,100; tori soba RED ¥950 (extra heat +¥50); chicken maze-soba ¥1,100; mini chashu rice bowl large ¥550; Akaboshi ¥660; maze-soba with lots of garlic; shredded chicken chashu; 6 waiting on the stairs; after a game at Kyocera Dome; the limited tori paitan sold out; tori soba BLACK ¥950 (garlic and black pepper); regular tori soba ¥900; D set with chicken chazuke ¥550; a light, easy soup; chicken bones; yuzu; yellow noodles rich in egg; self-serve water; one likens it to the nabeyaki ramen of Susaki, Kochi; a shoyu of old-hen bones boiled for hours; a tare of Kochi and Osaka shoyu; served piping hot; medium-thin straight noodles; one found the yuzu too strong; white pepper on the table; the tori-paitan versions with yuzu peel, chicken chashu and crunchy chicken; 2nd floor; Korean-style reimen ¥1,000 (kimchi, egg, chashu); cash only.

食べログ: 鶏か鶏以外か、大阪市大正区三軒家東1-17-20 秋月館ビル 1F、.en: Tabelog: Tori ka Tori Igai ka, Akizuki-kan Bldg 1F, 1-17-20 Sangenya-higashi, Taisho-ku, Osaka; 117 m from Taisho; Mon and Thu–Sun 11:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:45) and 18:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30), Tue 11:00–15:00; closed Wednesdays; no cards or e-money; PayPay accepted; 7 counter seats; opened 17 September 2024. Reviews (December 2024 – October 2026): an anniversary ramen each year; mixed rice; two lines, tori paitan and chuka soba; coupons for registering on LINE; salt ramen; 2 kinds of chashu including rare; radish sprouts; a creamy chicken soup; thin noodles; bright and clean; one calls it the first tori paitan in Taisho; summer cold editions (cold sea-bream and hamaguri salt, cold grated-yam shoyu); the cold lunch sold out; spicy tori paitan; frothed tori paitan; rare pork-shoulder chashu and another roast pork; seasoned egg; maze-soba (limited); extra-meat tori paitan ¥1,200; mini rice ¥100; noodle refill ¥150; free takana and spicy mentaiko with rice; grilled pork-belly chashu; one found the refill salty; 6 waiting before 20:00 in August; cold salt ¥1,300 with tempura; cold shoyu with grated yam ¥1,000; cartilage tsukune ¥200; rare chashu rice bowl ¥400 (egg yolk); pork-belly chashu rice bowl ¥450; the shoyu is strongly shoyu; one found the savoury-spicy ramen salty.

食べログ: 鶏と牛のお店 火澄屋、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-4-1 オリエンタル東.en: Tabelog: Tori to Gyu no Omise Kasumiya, Oriental Higashi-Shinsaibashi Bldg 1F (107), 1-4-1 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; a restaurant building right by Nagahoribashi Station exit 7; Mon–Fri 12:00–14:00 and 17:30–24:00, Sat 17:30–24:00; closed Sundays and holidays; may not answer the phone 15:00–18:00; starter ¥500; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; smoking allowed; 20 seats; semi-private rooms; Instagram. Reviews (October 2023 – June 2026): a hidden shop at the back of the building; semi-private rooms with a folk-tale feel; lunch set meals about ¥1,000 (karaage with tartare, karaage and offal, fish set meal with many sides); one says the karaage batter got thinner and better; in March 2025 curry only from ¥600 (free raw egg); chicken and beef tongue with drinks at night; small tables; cigarette smoke.

食べログ: 鶏に恋した日 寺田町店、大阪市生野区生野西2-1-37、JR寺田町駅.en: Tabelog: Tori ni Koishita Hi Teradacho, 2-1-37 Ikuno-nishi, Ikuno-ku, Osaka; 30 seconds from JR Teradacho Station north exit; daily 10:30–15:00 (L.O. 14:45) and 17:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:45); irregular closing days; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 26 seats (ground-floor counter 10, tables upstairs); opened 1 April 2023; official site. Reviews (January–September 2026): a tori-paitan specialist; a thick, rich tori paitan (shoyu-based); thin noodles; 4 slices of house rare chashu; special tori-paitan miso ramen ¥1,200 (heat and depth, chewy medium-thick noodles); tori-paitan tsukemen 200 g ¥1,000, 300 g ¥1,100 (thick noodles, big rare chashu, radish sprouts, yuzu); summer cold editions ¥1,000 (light shellfish-dashi cold ramen; refreshing cold ramen of niboshi and kombu with chicken-fat salt; shellfish-dashi cold tsukemen, 20 a day); yuzu-kosho; niboshi vinegar on the table; karaage; fried rice; ticket machine; limited items can be ordered verbally; a new, clean shop; one found portions smallish.

食べログ: 鶏や 梅の湯、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-13-10、心斎橋駅5番出口か.en: Tabelog: Toriya Ume no Yu, 1-13-10 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station exit 5; opposite a primary school's main gate; daily 18:00–23:00 (closes when sold out); irregular closing days (announced on Instagram); cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 17 counter seats; 1 November 2006. Reviews (June 2025 – May 2026): formerly a horse-meat restaurant, reopened as a yakitori shop; a public-bath theme; Showa kayokyoku; omakase yakitori set ¥2,800 (starter, 3 small dishes, 4 skewers; book ahead); Ume no Yu course ¥4,500 (8 skewers, a dish, small dish, salad, main, mini curry); 6-skewer platter; Kyoto Akadori thigh, breast, gizzard, neck; bone-in wings with rock salt; tsukune; negima; liver sashimi ¥660; Kyoto Akadori tataki ¥1,100; fried tomato with mascarpone; mozuku; potato salad; Camembert; Tochio aburage with ginger shoyu; plenty of shochu; some skewers sell out, booking recommended.

食べログ: 鶏ガラ醤油らーめん じゅうじせい、大阪市中央区南本町3-3-10、本.en: Tabelog: Torigara Shoyu Ramen Juujisei, 3-3-10 Minamihommachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 292 m from Hommachi Station; Mon–Fri 11:00–15:00 and 19:00–0:30 next morning, Sun 11:30–15:00 and 19:00–24:00; closed Saturdays; listed as no cards, e-money or QR; opened 5 January 2023. Reviews (August–September 2026): cold salt-shoyu ramen with lemon-juice pickles ¥800; thin straight noodles; pickled onion; prosciutto; black pepper; fried rice; white-shoyu tuna-flake ramen ¥1,030; a light shoyu of chicken bones and niboshi with bonito flakes; medium-thin straight noodles; wood-ear; leek; bean sprouts; karaage and half fried rice set ¥600; yuzu ramen; extra meat and seasoned egg; alone at 22:30; counter only; one says cards and phone payment worked at the ticket machine; add bonito flakes partway to change the flavour; not a big portion; deep chicken-bone flavour; balanced shoyu.

食べログ: 鶏白湯 大翔軒、大阪市中央区難波4-5-7、070-1736-143.en: Tabelog: Tori Paitan Daishoken, 4-5-7 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 070-1736-1434; no reservations; Tue–Sun 11:30–14:00 and 18:00–2:00 next morning; closed Mondays; no cards, e-money or QR; opened 1 April 2026. 2026 reviews (September–October): a street stall in a car park in Ura-Namba; tables and chairs in front of a kitchen car; at the back of a car park under the elevated tracks; garlic shoyu tori paitan ¥1,200; extra chashu ¥500; maze-soba ¥1,200; seared chashu rice bowl ¥1,200; shoyu tori paitan ¥1,200; rich shoyu tori paitan (thick and smooth, with a clean finish); medium-thick wavy noodles; kimchi, chopped onion, vinegar and sesame on the table; a soup of hamaguri broth; shoyu tori paitan A set ¥1,350; shellfish-broth tori paitan ¥1,200; sweetish rare chashu; leek; mizuna; many regulars; open until 2 a.m.

食べログ: 鶏白湯らーめん 自由が丘蔭山 あべのＱ'sモール店、大阪市阿倍野区阿.en: Tabelog: Tori Paitan Ramen Jiyugaoka Kageyama Abeno Q's Mall, Abeno Q's Mall 4F, 1-6-1 Abenosuji, Abeno-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Tennoji Station exit 12; daily 11:00–23:00; closing days follow Q's Mall; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 27 seats; opened 18 May 2017; official site. Reviews (October 2025 – October 2026): tori-paitan salt soba; rich and creamy yet light; chicken aroma; medium-thick noodles; squeeze lemon halfway; yuzu at the bottom; rice into the soup to finish; the special adds vegetables, wontons, soft-boiled egg, chicken chashu, chili, greens and onion chips; lunch set until 17:00 (half ramen with Sichuan-style mapo tofu or yu lin chicken); good-value evening set (mapo rice bowl); two found the mapo tofu salty; one found it underwhelming overall; queues at holiday lunch; families and large groups too.

食べログ: 鶏白湯らーめん 麺はともあれ、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋2-7-11 日宝.en: Tabelog: Tori Paitan Ramen Men wa Tomoare, Nippo Royal Bldg, 2-7-11 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-4708-8884; 9 seats; Mon–Fri 16:00–2:30 next morning, Sat 11:00–2:30 next morning, Sun 11:00–23:00; irregular closing days; no smoking; cards and e-money accepted; opened 22 December 2022. Shop introduction: an espuma-style soup and medium-thin flat noodles, several kinds of tori-paitan ramen, rice dishes, snacks. 2026 reviews: two groups waiting even at 10 p.m.; book at the machine in front; one says it lacks character; queued Saturday 16:45, seated 19:10; order first by QR code; 5 counter seats and one table; slow turnover; a faint smell when served; chewy flat noodles; cash only (June 2026); mentaiko tori paitan; a foamy mousse-like soup; pork chashu and soft-boiled egg; no sign on the street; ground floor of a multi-tenant building; Instagram @men_wa_tomoare; special tori-paitan ramen ¥1,705 (seasoned egg, chicken chashu, pork chashu, red onion, wood-ear); chicken umami lifted by shoyu; seasoned-egg rice.

食べログ: 鹿肉料理専門店 バトックス、大阪市中央区千日前1-4-19 中島ビル.en: Tabelog: Buttocks venison specialist, Nakajima Bldg 1F, 1-4-19 Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; Aioibashi-suji shopping street; 5 min walk from Namba Station; Mon–Sat and holidays 11:00–14:00 and 18:00–4:00 next morning, Sun 18:00–4:00 next morning (L.O. food 3:00, drinks 4:00); open every day of the year; starter/service charge ¥500 at dinner; 20 seats; private room upstairs for groups from 5; children welcome; cards, e-money and QR accepted; separate smoking. Reviews (November 2025 – October 2026): a venison specialist; several say no gamey smell and tender; venison lunch course ¥2,500 (venison cutlet, low-temperature roast, venison fried rice); venison bread (garlic toast with roast venison); venison rillettes; rillettes potato salad; carpaccio; roast eaten with salt, fried onion and sauce; pleat-less fried venison gyoza; venison maze-soba with choice of heat; carbonara; venison yaki-shabu course of 7 dishes by reservation ¥7,500; one says the cuts weren't explained; one says the wine was poured generously.

食べログ: 麓鳴館、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋1-3-12、心斎橋から206m、毎日1.en: Tabelog: Rokumeikan, 1-3-12 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 206 m from Shinsaibashi; daily 14:00–19:00 (subject to change); no cards, e-money or QR; 19 seats. Reviews (November 2025 – September 2026): a nostalgic kissaten down an alley off Shinsaibashisuji; a calm, old-fashioned interior; big speakers beside the counter; cute cups; carefully brewed coffee; Rokumeikan curry ¥1,200 (European-style, tangy with faint heat, a whole potato, soft-boiled egg, sausage, knife, fork and spoon); one found the potato cold inside; over ¥1,800 with coffee; booth seats are largely self-service; one says it was a bar from 21:00 in November 2025; given two pages in a book on Osaka kissaten.

食べログ: 麺LABO 唯奏、大阪市西区江之子島1-6-2、阿波座から220m、.en: Tabelog: Men LABO Yuisou, 1-6-2 Enokojima, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 220 m from Awaza; daily 11:00–14:30 and 17:00–21:30 (L.O. 20:30); irregular closing days; reservations accepted; cards, e-money and QR accepted; opened 1 September 2022. Reviews (August–October 2026): mobile ordering; egg-on maze-soba ¥800; 2 egg yolks; a rich sauce heavy on seafood; flat medium-thick noodles; boiled firm; self-serve water; limited cold sea bream; north of Nishi Post Office; an udon shop nearby; a small, clean shop; order and pay by QR; rich chicken-pork ramen ¥950; thin or medium-thick wavy noodles; a clear, smooth soup that isn't greasy; thin-sliced pork; ¥1,150 with leek rice; log in with Apple or LINE; cash also OK; past limited editions (chicken salt, cold sea-bream salt soba, sea-bream dashi salt and shoyu, cold kombu water, noodles with Matsusaka beef fat); light chicken ramen ¥900; plenty of thin-sliced chashu; the pork comes through in the chashu, the soup is mainly chicken; straight or hand-rubbed noodles; rich tsukemen with seasoned egg; hand-rubbed noodles.

食べログ: 麺joyLife、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-7-22 日宝シルキータワ.en: Tabelog: Men joyLife, Nippo Silky Tower 1F No. 6, 2-7-22 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 10 seats; daily 20:00–8:00 next morning; open every day of the year (long holidays announced on social media); no smoking; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; opened 24 March 2023; TikTok @men_joylife. Shop introduction: carefully made soup and house-made noodles; limited-edition ramen. 2024–2026 reviews: counter only; dark shoyu (chicken bones and bonito flakes, thin straight noodles, chicken fat); cold shellfish broth (clams, oysters, hamaguri; flat medium-thin noodles); Japanese-style maze-soba (oil of clams, oysters and shijimi); shellfish-broth ramen from ¥1,000; seared rare chashu rice bowl ¥400; ticket machine inside on the left; chicken bones with clams, shijimi and oysters; gentle flavour; house-made medium-thin straight noodles; rare shoulder-loin chashu; mizuna; menma; new onion; shredded white leek; mayo chashu rice bowl; special shellfish broth ¥1,300 (whole-wheat noodles, pork-belly chashu, soft-boiled egg, red onion); next to a club; one would not recommend the sudachi rice; shoyu and dark shoyu too.

食べログ: 麺とかき氷 ドギャン 谷四店、大阪市中央区谷町4-9-11、谷町四丁.en: Tabelog: Men to Kakigori Dogyan Taniyon, 4-9-11 Tanimachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min south of Tanimachi-Yonchome Station exit 8; on the corner of the Tanimachi 5 crossing; Mon, Thu and Fri 11:30–16:00 and 18:00–21:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 11:30–20:00; closed Tuesdays and Wednesdays; temporary closures on Instagram; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; 18 seats. Reviews (July 2025 – October 2026): a shop decorated with anime-film merchandise; seasonal cold ramen (blue-soup Yozora no Mukou gawa ¥1,200; cold corn ramen of corn and fresh cream on a salt-and-scallop base ¥1,650; white and black figs with cheese sauce; karaage); maze-soba with mayonnaise, chili oil and kombu vinegar to change the flavour; offal maze-soba; kakigori loaded with seasonal fruit (peach, fig, chestnut Mont Blanc piped in front of you, açaí); character kakigori; QR ordering; one item per person; book via Instagram; one says the combinations divide opinion.

食べログ: 麺と旨みの神隠し、大阪市中央区難波1-8-16 ナンバヒップス B1.en: Tabelog: Men to Umami no Kamikakushi, Namba Hips B1F, 1-8-16 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; daily 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–22:00; no reservations; listed as no cards, e-money or QR payment; no smoking; opened 28 December 2024. 2026 reviews: fully cashless (card and PayPay only; some couldn't pay in cash); handy when changing between OCAT and Nankai; tonkotsu ramen with tender chashu; a stylish counter; umami miso tonkotsu ¥1,550 (tang of pickled onion); back-fat shoyu ¥1,350 (black pepper, lighter than it looks); softish noodles divide opinion; large +¥150; tsukimi chashu rice bowl with special sauce ¥500; tastes like oden with daikon and konnyaku; drinks are alcohol only; in front of a pachinko parlour; one person working alone, called curt by some and kind by others; no toilet nearby; a counter along the corridor; one big slice of chashu; thin noodles; menma, pork, leek.

食べログ: 麺と無限の可能性 日本橋本店、大阪市中央区日本橋1-9-13 アメニ.en: Tabelog: Men to Mugen no Kanosei Nippombashi main shop, Amenity Bldg 1F, 1-9-13 Nippombashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; Nippombashi Station exit 7; Mon–Thu 11:00–24:00, Fri–Sun 11:00–1:00 next morning (L.O. 23:30), some days until 5 a.m. (announced on Instagram); temporary closures for typhoons; irregular closing days; no reservations; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; 26 seats; no smoking (smoking area outside); opened 10 April 2023. Reviews (November 2025 – September 2026): maze-soba of flat noodles with oil and sweet shoyu; the cheese ramen 'Chicken Fromage' ordered verbally; about a 15-minute wait; a pasta-like hybrid flavour; maze-soba ¥1,320 (extra-thick noodles, egg yolk, onion chips, leek, onion, lots of chashu); junky; black-sesame cold tantanmen; yakitori too; many overseas diners and plenty of non-ramen dishes; slow service at lunch; one likens the noodles to udon; the chicken tantanmen is mild and adjustable; open late; tori-paitan ramen with thin noodles, mild; karaage set meal.

食べログ: 麺と肉 だいつる 鶴橋店、大阪市天王寺区舟橋町18-3、鶴橋駅から徒.en: Tabelog: Men to Niku Daitsuru Tsuruhashi, 18-3 Funahashicho, Tennoji-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Tsuruhashi Station; daily 11:00–22:00; no cards, e-money or QR; 12 counter seats; opened 12 September 2016. Reviews (January 2025 – October 2026): shoyu niku soba; Korean chili; standard heat 2, 0 available; sesame-oil aroma; medium-thick to thick straight noodles; ¥1,480 with melting cartilage-chashu topping; spicy offal maze-soba (heat 3) ¥1,480 (beef offal, kimchi, vegetables); a free raw egg or large size for following on social media; spicy gochujang offal ramen with flat noodles; pork belly; karaage; extra leek; large rice ¥100 to finish; garlic and ginger on the table; write your name and wait in the queue; one says it was chosen among Osaka's popular ramen shops of 2025.
